title: Account Executive, Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Build and grow with us! Join Flexport Switzerland as a Founding Account Executive 

About the roleThis is the first Account Executive position on the ground in Switzerland, Flexport’s newest market. As part of the founding commercial team, you’ll build the territory from the ground up: shaping the go-to-market approach, establishing our first customer relationships, and defining how Flexport operates and wins in the Swiss market.

You’ll drive complex, high-value deals and build long-term strategic partnerships with medium-sized and large customers. These are multi-stakeholder sales cycles that often span regions, business units, decision layers and require the ability to translate solutions into value

You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, shaping deal strategy, influencing executive stakeholders, and orchestrating cross-functional teams to deliver differentiated, value-driven solutions.

What you’ll do

Build pipeline and dive deep into the market

  • Build a strategic pipeline through your own prospecting, account planning, and in close collaboration with our SDR team.
  • Represent Flexport at industry events, associations and networks to build the brand.
  • Share market insight and customer feedback with leadership, and help shape the Swiss sales playbook.

Win new business

  • Own the full sales cycle, from first meeting to signed contract, and meet or exceed quota.
  • Lead discovery with senior stakeholders in logistics, procurement, finance, IT, and leadership.
  • Design integrated, multi-product Flexport solutions aligned to customer priorities and backed by clear business cases.
  • Lead pricing, negotiation, and contracting, bringing in Ops, Finance, Legal, and Product as needed.
  • Keep forecasts and pipeline accurate in Salesforce.

Launch and grow customers

  • Own onboarding so new customers ramp smoothly and become our Swiss references.
  • Build long-term relationships with senior customer stakeholders and hand accounts over smoothly to Account Management.
  • Contribute to deal reviews, sales best practices, and peer coaching across the team.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of B2B sales closing complex deals with several decision-makers, with consistent quota attainment.
  • Logistics, freight forwarding or supply chain experience, combined with tech sales acumen: you can sell a platform as confidently as a freight service.
  • A deep understanding of the Swiss market and local business landscape, with the credibility to engage senior buyers from day one.
  • A self-starter who ramps fast, stays curious and does well with ambiguity and no established playbook.
  • Strong executive presence, plus value-based discovery and negotiation skills.
  • Fluent German and English; French and/or Italian are a plus.

What we offer

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being part of a thriving multinational environment.
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion-dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.
  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members.
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your family in one of the most important times in life, the birth of a child. Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Account Executive, Financial Services
descriptionHtml:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Role   We’re seeking an entrepreneurial, high-performing New Business Sales Executive to fuel our continued expansion across London & EMEA, focused on net-new logo acquisition within Financial Services (BuySide & Sell Side Institutional Investment).
This is a rare opportunity to join a hyper-growth company where you will sell a category-defining GenAI platform that is transforming how the investment world accesses and interprets information. You will play a pivotal role in shaping our regional growth trajectory and win big along the way!   Who You Are
  • Proven success selling SaaS technology to Hedge Funds, Asset Managers, and Investment Banks across the U.K., Ireland, and Europe
  • Strong track record of exceeding new-business targets in a high-volume, high-velocity B2Bsales environment
  • Expert prospector with the discipline to drive the full sales cycle—from cold outreach and discovery to demo, trial, and close
  • Natural relationship-builder who influences stakeholders across complex organizations
  • Energetic, curious, and resourceful, with a reputation for ownership, initiative, and consistent overachievement
  • Exceptional communicator with outstanding presentation and storytelling skills
  • Ability to simplify complex concepts and articulate a compelling value narrative
  • Comfortable traveling within the region as needed
What You'll Do
  •  Own the end-to-end new-business sales process in your territory, targeting hedge funds, asset managers, banks, and research teams
  • Drive net-new logo acquisition through rigorous prospecting, outreach, demos, trials, and negotiation
  • Develop and maintain a robust pipeline, forecasting with accuracy and consistency
  • Collaborate with Marketing to amplify AlphaSense's brand presence and regional market penetration
  • Partner with Product Specialists to deliver high-impact trials and exceptional client experiences
  • Surface client and market insights to Product, Content, and Marketing to enrich platform innovation and GTM strategy

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
In just over a year, we've gone from 0 to 900 customers with very little marketing spend and a sales team of three, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We're now on the hunt for someone truly brilliant to join our growing commercial team, help us deal with a flood of inbound requests, and build out a professional sales motion for the next phase of our growth.

Quick background on Spruce

Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes — there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But there's a problem: the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it really hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job, doubling their sales conversion rates, and boosting their bottom line.

Having raised a substantial Seed round last year and with strong customer demand, we're scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We're now starting to expand beyond heat pumps and ultimately want to build an operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain.

The Role

You'll be working closely with Jim, Ashley, Joe, Hector and Jo to accelerate Spruce's already very rapid growth. You'll have direct input into company strategy while seeing the immediate impact of your work in both our growth metrics and the acceleration of the UK's heat pump adoption. Your work will include:

  • Lead the full sales cycle — From handling qualified inbound demo requests to chasing prospects and closing deals with installers of all sizes. You'll be the driving force converting interest into revenue.

  • Build our sales engine — Help design, implement, and continuously refine our sales processes from the ground up. This isn't about following an existing playbook — it's about creating something exceptional for this specific space.

  • Pursue enterprise opportunities — Work directly with our founder, Jo, to land transformative deals with manufacturers, suppliers, and energy companies that can exponentially scale our impact.

  • Implement cutting-edge systems — Identify, champion, and deploy whatever tools and technologies will supercharge you/our sales function, including leveraging LLMs to create unprecedented efficiency.

Requirements

You'll have somewhere between 1 and 4 years sales experience and you'll ideally be:

  • A proven self-starter — You have a track record of taking initiative and making things happen without being told what to do (and we'd love to hear specific examples from throughout your life); you naturally take responsibility for things and are always pushing to make things around you better.

  • Highly driven — You have a hunger to succeed and aren't afraid to put in the graft to achieve your goals.

  • A natural "people person" — You build trust through authenticity rather than pushy sales tactics and instantly develop strong relationships with your prospects (and our team around you!).

  • Logically & emotionally intelligent — You excel both with analytical/numerical reasoning and have outstanding interpersonal intelligence that helps you build genuine connections.

  • A clear and concise communicator — you can explain complex concepts clearly and simply and you take pride in the quality of your written communication and have a keen eye for detail.

…and you'll hopefully also love heat pumps! 🤓

Benefits

  • 💰 Base salary £40–60k, plus 100% on-target bonus paid monthly (£80k–£120k OTE)

  • 🍰 Slice of equity (options) in the company

  • 🏖️ 33 days holiday and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year

  • 🏡 Hybrid working: 3 days a week in-person in London, with full-team meetups every fortnight (with the Bristol folk)

  • 👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme (YellowNest)

  • 🏥 Private Medical Cover

  • 🧑‍🍼 Enhanced Parental Leave

  • 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow

  • 🌍 Meaningful, impactful work that genuinely improves the world.

Working at Spruce

  • We're currently a close-knit team split between London and Bristol. We spend 2-4 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone altogether every fortnight.

  • You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

  • We want everyone to spend time with installers on-site, feel their pain points, then be able to rapidly suggest and implement solutions based on real feedback rather than assumptions.

  • We move fast and ship imperfect things, learning from users rather than trying to perfect in isolation. When things break, we focus on how we fix it, what can we learn and never blame. You'll own your outcomes whilst knowing the team has your back.

  • Feedback is constant, direct, and kind — we'll tell you when something isn't working and expect the same honesty (and empathy) back.

Compensation: £80K – £120K • Offers Equity

  • • OTE £80K – £120K • Offers Equity

title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Tracksuit exists to help marketers prove their brand building is working. We give teams the data they need to make smarter decisions, convince stakeholders, defend budgets, and track their progress. The brand tracking industry is dominated by 100-page reports, static data and big price-tags. We're doing things differently by being built for the modern marketer: always-on, accessible, and approachable.

We're now tracking more than 16,000 brands across 25 countries globally. With offices in Auckland, Sydney, London and New York City, we're scaling fast with a brilliant team of collaborative and ambitious humans. Our culture is defined by "high care, high performance". We strive to be the best and look after each other while we do it.

Are you our next Account Executive in London?

Brand matters. Most marketers know that already. The hard part is proving it to a CFO. That's where Tracksuit comes in, and it's where you come in too.

We're growing our London sales team, and we're hiring several Account Executives to start together in the new year. You'll own new business across the UK and Europe. You'll run the whole sales cycle with some of the world's most exciting consumer brands, and help shape how we win in one of our fastest-growing markets. You'll also be joining just as we reveal the next chapter of brand tracking in January 2027, so there's a lot to talk about.

What you'll do

  • Own a new business target and run the whole sales cycle, from first conversation to signed deal

  • Work leads that come in to us, meetings our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) book for you, and opportunities you create yourself, mostly with mid-sized consumer brands

  • Sell alongside our Partnerships team on deals that agencies bring us

  • Run deals that cover several UK and European markets at once

  • Run sharp, story-led demos that show each brand what its own data can do for it

  • Work with Marketing, Events and Partnerships to build pipeline, because nobody here hits their number alone

  • Be a face of Tracksuit at London events and dinners

What you'll bring

  • A record of hitting your own revenue target. You've built your own pipeline and closed deals against it. We're hiring at more than one level, so we'd love to hear from you whether you've carried a number for 2 years or 5.

  • You create your own opportunities. You don't wait for leads to come in.

  • Experience selling to mid-sized companies. Some larger enterprise deals are a bonus.

  • Drive that holds up after a "no". You stay organised and focused on your goals, and you see a lost deal as something to learn from.

  • You want to be coached. You ask for feedback and use it quickly. (Fair warning: you'll get to show us this in the interview.)

  • You like being out and about. Networking, events, and being a face of a fast-growing company.

Bonus points if you love brands, or know marketing or marketing technology.

An SDR background is welcome. This role does need someone who has already been responsible for closing deals.

Why you'll like it here

  • You'll start with a cohort. You'll join alongside other new starters, so you'll learn and ramp up together, not on your own.

  • Time together in the office. With the team in 3 to 4 days a week, you'll pick things up faster: sitting alongside people who've done it before, getting feedback in the moment, and celebrating the wins together.

  • A product with a point of view. Brand tracking has long meant 100-page reports and big price tags. We do it differently, and you'll be selling to the people who care most about brand.

  • Room to make your mark. Our London team is still small and growing fast, so your ideas will shape how we sell.

  • A team that wins together. High care, high performance. We're competitive, but we're not jerks about it.

Salary

Our pay range is fixed, so what you see is what we offer.

  • Account Executive: £61,000 to £74,000 base salary, with on-target earnings (OTE) of £122,000 to £148,000

OTE is your base salary plus commission when you hit 100% of your target. Commission depends on performance and isn't guaranteed.

The details

  • Location. London, our Clerkenwell office. We're office-first, so you'll be in with the team 3 to 4 days each week.

  • Start date. Offers by the first week of January, with hires starting from mid-January into February.

How our process works

We want to get to know more of the people who apply, not just the ones whose CV tells the whole story. So instead of shortlisting on CVs alone, we'll invite more applicants into the first stage of our process.

That first stage happens in your own time. You'll record a short video interview and complete any other quick online steps, whenever suits you over a few days. It's your chance to show us how you think and what drives you. AI tools help us review these, and a real person makes every decision.

Once we've reviewed the video interviews, shortlisted candidates get a chance to speak with our Talent team about the role and their application in more detail. Then you'll come into our office to interview with the team. We'll let you know exactly what to expect, and anything to prepare, when we invite you.

Key dates

  • From Monday 23 November: invitations to record your video interview, sent as applications come in

  • Sunday 29 November: applications close

  • Once we've reviewed the video interviews: if you're shortlisted, a chance to talk with our Talent team about the role and your application in more detail

  • Monday 14 to Wednesday 16 December: interviews in our office. That's our goal, though some interviews may take place the following week

  • By the first week of January: outcomes and offers, once we're back from the Christmas break

  • From mid-January into February: new hires start!

You'll hear from us either way.

Sound like you? Hit apply before Midnight Sunday 29 November. We’d love to hear from you.

Compensation: £61K – £85K • £61K – £85K Commission • Multiple Ranges

  • L3 • OTE £122,000 to £148,000 (50/50) £61K – £74K • £61K – £74K Commission
  • L4 • OTE £140,000 to £170,000 (50/50) £70K – £85K • £70K – £85K Commission

title: Account Executive, Mid-Market - DACH
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €10k to €300k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

    • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
    • Get In Early: The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. 
    • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

  • Winning DNA: Minimum 18 months+ closing experience in an outbound-heavy SaaS environment. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Over-achievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt
  • Native German language speakers

Advantageous:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don’t rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Damit hast du maßgeblichen Einfluss auf den Erfolg und das Wachstum unserer JobAuto Unit.

title: Account Executive - SaaS Sales
descriptionHtml:
Avetta is building the largest global community of hiring clients and suppliers that are Ready to Work. Its unified platform streamlines compliance, prequalification, safety and performance benchmarking in a single, integrated experience. Trusted by 360,000 businesses across more than 120 countries, Avetta blends AI-driven insights and human expertise to close risk gaps and strengthen supplier reliability so projects start on time, risks are managed proactively and operations scale with certainty.

SUMMARY

The Account Executive will play a key role in expanding Avetta's footprint by driving new business with mid-market and enterprise clients in the EMEA region. This role requires a consultative sales approach - listening, uncovering challenges, and crafting solutions that deliver measurable impact. The ideal candidate has a track record of closing mid to high-value SaaS deals, managing complex sales cycles, and meeting revenue targets. This includes experience working with large multinational companies, engaging complex buying committees and buyer journeys, and applying proven methodologies such as MEDDPICC -  with exposure to Challenger selling principles - to drive success. At Level I, the Account Executive operates with active guidance from sales leadership, building proficiency in Avetta's sales motion, methodology, and buyer dynamics. The Account Executive owns the primary relationship with prospective Avetta clients before and during their buyer journey. Once a prospect becomes a client, the Account Executive continues to manage and service the relationship until the account is fully established, at which point it transitions to the Account Management Team for ongoing support and expansion.

This is a hybrid role, working three days a week in our beautiful Maidenhead Office.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive new client acquisition by identifying and engaging mid-market and enterprise prospects, building relationships with key decision-makers, and developing strategies to generate business opportunities and grow Avetta's sales pipeline.
  • Oversee the full sales cycle - from prospecting and qualification through presentations, negotiations, and signed agreements - while partnering with internal teams to ensure client needs are met.
  • Apply MEDDPICC to qualify and progress opportunities, developing proficiency in the methodology with coaching from leadership.
  • Maintain a weekly emphasis on business development initiatives to ensure consistent progress.
  • Consistently work toward revenue goals while keeping a well-managed pipeline in Salesforce, and provide clear, timely forecasts and insights to leadership.
  • Partner with an assigned Sales Development Representative to execute targeted prospecting strategies.
  • Represent Avetta at industry trade shows and engage in networking activities to build relationships and promote Avetta's solutions.
  • Conduct comprehensive Avetta Overview Presentations and Product Demonstrations online.
  • Travel regularly to client sites and key accounts to facilitate in-person meetings, plus sales events, conferences, and other client-facing engagements.
  • Provide essential support to new clients during the initial launch phase and throughout the first ninety days, with a focus on maximizing revenue and ensuring client success.
  • Actively participate in weekly 1-on-1 meetings and team calls to stay aligned with Avetta's goals and strategies.
  • Attend additional trainings, meetings, and seminars as required, and adhere to other duties assigned to contribute to Avetta's success.

IDEAL EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION & TRAINING:

  • 2 - 5 years of SaaS sales experience, including exposure to both mid-market and enterprise-level SaaS sales.
  • Familiarity with a structured sales methodology such as MEDDPICC; exposure to Challenger selling a plus.
  • Experience selling safety-related products or services, working with contractors, working in procurement, or working in an industry that Avetta has current customers is considered a plus.
  • Excellent organizational skills - this role requires significant travel, meeting coordination, and RFP/RFI/RFQ response management.
  • Superior communication - exceptional interpersonal and written communication skills.
  • Strong public speaking - ability to confidently present to groups, maintain engagement, and communicate complex topics with clarity.
  • Self-motivated - able to set and pursue goals with guidance and support from sales leadership.
  • Technical understanding - able to grasp and communicate SaaS software functionality and demonstrate product capabilities to clients.
  • Ethical - embodies Avetta's core values of honesty and integrity.

OTHER DESIRED TRAITS:

  • Excellent time management, technical proficiency (CRM/Salesforce), problem-solving, attention to detail, and adaptability.

To apply for the Account Executive- Enterprise EMEA position, please submit your online application by December 4th, at 11:59 PM PST.

title: Agentic AI Senior Consultant
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Agentic AI Senior Consultant based in Netherlands.

In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor and hands-on engineering expert, helping enterprise customers design, implement, and scale advanced agentic AI solutions. You will lead the entire customer delivery lifecycle, from identifying high-value business opportunities and designing multi-agent architectures to deploying production-ready systems. Combining strong software engineering expertise, applied AI knowledge, and event-driven architecture experience, you will transform AI concepts into secure, scalable, and reliable enterprise applications. You will work closely with customer engineering teams, business stakeholders, and internal product specialists to accelerate the adoption of intelligent automation. Your responsibilities will also include establishing best practices for agent development, evaluation, monitoring, and governance while mentoring other technical professionals. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation within an international, customer-focused, and technically ambitious environment.


Accountabilities:
  • Own the technical success of enterprise customers' agentic AI initiatives, managing the complete delivery lifecycle from initial discovery and solution design through development, production deployment, ongoing operations, and advisory services.
  • Lead customer workshops to identify, assess, and prioritize high-value agentic AI use cases, translating business objectives into measurable and technically achievable workflows.
  • Design and implement sophisticated multi-agent architectures, including agent decomposition, orchestration, task delegation, tool integration, memory management, state handling, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Develop, review, and troubleshoot production-quality software using Go or Python, building agents, plugins, tools, and integrations that meet enterprise requirements.
  • Deploy and operate agentic AI applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and major cloud platforms, ensuring scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, data sources, and legacy systems through MCP servers, A2A protocols, REST APIs, and event-driven messaging architectures.
  • Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, knowledge bases, embeddings, and real-time event context strategies to improve agent accuracy and access to relevant information.
  • Apply the Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC) throughout solution delivery, covering requirements gathering, architecture design, evaluation pipelines, testing, version control, release management, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Establish robust observability, security controls, governance frameworks, and responsible AI practices for agentic systems, including tracing, quality evaluation, cost and latency monitoring, access control, and auditability.
  • Advise customers on large language model selection and optimization across providers such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, AWS Bedrock, and Azure AI Foundry, considering prompt engineering, token consumption, costs, and model performance trade-offs.
  • Act as a long-term technical advisor, identifying opportunities for further AI adoption and helping customers progress from isolated pilots to enterprise-wide, event-driven AI implementations.
  • Conduct recurring technical reviews, solution health checks, and roadmap discussions aligned with customer priorities and annual planning cycles.
  • Enable customer engineering teams to independently operate, maintain, and extend implemented solutions through technical workshops, collaborative development sessions, and comprehensive documentation.
  • Develop reusable technical assets, including reference architectures, implementation patterns, accelerators, and best practices, to improve delivery efficiency and consistency across future engagements.
  • Represent customer needs and technical feedback to internal Product and Engineering teams, contributing insights that influence product development and roadmap priorities.
  • Collaborate closely with agentic AI platform engineering teams to resolve complex customer challenges, validate new capabilities, and contribute reusable agents, plugins, and accelerators.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other professionals, helping strengthen agentic AI expertise and delivery capabilities across the Professional Services organization.
  • Communicate complex technical concepts, AI-related risks, and architectural trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Travel when required to support customer engagements, including occasional international travel.

    • Requirements:

  • At least 7 years of professional experience in professional services, technology consulting, systems integration, forward-deployed engineering, or enterprise application development.
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying LLM-based applications and agentic AI solutions, including at least one solution successfully taken into production.
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices, including version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and release management, with practical experience applying a structured Agent Development Lifecycle (ADLC).
  • Strong programming proficiency in Go or Python, with Go considered a significant advantage.
  • Practical experience designing and implementing multi-agent systems, including task delegation, orchestration, coordination, and autonomous decision-making.
  • Familiarity with agent development frameworks such as Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with agent interoperability and tool integration, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols, and designing APIs for agent-based applications.
  • Solid understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and context management techniques.
  • Experience implementing evaluation frameworks, observability solutions, and security guardrails for enterprise LLM applications.
  • Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures, asynchronous messaging, distributed systems, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Hands-on experience deploying distributed applications on cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Understanding of enterprise security and identity management practices relevant to AI systems, including OAuth 2.0, role-based access control (RBAC), secrets management, and data privacy.
  • Ability to independently lead customer engagements, make sound technical decisions, and manage complex projects with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience facilitating technical workshops and presenting recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Professional fluency in English and either Spanish or Italian, both written and spoken.
  • Experience working with agentic AI platforms or enterprise messaging technologies is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with Solace Agent Mesh or similar agentic AI platforms is a plus.
  • Proficiency in both Go and Python is an additional advantage.
  • Experience with messaging technologies such as Solace, Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, IBM MQ, or TIBCO is beneficial.
  • Working knowledge of LLM platforms and services, including Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini/Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, or Azure AI Foundry, is desirable.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps or MLOps practices, including prompt and model versioning, evaluation frameworks, and production monitoring, is a plus.
  • Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI frameworks, and regulatory requirements in industries such as financial services, healthcare, or the public sector is advantageous.
  • Experience using AI-assisted and agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, including the ability to demonstrate and share these practices with others.
  • Familiarity with MQTT, AMQP, REST APIs, and enterprise integration architectures is beneficial.
  • Relevant certifications, such as AWS Certified Machine Learning or Generative AI, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, are considered an advantage.
  • Previous experience creating technical workshops, reference architectures, blogs, presentations, or demonstrations focused on agentic AI is a plus.

    • Benefits:

title: AI Researcher - Full time
descriptionHtml:
TLDR; Davis is hiring an AI Researcher to push the frontier of floorplan generation. Working directly with architects, you'll own research directions end-to-end, from diffusion and flow matching models (continuous and discrete) to deployment in a product used by real estate professionals.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate 4-5 fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they'll need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

Our Mission

We build a foundation model for architectural design that generates compliant, editable building layouts from scratch. By leveraging discrete diffusion models (operating on structured representations rather than pixels), we aim to produce floorplans and site plans that respect real-world constraints (zoning laws, space requirements, etc.) and can be iteratively refined like a human-designed plan.

The Role

We are looking for a AI Researcher to lead this effort in our Paris office. If you’re excited about improving our current state-of-the-art floorplan generative model and applying it to a high-impact domain, this role offers a unique opportunity to define a new class of AI-driven design tools. You will work within a focused team of 3–4 engineers and researchers, collaborating daily with architects to turn foundational research into deployable tools.

What you'll own:

  • Model Architecture & Design Space: Design the core model architecture and work on a discrete design space for architectural layouts. You will choose how to represent floorplans (e.g. as graphs of rooms/connections or token grids) such that the diffusion model’s outputs are editable and code-compliant by construction. This involves ensuring the model can enforce architectural rules (e.g. room sizes, adjacency constraints) within its generation process.

  • Large-Scale Model Training: Lead the training of a foundation diffusion model from scratch on GPU clusters. You’ll set up distributed training across multiple nodes, optimize data loading and checkpointing, and manage experiments at scale. The role requires hands-on engineering for efficient training of large models on high-performance computing infrastructure.

  • Benchmarking & Iteration: Evaluate the model’s performance and establish benchmarks to measure success. Using these evaluations, you’ll iterate on the model to push performance beyond existing methods. Our goal is to surpass the latest research results and produce genuinely useful architectural designs.

What We’re Looking For

  • Applied Research Excellence: PhD or Master’s in Maths, Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Strong foundations in ML and a track record of innovative research, publications, or high-impact projects.

  • Diffusion Model Expertise: Deep understanding of diffusion models (discrete or continuous), guided generation techniques, and the latest advances in generative modeling.

  • Large-Scale Model Training: Proven experience training large-scale deep learning models on GPU clusters. Comfortable with distributed training, multi-node jobs, experiment management, and handling large datasets.

  • Technical Engineering Skills: Proficiency in Python with experience in PyTorch or similar frameworks. Ability to write efficient, maintainable code and optimize training pipelines. Familiarity with distributed training libraries (e.g., PyTorch Lightning) is a plus.

  • Research Literacy: Ability to read, evaluate, and implement advanced ML research. You stay current with state-of-the-art generative modeling work and can adapt cutting-edge methods to domain-specific problems.

  • Collaboration & Communication: Strong teamwork skills. Able to articulate complex concepts clearly and work closely with AI engineers, researchers, and domain experts to integrate technical solutions into the architectural design workflow.

Nice to Have

  • Industry Experience: Background in a top AI research organization or cutting-edge startup, especially working on foundation models or generative AI tools.

  • Publications/Open Source: Research publications in generative modeling (diffusion, VAEs, flows, GANs) or significant open-source contributions demonstrating ability to push state-of-the-art systems.

  • Domain Knowledge: While not required, an interest in architecture or design will help.

  • Reinforcement Learning & Optimization: Experience with RL, reward modeling, or constrained optimization (particularly MCTS, GRPO and RLHF) relevant to guiding generative models under complex constraints.

  • Multimodal Generation: Experience with graph-based, sequence-based, or discrete structured generative models (e.g., molecule generation, layout generation, program synthesis) or with graph neural networks.

Why Join Us

You're joining a team of 12 at the very beginning - where every decision you make shapes the product, the culture, and the trajectory of the company. What you build here will be yours.

  • Build what no one has before: the foundation model that automates architectural design and redefines how cities are imagined, designed, and built.

  • Work on meaningful challenges: from constraint-aware generative models to real-world deployment in major construction projects.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity in an early-stage company.

  • Ship fast, iterate boldly: go from research to prototype to production in weeks, not years.

  • Join a world-class team: a mix of AI researchers, engineers, and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we’re going after:

Team

Mehdi (CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Yet

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability; parametric tools only check constraints after generation, leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. As a result, floorplans may “look” plausible but break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they're usable.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenAgents is our platform for building and running conversational AI agents at scale. As our first Application Security Engineer embedded in the Agents team, you’ll make the secure way the easy way. You’ll build the security tooling and reusable primitives that let engineers ship securely by default.

This is a builder role. Expect to spend about 70% of your time building tools and internal systems, and the rest working with engineers, staying in sync with Core Security, and doing security research. More than half of the work is greenfield and most of it starts with you, you’ll spot the problems worth solving and own each solution from idea to production.

You will:

  • Build security primitives that are easy for engineers to adopt, starting from what you find when you audit the Agents codebase

  • Review new product work for security and feed what you learn back into shared tooling

  • Lead the major security improvements to the Agents platform, working closely with Core Security

  • Make sure Agents platform uses authn and authz controls correctly and building the guardrails that keep the platform from compromising on security best practices

  • Set the security bar for the Agents platform and make meeting it the easy path for product engineers

  • Work with engineers daily to help them ship fast and safely

Requirements

  • 5+ years in application security engineering at scale, covering secure design, vulnerability management and security tooling

  • Strong software engineering skills: you have built and shipped products end to end, in production-quality code

  • Fluency in Python, our main language. Golang or another language is fine if you can pick up Python quickly

  • Hands-on experience with authentication and authorization. Experience securing cross-service communication is a bonus

  • Experience with large-scale, customer-facing backend systems and enterprise-grade security

  • Clear communication and a real enjoyment of working with developers

  • A track record of owning delivery end to end

Bonus:

  • Security for AI and LLM applications

  • Cloud-native experience (AWS or GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, IAM, networking, Linux internals)

  • Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI, HIPAA)

  • Not required: Compliance certifications, incident response experience, a traditional security background, or prior domain knowledge. We care about what you have built and shipped, and open source work or conference talks are welcome evidence of that.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. However, to facilitate working with the Security Team, we prefer candidates based in GMT to GMT+3 or UK. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Dublin, London or Warsaw

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Partners Solutions Architect on Anthropic's Applied AI team, you'll be a pre-sales architect focused on building technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs) and cloud partners (AWS and GCP). You'll strengthen these relationships to accelerate indirect revenue, enable partners' AI practices, and execute our long-term go-to-market strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Strategic technical partnership: Act as a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team. Bring technical expertise to help us understand the partner landscape, drive key strategic programs, and find ways to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, and evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities. You'll also serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.

  • Joint solution development: Work with partners to identify high-value, industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions, and codify reference architectures and best practices that speed time to deployment.

  • Customer deal support: Step in to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.

  • Partner ecosystem and events: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, AWS summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.

  • Product feedback: Gather and validate feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns. Deliver it to the relevant Anthropic teams to inform the product roadmap and partner strategy.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 5+ years in technical customer-facing or partner-facing roles, such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager

  • A track record of partnering successfully with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery

  • Exceptional ability to build relationships and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, including C-suite executives and engineering and IT teams

  • Strong presentation and technical communication skills, with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders

  • Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems

  • Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools, or a background in machine learning or data science

  • Enthusiasm for cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities

  • A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed

  • A passion for using technology in ways that are safe and beneficial, and that advance the goal of safe AI systems

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:£150,000—£190,000 GBP

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Architecte Logiciel et Système d'Information
descriptionHtml:
Nous recherchons un(e) Architecte Logiciel et Système d'Information pour rejoindre nos équipes à Toulouse.
Vous contribuerez à définir et faire évoluer l’architecture de notre système d’information et de nos produits digitaux : plateforme immobilière, application mobile, sites Internet, APIs, services et outils internes.
Vous ferez le lien entre vision d'architecture et réalité du terrain. Vous contribuerez aux décisions structurantes du SI tout en restant proche des développeurs et des problématiques concrètes de conception, de réalisation et d'exploitation.

Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec les développeurs, Product Owners, SRE, QA, équipes Infrastructure et Sécurité. Le poste combine une vision transverse du SI avec une forte proximité avec les équipes techniques.

Vos missions

  • Concevoir et faire évoluer l’architecture de nos applications, services et produits numériques en cohérence avec les besoins métiers et la trajectoire du SI.
  • Accompagner les équipes de développement dans leurs choix de conception, questionner les solutions proposées et garantir la cohérence entre les différents composants.
  • Faire évoluer l’existant en identifiant les possibilités de simplification, de modernisation et de restructuration, avec une approche pragmatique de la dette technique.
  • Intégrer les exigences non fonctionnelles dès la conception : performance, disponibilité, résilience, capacité à monter en charge, maintenabilité et sécurité.
  • Participer aux choix de technologies, frameworks, patterns et solutions techniques.
  • Faire progresser les pratiques d’architecture en contribuant aux choix technologiques et en définissant des principes, règles et méthodes de documentation partagés.
  • Travailler avec les équipes SRE, Infrastructure et Sécurité sur les problématiques Cloud, infrastructure, observabilité et sécurité.
  • Travailler sur les enjeux transverses du SI avec les équipes infrastructure, sécurité et qualité : cloud, conteneurisation, observabilité, sécurité et évolutions technologiques, notamment autour de l’IA.

Vos compétences

  • Vous avez une solide expérience en développement logiciel et avez progressivement élargi votre champ d'intervention vers des problématiques de conception et d’architecture.
  • Vous savez concevoir et faire évoluer des applications en ligne, des systèmes distribués et des APIs, dans un contexte cloud et conteneurisation.
  • Vous savez adapter les méthodes d'échange entre applications et les modes d'intégration en fonction des contraintes de l'existant.
  • Vous prenez en compte les problématiques de sécurité applicative, de performance, de disponibilité et de montée en charge dès la conception.
  • Vous savez analyser un système existant et proposer une trajectoire d’évolution réaliste, en arbitrant entre qualité architecturale, complexité, dette technique, coûts et contraintes opérationnelles.
  • Vous documentez et expliquez vos décisions, y compris auprès d’interlocuteurs ayant des niveaux de technicité différents.
  • Vous aimez transmettre, questionner les choix et accompagner les équipes sans imposer une architecture déconnectée de leurs contraintes. Vous êtes capable de prendre de la hauteur tout en conservant une vraie proximité avec le code et les problématiques d’ingénierie.

Compétences recherchées

Appréciées :

  • Expérience avec Kubernetes et AWS.
  • Expérience des architectures orientées événements et des systèmes asynchrones.
  • Connaissance des problématiques d’observabilité, de fiabilité des systèmes et plus globalement SRE.
  • Formalisation des décisions d'architecture (par ex : ADR) et de la modélisation (par ex : C4).
  • Expérience de modernisation d’applications ou de SI existants.
  • Utilisation d’IA appliquée au développement, à la documentation ou à la conception d’architecture.

title: Broker Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Brokers bring in nearly all of Flock’s business, so they’re central to how we grow. As a Broker Development Manager, you’ll look after a panel of key broker partners with real growth potential, deepen the relationships we already have and build new ones as we move into new sectors. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution.

You’ll show brokers what our connected fleet proposition does for their clients: it cuts risk and cost and keeps drivers safer. We’re AI-first, so you’ll use AI every day to research brokers, prepare for meetings and spot opportunities across your panel, leaving more time for the conversations that win business.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Be the main face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners and grow the business you do together.

  • Drive a high volume of quality submissions from your panel.

  • Grow the panel, onboarding new brokers quickly and getting them trading.

  • Find new ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

  • Build data-led growth plans for each account and follow them through.

  • Support day-to-day trading so brokers win and keep business with Flock, keeping conversion and retention high.

  • Work with underwriting, product and other teams across Flock towards shared growth goals.

  • Use AI daily for broker research, meeting prep and pipeline analysis.

 

What you’ll need

  • At least five years managing broker relationships in insurance, with a strong reputation in the market.

  • An existing network of broker contacts you can bring to Flock from day one.

  • A strong understanding of the commercial broker market, competing carriers and how broker businesses work.

  • A track record of beating revenue targets and working well with teams across a business.

  • A consultative sales approach that matches Flock’s proposition to what each broker needs.

  • Pace and energy: you move fast, spot opportunities and solve problems.

  • Comfortable using AI at work and curious about where else it could help you win business.

Nice to have: experience building broker networks in Commercial Motor Fleet, an active broker panel in commercial insurance, or a record of taking new technology or products to brokers.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

This role is expected to be field based rather than office based, working with brokers across Leeds and the surrounding region, so visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days. As long as you’re meeting brokers consistently each week, time at our Central London office, a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street, can be weekly or monthly.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

descriptionHtml:
We’re hiring an associate to build and run their own book of investors who back startups directly, and to introduce those investors to the founders we work with.

About Pairs
Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout US founders, from seed to Series B, in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who know their market and can open the doors they need. We work only with the top 1% of deals, vet every founder and investor before they join, and invest our own money alongside our investors in a few of the companies we believe in most.

The role
You grow the investor side of Pairs. Your book is made of the investors you bring with you and the ones you open here, you keep those relationships warm, and you book the meetings between our founders and the investors who fit them. Family offices and private wealth are the investors we most want more of, so a network that reaches them matters a lot, but VCs are also still a big part of what we do. Pairs has made more than 3,500 investor introductions for founders since we started. You decide which founders an investor in your book hears about, since you are the one who has read the deal and knows the investor. Software and AI run the admin, so the role isn’t technical and your time goes to investors.

What you will own
• Your book of 70 to 150 investor relationships, each one qualified and kept warm.
• First conversations every week with investors who are new to Pairs.
• The meetings between our founders and your investors.
• Support for our senior team on live deals, which means qualifying investors and writing briefing notes before a meeting and following up after it.

You are a fit if you
• Have built your own network of investors who back US startups, ideally with family offices and private wealth in it.

• Have spent at least a year in venture or in another role where you spoke to investors yourself.
• Can explain a repeatable method for finding investors who fit and earning a first conversation, and how you stay useful to them afterwards.
• Communicate clearly and with confidence, on calls and in writing.

Location and working style
Fully remote and async. Your day overlaps with US Eastern time. The team works across London, New York, Dubai and San Francisco. You get the best AI tools, paid for, a senior team that coaches you every week, live deal flow from your first week and a path to running your own side of the network.

title: Category Management Werkstudent (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
