Als Online-Supermarkt ist das Herzstück unseres Businesses natürlich die Picnic App. Das Category Management Team sorgt dafür, dass unsere digitalen Regale in allen 6 Regionen perfekt mit lokalen Produkten ausgestattet sind.

Als WerkstudentIn bist du das operative Rückgrat unseres Teams. Mit logischem Denken und smarten Automatisierungstools machst du unsere Prozesse jeden Tag ein Stückchen besser. Du arbeitest eng mit Category, Brand und cross-funktionalen Teams zusammen, um Lieferengpässe zu lösen, Daten zu checken und dafür zu sorgen, dass unsere App für die KundInnen immer perfekt gepflegt ist.

Das erwartet dich

  • Artikelerstellung & Onboarding: Du übernimmst die Anlage und Erstellung neuer Produkte im System und stellst sicher, dass alle notwendigen Informationen vom ersten Tag an korrekt und für unsere KundInnen bereit sind.
  • Tool-Support & Validierung: Du begleitest die Einführung und Nutzung unseres neuen Automatisierungstools. Als wichtige Instanz für die Qualitätskontrolle hinterfragst du Prozesse kritisch und stellst sicher, dass die Systemausgaben korrekt sind. 
  • Produkt-Performance-Monitoring: Du behältst Verkaufs- und Bestandsanomalien genau im Auge. Wenn ein Top-Priority-Artikel sich nicht verkauft oder als nicht verfügbar angezeigt wird, tauchst du ins System ein, um die Ursache zu finden, damit unsere digitalen Regale immer den maximalen Umsatz erzielen.
  • Content- & Storefront-Optimierung: Wenn unvollständige Produktpräsentationen den Verkauf hemmen, reagierst du schnell und taktisch – z. B. durch das schnelle Beheben von fehlenden Produktfotos oder unvollständigen Artikelinfos in der App.
  • Lieferkette & Inbound-Abstimmung: Du unterstützt das Team bei täglichen kommerziellen Fragen zur Lieferkette und klärst Probleme bei der Produktanlieferung, um einen reibungslosen Ablauf in deinen Kategorien zu garantieren.
  • Teamarbeit: Du bietest starke operative Unterstützung über verschiedene Prioritätsstufen hinweg und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit dem gesamten Category-Team, um die täglichen Aufgaben optimal zu balancieren.

Das bringst du mit

  • Fortgeschrittenes Bachelorstudium oder aktuell im Master in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, E-Commerce, Supply Chain Management, Volkswirtschaftslehre oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.

  • Exzellente organisatorische Fähigkeiten, eine proaktive Einstellung zur Übernahme von Verantwortung und Routine im Umgang mit täglichen Arbeitsabläufen.
  • Eine echte Affinität für die Lebensmittelbranche und Begeisterung für die Arbeit mit neuer Software Systemen.
  • Zeit, unser Team für 16 - 20 Stunden pro Woche zu unterstützen.
  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Starte mit uns durch: Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.
  • Verpflegung: Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück und Mittagessen in unserem Büro, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.
  • Unvergessliche Momente: Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.
  • Ein moderner Workspace: Unser neu renoviertes Büro ist auf Zusammenarbeit ausgelegt und bietet dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie 30 Urlaubstage (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche).

descriptionHtml:
STAGE – CHARGÉ(E) DE COMMUNICATION & MARKETING

Fondation ICAPE Planète Bleue

Durée : 4 à 6 mois

Localisation : Fontenay-aux-Roses (92)
Début : Septembre / Octobre 2026

Qui sommes-nous ?

ICAPE Group est un groupe international spécialisé dans la distribution de circuits imprimés (PCB) et de pièces techniques sur mesure destinés à l’industrie électronique.

Présent à l’international, le Groupe accompagne ses clients dans de nombreux secteurs industriels et s’appuie sur des équipes réparties dans le monde entier.

Au-delà de son activité, ICAPE Group souhaite également agir concrètement en faveur de projets environnementaux et solidaires. C’est dans cette démarche qu’a été créée la Fondation ICAPE Planète Bleue.

La Fondation ICAPE Planète Bleue

La Fondation ICAPE Planète Bleue porte et soutient des initiatives à impact environnemental, social et solidaire.

À travers ses propres projets et le soutien apporté à des associations, elle souhaite contribuer concrètement à des causes liées notamment à la préservation des océans et de l’environnement, la solidarité, l’inclusion et l’accès à des expériences porteuses de sens pour des publics fragilisés.

Parmi ses projets emblématiques figure notamment Cap Magie Bleue, une association créée autour de la goélette Magie Bleue. Après plusieurs années de rénovation, ce bateau historique reprend la mer avec une nouvelle vocation : devenir un outil au service de la solidarité, de la sensibilisation à l’environnement et du monde associatif.

Votre mission

Dans le cadre du développement des activités de la Fondation, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire en Communication & Marketing pour nous aider à faire connaître ses actions, valoriser les projets soutenus et développer l’engagement autour de ses initiatives.

Vous travaillerez sur des sujets très concrets, au contact des équipes, associations et partenaires, avec une vraie dimension communication, création de contenus et terrain.

Vos missions

Communication & création de contenus

  • Participer à la construction et au suivi du calendrier éditorial de la Fondation ;
  • Rédiger des contenus pour différents supports : réseaux sociaux, actualités, newsletters, site internet, présentations et supports de communication ;
  • Mettre en valeur les projets soutenus, les associations partenaires et leurs bénéficiaires ;
  • Recueillir témoignages, photos, vidéos, chiffres clés et informations sur les actions réalisées ;
  • Imaginer de nouveaux formats : interviews, portraits, vidéos courtes, infographies, témoignages, reportages terrain ;
  • Participer à la création et à l’adaptation de supports visuels et éditoriaux.

Communication digitale & réseaux sociaux

  • Participer à l’animation des réseaux sociaux et des différents canaux de communication ;
  • Contribuer à la mise à jour des contenus web ;
  • Proposer de nouveaux sujets et formats pour développer la visibilité de la Fondation ;
  • Participer au développement de la notoriété des différents projets ;
  • Suivre les performances des communications et identifier les contenus les plus engageants.

Événementiel & projets terrain

  • Participer à l’organisation des événements et opérations portés ou soutenus par la Fondation ;
  • Préparer les supports de communication, invitations et contenus associés ;
  • Participer à la communication avant, pendant et après les événements ;
  • Contribuer à la couverture des événements : photos, vidéos, interviews, contenus pour les réseaux sociaux ;
  • Participer aux initiatives permettant d’impliquer les collaborateurs, partenaires et associations autour des projets de la Fondation.

Valorisation des projets & de leur impact

  • Participer au suivi et à la valorisation des projets soutenus ;
  • Collecter et structurer les principaux chiffres et résultats ;
  • Créer des présentations, bilans et contenus permettant de montrer concrètement l’impact des actions ;
  • Réaliser une veille sur les initiatives et bonnes pratiques en matière de mécénat, d’engagement, d’environnement et de communication des fondations d’entreprise.

Profil recherché

Vous êtes étudiant(e) en Bac+2 (BTS), Bac+3 à Bac+5, en école de communication, marketing, commerce ou formation équivalente.

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne :

  • Créative, curieuse et force de proposition ;
  • Avec une très bonne capacité rédactionnelle ;
  • À l’aise avec les réseaux sociaux et la création de contenus ;
  • Organisée, autonome et polyvalente ;
  • Capable de travailler sur plusieurs projets simultanément et de gérer les priorités, y compris lorsque les délais sont courts ;
  • À l’écoute des équipes de la Fondation et de l’Association, capable de prendre en compte leurs retours et leurs demandes et de les traduire concrètement en actions de communication ;
  • À l’aise avec des interlocuteurs variés : collaborateurs, associations, partenaires et prestataires ;
  • Qui apprécie autant réfléchir à une idée que la mettre concrètement en œuvre.
  • Une sensibilité aux sujets liés à l’environnement, aux océans, à la solidarité, à l’inclusion, au monde associatif ou au mécénat sera particulièrement appréciée.
  • La maîtrise de Canva et/ou d’outils de création de contenus photo/vidéo est un plus.
  • Un bon niveau d’anglais serait également apprécié.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Ce stage offre l’opportunité de travailler sur des projets très variés et surtout concrets, avec une forte dimension humaine et terrain.

Vous pourrez participer à un projet de A à Z : imaginer une communication, rencontrer les acteurs concernés, créer les contenus, participer à l’événement ou à l’action puis en valoriser les résultats.

Vous rejoindrez un environnement international tout en travaillant sur des projets locaux et associatifs, avec une réelle liberté pour proposer de nouvelles idées, tester de nouveaux formats et contribuer au développement de la visibilité de la Fondation.

Nous recherchons une personne qui ait envie de faire, proposer, créer et raconter des projets qui ont du sens.

title: Chief Engineer, Air
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

UFORCE is looking for a Chief Engineer, Air to lead the engineering of our Western-facing air platforms and turn operational lessons from Ukraine into reliable, manufacturable products that global customers can test, deploy and reorder.

You’ll own the technical baseline across the air portfolio, initially focusing on Platform N and expanding to other platforms sold outside Ukraine. You’ll work closely with Ukrainian engineering teams to understand the wider Nemesis pipeline, translate field experience into product improvements and build a consistent view of configurations and engineering evidence across the portfolio.

This is a hands-on senior technical leadership role. You’ll stay close to the hardware and the field, build a small engineering team, and bring engineering, manufacturing, supply chain and commercial partners together to deliver products at pace without compromising technical rigor.

The role is based in the UK and involves regular travel to engineering teams, manufacturing sites, test ranges and customers. Reporting arrangements and travel expectations will be confirmed during the hiring process.

What you’ll do

  • Own the air portfolio’s technical baseline. Establish controlled requirements, configurations, bills of materials and test evidence, starting with Platform N and extending across Western and Ukrainian air platforms. Put clear ownership and practical change control in place.

  • Lead end-to-end systems engineering. Make and coordinate technical decisions across airframe, propulsion, power, avionics, flight control, communications, navigation, payload interfaces, software interfaces and ground systems, bringing in specialists where needed.

  • Improve reliability and performance. Establish a disciplined failure-reporting and corrective-action process, investigate priority field and test issues, and demonstrate improvements against agreed requirements through repeatable testing.

  • Turn operational lessons into product improvements. Work with Ukrainian engineering and field teams to understand what has worked, capture operator feedback and agree a prioritised design-change roadmap for Western variants.

  • Build for repeatable production. Lead design-for-manufacture reviews and partner with manufacturing teams to release production-ready engineering packages for US and allied sites.

  • Strengthen the supply chain and cost position. Work with supply-chain and compliance partners to assess component sourcing, qualification, capacity and critical supplier risks. Develop a unit-cost roadmap and evaluate where components and systems should be built across UFORCE locations.

  • Support go-to-market and customer delivery. Partner with Sales and Business Development on customer requirements, priority markets, product positioning and business cases. Provide technical input on configurations, capability claims, pricing, delivery and support assumptions.

  • Prepare for trials and launch. Establish technical readiness gates covering demonstrations, compliance evidence, production readiness and handover to field support. Communicate product capabilities and limitations honestly to customers and test authorities.

  • Set the direction and build the team. Work with founders, Ukrainian colleagues and global leadership to develop the air product roadmap. Hire and develop engineers, establish clear ownership and build the practices needed as the function grows.

Required Skill

  • Experience leading the design and development of a complete UAS, with personal ownership of system-level technical decisions and demonstrated flight or field outcomes.

  • Strong systems engineering judgement across airframe, propulsion, power, avionics, flight control, communications, navigation and software interfaces.

  • Experience taking an aerial or comparable electromechanical product from prototype into repeatable production, including design for manufacture, configuration control and production testing.

  • A track record of investigating field failures, identifying root causes and measurably improving reliability through verified corrective actions.

  • Practical experience with applicable NDAA / Blue UAS sourcing requirements, restricted components and export-control considerations, including qualification or re-sourcing decisions.

  • Understanding of how contested operating conditions, including GNSS denial, jamming and communications resilience, influence product requirements and testing.

  • Experience supporting customer trials, competitions or tenders and communicating technical capabilities, limitations and risks to customers or test authorities.

  • Experience hiring or developing engineers and leading multidisciplinary teams across organisational and geographic boundaries.

  • Sound judgement on cost, performance, production readiness and supplier trade-offs, with the ability to make decisions in an evolving startup environment.

  • A hands-on approach, clear communication and the ability to balance speed with appropriate engineering discipline.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to engineering teams, manufacturing sites, test ranges and customers.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience working with Ukrainian UAS teams, products or operators.

  • Experience with military or Ministry of Defence contracts.

  • Experience with military or civil airworthiness, qualification or certification.

  • Experience with payload integration or payload-release systems.

  • Experience coordinating engineering and manufacturing across multiple countries.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

Are You?

title: Chief Of Staff
descriptionHtml:
Hozah is scaling fast, and the CEO's time has become the bottleneck. We're looking for a Chief of Staff to multiply it: someone who works across every department, uses AI and clear structured thinking to find what is slowing the business down, and fixes it.

Above all, you get things over the line. In a growing business, good initiatives stall between departments, wait on decisions nobody owns and quietly lose momentum. You'll pick them up, clear the blockers, chase the decisions and drive each one to a finished, measured result, with urgency and without waiting to be asked.

This is not an executive assistant role and not a strategy-deck role. You'll own a portfolio of cross-functional initiatives and the leadership operating rhythm, and your influence will come from results and relationships, not borrowed authority.

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of cross-functional initiatives the CEO would otherwise drive personally, from diagnosis through to a finished, measured result.

  • Own the problems that sit between departments: find what is slowing the business down, size it in numbers and get it fixed with the team that owns it.

  • Own the leadership operating rhythm: the board pack, SLT agenda, KPI and OKR tracking, and the decision and action log.

  • Own the follow-through on strategic initiatives, tracking them to completion and raising slippage early with a recovery plan.

  • Own practical AI adoption across the business, building the shared workflows, tools and templates that remove manual work, and helping teams use them well.

  • Own the judgement calls the CEO shouldn't have to make: what you decide, what goes to the CEO and what gets dropped, with board, investor and people-sensitive information handled discreetly.

Who we're looking for

  • You've personally delivered cross-functional improvements end to end in the last two to three years, and can show the before and after in numbers, including at least one in a function you didn't run.

  • You build with AI and data, not just use them. Show us something you made yourself: a Claude or GPT workflow, a script, a SQL query, a model or an automation. Tell us what it replaced and how you checked it.

  • You take an ambiguous problem, break it down, question the data and come back with a recommendation, not a list of observations.

  • You've got senior people to change how their teams work without managing them, and stayed on good terms.

  • You've run or improved an executive cadence (board packs, leadership meetings, KPI or OKR tracking) and you make sure actions actually close.

  • You know what to decide, what to escalate and what to drop, and you handle confidential information carefully.

  • You read a P&L, unit economics and an operational dashboard without help, and you talk in numbers.

  • You'll take on the unglamorous work, challenge with evidence and give the credit to the team that owns the result.

  • You tell it straight, including what didn't work.

What We Offer

  • A newly created role with direct access to the CEO and regular exposure to the Board.

  • Real breadth: you'll work across every department of a fast-scaling tech business.

  • The chance to shape how a whole company uses AI.

  • Hybrid working: three days in our office next to East Croydon Station, two from home (and friendly office dogs).

title: Composite Technician - Airframe
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

As the composite technician on the Airframe team, your core mission is to prototype carbon structures fast, in-house — from mould to finished, quality-checked part — and to bring innovative solutions that make assembly and prototyping easier. A true hands-on professional, you combine technical skills, initiative, and a maker mindset. You build tooling, lay up and finish composite parts (carbon / glass fibre), and turn the engineers' CAD into flight-worthy structures on short cycles. You are also the owner of technical drawings and supplier quotations for the parts you handle, and the one who trains production operators when a design moves to series. You thrive with minimal supervision, favour pragmatic, quick-result approaches over perfect-but-slow tooling, and are equally comfortable laying up a part, machining or printing a mould, and reading a technical drawing.

Technical skills

Key responsibilities

Rapid in-house prototyping (core)

  • Produce carbon prototype structures quickly in-house, choosing the fastest viable route rather than heavy tooling when a proto is the goal.

  • Propose innovative, simple solutions to speed up assembly and prototyping.

  • Design certain parts and prototyping tools yourself (fixtures, adapters, simple structural parts) when it is faster than going through the design loop.

  • Iterate fast with the design engineers: short loops between concept, part and feedback, flagging manufacturability issues before they cost a mould.

Tooling & moulds

  • Build and maintain moulds and tooling, in coordination with the design team; machine or 3D-print mould masters, prepare and polish mould surfaces.

  • Design and build layup jigs, trimming templates, bonding and assembly fixtures.

  • Manage the composite workshop consumables and material inventory (fabrics, resins, cores, vacuum consumables) including storage and shelf-life follow-up.

Design & documentation

  • Read and interpret 2D/3D drawings and ply books; model simple parts and tooling in CAD when needed; give manufacturability feedback early.

  • Own the technical drawings: produce and keep up to date the manufacturing drawings for the parts and tooling you handle.

  • Write and maintain clear, accessible fabrication procedures, ply books and cure logs on Confluence so processes are repeatable by others.

  • Optimise part designs for their manufacturing process: adapt geometries for plastic injection (wall thickness, draft angles, ribs) or for composite / 3D-printed fabrication (layup feasibility, demoulding, printability), in collaboration with the design engineers.

Support & improvement

  • Support assembly and mechanical testing, including preparing test coupons and samples for structural analysis.

  • Identify and propose process and quality improvements; help run the composite workshop safely (dust extraction, PPE, resin handling and waste management).

  • Own the knowledge transfer to production: train the production operators on fabrication and assembly processes, and validate that a process is repeatable by others before handover.

Candidate profile

  • Technical diploma or degree in composite materials, mechanical / aerospace manufacturing, industrial technology, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Proven experience in rapid in-house composite prototyping (carbon / glass fibre): hand layup, vacuum bagging, infusion and/or prepreg; mould making and surface preparation a strong plus.

  • Track record of quick, pragmatic solutions — getting a functional carbon part out fast, with sound trade-offs, rather than perfect parts requiring heavy tooling.

  • Ability to read technical drawings and ply books, and to control layup orientation, resin ratios, debulking and cure cycles with rigour and traceability.

  • Ability to produce manufacturing drawings (2D plans)

  • Understanding of design-for-manufacturing basics for plastic injection (wall thickness, draft angles) and composite / 3D-printed parts, to optimise geometries with the design engineers.

  • Hands-on finishing skills: trimming, sanding, drilling composites, structural bonding, insert fitting, and basic defect detection (porosity, delamination).

  • Proficiency with common fabrication tools (hand tools, bench equipment, 3D printer; basic machining appreciated); CAD literacy (Fusion 360, SolidWorks, FreeCAD or similar) to adapt tooling and jigs.

  • Highly autonomous — able to take ownership of tasks and drive them to completion with minimal supervision; resourceful and solution-oriented, comfortable improvising with available means.

  • Pedagogy and communication: able to write clear, accessible procedures and to train production operators so processes remain repeatable without you; rigorous on process, safety and documentation.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Curriculum Manager - AI Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About DataCamp

Data and AI skills are critical for thriving today, and DataCamp is the platform that empowers everyone to learn them. We help individuals and Fortune 1000 companies close the data and AI skills gap through world-class learning, hands-on training, and a global community of expert instructors.

In this role, you’ll combine AI skills, technical expertise, and passion for great didactic experiences to usher in the next generation of education. 

About the role

This is an individual contributor role. You will collaborate with subject matter experts and leverage in-house-built cutting-edge AI tooling to scale high-quality course creation across AI engineering: building applications with large language models (LLMs), prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and related topics such as evaluation, fine-tuning, guardrails, and LLMOps. Here's what your day-to-day will look like:

  • Manage the entire content development lifecycle and deadlines.
  • Source and recruit top-tier subject-matter experts as instructors.
  • Collaborate with instructors to create engaging content.
  • Consistently leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and more to drive high-quality content production at scale.
  • Design, review, and create content on LLM application development, prompt and context engineering, RAG and vector databases, agents and tool use, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring of AI systems, and related topics. You will review content from a learner perspective, ensuring it is technically accurate, reflects current AI engineering best practices in a fast-moving field, and is pedagogically effective.
  • Continuously assess course performance using learner feedback and engagement data to drive improvements.
  • Identify and prioritize existing curriculum gaps or new topics in DataCamp's AI engineering curriculum.

We’re excited about you because you have the following:

  • A solid hands-on background building and shipping production AI applications as an AI engineer, machine learning engineer, or software engineer. Experience taking LLM-powered systems from prototype to production (e.g. evaluation, monitoring, cost and latency optimization) is a strong plus.
  • Broad AI engineering fluency spanning LLM fundamentals, prompt and context engineering, RAG, agents, and evaluation, with additional depth in at least one area such as agentic systems, retrieval and search, fine-tuning, or LLMOps.
  • A solid technical background in Python, with comfort working with LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic), open-source models and frameworks (e.g. Hugging Face, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex), agentic systems, vector databases, Git, and the command line.
  • Intuitive understanding of instructional design, with proven ability to structure and teach technical concepts clearly.
  • Graduate degree (Master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related STEM field—or equivalent industry experience.
  • Strong experience with agentic coding systems, including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or Replit. You consider yourself a sophisticated user of these tools.

Bonus if you have the following:

  • A deep understanding of the DataCamp course format—you have an intuitive understanding of what makes a great DataCamp course.
  • An existing network of potential subject matter experts who can become DataCamp instructors.
  • An extensive track record of teaching AI engineering to technical audiences.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

title: Data & AI Strategic Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Functieomschrijving

Organisaties willen meer met data en AI, maar de weg ernaartoe is vaak onduidelijk. Als consultant help jij onze klanten om het volledige potentieel van hun data te benutten, van strategie tot werkende praktijk. Je overbrugt de kloof tussen technische data-oplossingen en zakelijke doelstellingen, zodat klanten betere, datagedreven beslissingen kunnen nemen.

Over ons team

Wij zijn een klein, enthousiast en leergierig team van drie personen. De lijnen zijn kort, iedereen heeft invloed en ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord maar ook uitgeprobeerd.

Onze focus ligt op de consultancykant van data en AI. We begeleiden organisaties bij AI-transformaties en beginnen altijd bij het échte probleem van de klant. Daarna maken we roadmaps en begeleiden we de implementatie. We werken aan data- en AI-governance, data- en AI-strategie, change management en data quality. We vragen onszelf steeds af hoe we dit slimmer en meer AI-driven kunnen doen, en gebruiken AI dus ook zelf in ons dagelijks werk.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. Heb je een andere achtergrond binnen datamanagement? Ook dan willen we je graag leren kennen. Wij leren graag van je mee.

Wat je doet

Consultancy en klantbetrokkenheid

  • Trusted advisor zijn voor klanten: hun zakelijke vraagstuk begrijpen en een passende aanpak voor datamanagement, data- en AI-strategie bieden.

  • Workshops en sessies faciliteren om behoeften op te halen, bevindingen te presenteren en concrete aanbevelingen te doen.

  • Klanten begeleiden bij AI-transformaties, van probleemanalyse en roadmap tot begeleiding van de implementatie.

  • Sterke klantrelaties opbouwen, waaruit nieuwe kansen voor adesso ontstaan.

Expertise in datamanagement

  • Adviseren over data governance, datastrategie en data-architectuur volgens best practices.

  • Bestaande datamanagementprocessen beoordelen, zoals datakwaliteit, en verbeteringen voorstellen.

  • Onderzoeken hoe datamanagement en datakwaliteit meer AI-driven kunnen worden.

  • Op de hoogte blijven van ontwikkelingen in data en AI en die vertalen naar onze dienstverlening.

Projectleiding

  • Datamanagementtrajecten van start tot finish leiden, binnen tijd, budget en kwaliteit.

  • Projectplannen opstellen, voortgang bewaken en samenwerken met data engineers, analisten en andere consultants.

Business development

  • Meedenken over proposities en use cases, en kansen signaleren via je netwerk.

  • Bijdragen aan voorstellen en presentaties voor nieuwe klanten, samen met het salesteam.


Wat jij meebrengt

  • Bachelor of Master in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Computerwetenschappen of een verwant vakgebied.

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ervaring in een dataomgeving, bijvoorbeeld als data-analist of als consultant met focus op datamanagement.

  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in consultancy, bij voorkeur bij een gerenommeerd adviesbureau.

  • Goed begrip van datamanagementconcepten, zoals data governance en datastrategie.

  • Ervaring met het leiden van complexe projecten.

  • Je gebruikt AI zelf in je werk en hebt zin om samen met ons te ontdekken wat er nog meer kan.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden: je betrekt en beïnvloedt stakeholders op alle niveaus.

  • Flexibel en leergierig: je schakelt makkelijk tussen klanten, omgevingen en onderwerpen.

  • Vloeiend Nederlands en Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk.

Nice-to-have: kennis van AI-governance en data-readiness voor AI, en commercieel inzicht.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.


En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

· Een salaris van €5.400 tot €6.600 bruto per maand (40 uur)

· 8% vakantiegeld

· Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week.

· Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris.

· 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen.

· €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen.

· Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden

· Goede pensioenregeling

· Doorgroeimogelijkheden

· Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team.

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

title: Data Architect (Adobe Campaign Classic to Adobe Journey Optimizer) (EMEA Only)
descriptionHtml:
About AllShore Talent

AllShore Talent partners with growing organizations to build high-performing technology and consulting teams. We connect skilled professionals with meaningful, long-term engagements across web technologies, digital experience platforms, and enterprise software delivery — offering competitive compensation, flexible engagement models, and a collaborative, remote-friendly culture.

About The Role

The Data Architect provides hands-on data architecture and technical delivery expertise for Adobe Campaign Classic to Adobe Journey Optimizer modernisation. The role assesses the customer’s Campaign data model, workflows and integrations, defines the Adobe Experience Platform and AJO target data architecture, maps legacy data and processes to the new platform, and guides implementation, validation and transition.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery covering current data collection, data models, identities, integrations and platform configuration.

  • Document the current-state architecture and define a scalable target-state architecture based on Adobe Experience Platform.

  • Translate business and migration requirements into schemas, datasets, identity designs, data flows and integration specifications.

  • Map legacy implementation components and data structures to the target platform, identifying what should be migrated, redesigned or retired.

  • Work with technical consultants and customer engineering teams to implement the agreed architecture.

  • Define data quality, governance, privacy, security, retention, validation and reconciliation requirements.

  • Investigate source-to-target discrepancies and guide their resolution.

  • Produce clear architecture, design, mapping and implementation documentation, and identify dependencies, assumptions and risks early.

  • Support architecture governance and technical quality throughout implementation.

  • Understanding of AEP guardrails and licensing constraints, including recognising when a design is technically possible but not available under the customer’s licence.

  • lead workshops, present and recommend solutions, document designs and gain customer agreement.



Experience and Skills

Essential

  • Strong technical experience with Adobe Campaign Classic (ACC).

  • Understanding of Campaign schemas, recipient and broad-log data, workflows, typologies, deliveries, integrations and custom extensions.

  • Strong Adobe Experience Platform experience, including XDM schema design, datasets, batch and streaming ingestion, identity namespaces, identity resolution, Real-Time Customer Profile, audience design, data governance and consent.

  • Practical experience with Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO).

  • Experience designing the data foundation required for AJO journeys, audiences, decisioning and message personalisation.

  • Ability to assess existing Campaign data and workflows and determine what should be migrated, redesigned or retired.

  • Experience mapping Campaign customer, interaction, campaign and delivery data into appropriate AEP schemas and datasets.

  • Experience integrating AEP and AJO with enterprise data sources and downstream activation or messaging services.

  • Experience facilitating customer-facing technical discovery and design workshops.

  • Ability to define validation and reconciliation approaches for migrated data and integrations.

Highly desirable

  • Previous delivery of an Adobe Campaign Classic-to-AJO migration or modernisation program.

  • Experience with Campaign custom schemas and complex workflow-based data processing.

  • Experience redesigning Campaign capabilities as AEP audiences, AJO journeys or platform integrations.

  • Understanding of AJO journeys, channel configuration, content, offers, decisioning and message execution.

  • Knowledge of consent, suppression, frequency-management and customer-preference patterns.

  • Experience supporting coexistence and transition between Campaign Classic and AJO.

  • Familiarity with APIs and event-driven integrations used to initiate journeys or update customer profiles.

  • Working knowledge of SQL, JSON, REST APIs and data-query or validation tools.

Expected deliverables

  • Current-state Campaign data model, workflow and integration assessment.

  • Target-state AEP and AJO data architecture.

  • Source-to-target mappings and XDM schema and dataset designs.

  • Identity, profile, audience, consent and governance design.

  • Batch, streaming, API and event-driven integration designs.

  • Migration and coexistence assumptions, dependencies and risks.

  • Validation, reconciliation and acceptance plan.

  • Technical implementation and operational handover documentation.

Engagement profile

This is a delivery-focused data architecture role. The successful contractor must be able to move between architecture and implementation-level detail, work effectively in a blended Adobe, customer and partner team, and provide clear evidence of personal ownership of relevant designs and delivery outcomes.

Engagement details section

  • Contract role.

  • Starts soon; a two-week notice period is acceptable.

  • Lasts 1–3 years.

  • Remote anywhere in EMEA, preferably Central Europe.

  • Occasional business travel, with expenses covered.

Program context: two migration paths built on AEP (AA → CJA and Campaign Classic → AJO). Customers are mostly B2C, across the UK, France, Spain, Germany, Norway and Italy.

Languages: strong professional English is required. German, French or Italian is highly valued.

title: Data Engineer (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Aufgaben

Als Data Engineer ist dein Job vielfältig und herausfordernd: Einerseits bist du Lösungsarchitekt und konzipierst in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden – vom Start-Up bis zum DAX-Konzern – moderne Datenplattformen nach aktuellen Best-Practices. Andererseits bist du Entwickler, indem du deine Ideen hands-on durch eigenen Code Wirklichkeit werden lässt.

Dein Job ist getan, wenn die Rohdaten aus den verschiedensten Quellen unserer Kunden perfekt orchestrierst, verlässlich und kostenoptimiert durch das Unternehmen fließen und so die Dashboards der Kunden stets up-to-date sind.

In unseren Projekten nutzen wir insbesondere Technologien des Modern Data Stack. Bedeutet für dich, dass du innerhalb kürzester Zeit verschiedenste Lösungen rund um Tools wie dbt, Snowflake, Databricks in allen Hyperscalern wie AWS, Azure oder GCP kennenlernen und in deiner täglichen Arbeit einsetzen wirst.

Ein Auszug aus deinem zukünftigen Alltag:

  • Du arbeitest in funktionsübergreifenden Teams – gemeinsam mit Data Engineers, Data Analysts und Business People, von uns und unseren Kunden
  • Du entwirfst und entwickelst robuste und skalierende Datenlösungen entsprechend kundenseitiger Projekterfordernisse
  • Du erstellst, optimierst und orchestrierst ELT-Prozesse, um Daten aus unterschiedlichen Quellen in einem Data Warehouse zu konsolidieren
  • Du hältst mit uns gemeinsam Ausschau nach neuen Technologien und Trends
  • Du hast jeden Tag ein Team hinter dir, welches dich bei allen noch so komplexen Herausforderungen entlang deiner Projekte unterstützt

Dein Profil

In unserem Team arbeitet ein Mix aus erfahrenen und neuen Personen im Data-Umfeld. Für diese Stelle suchen wir nach jemandem, der/die bereits erste Erfahrungen in der Datenverarbeitung in der Cloud sammeln konnte und dafür brennt, die nächsten Schritte auf dem Weg zum Data-Experten zu gehen.

Perfekt wird es, wenn du folgende Voraussetzungen mitbringst:

  • Das Wichtigste: Du brennst für das Thema „Daten“ und möchtest Tag für Tag in einem hochmotivierten Team neue Dinge dazulernen
  • Du trägst das „Tüftler-Gen“ in dir und machst dich selbstständig auf die Suche nach der besten Lösung für deine aktuelle Herausforderung
  • Data Warehouse, Data Lake und Data Lakehouse sind dir ein Begriff und du verfügst über Wissen in der Anwendung von Snowflake, BigQuery oder Databricks? Chapeau!
  • Du hast hands-on Expertise im Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanktechnologien und in der Nutzung von performantem SQL
  • Du hast Kenntnisse in einer oder mehrerer Programmiersprachen, vorzugsweise Python, Java, Scala
  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der Implementierung Cloud-nativer Infrastruktur und kennst wesentliche Konzepte wie etwa IAM, Networking, Docker – egal ob in AWS, Azure oder GCP
  • Du hast fließende Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C2-Niveau)

Warum wir?

Aktuell sind wir 10 Mitarbeiter*innen. Bedeutet, dass du früh an Board bist und die Gelegenheit bekommst, aktiv an der Gestaltung unseres Wachstums teilzuhaben. Was wir dir noch bieten?

  • Du wirst fester Bestandteil eines super motivierten Teams im Herzen von Oldenburg!
  • Frisches Obst und Getränkeflat sind cool, besser sind ein attraktives Gehalt mit echten Aufstiegschancen. Wir bieten dir beides!
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice sind fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmenskultur.
  • Wir wollen, dass du nicht nur im Job neue Dinge kennenlernst. Mit 30 Urlaubstagen kannst du neue Länder und Kulturen bereisen. Dein Laptop bleibt dabei zu Hause!
  • 2 Workations jährlich in Dänemark und auf den Kanaren, Teamevents von Kohltour bis Weihnachtsfeier oder einfach ein gemeinsames Getränk nach Feierabend – wir lieben Unternehmungen zusammen im Team!
  • Wir statten dich mit vollem Equipment aus - für Büro und zu Hause. Neues MacBook, moderne Monitore und alle Tools, die du benötigst.
  • Deine persönliche Weiterentwicklung findet nicht nur in den Projekten statt! Neben Austauschformaten zu neuesten Technologien übernehmen wir die Kosten für jedes Zertifikat, das du in Angriff nehmen möchtest.

title: Data Officer
descriptionHtml:
Als Data Officer speel je een belangrijke rol in het ondersteunen van het productontwikkelingsproces door technische gegevens over grondstoffen en verpakkingscomponenten te verzamelen en in te voeren in het Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) en Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systeem van het bedrijf. De functie omvat regelmatige communicatie met leveranciers om informatie op te vragen, de volledigheid van gegevens te controleren en ervoor te zorgen dat alle artikelgegevens accuraat en up-to-date zijn.

Deze functie is ideaal voor iemand met veel oog voor detail en interesse in cosmetica, gegevensbeheer of productontwikkeling.

Ons Data team maakt onderdeel uit van de afdeling Regulatory Affairs. De afdeling bestaat uit twee Regulatory Affairs Specialisten, vier Regulatory Affairs Officers. en twee Data Officers. In deze functie rapporteer je aan de Manager Regulatory Affairs.

MISSION

  • Het bij leveranciers opvragen en verzamelen van technische gegevens, specificaties en documentatie voor grondstoffen en verpakkingen.

  • De door leveranciers ingediende documenten controleren op volledigheid en juistheid (bijv. INCI-lijsten, veiligheidsinformatiebladen, specificaties, certificaten, enz.

  • Nauwkeurig invoeren en bijwerken van materiaal- en verpakkingsgegevens in het PLM- en ERP-systeem.

  • Bijhouden van openstaande leveranciersinformatie en indien nodig opvolgen.

  • Ondersteunen van interne teams (Innovation & Research, Regulatory Affairs en Purchase) met nauwkeurige gegevensbeschikbaarheid.

  • Assisteren bij het handhaven van datakwaliteitsnormen en documentatietemplates.

  • Meewerken aan basis PLM-gegevensaudits en verbeteringsinitiatieven.

YOU

  • Een MBO-diploma scheikunde, farmakunde, verpakkingstechniek of een verwant vakgebied is een pré;

  • Enige ervaring met gegevensinvoer, productdocumentatie of leverancierscoördinatie heeft de voorkeur;

  • Goede organisatorische- en tijdmanagementvaardigheden;

  • Duidelijke en professionele communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk in het Nederlands en Engels;

  • Vermogen om zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband te werken in een multifunctioneel team;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding;

  • 27 vrije dagen per jaar (o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband);

  • En nooit meer een ‘bad hair day’ dankzij de personeelskortingen op de gehele Keune collectie!

KEUNE

Wij zijn een familiebedrijf met een langetermijnvisie, waar wetenschap het hart van alles is wat we doen. Ons verhaal begon in 1922 in Amsterdam. Keune is een van de snelstgroeiende merken in professionele haarverzorgingsproducten. title: Data Operations Associate - News & Market
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

At 9fin, we've built a dedicated Data Operations team in Belfast to enhance our data processing capabilities.

You'll be part of a highly skilled team focused on ensuring high-quality, lightning-fast data is delivered to our platform, enabling our clients to act with speed and confidence.

You'll work closely with teams in New York, London, and Belfast across Leveraged Finance, Structured Credit, Private Credit, and Distressed Debt.

What you’ll work on

Every day brings new challenges, and the team’s responsibilities will continue to expand.

Associate - News & Market Data Team

Providing fast, reliable news and market data across a wide range of financial markets is no small task. Our team uses cutting-edge technology to source, analyse, and publish the most relevant information for our clients.

Here’s a snapshot of what you might work on:

  • Leverage proprietary technology – Understand and navigate HTML, using 9fin’s in-house tools to automate publishing and streamline data workflows.

  • Monitor and review market-moving news – Identify price-sensitive information in articles surfaced by our in-house aggregator.

  • Track financial results and company performance – Ensure timely updates on earnings publications and corporate disclosures.

  • Portfolio management – You will take ownership of your portfolio of companies within a specific industry, ensuring that all investor relations details are accurately maintained and up to date. You’ll be responsible for monitoring and recording key reporting dates, ensuring they are accurately tracked and updated on internal and client facing platforms.

  • Analyse new deal terms and structures – Act fast to alert clients to key developments in the market.

  • Stay ahead of ratings changes – Keep track of company ratings updates and ensure they are accurately reflected in our systems.

  • Publish structured credit updates – Cover CLO deal alerts and other structured credit market movements.

  • Monitor redemptions and maturities – Conduct checks on bond and loan redemptions, updating relevant datasets and client alerts.

About You

If you are a graduate or recent graduate with some or all of the following attributes, we’d love to hear from you:

  • Team player – You enjoy working collaboratively, supporting those around you, and contributing to shared success.

  • Growth mindset – You believe that dedication and hard work drive improvement, and you’re always looking to develop new skills.

  • Strong attention to detail – You have exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to quickly identify key information and act on it.

  • Ability to work quickly and accurately – You thrive in a fast-paced environment, where monitoring multiple sources of information and making rapid, informed decisions is key.

  • Ability to prioritise multiple tasks – You are adept at managing competing priorities, ensuring that the most important tasks are addressed in a timely and efficient manner.

  • Curiosity about financial markets and business – While prior knowledge isn’t required, you have a keen interest in how markets, companies, and financial news interact.

  • Willingness to challenge the status quo – You see how things could be done better and aren’t afraid to speak up with ideas for improvement.

  • Communication skills – You can convey information clearly and concisely, both in writing and verbally.

Due to our global operations, you will work a rotational shift pattern, alternating between an EU shift (9 AM – 6 PM UK time) and a US shift (1 PM – 10 PM UK time). The schedule will be determined by the team. You should be comfortable with periods where your working hours will differ from standard UK office hours.

This role is well suited to those with backgrounds in business, data analytics, journalism, or other disciplines requiring strong analytical and communication skills. More than specific experience, we’re looking for individuals who can work at pace, spot what matters, and adapt quickly in a dynamic environment.

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up and we enjoy sharing our success. When the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth, and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity options

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%) Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • AI experimentation budget of £800 per employee to trial AI tools

  • Bi-annual team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

descriptionHtml:
At flaconi, we believe that diversity fuels creativity, innovation and growth. It thrives in all its forms of beauty. Our team is a mosaic of individuals from different backgrounds, cultures and life journeys, all united by a shared passion for beauty. Our commitment is grounded in our core values, particularly #trustinpeople. flaconi is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes and encourages all qualified  from all backgrounds and identities, regardless of ethnicity, race, gender identity, migration background, national origin, disability status, sexual orientation, religion, or age to apply.

We are seeking a (Senior) Data Scientist (all genders) to join a dynamic team of five within our DATA department. You'll dive into diverse challenges including training and deploying machine learning models, developing Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, and statistical modeling. We believe in flat hierarchies, which means you'll work closely with colleagues of various seniorities in a fun environment. You'll play a key role in extracting valuable insights and developing data and AI solutions to optimize our e-commerce platform across Europe, taking end-to-end ownership of your projects and collaborating closely with business stakeholders along the way. Your contributions will have a direct impact on business decisions and process efficiency across a wide spectrum of unique use cases.

Your Role

  • Employ statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms for regression, classification, and clustering (e.g., Gradient Boosting, Random Forest, Hierarchical Clustering, ensemble methods).
  • Develop and productionalize Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions alongside modern NLP techniques using transformer architectures (e.g., BERT, GPT).
  • Utilize time-series forecasting methods (e.g., ARIMA, LSTM, DeepAR, Prophet) for predictive modeling.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA), advanced feature engineering, and dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE).
  • Develop and implement deep learning models in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras while leveraging transfer learning strategies.
  • Showcase your skills across key e-commerce data science use cases including demand forecasting, churn and CLTV modeling, pricing, customer segmentation, recommender systems, and personalization.
  • Handle large-scale datasets using distributed computing frameworks (Apache Spark) on a tech stack comprising Python (PySpark, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, LightGBM), SQL, Databricks (Data Lakehouse & ML platform), AWS (S3, Lambda, EC2, SageMaker, Bedrock), GitHub, and AI-augmented tools (Claude, Copilot) while collaborating directly to proactively address stakeholder business needs.

Your Profile

  • Bring a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in developing and deploying machine learning solutions for real-world business problems.
  • Demonstrate background exposure to e-commerce (ideal), fintech, or fast-paced agency environments.
  • Demonstrate hands-on experience with Databricks as a Data & AI platform (required) alongside cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Prove hands-on experience in building, productionalizing, and deploying Generative AI or Agentic AI solutions.
  • Apply hands-on experience with MLOps practices and tools (required) for end-to-end model lifecycle management.
  • Possess a strong grasp of core data science principles to select the most appropriate techniques, combined with advanced proficiency in SQL, Python (PySpark, scikit-learn, NumPy, matplotlib, pandas), and AI-augmented development tools (Claude, Copilot).
  • Communicate exceptionally in English (written and verbal) to articulate complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders, driving projects with full end-to-end ownership as a collaborative team player.

What We Offer

  • Our employees matter to us: We offer you a permanent contract and cover the costs for your Deutschland ticket.
  • Work-life balance: 29 vacation days plus additional days off on the 24th and 31st December, flexible working hours, up to three days of working from home per week, working abroad options, paid sabbatical.
  • flaconi Academy: Actively shape your own career path by taking advantage of our internal and external training opportunities.
  • We care about your well being: We want to support you also during difficult times. For this, we offer you and your close relatives counseling sessions with mental health professionals.
  • flaconi fitness: a wide range of sports options & discounts on memberships.
  • Family first: Our “emergency-daycare” is there for you in out-of-the-ordinary situations to look after your child on site at our office.
  • Thinking about tomorrow together: flaconi subsidizes your savings contribution to the company pension scheme with an additional 20%.
  • A comfortable working space with everything you need: High end technical equipment, fruits and drinks, no dress code and dogs are welcome in our office!
  • Other perks: Great discounts in our online shop as well with our partner companies, cool team events & company parties!

Check out all benefits HERE.

Founded in 2011 as one of the first online perfumeries, flaconi is honored to work with more than 700 people from 60 different nations at the flaconi headquarters in Berlin-Charlottenburg and its fulfillment center in Halle. Shape our company’s success with us and apply now online! descriptionHtml:
Nous recherchons un-e Data Steward Corporate Operations Finance basé-e à Lille ou Paris

La fiabilité, l'accessibilité et la conformité des données financières sont des enjeux critiques pour répondre aux exigences réglementaires et d'audit, tout en offrant une expérience fluide aux équipes métiers (contrôle de gestion, comptabilité, trésorerie).

L’équipe Data Governance Finance recrute un(e) Data Steward pour structurer ce périmètre complexe. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Data et les fonctions financières pour délivrer un socle de données robuste, documenté et auditable.

Vos responsabilités principales

En tant que Data Steward, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la gestion et la protection des données au sein de l'entreprise. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes métiers, les équipes IT et les autres parties prenantes pour garantir que les données de votre domaine soient documentées, fiables, accessibles et conformes aux normes internes et réglementaires :

  • Documentation & discoverability : vous participez à la structuration des concepts business et garantissez une documentation cohérente et centralisée dans le Data Catalog (Collibra). Vous assurez le lineage entre les concepts métiers et les connaissances techniques
  • Accessibilité de la donnée : vous traduisez les besoins métiers en exigences techniques d'exposition, et accompagnez les Data Users dans la localisation et l'utilisation des données en favorisant l'usage du Data Catalog. Vous vous assurez que les ingestions de données dans le Datalake respectent les standards (storage zone, schémas, nomenclatures…)
  • Sécurité & conformité : vous veillez à ce que la donnée reste strictement conforme aux exigences de sécurité et aux règles légales (ex: CNIL, RGPD, PIPL). Vous vérifiez l'alignement avec le registre de traitement du DPO
  • Animation & collaboration : vous collaborez activement avec les Data Owners, Data Quality Manager, Data Manager, Product Owners/Data Producers et équipes techniques (Data Engineers, BI Engineers). Vous contribuez également à la communauté globale des Data Stewards pour améliorer la maturité et faire évoluer les standards.

Votre écosystème & les spécificités finance

  • Outils & processus : vous évoluerez dans un écosystème structuré autour de grands ERP financiers (ex: SAP, Oracle) et d'outils de consolidation et de performance

  • Enjeu clé de conformité : une attention extrême sera portée à l'auditabilité et à la traçabilité absolue des flux pour répondre aux normes comptables, et au pilotage de la performance.

Ce dont tu as besoin pour réussir

  • Expérience : expérience avérée en Data Stewardship idéalement appliqué au domaine de la Finance ou profil hybride (contrôle de gestion / audit doté d'une forte appétence pour l'architecture des données)
  • Savoir-faire technique : maîtrise de l'usage d'un Data Catalog (idéalement Collibra), compréhension des flux et architectures Data (API, Datalake, Data Warehouse), requêtes SQL simples, et méthodologies Agiles (Jira). Connaissance des environnements Cloud (Databricks, Tableau)
  • Savoir-être : extrême rigueur liée à la nature de la donnée financière. Capacité de synthèse, diplomatie et pédagogie pour aligner des directions exigeantes. Anglais courant indispensable (niveau B2/C1) pour piloter le réseau mondial
  • Niveau d'autonomie : capacité à travailler en autonomie sur des périmètres complexes, à influencer les bonnes pratiques et à animer des initiatives transverses à fort impact 

Ce que nous t’offrons

  • Mode de travail hybride (3 jours sur site / 2 jours de télétravail)
  • Matériel fourni en accord avec tes missions et nos engagements sociétaux
  • Une équipe apprenante : intégration dans la team People Data composée de plus de 30 experts et une communauté globale de Data Quality Managers.
  • Développement des compétences et accompagnement (diversité des projets, certifications techniques dès la première année, formations internes et externes, etc.)
  • Package de rémunération (participation des employés aux actions de l'entreprise, bonus mensuels/trimestriels)

Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. descriptionHtml:
Our Story Hello there. We’re Zopa. We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. The DBA team sits within Zopa’s Platform Tribe, alongside Cloud Infrastructure and DevX. We support the databases and data stores behind critical customer and engineering services, while evolving how those services are delivered.

This is not a traditional, server-only DBA role. We are automating database operations, strengthening cloud and infrastructure-as-code practices, and giving engineering teams clearer, safer ways to use database services.

The team is also progressing a major transition from Microsoft SQL Server towards PostgreSQL, creating meaningful technical change for someone who enjoys both depth and improvement.


A day in the life:

  • Support mission-critical PostgreSQL and AWS database services with strong operational discipline.

  • Automate repeatable DBA work using infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and deployment pipelines.

  • Improve backup, restore, monitoring and replication practices.

  • Partner with Cloud Infrastructure colleagues on AWS, Terraform and platform patterns.

  • Help engineers self-serve database capabilities safely and with clear guardrails.

  • Contribute to the move away from Microsoft SQL Server towards PostgreSQL.

  • Join the shared on-call rota and continually reduce avoidable alerting and toil.


    • About you:

  • Practical AWS experience supporting mission-critical database services.

  • Strong PostgreSQL knowledge and experience with backup and restore.

  • Terraform and CI/CD experience, with a focus on automation.

  • Experience participating in on-call support for production services.

  • A database-engineering mindset combined with practical platform automation.

  • Ability to reason about reliability, resilience, security and operability.

  • Collaborative working style and confidence partnering with platform engineers.


    • Added bonus:

  • AWS certification.

  • Experience supporting MySQL or SQL Server instances.

  • Database automation and PostgreSQL replication experience.

  • Monitoring experience with Redgate Monitor, Honeycomb or comparable tools.

  • Pragmatic use of AI in day-to-day engineering work.

    • #LI-AP1

    At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

    We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

    You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

    *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

    Diversity Statement

    Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

    Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

title: Design Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Design Operations Manager (DesignOps), you will sit within Mistral's Product Operations function, with a focus on streamlining the operations of the design team. You will own how the Design team operates as a system — its cadences, its rituals, its coordination, and the connective tissue that lets designers focus on design. This role exists because a design org at our scale needs someone whose full-time job is the operating system itself: defining it, holding it, and continuously tuning it so the team runs with a heartbeat rather than on ad-hoc heroics.

You will own the team's weekly and quarterly cadences — from leadership syncs to planning, retros, and share-outs — and establish how we track work, surface it outward, and make decisions. You'll design the forums where decisions get made and recorded, keep the rituals that create alignment, and aggressively cut the ones that are just overhead.

Equally, you are the bridge across the org. You will coordinate the interlocks between Brand and Marketing for upcoming launches, and between Product and Product Design for the build pipeline — so interdependencies are understood and planned for, not discovered at the last minute. You will partner closely with marketing, PMs, engineering, GTM to align design work with go-to-market timing and surface what's shipping before it ships.

This is a team-of-one role with a founding design-ops mentality. You will build the discipline from scratch, automate repetitive coordination with AI where it helps, and coordinate people where it matters. You report to the Head of Product Operations, working day-to-day with the Head of Design and the design team.

 

What You Will Do

descriptionHtml:

Qualifications

Key Responsibilities

· Lead the development and execution of commissioning plans across STACK EMEA projects, including all commissioning levels through Integrated Systems Testing and handover.

· Develop, standardise and review commissioning documentation, including Functional Performance Tests, Factory Acceptance Tests, equipment start-up procedures, installation checklists, test protocols, scripts and methods.

· Ensure commissioning documentation and activities align with project design, specifications, Basis of Design and Owner’s Project Requirements.

· Provide programme-level oversight of multi-discipline pre-commissioning and commissioning activities across critical infrastructure construction and special projects.

· Coordinate with project teams, client engineers and technical stakeholders to assess issues identified during testing, determine criticality and drive appropriate resolution.

· Oversee QA/QC of pre-functional and functional test results, ensuring completeness, accuracy and appropriate interpretation of results.

· Provide commissioning input into project design, planning and schedules, identifying risks, dependencies and potential constraints early.

· Ensure commissioning activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality and technical standards, and actively support STACK safety programmes.

· Manage and coordinate commissioning agents and subcontractors on site, escalating issues or potential blockers that could affect project delivery.

· Track commissioning progress against key delivery milestones and provide programme reporting, metrics and data-driven insight to stakeholders.

· Manage commissioning budgets and support effective commercial oversight of commissioning activities.

What You’ll Bring

· Demonstrable commissioning leadership experience within data centres or other mission-critical environments, with strong experience managing complex mechanical and electrical commissioning programmes.

· A qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

· Strong technical knowledge of mechanical and electrical plant and services supporting mission-critical Data Centre environments, including MV/LV distribution switchgear, automatic transfer schemes, standby generators, UPS, chillers, CRAC/CRAH systems, ancillary cooling plant, BMS and automation/monitoring systems.

· Advanced understanding of mechanical and/or electrical systems commissioning, controls and design principles.

· Ability to read and interpret construction and technical documentation, including electrical and mechanical schematics, control diagrams, specifications and design drawings.

· Knowledge of Data Centre and mission-critical design concepts, commissioning standards and safety requirements.

· Experience developing and reviewing test scripts and protocols that validate design intent and operational performance.

· Commercial awareness, including budget management, contracting considerations, programme reporting and performance metrics.

· Strong communication, stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, delivery, operations, clients and external partners.

· Comfort working across multiple projects and countries, with the ability to travel to EMEA project and installation sites as required (approximately 20%).

· The chance to build your career with STACK in a fast-growing, international Data Centre business.
