The role will lead the development and implementation of a multi-country program that strengthens government capabilities to identify and address barriers to quality care, translate data into action, and deliver measurable improvements in health outcomes.

The Director will have overall accountability for the strategy, resources, quality, performance, and results of the maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, leading a multidisciplinary team and working closely with governments, technical partners, and colleagues across RTSL to design, implement and scale evidence-informed approaches. The role requires deep expertise in sexual, reproductive and maternal health, strong program leadership, and the ability to translate technical evidence into practical, sustainable health system improvements.

Work Location: 100% Remote with travel as stated. 

Duration: Full-time employment for a fixed term of 24 months.

Core Duties and Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership and Portfolio Management

  • Set the strategic direction, priorities and implementation approach for RTSL's maternal survival and reproductive health portfolio, exercising delegated authority to make program investment, resource allocation, and partnership decisions within approved organizational parameters and in alignment with country priorities.
  • Oversee a multi-country portfolio, with accountability for program planning, budget development and management, resource allocation, performance and delivery against strategic objectives.
  • Lead and manage a multidisciplinary team, establishing clear responsibilities and performance expectations, overseeing staffing and talent development, addressing performance and capacity gaps, and building the capabilities needed for sustained program delivery.

Technical Leadership and Program Development

  • Provide expert technical leadership across maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, including maternal death surveillance and response, quality maternal care, family planning, and adolescent pregnancy prevention.
  • Lead the development and adaptation of evidence-informed approaches that connect data-driven learning with targeted improvements in clinical care, service delivery and wider health system capabilities.
  • Guide the design and implementation of country programs, identifying opportunities to strengthen government leadership, institutional capabilities and sustainable approaches to improving health outcomes.
  • Drive innovation and collaboration across RTSL's technical teams, drawing on expertise in PHC delivery, digital health, measurement and financing to address priority health system bottlenecks.

Country Engagement and Strategic Partnerships

  • Lead senior-level engagement with Ministries of Health and national partners to identify priorities, shape country strategies and secure government ownership of programs and results.
  • Develop and manage strategic partnerships with donors, multilateral agencies, technical institutions and implementing partners, identifying opportunities for collaboration, investment and program expansion, and representing RTSL in high-level technical and policy discussions.

Performance, Learning and Accountability

  • Maintain overall accountability for portfolio performance and results, establishing clear performance expectations and monitoring mechanisms, and using evidence and implementation learning to inform strategic decisions, address delivery challenges, and adapt approaches.
  • Oversee the generation, synthesis and dissemination of evidence and practical learning to inform policy, program improvement and scale-up across countries.

Qualifications

Education

  • Advanced degree in medicine, public health, sexual and reproductive health, obstetrics and gynecology, or a related field.

Experience

  • At least 15 years of relevant global health experience, including substantial technical and leadership experience in sexual, reproductive and maternal health in low- and middle-income countries.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and leading complex, multi-country programs, including strategic planning, budget oversight and accountability for results.
  • Extensive experience engaging senior government officials, donors and international partners, with the ability to build relationships and influence strategic decisions.

Skills & Abilities

  • Recognized technical expertise in maternal survival and reproductive health, with a strong understanding of evidence-based interventions, health service delivery and health system strengthening.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop multidisciplinary teams and manage programs across different countries and organizational functions.
  • Strong understanding of data-driven program improvement, implementation challenges and approaches to translating evidence into sustainable results.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, judgement, communication and leadership skills, with the ability to navigate complex political and operational environments.
  • Fluency in English required; proficiency in French desirable.
  • Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 30% during program start-up and up to 25% thereafter.

Compensation and Benefits

Resolve to Save Lives prides itself on cultivating a supportive, connected remote team doing work that matters. We do everything possible to ensure our employees are connected and set up for success. 

The salary range for applicants based in the US is $150,000 to $170,000 annually. The exact offer will be determined by various factors, such as the candidate's skills and experience relative to the requirements of the role. For applicants based outside the US, salaries are set according to national labor rates for the international NGO sector.  

In addition to a competitive salary, Resolve to Save Lives provides a generous package of benefits, including: 

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents 
  • Contributions toward retirement  
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave, in addition to public holidays 
  • Two paid, week-long organization-wide breaks at mid-year and end-of-year  
  • Professional development and home office setup benefits 
  • Up-to-date computer equipment

RTSL believes its programs are strengthened when they are developed and supported by individuals with diverse life experiences whose understanding of social and cultural issues can help make our work and workforce more inclusive. We encourage applications from and provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, ancestry, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, organ donor status, or status as a veteran. title: Director of Product, Order
descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position

Vinted is Europe's largest online C2C marketplace for second-hand fashion. Every purchase starts a journey: a seller prepares a parcel, a carrier moves it across Europe, and a buyer waits for it. Sometimes something goes wrong along the way. The Order domain owns everything that happens after a member pays: shipment preparation, the parcel's journey, problems and disputes, and refunds and compensation.

Our ambition is simple to say and hard to do: members should be certain about every order, and when something goes wrong it should be resolved fast and fairly, ideally without anyone having to contact support. As Director of Product, Order, you will lead this. You will set the product strategy for the post-purchase experience and lead a product organisation of five teams. Order is one of the most interconnected domains at Vinted, so you will also drive outcomes that depend on logistics, member support and payments partners.

In this position, you'll

  • Set the Order strategy: Own the multi-year vision and roadmap for the post-purchase experience. Turn certainty and fast, fair resolution into product priorities that members notice and that keep them coming back.
  • Own the trade-offs: Balance member experience, support and compensation costs, fairness between buyers and sellers, and consumer-protection expectations across many markets.
  • Lead across boundaries: Many of Order's outcomes start with logistics (Vinted Go), member support, payments or trust. Align roadmaps with these partners and win priority for the things Order does not own.
  • Modernise the foundation: Work with engineering leadership to move Order's core flows out of the monolith without stalling delivery, and make the case for platform work that has no direct euro value.
  • Lead and grow the team: Directly lead the Product Managers in the domain, raise the bar on product craft, and shape team structure as scope and scale grow. Stay hands-on in the product you are responsible for.

About you

  • Multi-team product leader: You have experience leading multiple product teams and/or managing other Product Managers in a scaled consumer marketplace, e-commerce, delivery or fintech business at scale.
  • Strong product and operations experience: You understand the challenges across the post-purchase journey, from fulfilment and logistics to payments, refunds, customer support and disputes. You know that many of the toughest problems happen at the intersection of the product, the carrier and the support team.
  • Commercial and systems thinker: You can turn cost lines (support, compensation, shipping labels) into product bets and size them. You know when an assumed link, such as cost reduction driving retention, still needs proving. You are comfortable deciding with incomplete information.
  • Hands-on and data-fluent: You are comfortable setting goals, defining hypotheses, designing experiments and deciding what success looks like. You work directly with data and use it to understand what is working, where to invest further and when it's time to change direction.
  • Credible technical partner: You can engage engineering leaders on architecture and platform trade-offs and own the sequencing that follows. You are also curious about how AI can help solve problems and accelerate progress towards business goals.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance 
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:€106.300—€143.800 EUR

title: Enablement Manager (Client Operations)
descriptionHtml:

Client Operations ist der Ort, an dem unsere Programme auf die Praxis treffen: Fördergeber, Arbeitgeber, Partner und Lernende sind darauf angewiesen, dass dieses Team einen hervorragenden Job macht – von der Anmeldung und Förderverwaltung bis hin zur täglichen Kundenkommunikation und Problemlösung. Die Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Konsistenz dieser Arbeit wirkt sich unmittelbar auf die Lernendenbindung, die Kundenzufriedenheit und unsere regulatorische Stellung aus.

Diese Rolle gibt es, um dieses Team exzellent zu machen. Du setzt KI-Tools täglich in deiner eigenen Arbeit ein und unterstützt das Team dabei, sie zu nutzen, um klüger statt nur härter zu arbeiten.

Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit Menschen auf allen Ebenen zusammen – Client Operations, Delivery, Learning, Quality und der Geschäftsleitung – und lernst, wie ein Bildungsanbieter von Anfang bis Ende funktioniert. Und du hast ein Mitspracherecht dabei, wie wir uns weiter verbessern.

Ownership
Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

  • ENSIMAG

  • CentraleSupélec

  • École Polytechnique

  • EPFL

Meet us there and tell us what excites you.

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link.


Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

title: Enterprise Success Manager, NL (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As an Enterprise Success Manager at Mistral, you own what happens to our most strategic enterprise accounts after the build: you make deployed AI stick in real workflows, keep production ARR healthy, defend renewals, and source the expansion signals Sales closes.

Mistral's Solutions teams create high-value AI use cases with our customers. Your job is to make those investments successful beyond delivery — adopting what has been built, operating it with confidence, measuring its business impact, and scaling value across the organization. You will work with customer sponsors, business teams, IT and security stakeholders, and across Mistral with Solutions, Product, Engineering and Support.

This is not a high-volume, ticket-queue customer success role. Portfolios are small and deep. It calls for a strategic account mindset, the technical judgment to navigate complex deployment environments, and the energy to build the customer success function as Mistral grows.

You will join on one of two tracks (and can move between them):

  • Adoption track — embedded in flagship transformations while Solutions is still delivering. You own the adoption and change-management motion around the build: user waves, enablement, champions, training programs, and the measurement that proves value is landing.

  • Operational track — you take accounts through a structured handover once Solutions completes delivery, and own the run phase end-to-end: operational health, value realization, renewals, and expansion signals.

In both tracks you operate in close partnership with Solutions: they deliver and hand over; you own post-handover; they re-engage on expansion signals. Occasionally, account teams will also pull you into late-stage pre-sales — authoring the customer training and scale-up plan that gives a buyer confidence in the rollout, a motion already credited in a major European win.

What You Will Do


Own the customer success and value plan

  • Build a clear view of each account's objectives, stakeholders, deployed use cases, commitments and risks. Translate it into a shared success plan with owners, milestones and measurable outcomes.

  • Establish a practical operating cadence with customer sponsors, business owners, IT and delivery teams. Lead success reviews that make progress, risks, decisions and next steps clear.

  • Define a baseline and track the outcomes that matter for each use case: adoption and usage against entitled seats, customer satisfaction, operational health and business impact. Turn the evidence into a clear value narrative.

Make deployment realities part of the success plan

  • Understand how each customer's deployment model — on-premises, VPC or serverless — affects the products and use cases they can access, operate and scale. Validate the specifics with the technical teams rather than assuming feature parity or identical operating models.

  • Identify the practical implications of deployment choices: security and data requirements, access and integrations, release and upgrade cadence, available features, capacity, observability and support processes. Explain the trade-offs clearly to customer and Mistral stakeholders.

  • Translate those constraints into an actionable adoption plan: align enablement and release communications with the version the customer actually runs, account for security approvals and upgrade windows, and agree how to measure usage when telemetry is limited.

  • Spot risks early, qualify their impact on adoption, renewal or value, and coordinate the right Solutions, Product, Engineering or Support owners to resolve them. Set clear expectations without making unvalidated technical or roadmap commitments.

Drive adoption, autonomy and sustained value

  • Help customer teams move from a delivered use case to regular, effective use. Identify the users, workflows and change-management needs that determine whether it sticks.

  • Coordinate onboarding, training, product updates and hands-on enablement with the right Mistral and customer teams. Develop customer champions and train-the-trainer motions so adoption scales beyond direct Mistral involvement.

  • Prepare the transition from delivery to run: clarify operational ownership, support and escalation paths, and the resources users need to succeed independently.

  • Monitor adoption and customer health, investigate where usage or value is falling short, and lead a coordinated plan to address the causes.

Defend and grow the commercial relationship

  • Own the renewal motion for your accounts: know every renewal date, the auto vs non-auto renewal terms, and the risk story behind each one. Run the renewal play early — no surprises at renewal time.

  • Track and improve account NRR. Identify new use cases, teams and expansion opportunities, and share them with the account team grounded in demonstrated value.

  • Lead business reviews with the account team: value delivered, risks owned, decisions needed, roadmap asks.

Bring the customer voice into Mistral

  • Gather and qualify feedback from users, technical teams and sponsors. Distinguish enablement needs from product gaps, deployment constraints and support issues, and route each to the right owner.

  • Track important requests and communicate progress and limitations back to the customer, while Product and Engineering retain ownership of product and technical decisions.

Build the company as well as the account

  • Create the playbooks, success plans, handover practices and measurement approaches that are missing. Test them with customers, improve them, and make them reusable across accounts.

  • Bring structure to ambiguity: identify what needs to happen, make a plan, mobilize the right people and follow through — without waiting for a perfect process or detailed instructions.

  • Roughly a fifth of your time is protected, rotating build time for exactly this work; it is part of the job, not extra to it.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles, such as Customer Success, Delivery/Implementation, or Solutions Consulting, ideally in a technical AI or SaaS environment.

  • Experience owning outcomes for enterprise customers of technical products or deployed solutions — adoption and commercial outcomes (retention, renewal, expansion), not relationship management or activity reporting.

descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 million de TPE/PME et plus de 7 000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Tu as une solide expérience en comptabilité et tu aimes comprendre comment fonctionnent les outils SaaS ?
Tu souhaites intervenir sur des problématiques complexes, à la frontière entre métier, produit et technologie ?
Rejoins Pennylane en tant qu’Expert·e Support Technique et Comptable.

Ton rôle
Tu prends en charge les sujets les plus complexes remontés par nos utilisateurs et nos équipes Support.
Ton objectif : comprendre l’origine des problèmes, qu’ils soient comptables, fonctionnels ou techniques, puis coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes Produit et Tech.
Tu joueras un rôle clé entre les utilisateurs, le Support, les développeurs et les équipes Produit.

Tes missions

  • Investiguer des bugs, anomalies et problématiques comptables ou fonctionnelles.

  • Reproduire les problèmes rencontrés et en identifier la cause.

  • Qualifier les incidents et coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes concernées.

  • Échanger avec les développeurs et le Produit pour transmettre des analyses claires et exploitables.

  • Utiliser les outils d’investigation disponibles : logs et SQL simple.

  • Documenter les solutions et contribuer à l’amélioration continue du produit et des process.

  • Partager ton expertise avec les équipes Support.


Le profil recherché

Tu peux venir de différents environnements : cabinet d’expertise comptable ou éditeur de logiciel comptable.

Nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • dispose d’une solide expérience en comptabilité et comprend les problématiques des cabinets et entreprises ;

  • a déjà travaillé sur des sujets complexes nécessitant analyse et coordination ;

  • est à l’aise avec les outils et problématiques techniques ;

  • sait communiquer clairement avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques ;

  • parle anglais dans un contexte professionnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral ;

  • fait preuve de rigueur, d’autonomie et de curiosité.

La connaissance de SQL est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable. Ce qui compte surtout, c’est ton envie de comprendre les systèmes et de monter en compétence sur les sujets techniques.

Pourquoi rejoindre Pennylane ?

Tu rejoindras une équipe au cœur de la qualité produit, en lien direct avec les utilisateurs, les développeurs et les équipes Produit. Tu travailleras dans un environnement international, en forte croissance, où ton expertise comptable aura un impact concret

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Finance team shapes the company's future by directing capital to high-impact investments, developing robust financial strategies, and ensuring we deliver long-term value while pursuing our ambitious mission.

We're looking for a Finance & Strategy Senior Associate to join our London team. In this role, you'll work with partners across Deliveroo to ensure we are making efficient, data-driven decisions that evaluate the effectiveness of our products and unlock new avenues for growth.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Finance & Strategy team. We accelerate the growth of our business by implementing new opportunities and solutions, partnering across the company to improve the profitability and scalability of our business model.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Consumer Product Impact: Evaluate the effectiveness of high-impact consumer products at scale and develop creative growth strategies.

  • Strategic Modelling: Build custom financial models tailored to specific business needs to improve high-stakes strategic decision-making.

  • Framework Development: Collaborate with stakeholders to develop new investment decision-making frameworks and processes in a fast-paced environment.

  • KPI Analysis: Track and analyse key business and financial KPIs, uncovering trends to assess risks and future opportunities.

  • Operational Scaling: Lead special projects to automate and scale reporting tools, investment frameworks, and cost-tracking methodologies.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Strategic Finance Background: Significant experience in strategic finance, corporate finance, or investment banking, ideally within the high-growth technology sector.

  • Advanced Modelling Skills: High proficiency in Excel with a proven ability to build robust financial models and perform complex analyses.

  • Data Fluency: Proficiency in SQL (or a strong willingness to learn) to manipulate large data sets and uncover hidden insights.

  • Commercial Mindset: Strong understanding of budget management and the ability to partner with cross-functional teams to drive operational value.

  • Adaptability: Proven ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, evolving environment that values autonomy and ownership.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

title: Finance & Controlling Analyst (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Das baust du mit uns auf

Wir entwickeln das Wertpapiergeschäft der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe weiter und schaffen ein neues digitales Neo-Brokerage-Angebot. Es richtet sich gezielt an junge, digital-affine Zielgruppen, die wir für unsere Finanzgruppe gewinnen wollen. Unser Ziel ist es, mit einem zukunftsweisenden Mobile-First-Angebot, bestehend aus einer leistungsstarken Brokerage-App, einem unverwechselbaren Marktauftritt mit erstklassigem Service und nahtlosem Zugang zu persönlicher Beratung unserer Primärbanken eine starke Antwort auf den sich wandelnden Brokerage-Markt zu geben. Dabei vereinen wir die Dynamik eines Start-ups mit der Stärke der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe.

Bei uns hast Du die einzigartige Chance, ein innovatives Angebot von Anfang an aktiv mitzugestalten – von der Markenentwicklung über die User Experience bis zum Produktdesign. Flache Hierarchien und agilen Arbeitsweisen erlauben dir schnell Verantwortung zu übernehmen und echten Impact zu schaffen.

Das wirst du bei uns machen

Als Finance & Controlling Analyst baust Du die finanzielle Steuerung mit auf und stellst sicher, dass Finanzdaten vollständig, belastbar und entscheidungsrelevant aufbereitet werden. Du verbindest saubere Finanzprozesse mit aussagekräftigem Controlling und schaffst damit die Grundlage für transparente Berichterstattung, regulatorische Sicherheit und eine zielgerichtete Unternehmenssteuerung._​

  • Durchführung der ordnungsgemäßen, vollständigen und nachvollziehbaren Erfassung aller Geschäftsvorfälle in der Buchhaltung als Grundlage für ein korrektes Kosten- und Ertragscontrolling​

  • Mitarbeit bei den Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlussprozessen ​

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Controlling-, Budgetierungs- und Forecast-Prozessen zur Steuerung der finanziellen Entwicklung der Gesellschaft​

  • Berechnung zentraler Finanzkennzahlen und Analyse dieser im Hinblick auf Soll/Ist-Abweichungen und Trends​

  • Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung aussagekräftiger Reports und Entscheidungsvorlagen für Geschäftsführung und relevante Stakeholder

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Finance, Accounting, Controlling oder Financial Reporting gesammelt, idealerweise in einer Bank, einem Finanzdienstleister oder FinTech gesammelt​

  • Du hast eine bankkaufmännische Ausbildung absolviert und diese um entsprechende Weiterbildungen mit Fokus auf die Finanzbuchhaltung ergänzt​

  • Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Rechnungslegung, Abschlussprozessen, Finanzberichterstattung und regulatorischen Anforderungen​

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, analytisch und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch und stellst eine verlässliche Finanzdatenbasis sicher​

  • Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale in Finanzprozessen und setzt Verbesserungen pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert um

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Raum für deine Ideen: Hier kannst du nicht nur mitreden, sondern mitgestalten. Deine Ideen sind gefragt und du hast die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen.

  • Wachstum statt Stillstand: Wir haben viel vor und unser Team wächst. Du kannst die nächsten Schritte aktiv mitprägen und gemeinsam mit uns Neues entwickeln.

  • Das Beste aus zwei Welten: Gestaltungsspielraum und Aufbruchstimmung treffen auf die Sicherheit und Stärke der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe.

Deine Benefits

Neben einer vielseitigen und abwechslungsreichen Tätigkeit im Herzen von Frankfurt wirst Du Teil eines dynamischen und motivierten Teams, das die Umsetzung eines innovativen Geschäftsmodells mit Fokus auf das Wertpapiergeschäft verfolgt. In diesem Rahmen bieten wir Dir Freiraum für Deine persönliche Entwicklung und fördern Dich dabei über gezielte Fortbildungsmaßnahmen. Durch das Leben flacher Hierarchien kannst Du die Entwicklung des GENO Broker mitgestalten.

title: Finance Team Lead (d/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
A bit about the finance function at Luminovo

Over the last 4 years, Luminovo has grown on a 73% compounding growth rate. Throughout this time, Luminovo’s Finance team has consisted of never more than 1.5-2 FTE and a part-time leader (Benedikt). The leadership role is graduating and needs to become full-time. Apart from that, we’re good for years to come and find delight in keeping the team as small as possible! We love to overwhelm our financial service providers with demands for better API and are often leading our Claude’s lines-of-code company dashboards.

Your role

Build a finance function that scales through better systems, not a bigger team.

We’re making our finance leadership a full-time role. You’ll lead and coach a team of two while staying close to the work: accounts, cash, reporting and the systems behind them. We want a finance operator who enjoys building with code and AI, not just introducing new tools.

What you’ll own

  • Own daily closing across our organisations on at least two continents. Improve the automation and controls behind it, whether the system is already running or still needs work when you join.

  • Build automatic financial feedback loops across Luminovo. Give leaders the information they need where they work, and use code and AI to automate routine decisions so people can focus on complex judgement.

  • Keep shareholders and lenders informed with timely, accurate reporting they can trust.

  • Protect our cash position. Own the connection between forecasts and reality across payables, receivables, treasury and working capital.

  • Help colleagues make better financial decisions. Coach team leads and company leadership on returns, trade-offs and the opportunity cost of each investment.

  • Lead, coach and mentor your team of two. Grow the team’s capabilities and the quality of our systems rather than relying on more headcount.

What you bring

  • Hands-on finance ownership across accounting, cash and reporting. You’re comfortable moving between operational detail and financial decisions with company leadership.

  • A builder’s approach to finance. You can show systems or workflows you’ve personally improved or automated using code and AI.

  • The ability to coach a small team, build reliable controls and make financial information useful to people outside finance.

  • German is a plus, not a requirement.

Location and language

This is a full-time role with a minimum of five days per month in our Munich office. Being based permanently in Munich is preferred but not required.

⚡️ About Luminovo

Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Our core principles: putting people first & building great things

As a remote-first company headquartered in Munich, our brilliant team is spread across cities including Munich, New York, Austin, Calgary, Berlin, London, Valencia, Nairobi, and Verona, among others. 🌍

Our team includes a mix of product enthusiasts, people advocates, business masterminds, and engineering experts. Among us are graduates from institutions like Stanford University and the University of Cambridge, as well as talented individuals with unconventional CVs. What matters most is their drive to build great things.

We provide an authentic environment based on psychological safety to empower Luminerds from various backgrounds to succeed, grow, and focus on impact. Putting people first means that we deeply care about who our employees are, what makes them unique, and what they excel at.

See what employees and candidates have to say about Luminovo on kununu and Glassdoor.

 

Compensation: €75,260 – €92,880 • Offers Equity

title: Finance Transformation Project Manager
descriptionHtml:
Join Qonto as a Finance Transformation Project Manager, based in Paris, and take full ownership of high-impact, cross-functional initiatives — from analyzing current gaps to selecting providers, implementing new processes, and driving adoption across Finance. Your work will directly shape how Qonto’s Finance functions at scale.

You will work closely with your Finance Transformation peers and Core Finance, Strategic Finance, Product and Tech teams. You will be in the details of our processes and tools, while keeping the big picture in sight.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own your projects end to end: frame the scope, build the plan, governance and risk tracking, and coordinate the delivery.

  • Diagnose our current processes and tools: in relation to your project scope, map the flows end to end, use data to find pain points and compliance risks, and turn them into a prioritized roadmap within your project plan.

  • Choose the right solution: define requirements, run build-or-buy analysis, run RFPs or assess our existing tools when relevant, and recommend the best option, whether that means improving what we have, building in-house or selecting a new solution.

  • Build and roll out hands-on: work shoulder to shoulder with the business teams, Product Owners and system experts on configuration, integrations and testing, then drive adoption across the teams concerned.

  • Steer cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority: run the project rituals, anticipate risks, arbitrate trade-offs and keep leadership updated on progress and blockers.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Project leadership: you have led finance transformation or systems projects end to end (framing, delivery, adoption) for 6+ years, and you drive Finance and Tech teams within your project scope without hierarchy.

  • Hands-on and systems-minded: you map processes yourself, analyze data and test solutions with Tech instead of only writing specs. You are comfortable with finance tools and data flows (ERP, purchase-to-pay or procurement tools such as Coupa).

  • Finance process know-how: you can map finance flows from purchasing to payment and accounting, spot dependencies and design pragmatic, compliant solutions.

  • Structured problem-solving: you diagnose with data, run tool selections or RFPs, and turn recommendations into changes that stick.

  • Clear communication & stakeholder management: you are able to influence across teams and present complex topics simply to any audience.

  • Qonto fit: you connect with our culture and with how we work: autonomy, customer satisfaction at the core, and collaboration across teams. You are fluent in English (French is a plus).

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Cross-functional exposure: work closely with teams across Finance, Product, Tech and Growth, giving you a 360° view of how finance operates in a fintech at scale.

  • A high-impact roadmap: participate in the transformation our current processes, tools and people into a best-in-class Finance function ready for our next stages of development.

  • A playbook to build: help create and refine our finance transformation playbook, challenge existing processes and shape how we work.

  • How we work: a data-driven, hands-on culture, with high autonomy and access to senior leaders when needed.

  • Tools we use: our Finance stack includes SAP ERP Cloud, Coupa, Kyriba, Amelkis, and Anaplan.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Marie Pouzin, Head of Finance Transformation. Marie has led multiple successful finance transformation projects across very different environments (audit, large corporation, small start-up, scale-up). She combines a strategic vision with a hands-on approach, so you get both the guidance and the support you need to make a real impact.

 


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here

[DATA RETENTION] By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.

🔒 Your security matters to us

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Qonto will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it to

title: Forward Deployed Engineer for Robotics (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Agile Robots SE is an innovative company with a clear mission: bringing intelligent robotic solutions to our customers. We combine the latest AI technology with powerful robotic systems, from industrial robot arms and mobile manipulators to humanoids, to solve tasks that classical automation cannot address. At the heart of our offering is a versatile software platform for orchestrating complex robotic systems. It allows efficient customization for specific customer requirements: configuring systems, developing reusable skills, parameterizing processes, and executing tasks reliably in production. Our solutions are deployed with international customers across a wide range of industries. Seamless integration and scalable deployment are at the core of our mission.   We are looking for a passionate Forward Deployed Engineer for Robotics to bridge cutting-edge robotics technology with real-world customer success. In this role, you will work directly with international customers to deploy, customize, and optimize advanced robotic automation solutions. You will become a trusted technical partner, translating customer challenges into scalable, production-ready robotics applications. The role is based in Munich, Germany.

Your Responsibilities

  • Deploy, integrate, and commission complex robotic systems for industrial automation and mobile manipulation applications
  • Customize and extend our robotic workcell automation framework by implementing customer-specific features, integrations, and workflows
  • Integrate and fine-tune AI models for robotic applications, including Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, end-to-end learned policies, and general machine learning components
  • Work closely with customers to understand technical requirements and translate them into robust software solutions
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve software and system integration issues both remotely and on-site
  • Travel to international customer sites for workshops, deployments, training, and technical support (up to 40% travel)

Essential Skills:

  • Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, AI, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field or equivalent practical experience
  • Minimum of four years of professional experience in robotics, AI, industrial automation, or software engineering
  • Experience with robot arms and other robotic hardware (cameras, AGVs, grippers, sensors, etc.)
  • Intermediate programming skills in C++ and Python
  • Practical experience in integrating and programming robotic applications
  • Experience working in Linux environments
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt quickly in customer environments
  • Fluency in English

Beneficial Skills

  • Experience with machine learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow), modern AI models (e.g., SAM, YOLO, GraspNET), or Vision-Language(-Action) models
  • Knowledge of control theory for robotics
  • Experience with computer vision (e.g., OpenCV, PCL)
  • Experience deploying and optimizing robotics applications on NVIDIA embedded platforms (e.g., Jetson Orin, AGX, Xavier)
  • Programming experience in Python
  • Familiarity with PLC programming
  • Practical experience with CAD software
  • Knowledge of industrial communication protocols (e.g., EtherCAT, CAN, OPC UA, Modbus)
  • Knowledge of functional safety standards

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

Find out more at: https://www.agile-robots.com/en/

title: Founding Marketer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Logistics is a $12 trillion industry powered by hard-working people, yet much of its operational work is still manual and running on tribal knowledge. We believe another software tool won’t solve this, but we need to change how work gets done in logistics.

That’s why we’re building Logistica OS: a flexible, multi-agent platform that understands how logistics teams work and takes on back-office tasks, starting with pallet accounting. We chose this first use case because we experienced the problem firsthand while running a digital forwarder for food logistics.

Backed by leading European investors, we partner with some of Europe’s most sophisticated logistics teams to create a new category of logistics technology.

The Role

We’re looking for a Founding Marketer to build our marketing function from scratch. Your number one goal is to help us shape our brand narrative and drive awareness in a market defined by (boring) legacy vendors. We want to stand out with a bold narrative that is backed by numbers, real customer voices and our domain experience.

This is a broad, hands-on role. You will run several channels in parallel, test new channels and generate inbound pipeline. This is a role with lots of freedom and resources (funding, complex product, great customers that move the physical world) to execute a bold vision while enjoying the ride.

Important: we’re not looking for someone that wants to copy & paste marketing tactics or only manage agencies. We want someone creative who can execute their own ideas before doubling down on what works.

Tasks

  • Translate our positioning into consistent brand messaging: Build a clear narrative around Logistica OS and the problems we solve, explaining how our platform solves our initial use case and how it expands

  • Build a bold brand: Shape our tone of voice and visual identity. Bring the creativity, clarity, and audience understanding of great consumer marketing into a complex B2B category without sacrificing substance or credibility

  • Create content: Write case studies, product explainers, opinion pieces, and deep dives. Build formats across LinkedIn, newsletters, video, webinars, and presentations, choosing channels based on where our audience actually spends its time

  • Direct video testimonials: Closely work with our designer and videographer to capture our customer voices into stunning video testimonials

  • Own our website and market presence: Make our website a clear, compelling introduction to Logistica OS and a strong trust asset. Build relationships with relevant media and associations, and shape our presence at industry events

  • Amplify the founders’ voices: Work directly with the CEO on LinkedIn content, articles, keynote material, interviews, and speaking opportunities. Help them bring a distinctive, informed perspective to the conversation about AI in logistics

  • Help Sales build trust faster: Create pitch decks, one-pagers and case studies that make our product easier to understand and buy

  • Build the marketing foundations: Establish repeatable content-systems, own our events calendar and a set up a framework to measure our marketing outcomes. Prioritize, experiment and learn what builds awareness, trust, and qualified inbound pipeline.

Requirements

  • 3-6 years experience in B2B marketing, ideally in a fast paced environment

  • Generalist marketer with experience across the main channels

  • A creative mind paired with hands-on execution and a high sense of urgency

  • Strong taste, you can define what “great” looks like across content and design

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills in German and English

  • Commercial sense, you understand how marketing should influence business outcomes

  • AI-native, you master your favorite tools and you understand how you can leverage yourself

  • Curiosity to understand our technology and how it changes logistics operators’ lifes

  • Plus: experience building marketing functions from scratch in early-stage startup or previous founding experience

You’re not a great fit if

  • You only want to manage one or two channels

  • You prefer managing agencies rather than do the work yourself

  • You need a detailed brief of what you need to do and how

  • You are not comfortable with a fast-paced, VC-backed environment

  • You do not speak German at least on C1 level

Benefits

  • Join at a pivotal growth stage with lots of opportunities to shape the company and your role

  • Work with an experienced team that blends logistics and tech experience

  • Learn how AI is deployed in real world logistics

  • Remote friendly setup with offices in Berlin and Munich

  • Team offsites every 12 weeks, regular inperson events

  • Competitive compensation package - fixed, variable, VSOP

title: Full-Stack Engineer - Data, Infrastructure & AI
descriptionHtml:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. These founding roles will shape both the product and the way we build it.

About the role

You will be a full-stack engineer, shipping customer features across the interface, application services and database. Your particular strength will be the data and infrastructure that make those features dependable: how records are stored, how imports and background jobs run, and how information moves between Agent F and a customer’s other tools. You will help build and operate the whole product, with deeper ownership of this foundation.

This is hands-on full-stack engineering. A typical piece of work could involve extending a data model, implementing an application service, connecting it to a screen, testing it against a real database and following the release into production. You will also investigate slow reports, failed imports and jobs that stop halfway through, then improve the system so it handles those situations reliably.

That foundation also supports our AI work. As we add document extraction, connected customer knowledge and software that takes actions for customers, you will build the services and data access those features need. The immediate priority is dependable software that customers can use, with more capable automation developed around specific tasks.

What you will build and improve

  • Application services and customer features. Build the logic and application programming interfaces (APIs) that connect records, business rules and screens. Take features through implementation, testing, release and production support.

  • The database foundation. Design clear data models, enforce relationships and transaction boundaries, and improve slow queries. Manage schema changes through reviewed migrations, preserve financial history and keep each customer’s data isolated.

  • Imports and integrations. Connect accounting tools, business systems and spreadsheets to a consistent model. Validate incoming records, handle changing source formats, and check that imported totals and reports agree with the source.

  • Reliable background processing. Build scheduled jobs and workers that process work outside a user request. Handle retries without creating duplicates, resume interrupted runs, and make progress and failures visible to the team.

  • Performance and recovery. Diagnose expensive queries, processing bottlenecks and partial failures. Test changes against real databases, plan for growing workloads, and build procedures to recover processing safely with the platform engineer.

  • Practical AI automation. Add features such as extracting invoice fields or preparing an order from approved business data. Give models access through controlled services, check the result and require approval where needed. Develop connected customer knowledge when a feature needs those relationships, and measure whether it improves the result.

For example, a large customer import stops halfway through and the same records arrive again on the next run. You would make processing resume safely, prevent duplicate records, verify the resulting totals and expose the job’s status in the product. You would also investigate whether database queries or worker capacity caused the failure and ship the necessary fix.

What you bring

You have seven or more years of software engineering experience, including substantial ownership of production applications and data systems. You have designed relational data models, built services and processing pipelines, and stayed responsible for them after release. You are comfortable delivering across the stack and using AI tools in your daily work.

You can explain how you diagnosed a slow query, recovered a failed job or shipped a database change safely. You understand what happens when two requests arrive at once, a dependency becomes unavailable or a process restarts halfway through its work. You can follow a problem from a source record through the application to the result a customer sees.

Core experience

  • Full-stack development with TypeScript, Node.js, React and PostgreSQL, or closely comparable technologies.

  • Relational data modelling, SQL, query optimisation, indexes, transactions and reviewed database migrations.

  • Application services and APIs, including permissions, validation and handling concurrent requests.

  • Data imports, integrations and background jobs, including queues, safe retries and recovery from partial failures.

  • Production debugging, service monitoring and performance work on systems used by real customers.

  • Automated tests against real databases and other service dependencies.

  • Practical use of AI in software, with an understanding of how to check outputs and control access to customer data.

  • Daily use of AI coding agents, with direct responsibility for code review and verification.

  • A computer science or computer engineering degree, or equivalent practical depth.

Useful additional experience

Financial or operational systems where correctness and traceability matter; larger data migrations; cloud storage and container-based workloads. Experience putting document extraction or features using large language models (LLMs) into production would be valuable. Knowledge graphs, which connect related company records, and privately hosted or adapted models are useful as we develop that part of the product.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would take ownership of an existing service or data flow, understand how it runs in production and ship a customer-facing improvement through it. You would address a concrete reliability or performance problem, such as a slow report, a fragile integration or a job that cannot recover cleanly after interruption.

We would look for working features, faster and more predictable processing, fewer failed or manually repaired jobs, and useful tests and monitoring. An early automation feature could follow where the data and services are ready and its benefit can be measured.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in a dependable application backbone: processing completes, records reconcile and customers can trust the results. When a job fails or figures disagree, you take ownership of the investigation and recovery. Missing transactions, duplicate entries or unexplained balance differences can be financial emergencies even while every service appears available. You assess the impact, contain affected processing, trace the cause and verify the repaired result before treating the incident as resolved.

Customer commitments shape how we work. You are willing to interrupt planned work, respond promptly and stay engaged when an urgent issue puts a service-level agreement (SLA), onboarding commitment or financial deadline at risk. That requires flexibility beyond normal working hours as part of agreed on-call coverage and coordinated incident response. You keep people informed and see the issue through to a verified recovery or an explicit handover. Afterwards, you improve the system so the same emergency becomes less likely.

How you will work

This is a senior founding role in a small team. You will own the application and data infrastructure for your work, and carry a full share of customer feature delivery. You will collaborate across infrastructure, operations and product design to deliver complete customer outcomes. You will use coding agents to implement changes and remain responsible for reviewing, testing and operating the result.

title: General Manager, League of Legends
descriptionHtml:
Fnatic League of Legends holds one of the richest histories and legacies in the game, from its inception to the present day. As General Manager, you will lead one of the premier teams in Fnatic’s portfolio, with a critical role in continually raising the bar and adding to that legacy of success.

In 2027 we go into a rebuild, and we are looking for an exciting new General Manager to lead that effort. You will shape the squad, the staff and the environment around them, and set the direction for the years that follow.

You'll report to the Chief Gaming Officer.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the sporting performance and delivery of results of Fnatic League of Legends, shaping a team capable of sustained success

  • Lead recruitment and selection of League of Legends athletes, coaches and performance staff, and execute changes as necessary, including benching and transfers

  • With the coaching staff, establish a high performance culture through defining key values and expectations that the team should represent and follow

  • Manage team performance and behaviours, ensuring standards are upheld through appropriate recognition and disciplinary actions

  • Create an elite-tier performance environment with the practice approach, facilities, scheduling and team operations required to win at the highest level

  • Establish a platform and team culture that makes Fnatic a home players and staff aspire to be at and want to stay at, through player care and player experience worthy of their ambition

  • Establish a clear team structure and processes, and continually optimise them in collaboration with senior Esports management

  • Manage the League of Legends team budget, allocating resources effectively to deliver competitive success whilst supporting revenue generating activities

  • Oversee player contracts and obligations, monitoring the delivery of player obligations towards Fnatic, Riot Games and our partners

  • Champion a data and science led approach across recruitment, performance and decision-making, building on Fnatic's analytics capability and the tools that support it

  • Nurture relationships with title stakeholders on League of Legends specific topics, including Riot Games, tournament organisers, teams and player representatives, protecting the team’s interests throughout

  • Be a proactive ambassador for Fnatic across media, community and partner activities, including but not limited to interviews, content, community, and fan meetings

  • Ensure Fnatic brand, content and partnership strategies can be activated through player insights and access, and that the wider business is integrated with, and understood by, our League of Legends division

  • Lead on ad-hoc sporting projects as defined by CGO

We’re looking for:

  • Leadership experience within professional gaming or sports, with genuine accountability for results

  • Passion for esports and a strong understanding of the League of Legends scene

  • Competitive instinct and knowledge of what it takes to win

  • People management experience, including coaches and world-class athletes

  • Ability to inspire and educate the current and next generation of professional gamers, with a readiness to walk the extra mile for players when needed

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the confidence to represent Fnatic publicly and build trusted relationships with players, staff and fans

  • Commercial literacy, comfortable holding a budget and producing business cases

  • Proven ability to work with talent and people from diverse cultures and backgrounds

  • Excellent written and verbal English, other languages desirable

  • Based in Berlin, or willing to relocate


Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: #AlwaysFnatic

At Fnatic, we believe that a diverse mix of voices leads to better discussions, decisions, and outcomes for everyone. We strive to recruit and nurture an inclusive workforce who feel empowered every day to forge the future as part of the Black and Orange squad.

We know that applying for jobs can be daunting - but be assured that at Fnatic:

  • Who you are, and how you identify has no impact on our selection process

  • We understand no candidate will tick 100% of what our job descriptions are seeking, so if you’re missing a point here or there, we still want to hear from you

  • We're happy to consider reasonable adjustments where needed to fully participate in Fnatic’s recruitment experience - just let us know.

About us

Fnatic is a global esports performance brand headquartered in London, laser-focused on seeking out, levelling up and amplifying gamers and creators. Our history is unparalleled. Founded in 2004, we are the most successful esports brand of the last decade, winning more than 200 championships across 30 different games.

Today, driven by our ability to advance esports performance, Fnatic is the channel through which the most forward-thinking brands communicate with young people. We deliver industry-leading content, experiences and activations globally with bases in Berlin, Belgrade, Tokyo among others. Our pros and creators generate hundreds of millions of watch hours, showcasing our global partners to an audience of millions of fans across our social platforms.

Forging the future is in our DNA. We pioneered the intersection of street culture and esports with merch collaborations, and continue to lead the industry with the quality of our pro wear and fan apparel. After launching in 2016, our award-winning esports equipment (comprising mice, keyboards, headsets and pads) has sold to hundreds of thousands of gaming enthusiasts who want to play better.

Gaming is the place where music, fashion, sport and technology come together, and Fnatic is leading the charge.

title: Graduate Mechanical Engineer (2027 start)
descriptionHtml:
Introduction

Are you a curious, creative and technically minded engineer excited by the opportunity to develop innovative solutions? Do you have a passion for understanding technology, solving complex problems and turning ideas into real-world products?

Would you like to work on a diverse range of projects spanning the Industrial, Consumer, Energy, Sustainability, Healthcare and Defence sectors?

We are currently recruiting for two specialist areas within our team and welcome applications from candidates with a particular interest in either Fluid Systems & Analysis, or DfX (Design for manufacture) disciplines, including design for manufacture, assembly and product industrialisation

  Successful candidates can join us between May and October 2027. There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.  

Your role

The Mechanics and Design Department undertakes the development of innovative devices, systems and equipment from concept to manufacture whilst addressing considerable technical and design considerations. We combine user-centred design, innovative mechanical engineering, ‘DfX’ (Design for X, eg. Manufacture, Assembly, Cost etc.) principles, a rigorous systems engineering approach and broad industry experience to form a powerful development team. Our work ranges from complete product developments from concept to market, through to specialist consulting in technology, strategy, development processes and manufacturing. Projects span mechanical engineering, fluidics and thermal systems, product design, manufacturing engineering, industrialisation and supply chain development.   Some examples of some of our more recent exciting and varied projects we have worked on include:
  • Collaborating with LEGO to develop LEGO® SMART Play™ 
  • Scaling transformative metal organic framework innovation with Ahbstra
  • Ouroboros - An Easily Repairable Smartwatch
 

What you'll be doing

This is an excellent opportunity for a mechanical engineer with the goals and intent to achieve excellent results within highly demanding industries under commercial and time constraints. You will be using your technical skills to contribute to product development projects with support and guidance from seniors; from initial idea generation through to the delivery and manufacturing support for market ready products. This may include:
  • Researching emerging technologies, markets and user needs.
  • Taking part in concept generation and problem-solving workshops.
  • Evaluating ideas using engineering analysis, simulation tools (including CFD and FEA where appropriate) and experimental evidence.
  • Preparing detailed designs from system level through to component level.
  • Applying DfX principles including manufacture, assembly, cost, quality and reliability.
  • Contributing to the development of manufacturing and industrialisation solutions.
  • Manufacturing parts and assemblies, either hands-on or by liaising with suppliers.
  • Testing prototypes and designs to ensure they meet client and end-user needs.
  • Analysing test data to gain insights into design, system and process performance.
  • Supporting products through development, manufacture and launch.
 

What you can bring

  • An excellent academic record studying towards, or having completed, a relevant engineering degree 
  • An interest in one or more of the following areas: mechanical engineering, product design, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, heat transfer, robotics, CAD, DfX, manufacturing engineering, prototyping or testing.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with colleagues, clients and suppliers.
  • The ability to use maths, physics and engineering fundamentals to solve complex problems.
  • A passion for designing elegant and effective engineering solutions.
  • The ability to obtain and evaluate simulated or empirical data to inform engineering decisions.
You do not need to be an expert in all of these areas. Along with your CV, please describe which areas of this job advertisement resonate most with you and why (eg manufacturing vs analytical problem solving), what you feel you can bring to Cambridge Consultants, and any achievements that you are particularly proud of.   We welcome applications from final-year students, recent graduates and candidates with relevant industrial, academic or research experience. We are as interested in your ability to learn quickly as we are in your experience.
