What we offer you

As our Graduate Social Media Manager you get the unique opportunity to take ownership of our content. You’ll be working in-person in your HQ in London where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never ending growth curve, we provide you with:

  • Opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll be getting operational experience in a start-up where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matter to the business.
  • Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.
  • Unlimited growth potential in our company - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.
  • Travel opportunity: You would be joining our conferences overseas.
  • Invaluable transferable skills - boost your interpersonal, research, organisation, outreach and project management skills through experience and training.

Your Responsibilities

Responsibilities in this job will vary however, they will be mostly centred around:

  • Email marketing: Manage copywriting, graphics, strategy and optimisation for our newsletter, product updates and exclusive promotions.
  • Social media growth management: Manage and grow our LinkedIn - our largest channel to interact with our audience - and frequently test new content formats. We would also like you to help us leverage our content on YouTube and launch our Twitter.
  • Graphic design: You will be responsible for our visual identity across all of our marketing channels. We will make sure you’re equipped to do this in the best way possible.
  • Website: Design, SEO activities, UX optimisation. Work with us on improving and launching new formats that reflect our brand identity.
  • Analytics: To continuously measure and improve our performance metrics across channels. You will be working towards challenging targets and KPIs.
  • Paid advertising and PPC campaign management.
  • Synergy: To collaborate with the other departments to identify content worth sharing with our audience, and also to inform them of our brands’ progress.

What we expect from you

Please note that this job does not require any specific previous work experience as training is provided and we are looking to incorporate candidates across different levels of experience. However, we do require you to have a UK work permit. We also expect candidates to have obtained a bachelors or masters degree, or to be working towards obtaining university qualification.

Furthermore, we are looking for candidates who:

  • Have a relentless drive and desire to be the very best at what they do;
  • Possess and unparalleled work ethic with a high sense of urgency;
  • Take ownership of everything they do, are proactive and follow through on commitments;
  • Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations;
  • Are an excellent communicator (especially) verbally and in writing;
  • Are well-organised and display the ability to structure and prioritise their work.

Startdate

Flexible

The role is onsite, Monday to Friday, based in our offices at Buckingham Gate. It is essential we work at a fast pace and collaborate in person to create market-leading, unmatched events throughout the calendar year. It will be great to have you as part of our team.

title: GRC Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Remote from the UK, Germany, Austria, Poland, Montenegro or Serbia.

At Secfix, we’re at the forefront of automating security compliance in Europe. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work.

Secfix is run by a 100% remote team with hubs in Munich, Berlin and London. We’re a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused, owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader.

We’ve just raised our $12M Series A and are backed by top VCs, including Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital.

About the Role

We're hiring a GRC Specialist (Governance, Risk and Compliance) to strengthen our compliance function as Secfix scales into more frameworks, mid-market customers, and a growing compliance team.

This role sits at the intersection of compliance delivery, content, and team support. You'll own the compliance knowledge that lives inside our platform, run internal audits, support our customer success team, and act as the compliance voice for customers, auditors, and product.

You'll work closely with our co-founder & CISO and our CS Lead. This is a high-impact role with real influence on how Secfix delivers compliance: both as a service to customers and as content inside our app.

What You'll Do:

You will own one of the most important pillars of Secfix: the quality and breadth of our compliance offering. We don't (and can't afford to) micro-manage. We've built strong foundations and will give you full context on what works. You can test new approaches, but at the end of the day, you have full ownership of how you deliver results (with a strong support network from within and outside the company). You will:

  • Build and maintain compliance frameworks in the Secfix platform (ISO 27001, TISAX, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS 2, DORA, ISO 27017/27018, ISO 42001, C5, and more as we expand)

  • Own internal audits for our customers end to end, from kickoff through to the final report they take into their external audit

  • Keep several audits moving at once and keep every one on schedule

  • Implement ISO 27001 and adjacent frameworks end-to-end for customers

  • Own the quality of compliance content in the platform (including creating policies, automated checks, evidence templates, Compliance enable playbooks for our CSMs, security awareness trainings and more)

  • Close framework gaps and incorporate auditor feedback into both team practice and platform improvements

  • Partner with product and engineering to translate compliance gaps into structured product work

  • Collaborate closely with CS, Product, and Founders to align compliance, customer, and roadmap priorities

  • Deepen relationships with our existing certification partners and train auditors on the Secfix platform so they can confidently use it during customer audits

To be qualified for this role, you must have the following:

  • English (fluent) is a must for this role

  • 3+ years of hands‑on information security and GRC experience

  • Led at least 1 successful ISO 27001 certification projects as an implementer and/or auditor at a startup or mid-market company

  • You have run at least 2 internal audits before.

  • Hands on experience with a GRC platform like Secfix, or similar GRC platforms

  • Real depth in at least one framework beyond ISO 27001 (TISAX, SOC 2, GDPR, NIS2, or similar).

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to break down ambiguous initiatives into concrete deliverables, prioritizes ruthlessly, and ships

  • Excellent written communication, especially in producing clear, precise compliance content for diverse audiences (auditors, founders, engineers)

  • Strong ownership mindset: operates as an individual contributor without waiting for direction

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on technical experience.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience mentoring or coaching colleagues in a compliance, audit, or GRC context

  • Experience in a startup environment is a plus

  • A PECB ISO 27001 Lead Auditor certification or a direct equivalent

  • Screening call with Talent team

  • 45 min - Final Founder Interview with Co-Founders (CTO & CISO)

What we offer

  • Competitive Salary: Industry-competitive local salaries. We pay local rates that are at or above the market. We share this philosophy with GitLab.

  • Equity: Generous equity package – we’re all owners of Secfix and beneficiaries of our collective success.

  • Annual Retreat: Annual retreat to build connections and inspire ideas (this year we’re headed to Milan!).

title: Group Financial Accountant
descriptionHtml:
About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

Remote within the UK, or from our offices in London or Cambridge if you prefer.

The opportunity

CircuitHub is trying to solve a difficult problem: why can software engineers iterate almost instantly while hardware engineers can still wait weeks or months to manufacture a new design?

The company was founded by engineers who had experienced that frustration first-hand. What began as software to make ordering electronics easier has evolved into a much more ambitious manufacturing platform, combining software, robotics and automation to redesign the production process itself.

Today CircuitHub operates an automated electronics manufacturing platform serving hardware businesses across areas including robotics, autonomous systems and other advanced technology applications. Its proprietary Grid system is a factory-scale robotic assembly platform designed for rapid, high-mix electronics production.

The business is now scaling quickly. CircuitHub has raised $45 million to expand manufacturing capacity in both the US and Europe, building on operations in Massachusetts and its growing UK presence. Cambridge is becoming an increasingly important hub alongside London and the company's distributed team.

That growth creates a corresponding need to strengthen the operating infrastructure behind the company. Finance is one of the areas where CircuitHub has deliberately remained lean for longer than it probably should have.

Context: where finance is today

The finance team is led by a Finance Director and Management Accountant, both experienced, qualified accountants. This role brings dedicated financial accounting and technical reporting capability into the team, taking ownership of the books, the audit and the technical questions that come with a growing international group.

CircuitHub uses NetSuite to operate its inter-company financial model across the UK and US. A significant amount of day-to-day UK finance activity is outsourced, while the internal team takes greater ownership of the larger US operation, group reporting and consolidation. This role will be the main point of contact for the outsourced firm, reviewing their work and making sure it meets the standard the group needs, while also working across the US side and the wider mechanics of an international business.

Just as importantly, CircuitHub is thinking carefully about what the next generation of finance roles should look like. AI and automation are already being deployed across the company, including in areas where repetitive finance work can be made considerably more efficient.

That makes strong technical accountants even more important. CircuitHub needs people who understand the numbers well enough to judge whether automated output is right, and who can use technology to improve how finance works without weakening control.

That combination of technical accounting, real ownership and a technology-enabled way of working is a central part of the opportunity.

The mandate

The Group Financial Accountant will take ownership of CircuitHub’s financial accounting across the UK and US. That means understanding how the books are put together, running a reliable close and being the person the Finance Director, the auditors and the outsourced accounting firm rely on for accurate, well-supported numbers.

Alongside the core accounts, the role will lead on technical accounting as the business scales. CircuitHub is investing heavily in manufacturing capacity and moving towards more flexible commercial models, which raises questions around revenue recognition, capitalisation and intercompany that need a clear owner.

The candidate must be willing to get their hands dirty to get a full appreciation of the sales cycle & work with the Finance Director to improve our systems and controls to improve our collection cycle, reducing DSO & further automation for our credit offering.

The candidate should have a good technical understanding in accounting that can lead to developing financial operations without complicating or delaying the reporting process. Developing our systems to improve the speed and efficiency of areas such as revenue recognition, R&D capitalisation & the consolidation process.

What you will work on

The precise balance will evolve with the candidate, but the remit is expected to include:

  • Financial accounting and close. Own month-end, including journals, accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations, with a clear understanding of how the accounts fit together.

  • Audit and statutory reporting. Act as the first point of contact for the auditors, manage their requests and prepare supporting schedules under UK GAAP and IFRS.

  • Technical accounting. Lead projects such as IFRS 15 revenue recognition, the capitalisation policy and the treatment of intercompany transactions as the business and its commercial models develop.

  • Group reporting. Support reporting across the UK and US entities, including intercompany reconciliations, and contribute to group consolidation in NetSuite where experience allows.

  • Outsourced provider management. Manage the relationship with the UK outsourced accounting firm, reviewing their output and holding it to the standard the group needs.

  • NetSuite and finance systems. Work directly in NetSuite and across the different systems and platforms that feed into it. Understand how data moves through the business rather than treating the accounting system in isolation.

  • AI and automation. Review and take ownership of automated and AI-generated finance output, making sure it is accurate and properly controlled, and help identify where further automation makes sense.

What success looks like

The first objective is to be a safe pair of hands. That means solving outstanding technical issues, taking ownership of monthly & quarterly close, a well-run audit and numbers the Finance Director and the team can trust without needing to revisit them.

From there, success means taking ownership of the technical agenda: a clear approach to revenue recognition as commercial models change, a robust capitalisation policy as CircuitHub invests in capacity, and clean intercompany accounting across the UK and US.

Over time, the finance team should have the capacity to report more frequently, stronger oversight of outsourced work and less technical accounting sitting with the Finance Director simply because nobody else can own it.

Processes should improve as well as move faster. Automation should remove low-value work without weakening financial control.

This is a role to build into over time. The scope will grow with the finance function and with the contribution the individual makes to it. As the business scales, the role is expected to grow into Group Financial Controller.

The person we are looking for

CircuitHub is looking for a qualified or near-qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA) with strong technical foundations. The specific qualification matters less than acumen, drive and personal qualities.

You are likely to have trained in practice, whether at a Big 4 or a top 20 firm, and be looking for your first move into an operating business. Alternatively, you may already be working in industry, in which case you will be qualified or close to qualifying.

The strongest signals are:

  • Relevant exposure. Experience getting the most out of NetSuite, working in a finance team to produce accounting information & ability to work autonomously and conscientiously to meet deadlines.

  • Technical grounding. Strong knowledge of UK GAAP and IFRS and a clear understanding of how a set of accounts is put together.

  • Technology fluency. You are comfortable working across systems and genuinely interested in how AI is changing finance. You see automation as a tool, not a substitute for judgement.

  • Practical curiosity. When something does not reconcile or a process feels unnecessarily difficult, your instinct is to understand why.

  • Commitment to building. You are motivated by breadth and ownership, and you want to build something over time in a growing business.

  • Interest in the business. CircuitHub sits at the intersection of software, robotics and physical manufacturing. You do not need an electronics background, but an interest in technology and how real products are built will make the environment much more compelling.

Why CircuitHub

This is a chance to join a profitable, fast-growing robotics and manufacturing business at a pivotal stage of scale, in a role with genuine technical ownership.

You will work closely with experienced qualified accountants and gain a breadth of exposure that is rare this early in an industry career: revenue recognition, capitalisation, intercompany, audit and reporting across a UK and US group.

You will also build for where finance is going next. CircuitHub is already using AI, automation and connected systems across the business, creating the opportunity to combine strong technical accounting with skills in systems, data and automation.

For someone with the capability and drive, there is real scope to grow as CircuitHub scales and the finance function builds out around it.

Pay

£75k–£85k, depending on experience, plus equity.

Comme l’ensemble de l’équipe de Business Développement, vous reposez sur un profil hybride dont les 2 piliers sont d’être :

  • Responsable du go-to-market conjoint avec nos partenaires technologiques stratégiques : co-construction des offres, des plans d’affaires et de la démarche de co-selling autour de nos capabilities auprès de clients et prospects,
  • Orchestrateur de l’écosystème en interne : enablement des équipes, montée en compétence et certifications sur les plateformes partenaires, pour activer la bonne expertise au sein de WPP Enterprise Solutions et du réseau WPP

Cette hybridation est la clé du succès : être à la fois moteur du business généré via l’écosystème partenaires et garant de la capacité des équipes à délivrer avec ces technologies.

Dimension Business :

  • Définit et déploie la stratégie de go-to-market et de marketing partenaires de WPP Enterprise Solutions avec ses partenaires technologiques stratégiques, afin de maximiser la valeur, la différenciation et le pipeline générés par l’écosystème,
  • Construit et anime les plans d’affaires conjoints (joint business plans) avec chaque partenaire clé (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), en pilotant objectifs, jalons et indicateurs de performance partagés,
  • Orchestre le co-selling et le co-marketing : aligne partenaires, équipes commerciales et Business Units pour transformer les opportunités de l’écosystème en deals, du sourcing à la conversion,
  • Conçoit et orchestre le plan d’événements dédiés ou co-construits avec les partenaires (webinaires, ateliers, salons, temps forts commerciaux), afin de générer visibilité, demande et pipeline,
  • Met en œuvre, en continu, l’excellence de la démarche partenaires via les processus et outils internes ainsi que les portails partenaires, à des fins de visibilité, de pilotage et d’animation globale en interne,
  • Sécurise et défend les intérêts économique et contractuel de WPP Enterprise Solutions dans le cadre des accords de partenariat (referral, reselling, MDF, niveaux de partenariat),
  • Pilote le niveau de préférence et de mindshare de nos partenaires à notre égard : positionne WPP Enterprise Solutions comme partenaire de référence dans leur écosystème, fait progresser notre niveau de partenariat et suit la performance des objectifs conjoints,
  • Contribue au thought leadership de WPP Enterprise Solutions sur les enjeux d’écosystème et de plateformes (IA, data, commerce, CX), via des prises de parole conjointes valorisant nos réussites dans une logique de ROI business,
  • Construit et fait vivre un patrimoine de connaissances sur l’écosystème technologique (roadmaps produits, niveaux et programmes de partenariat, dispositifs de financement) afin d’accélérer et de fluidifier l’action commerciale,
  • Incarne, diffuse et fait vivre l’excellence du modèle partenaires en interne, en particulier auprès des communautés commerciale et managériale, pour l’inspirer et développer son réflexe écosystème.

Dimension Enablement & Delivery :

  • Travaille de concert avec le CTO, à qui revient la responsabilité de l’enablement, des certifications et de la montée en compétences des équipes sur les plateformes partenaires ; il s’assure que ces chantiers progressent au rythme des priorités business et des engagements pris auprès des partenaires,
  • Veille à la disponibilité et à la capitalisation des assets conjoints (cas clients, références, supports de co-vente) et au partage des retours d’expérience.

Profil recherché

Vous justifiez de 5 à 10 ans d’expérience, dont une expérience significative en alliances / partenariats technologiques, channel ou business development – idéalement acquise en cabinet de conseil, ESN, agence ou chez un éditeur / hyperscaler.

Notre croissance reposant sur un écosystème de partenaires technologiques (Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, Shopify…), vous maîtrisez les mécaniques de co-selling, de co-marketing et de joint business planning.

Vous pouvez justifier de contributions ou de succès significatifs dans le cadre d’initiatives partenaires ou de développement business, au-delà d’en comprendre la logique ou les bonnes pratiques.

Votre capacité à nouer des relations de grande qualité, tant avec les équipes partenaires (alliance managers, channel, avant-vente) qu’avec les décideurs internes (Directions commerciales, Business Units, Marketing), fait de vous un orchestrateur d’écosystème performant, du sourcing d’opportunités à la conclusion de deals conjoints équilibrant les intérêts du partenaire, du client et de WPP Enterprise Solutions.

Les enjeux des plateformes technologiques et de l’écosystème IA / data / commerce vous passionnent, et vous savez vous appuyer sur vos expériences pour bâtir un discours solide en interne comme auprès des partenaires.

Votre rigueur et votre curiosité font de vous un acteur à la fois à l’aise dans la logique de développement business sur des clients existants que sur de la conquête opportuniste, ou en relai d’un partenaire.

La maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit, est indispensable : vous adressez des partenaires et des interlocuteurs internationaux de manière totalement autonome.

Tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Intégrer WPP Enterprise Solutions, c’est choisir d’évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, humain et innovant, propice au développement de chacun, à la réalisation de missions enrichissantes et aux évolutions de carrière. title: Head of Content Marketing (m/w/d) – B2B Personal Branding
descriptionHtml:
Du baust Founder-Brands, die Deals schließen?

Dann baue zwei B2B-Founder-Brands von 0 auf, steuere LinkedIn & Funnel und werde direkt am erzeugten Umsatz beteiligt.

Das ist eine Senior-Rolle mit voller Verantwortung, direkt an der Seite der beiden Gründer.

Vor 5,5 Jahren saßen wir zu zweit in einer WG in Düsseldorf. Kein Büro, kein Umsatz, keine Kunden. Nur ein Telefon.

Heute sind wir 35 Leute auf knapp 900 m² Office. Rügamer & Steiner ist eine E-Mail- und CRM-Marketing-Agentur für E-Commerce: Wir helfen Onlineshops, mehr Umsatz aus ihren Bestandskunden zu holen – mit E-Mail-Marketing, WhatsApp, Printmailings und datengetriebenem CRM. Für über 150 Shops steuern wir so über 200 Mio. € Jahresumsatz mit. Unser eigener Umsatz liegt im mittleren einstelligen Millionenbereich und hat sich seit der Gründung jedes Jahr verdoppelt.

Alles davon ist aus Telefonaten entstanden. Kein Marketing, keine Brand, kein Content. Erst haben wir selbst telefoniert, heute tut es ein 6-köpfiges Sales-Team, das gerade auf 10 wächst.

Unser Haken: Uns kennt kein Mensch.

Das ändern wir jetzt. Bis 2028 wollen wir 30 Mio. € Jahresumsatz machen und europäischer Marktführer werden in dem, was wir tun. Für unsere Kunden wollen wir jedes Jahr über 1 Mrd. € Umsatz bewegen. Dafür brauchen wir Sichtbarkeit. Und dafür brauchen wir dich.

Das Material liegt bereit: eine echte Geschichte, Zahlen, Cases und zwei Gründer, die jedes Jahr über 300.000 € investieren, um von den Besten zu lernen – unter anderem in der höchsten Mastermind von Alex Hormozi.

Deine Mission

  • Du baust die Personal Brands von Noah Rügamer und Aurelian Steiner auf – zuerst auf LinkedIn, später Newsletter, YouTube und Podcast.

  • Du entwickelst Positionierung, Content-Strategie, Formate, Hooks und Redaktionsplan – mit Fokus auf E-Commerce-Unternehmer, die mehr aus ihren Bestandskunden holen wollen.

  • Du baust den Weg von Reichweite zu Umsatz: Post → Kommentar oder DM → Termin → Auftrag für unser Sales-Team.

  • Du machst die Brands gleichzeitig zum Recruiting-Magneten für die besten Leute.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit uns Gründern: Content-Tage, Interviews, Skripte. Dein Ziel ist, dass wir so wenig Zeit wie möglich brauchen.

  • Daneben schärfst du den Marketing-Auftritt der Firma mit: Website, Ads, Bewerber-Kommunikation. Das ist der kleinere Teil.

Was du mitbringen musst

  • Du hast nachweislich eine B2B-Founder-Brand aufgebaut oder mit aufgebaut – deine eigene oder als Ghostwriter, Stratege oder Head of Content.

  • Über diese Brand ist nachweislich Umsatz entstanden: mindestens 100.000 € im Monat, idealerweise 200.000 bis 300.000 €.

  • Idealerweise kommst du aus dem B2B-Dienstleister- oder Agentur-Umfeld oder hast selbst eine Agentur über Personal Branding skaliert. Bonus: E-Commerce, Marketing oder SaaS.

  • Du denkst in Zahlen, nicht in Likes: Impressions → Leads → Termine → Aufträge.

  • Du bist stark in Strategie und dir trotzdem nicht zu schade, selbst Hooks zu schreiben, Posts zu veröffentlichen und DMs aufzusetzen.

  • Du arbeitest vor Ort in Düsseldorf.

Was wir bieten

  • 7.000 bis 10.000 € Fixgehalt im Monat. Mit variabler Vergütung sind 25.000 € und mehr im Monat möglich. Deine Ergebnisse bestimmen dein Gehalt.

  • Mentoring von den Besten auf dem internationalen Markt: Für Masterminds, Mentorings und Beratung geben wir jedes Jahr über 300.000 € aus, unter anderem für die höchste Mastermind von Alex Hormozi. Du bekommst Zugriff auf alle Inhalte und kommst als Teilnehmer mit auf die Events.

  • Direkter Draht zu beiden Gründern, keine Politik, keine Konzernstrukturen.

  • Ein hochmotiviertes Team, in 5,5 Jahren von 2 auf 35 Leute gewachsen.

  • Apple-Ausstattung, Urban Sports, Benefit-Card, Parkplatz, Team-Events.

So bewirbst du dich

Lade deinen Lebenslauf hoch und beantworte drei kurze Fragen: Links zu 1–3 Founder-Brands, für die du verantwortlich warst, welcher Umsatz darüber entstanden ist (3–5 Zeilen mit Zahlen) und dein LinkedIn-Profil.

title: Head of Sales, UK & Europe — Agentis Asset Management Services
descriptionHtml:
Our Firm

Asset Management Services (“AMS”) is the asset management practice of Agentis Capital Advisors, a global infrastructure advisory and investment platform. AMS manages more than 120 infrastructure assets representing over $35bn in enterprise value across renewables, public-private partnerships, digital and social infrastructure. We support our clients over the life of their assets through four service pillars:

  • Financial Model Management – We build, standardise, enhance and maintain the financial models behind our clients’ funds and portfolio companies

  • Financial Services Management – We run the accounting, budgeting, lender compliance and financial reporting for project companies

  • Operations Management – We oversee the day-to-day management of assets, including contract administration, performance monitoring, and board and stakeholder support

  • Fund Operations & Reporting – We maintain the fund-level valuation models, NAV and exit calculations, and leadership and LP reporting

AMS gives private markets and infrastructure investors one consistent, auditable and trusted view of their portfolios, delivered as a managed service. Our clients include leading infrastructure funds, pension funds, developers and project companies. Our guiding principles of excellence, client success, commitment, people and entrepreneurship set us apart.

The Opportunity

Private-markets managers and large asset owners run their portfolios on hundreds of inconsistent models, built by different advisors in different formats. Valuation, investor reporting and portfolio oversight are slow, manual and hard to audit. AMS solves this. We take over a client’s portfolio models, rebuild them to one standard on our technology-enabled platform, and deliver a live, fund-level view of the whole portfolio. We maintain and enhance it with our specialists on an ongoing basis.

We are looking for a Head of Sales, UK & Europe, based in London, to take this service to market and expand our client base. This is a hands-on, player-coach role, reporting to the Agentis Capital Managing Partners.

This role suits a commercially driven seller who has sold value-added services into funds (e.g., fund administration, back-office, data, valuation or portfolio-monitoring software and services), selling to CEOs, heads of asset management, CFOs, COOs and finance teams of private-markets managers. You want to own a territory and build a business, not inherit a book.

Our Differentiators

  • The first dedicated sales leader for a new AMS service line, shaping how it goes to market from day one

  • A differentiated product to sell: an exclusive, technology-enabled modelling and portfolio-reporting platform, delivered by Agentis professionals as a managed service and not as another software licence

  • Ability to build on Agentis’s long-standing relationships with infrastructure funds, pension funds and asset owners

  • A competitive base plus uncapped commission tied to the recurring revenue you bring in

  • The opportunity to hire and lead additional sales professionals as the business grows

  • An entrepreneurial culture with a flat structure and direct access to Partners and senior leadership, where good ideas are acted on quickly

Key Responsibilities

Build and Run the UK & European Pipeline

  • Own the UK and European target universe: private-markets fund managers (infrastructure and renewables first, then real estate and private equity), pension and institutional direct investors, and large asset-portfolio owners

  • Run a disciplined outbound campaign: prioritise and tier targets, secure first meetings and keep a steady weekly cadence of new conversations

  • Use Agentis’s existing relationships, working with Partners to convert warm introductions into qualified opportunities

  • Keep the CRM accurate as the system of record for contacts, meetings, pipeline stage, forecast and next steps

Win and Close Mandates

  • Lead the full sales cycle, from discovery and demonstrations to pilots, proposals, pricing, negotiation and signed multi-year mandates

  • Sell to multiple stakeholders: CFOs, COOs, heads of portfolio/asset management, valuation and investor relations, and the risk, IT and procurement teams who must approve the service

  • Run structured pilots and proofs of concept that turn into paying, recurring engagements

  • Address data-security, information-handling and technology questions with the AMS delivery team, including due-diligence questionnaires

  • Expand existing clients from an initial portfolio into wider fund, valuation and reporting work

Shape the Go-to-Market

  • Feed market insight into the sales narrative, buyer personas, objection handling, pricing and packaging

  • Help develop sales collateral, case studies, demonstrations and the website, using the platform’s outputs as proof points

  • Represent AMS at industry conferences and events across the UK and Europe, and build the service’s profile in the market

  • Track competitors and adjacent offerings, and report what is winning and losing deals

Build the Sales Team

  • As the business grows, recruit, onboard and lead additional sales professionals

  • Coordinate with the North American sales lead on shared global clients, consistent messaging and pipeline reporting

Partner with Delivery

  • Work closely with the AMS modelling and delivery team so that what is sold can be delivered well and on time

  • Ensure a smooth handover from sale to delivery during onboarding, set realistic client expectations and support client change management

  • Report weekly to the Partners and AMS steering group on pipeline, conversion, forecast and market feedback


Skills and Experience

  • A substantial and proven track record in B2B sales or business development, including selling value-added services, data or software into funds or institutional investors

  • Experience selling fund administration, fund accounting, back-office, valuation, portfolio-monitoring, investor-reporting or financial-data solutions to private-markets managers is strongly preferred

  • A proven ability to open new doors and close complex, consultative, multi-stakeholder sales with long cycles and recurring revenue

  • A working understanding of how funds and portfolio companies are valued, modelled and reported

  • An existing network of finance and asset management leaders at UK and European private-markets managers, pension funds or asset owners is a strong asset

  • Comfort selling a technology-enabled service, and explaining data-security and AI-governance safeguards with credibility to risk-averse buyers

  • Self-motivated and entrepreneurial: comfortable building process, collateral and pipeline from scratch in a start-up setting within an established firm

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication and presentation skills

  • Infrastructure, renewables or real-assets experience is an asset


Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation arrangement including an uncapped commission on recurring revenue

  • Eligibility for the Agentis employee ownership programme and access to principal investment opportunities alongside Partners, subject to programme terms

title: Head of Talent Acquisition at Private Equity Insights

Do you want to be part of an exceptional entrepreneurial team with motivated and extremely driven people? And are you curious or passionate about people? If so, you might be our next Head of Talent Acquisition.

About us

Private Equity Insights is the world's leading Private Equity community. We connect and develop more than 240,000 investment professionals across the world, through our platforms, which include conferences, webinars, magazines and news reports.

Private Equity Insights is part of United Media (https://www.united-media.com/) which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.

What we offer you

Flexible

title: HR Business Partner, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Hi! I'm Hannah and I lead the HRBP Team here at Ashby. I joined over four years ago as the first People hire, and I'm excited that our team is expanding! The People Team provides support to Ashby employees through the development and implementation of programs, policies, and services that contribute to a productive and inclusive working environment. We ensure that the work we do aligns with our Operating Principles and strengthens the environment we're building at Ashby. Our approach is to do things differently; we prioritize what truly fits our team and enhances how we work together. By embracing creativity and customization, we aim to create a people-first culture that drives both individual and organizational success.

We review all applications, and there's no benefit to applying quickly. Take your time, look over the application questions, and please submit before the application deadline! We can't take calls outside the interview process, so reaching out to the team won't move your application forward.

Role overview:
We're looking for an experienced, UK-based HR Business Partner (HRBP) to play a key role in supporting Ashby’s next phase of growth and to be Ashby's first dedicated HR presence in EMEA. You'll be the go-to People partner for our EMEA leaders and employees. You'll bring the local expertise we need around UK employment law, benefits, employee relations, and entity compliance, and you'll work closely with our US-based HR Business Partners, who also support teams in the region. Building strong relationships, getting the details right, and creating a great employee experience should all be equally important to you.

As our HRBP for EMEA, you'll translate business objectives into a people strategy that fits how Ashby operates in the region. You'll be a trusted advisor to leaders and work closely with our wider People team, while also diving into the details to make sure our processes and procedures run smoothly. We're a growing startup, so there's a lot to accomplish! You'll move easily between strategic projects and administrative tasks and support the team wherever it's needed. In this role, you'll join a high-impact team that is rethinking how People Ops can and should work, while shaping an exceptional workplace culture for our global team.

Role requirements:

  • UK employment expertise: You have deep, hands-on knowledge of UK employment law and practice, including contracts, benefits and pensions, leave, performance and separation processes, and workplace requirements. You know when to partner with external counsel and advisors, and you help us reduce risk while staying true to how Ashby operates.

  • Strategic HR partner: At your core, you build strong relationships with leaders and earn credibility and trust as a strategic partner. You proactively assess team, manager, and company needs, make recommendations, and put solutions in place.

  • People Operations Expertise: You bring broad knowledge of People Ops and HR, including compensation, benefits, performance management, and compliance, and you're happy to roll up your sleeves on projects outside your core remit.

  • Multi-country and entity support: You've supported employees across multiple EMEA countries and understand how working through an entity differs from working through an EOR. You're ready to help as we expand our footprint.

  • Strategic Thinking: You have the ability to translate business objectives into actionable people strategies

  • Strong Communicator: You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can effectively convey information to all stakeholders and have the ability to present and facilitate discussions clearly and confidently.

  • Compensation Expertise: You have experience using compensation market data to develop and maintain competitive, equitable compensation practices, with an understanding of how to apply market data across EMEA and other international regions.

  • Performance Management: You have deep experience building and evolving performance management practices. You are comfortable coaching managers through difficult performance conversations and helping build scalable approaches that align with company culture and operating principles.

  • Training and Development: You have experience building and scaling internal training programs, specifically for management teams. You are comfortable facilitating topics to all levels of employees.

  • Employee Relations & Risk Management: You offer guidance to leaders in managing sensitive employee situations. As needed, you act as a mediator and investigate escalated issues. You stay up to date on legal requirements related to employment and regulatory compliance, partnering with legal counsel as needed to mitigate risk.

You could be a great fit if:

  • 💻 You have deep experience (~8 years) in HR or People Ops, ideally in a high-growth, scaling company

  • 🇬🇧 You're a UK-based HR generalist with strong expertise in UK employment law, benefits, and employee relations

  • 🌍 You've supported a globally distributed, asynchronous workforce across multiple EMEA countries

  • 🔑 You take real ownership. You move work forward on your own, keep the right people in the loop, and see things through

  • 🧭 You're a principled thinker who wants to understand why things work the way they do before deciding what should change

  • 📣 You communicate clearly and directly, with strengths in coaching, facilitation, and policy development

  • 🔄 You are flexible in your approach and avoid rigid adherence to past playbooks or overly process-heavy solutions.

  • ⚡️ You're energized by a fast-paced environment with a mix of strategic and hands-on work

  • 🤝 Handling complex employee relations issues is one of your strengths

  • ⚙️ Continuous Improvement is core to how you operate. You're detail-oriented and always looking for ways to improve People Ops processes and documentation

  • 🔍 You've used HRIS, compensation tools, and other HR systems to drive operational excellence

Bonus points if you have:

  • An advanced degree in HR, business, or organizational development

  • CIPD qualification (Level 5 or 7) or an equivalent HR certification

This role may not be a fit if:

  • You’re looking to simply bring processes or programs from previous roles and implement them here. While past experience is valuable, you'll need to apply principled thinking to assess what would work well for Ashby.

  • Working independently feels uncomfortable and you require a significant amount of guidance in how to perform your job.

  • Having difficult conversations with all levels of employees makes you uneasy

  • You shy away from ambiguity - preferring structured, pre-defined assignments.

  • You prefer working with a single team instead of multiple teams.

Interview process
Our interview process is thorough. We want to make sure everyone who joins is the right fit for Ashby, and we'll give you plenty of information to decide whether Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is:

  • Recruiter screen with the Talent Acquisition team (30 minutes)

  • People Ops team interview (45 minutes)

  • Take-home assignment (1 hour)

  • People Leader interview (45 minutes)

  • Virtual onsite (2–3 hours)

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby -do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited holiday with five weeks recommended per year on top of UK bank holidays. Expect "Holiday?" on our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • A generous budget for equipment, software, and office furniture. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • Top-notch supplemental health insurance (private medical and dental) for you and your dependents, with premiums covered by us, plus company-paid life insurance + income protection, and a workplace pension with a 3% Ashby contribution.

  • Generous family leave. You'll get your full statutory family leave entitlement, and Ashby pays the first 12 weeks at 100%.

  • £100/month education budget, with bigger items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby's success depends on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We're being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

Für meinen Mandanten, ein international erfolgreiches Industrieunternehmen am Standort Hückelhoven-Baal, suche ich einen erfahrenen HR Business Partner (m/w/d) im Rahmen einer auf zwölf Monate befristeten Vertretung.

Im Mittelpunkt steht eine vielseitige Position, in der Sie das lokale Management beraten, personalwirtschaftliche Themen eigenverantwortlich begleiten und Ihre Expertise insbesondere bei arbeitsrechtlichen und tariflichen Fragestellungen einbringen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Beratung und Unterstützung des lokalen Managements als kompetenter Sparringspartner in sämtlichen personalwirtschaftlichen und arbeitsrechtlichen Fragen

  • Vertrauensvolle und konstruktive Zusammenarbeit mit dem Betriebsrat

  • Verantwortung für HR-Themen rund um das ERA-Entgeltrahmenabkommen, insbesondere Eingruppierungsfragen und entsprechende Projekte

  • Beratung und Begleitung von Führungskräften bei Personalentwicklung, Mitarbeiterführung und organisatorischen Veränderungen

  • Verantwortung für das lokale Recruiting und Begleitung personeller Maßnahmen

  • Umsetzung der HR-Strategie sowie Sicherstellung effizienter HR-Prozesse, -Systeme und -Instrumente

  • Begleitung von Veränderungs- und Organisationsentwicklungsprozessen

  • Mitarbeit an standortübergreifenden HR-Projekten und Implementierung neuer HR-Lösungen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den nationalen und internationalen HR-Funktionen

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare qualifizierte Ausbildung mit Schwerpunkt Personalmanagement, Betriebswirtschaft oder Arbeitsrecht

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als HR Business Partner, Personalreferent oder Personalleiter (m/w/d), idealerweise in einem produzierenden Industrieunternehmen

  • Fundierte arbeitsrechtliche Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Betriebsräten

  • Gute Kenntnisse des ERA-Entgeltrahmenabkommens sowie Erfahrung mit tariflichen Eingruppierungen

  • Sicherheit in der Beratung von Führungskräften und ein gutes Verständnis für betriebliche Zusammenhänge

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Empathie und ein souveränes Auftreten

  • Eine pragmatische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit modernen HR-Systemen, idealerweise Workday

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

Besonders wichtig ist meinem Mandanten, dass Sie sich aufgrund Ihrer bisherigen Erfahrung zügig in bestehende Strukturen einfinden und die anstehenden HR-Themen eigenständig und zuverlässig begleiten können.

Das erwartet Sie

  • Attraktive Jahresvergütung von ca. 75.000 bis zu 85.000 € brutto, abhängig von Ihrer Erfahrung und der konkreten Vergütungsvereinbarung

  • Vollzeitbeschäftigung mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und Gleitzeit

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld sowie vermögenswirksame Leistungen

  • Verantwortungsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit Gestaltungsspielraum

  • Ein international erfolgreiches Industrieunternehmen mit modernem Produktionsumfeld

  • Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Unternehmenskultur

  • Individuelle Einarbeitung und Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen HR-Kolleginnen und -Kollegen

Bewusst befristet – trotzdem eine interessante Aufgabe!

Die Position ist aufgrund einer Vertretung zunächst auf zwölf Monate befristet. Eine anschließende Weiterbeschäftigung kann derzeit nicht zugesagt werden.

Vielleicht befinden Sie sich gerade in einer beruflichen Phase, in der Sie sich nicht mehr langfristig binden möchten. Oder Sie suchen ganz bewusst eine zeitlich überschaubare Aufgabe, bei der Sie Ihre Erfahrung und Ihr Fachwissen einbringen können.

Entscheidend sind Ihre fachliche Kompetenz, Ihre Motivation und Ihre Freude an der Personalarbeit – nicht, wie langfristig Sie Ihre weitere berufliche Zukunft planen.

Habe ich Ihr Interesse geweckt?

Dann freue ich mich darauf, Sie kennenzulernen!

Senden Sie mir gerne Ihren Lebenslauf mit Angabe Ihres frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins. Auch wenn Sie zunächst Fragen zur Position oder zur Befristung haben, sprechen Sie mich gerne an.

Ich begleite diese Besetzung persönlich im Rahmen der Direktvermittlung. Der befristete Arbeitsvertrag wird direkt mit meinem Mandanten geschlossen.

title: HR Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Agieren Sie als vertrauenswürdiger HR Business Partner und beraten Führungskräfte strategisch sowie operativ in allen personalrelevanten Fragestellungen.

  • Unterstützen und begleiten Sie Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte während des gesamten Employee Lifecycles und fördern Sie eine positive Employee Experience sowie ein hohes Engagement.

  • Steuern und koordinieren Sie HR-Initiativen in den Bereichen Talententwicklung, Performance Management und Mitarbeiterbindung.

  • Gestalten und begleiten Sie den Performance-Management-Prozess, einschließlich Zielvereinbarungen, Leistungsbeurteilungen und individueller Entwicklungspläne.

  • Analysieren Sie HR-Kennzahlen und Personaldaten, identifizieren Sie Trends und leiten Sie geeignete Maßnahmen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung ab.

  • Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Talent Acquisition Team und den Führungskräften zusammen, um eine hochwertige Recruiting- und Onboarding-Erfahrung sicherzustellen.

  • Stellen Sie die Einhaltung arbeitsrechtlicher Vorgaben, interner Richtlinien und HR-Standards sicher und beraten Sie Führungskräfte zu Best Practices.

  • Unterstützen Sie organisatorische Veränderungsprozesse, die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Betriebsrat sowie komplexe arbeitsrechtliche und mitarbeiterbezogene Themen, um den nachhaltigen Unternehmenserfolg zu fördern.

Qualifikationen

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Human Resources, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder in einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet.

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer generalistischen HR-/People-Funktion innerhalb eines größeren, international ausgerichteten Unternehmens.

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Arbeitsrecht, in HR-Richtlinien sowie in modernen Personalmanagement-Praktiken.

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Wort und Schrift.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen sowie Erfahrung im Arbeiten mit HR-Systemen und digitalen Tools.

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeit im Stakeholder-Management sowie im Aufbau und der Pflege vertrauensvoller Beziehungen auf allen Unternehmensebenen.

  • Analytische Denkweise und Erfahrung in der Nutzung von HR-Kennzahlen, Datenanalysen und Insights zur Unterstützung fundierter Entscheidungen.

  • Hohe Organisationsfähigkeit sowie eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten gleichzeitig zu managen, Fristen einzuhalten und sowohl eigenverantwortlich als auch im Team erfolgreich zu arbeiten.

Über DP World


Handel ist das Lebensblut der Weltwirtschaft, er schafft Chancen und verbessert die Lebensqualität der Menschen auf der ganzen Welt. DP World existiert, um den weltweiten Handelsfluss zu verbessern und die Möglichkeiten für die Kunden und Gemeinschaften, die wir weltweit bedienen, zu verändern.


Mit einem engagierten, vielfältigen und professionellen Team von mehr als 115.000 Mitarbeitern aus 159 Nationalitäten in 77 Ländern auf sechs Kontinenten treibt DP World den Handel weiter und schneller voran, hin zu einer nahtlosen Lieferkette, die für die Zukunft gerüstet ist.


Wir transformieren und integrieren unsere Geschäftsbereiche – Häfen und Terminals, Seeverkehrsdienste, Logistik und Technologie – schnell und vereinen unsere globale Infrastruktur mit lokaler Expertise, um stärkere, effizientere End-to-End-Lieferkettenlösungen zu schaffen, die den weltweiten Handel verändern können.


Darüber hinaus gestalten wir die Zukunft neu, indem wir in Innovationen investieren. Von intelligenten Liefersystemen bis hin zur automatisierten Lagerbeladung sind wir auf dem neuesten Stand der disruptiven Technologie und treiben den Sektor zu besseren Handelsmethoden an, um Störungen von der Fabrikhalle bis zur Haustür des Kunden zu minimieren.


DP World hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, Grenzen zu überschreiten und die Kluft zwischen allen Nationen und Kulturen zu überbrücken – nicht nur in dem, was wir tun, sondern auch in unserem Verhalten.


Wir sind bestrebt, eine Kultur zu schaffen, in der sich jeder respektiert, unterstützt und befähigt fühlt, sein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Wir glauben, dass die Akzeptanz von Inklusion und Vielfalt Innovation und Wachstum vorantreibt und uns hilft, Menschen, Unternehmen und Gesellschaften zu verbinden. Freie Geister und unterschiedliche Perspektiven verändern unsere Welt, und gemeinsam können wir verändern, was möglich ist.


Die DP World-Familie besteht aus Syncreon, Imperial und P&O.

TO CHANGE WHAT'S POSSIBLE FOR EVERYONE.

title: HR Teamlead
descriptionHtml:
Voor Interconnect, een toonaangevende Nederlandse aanbieder van data- en clouddiensten, is Staffplanning op zoek naar een ervaren en ondernemende HR Teamlead. Een mooie kans voor een HR-professional die graag een team aanstuurt, het management adviseert en HR-processen verder professionaliseert.

De functieAls HR Teamlead geef je leiding aan het HR-team van Interconnect, bestaande uit een HR Business Partner en twee HR-medewerkers. Het team maakt onderdeel uit van de afdeling Business Support.Samen zorgen jullie voor goed functionerende HR-processen op het gebied van instroom, doorstroom, uitstroom, verzuimmanagement, personeelsplanning en performance management.Je bent een belangrijke sparringpartner voor directie en management en vertaalt strategische HR-doelstellingen naar concrete verbeteringen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met de HR Business Partner, die zich voornamelijk richt op de teamleiders binnen de organisatie.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Aansturen, begeleiden en coachen van het HR-team.

  • Adviseren van directie en management over tactische en operationele HR-vraagstukken.

  • Bijdragen aan de ontwikkeling en uitvoering van de HR-strategie.

  • Initiëren en begeleiden van HR-projecten en verbetertrajecten.

  • Deelnemen aan het periodieke teamleidersoverleg en overleg met de ondernemingsraad.

Wie ben jij?

Interconnect zoekt een praktische, communicatief sterke en resultaatgerichte HR-professional die zowel op tactisch als operationeel niveau kan schakelen.Je hebt plezier in het begeleiden van collega's, weet mensen mee te nemen in veranderingen en voelt je thuis in een organisatie met korte lijnen.Je beschikt over:

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur HRM of Personeel & Organisatie.

  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring als HR Teamlead, HR Business Partner of in een vergelijkbare functie.

  • Actuele kennis van HR-processen en arbeidswetgeving.

  • Sterke communicatieve en adviserende vaardigheden.

  • Een proactieve, zelfstandige en oplossingsgerichte instelling.

  • Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 32 uur per week.

Wat biedt Interconnect?

Je komt terecht bij een stabiel en groeiend familiebedrijf waar professionaliteit, samenwerking en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tot € 5.500 op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. Voor zeer ervaren kandidaten is een hoger salaris bespreekbaar.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

Over Interconnect

Interconnect is een Nederlands familiebedrijf dat sinds 1995 actief is in de wereld van IT-infrastructuur, datacenters en clouddiensten. Met ongeveer 130 medewerkers en eigen Tier III-datacenters in ’s-Hertogenbosch en Eindhoven levert Interconnect veilige en betrouwbare IT-oplossingen aan onder andere managed service providers, softwarebedrijven en zakelijke eindgebruikers. title: Human Resources Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role
You'll own the people agenda for our teams in France, where the large majority of Vibe's engineering and product talent sit. You'll be the go-to HR partner for our technical organization, working hand in hand with the CTO, the SVP Product, and the SVP Engineering, while leading employee relations and French labor law compliance across France. You'll report to our HRBP Director in New York and partner closely with our Chief People Officer, based in Paris. This role exists because our European headcount is scaling fast and the technical org needs a dedicated partner on the ground. You'll get real ownership of a strategic region, direct exposure to senior technical leaders, and the chance to shape how we grow talent across three continents.


What You'll Do

  • Partner with leaders on the full talent lifecycle, from onboarding to retention.

  • Serve as the primary HR partner to the CTO, SVP Product, and SVP Engineering on their technical teams.

  • Lead employee relations across France, from everyday cases to complex situations.

  • Own compliance with French labor law across all people practices.

  • Coach managers across the region to raise the bar on people management.

  • Advise on organizational design as the technical org scales.

  • Build career frameworks that give technical teams clear growth paths.

  • Adapt company-wide People programs to the local context: Total Rewards, performance, mobility.

What You Need

  • 3–5 years as an HRBP or HR generalist, including time in both a scale-up and a larger group.

  • Working knowledge of French labor law and employee relations.

  • Experience supporting engineering and product teams.

  • Fluency in English (our working language) and French.

  • Familiarity with People programs like Total Rewards, performance cycles, or internal mobility.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience partnering with teams across multiple countries and time zones.

  • A track record of connecting people decisions to business outcomes.

Our Values
At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.
You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.
This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.
If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.


What We Offer

The pay range for this role is €60,000–€90,000.
At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

  • Equity — Employee Stock Ownership Plan. You're building this; you should own part of it.

  • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

  • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

  • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

  • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

  • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

Our Interview Process
We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect — no surprises, no ghosting.

  • Recruiter screen — 30 min. We'll share context; you'll share yours.

title: Influencer & Branded Content  Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
We are PMG

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.

Who You'll Be Working With

At PMG, our Influencer & Branded Content team is at the intersection of culture, storytelling, and strategy, helping brands connect with audiences in authentic, meaningful ways. We craft high-impact influencer campaigns that go beyond traditional advertising, driving engagement, building brand affinity, and delivering measurable results across social, digital, and experiential platforms.

As the Influencer & Branded Content Senior Manager, you’ll play a key leadership role in shaping and delivering influencer and creator strategies across PMG’s clients. You’ll collaborate with creators, talent agencies, media strategists, content teams, client leaders, and brand partners to develop programs that connect cultural relevance with business impact. You’ll help strengthen PMG’s influencer and creator marketing capabilities by establishing scalable best practices, developing strong talent and platform relationships, and ensuring a high standard of strategy, execution, measurement, and client service.

You’ll help advance the future of branded content at PMG by identifying emerging creator trends, exploring new content formats and platforms, and translating innovation into actionable opportunities for clients. You’ll also lead and develop team members, helping them strengthen their strategic thinking, channel expertise, and ability to deliver exceptional work.

If you’re passionate about shaping culture through creator-driven storytelling, using data to guide meaningful decisions, and building innovative influencer programs that deliver measurable impact, this is the place to make your mark.

What You Will Do

  • Lead full-scale influencer and branded content campaigns from brief to delivery—including strategy development, talent identification, negotiations, publisher partnerships, content approvals, and reporting—translating business objectives, audience insights, and cultural trends into impactful creator programs.
  • Oversee campaign strategy and execution in partnership with internal team members, ensuring every detail is delivered with excellence, on time, aligned with brand standards and client business objectives, and optimized for measurable success.
  • Manage and mentor a team of professionals, supporting workload planning, day-to-day execution, coaching, feedback, performance management, and long-term professional development while building a culture of collaboration, creativity, and accountability.
  • Partner with the Director of Influencer & Branded Content to help evolve PMG’s offerings, develop scalable frameworks, best practices, processes, and measurement approaches, and train team members to grow their expertise and impact.
  • Serve as a senior subject matter expert in influencer marketing and branded content, bringing a strong point of view to client conversations, strategic recommendations, new business opportunities, and emerging creator trends.
  • Serve as a senior point of contact for clients, clearly communicating strategic plans, campaign updates, recommendations, and results through regular calls, emails, and in-person meetings.
  • Develop innovative influencer and branded content programs for existing clients and new business opportunities, partnering closely with account, strategy, media, and creative teams to connect creator ideas to broader marketing objectives.
  • Play an active role in new business efforts, contributing to RFPs, pitch development, influencer research, and presentation storytelling.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creators, talent agencies, publishers, and platform partners to expand access to talent, industry insights, platform innovation, and strategic opportunities.
  • Bring platform fluency across both established and emerging social channels, shaping creator strategies that are native to each platform.
  • Track and distill influencer marketing trends into practical strategies that keep our work relevant, fresh, and forward-thinking.
  • Apply and evolve measurement frameworks to evaluate creator performance, campaign effectiveness, audience engagement, and business impact, translating results into actionable recommendations for clients.
  • Provide strategic guidance and quality oversight across campaign planning, creator selection, contracting, content approvals, reporting, compliance, and partnership deliverables.
  • Partner with senior leaders to identify opportunities to improve team processes, resource planning, capabilities, and approaches that support continued client and business growth.
  • Use AI, automation, and technology to elevate the quality and efficiency of work, streamline processes, and enable faster, more informed decision-making.
  • The primary focus of this role is the Influencer & Branded Content channel, ensuring excellence in strategy, execution, and performance. However, responsibilities may extend across other media channels as needed to support broader campaign objectives and business priorities.

What You Will Bring

  • 6+ years of experience in Influencer & Branded Content, including 3+ years of leadership experience, with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • You bring advanced expertise in content creation and influencer marketing strategy, developing creator-led programs that connect cultural insight, platform behavior, audience needs, and client business goals.
  • You have strong experience in contract review and proposal development, navigating creator and partnership negotiations with clarity, consistency, and a focus on delivering value for clients and partners.
  • You bring exceptional attention to detail, maintaining high standards across campaign execution, reporting, content approvals, compliance, and partnership deliverables.
  • You have strong proficiency in project implementation, leading complex influencer and branded content programs from strategic planning through launch, optimization, and post-campaign learning.
  • You are skilled in presentation and communication, delivering clear strategic narratives, senior-level recommendations, and performance insights to clients, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • You have a deep understanding of advertising standards, client service, and relationship management, helping brands and creators build trusted partnerships that meet business, legal, and platform expectations.
  • You are proficient with influencer management dashboards, social media platforms, and the broader social media ecosystem, using data to evaluate creators, guide recommendations, and improve campaign performance.
  • You have experience building relationships across the influencer marketing ecosystem, including creators, talent agencies, publishers, and platform partners, and leveraging those relationships to strengthen client programs.
  • You bring strategic thinking, business and financial acumen, and thoughtful resource management to guide account priorities, team planning, and scalable approaches to client growth.
  • You have demonstrated experience managing and developing team members, balancing day-to-day leadership with coaching, feedback, performance management, and long-term professional development.
  • A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a Customer-Focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value.
  • A dedication to People-Focused leadership, fostering collaboration, innovation, and professional growth by Leading by Example and nurturing strong relationships that empower others to excel.

What We Offer

Performance-Based Rewards: Your impact should be part of your reward. This role is eligible for PMG’s annual bonus program—a standout part of our total compensation offering and an opportunity to share in our success. Bonus awards are informed by individual impact and performance, as well as team and company results, and are subject to applicable program terms.

Professional Development: Keep growing through learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and support for career advancement.

Generous Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge, connect with loved ones, and enjoy life outside work.

Parental Leave: Receive paid parental leave during life’s important family moments.

Retirement Benefits: Build for your future with competitive retirement benefits, including employer contributions or matching where applicable.

Fertility and Family Support: Access fertility and family-building benefits for eligible employees and their spouses or partners.

Healthcare: Choose from medical, dental, and vision coverage designed to support you and your family.

Pet Insurance: Access optional coverage for the four-legged members of your family.

Lifestyle Spending Account: Receive company-funded support for eligible health and well-being expenses.

Commuter Benefits: Access support for your commute where available.

Volunteering Opportunities: Receive eight paid hours each year to give back to your community.

AI Tools and Training: Access enterprise AI tools and ongoing training that helps PMGers use AI effectively, creatively, and responsibly.

Our benefits and compensation programs may vary by location and eligibility and are subject to applicable plan terms. We’ll share full details during the hiring process.

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way.

In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that we only change for the better by bringing diverse perspectives to our company. PMG recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Intern - Founders Associate (f/m/d) Fintech Startup (Serial Entrepreneurs) Starting in January 2027
descriptionHtml:
We co-founded and led Viafintech (Barzahlen) to 100+ FTE, one of the most successful German fintechs, active in 17 markets across the EU and USA, and sold it in 2021 for a € three-digit million amount to NYSE-listed Paysafe Group.

Now we’re off to our next venture. This time we’re building a global champion for prepaid products: gift cards (Apple, Amazon, Google), airtime and eCash, all in one simple API. Think of finperks as a Stripe/Adyen for all prepaid products and payments.

We started in summer 2025. Since then, we’ve raised a $4M pre-seed round led by Motive Partners, built access to more than 1,000 brands across Europe, and gone live with 11 clients.

Many people completely underestimate the market size: about €600bn sold per year today, going to €1.8tn by 2028.

Instead of 5 players in the chain (brand → issuing tech provider → global distributor → local distributor → client), we connect brands directly with clients via the finperks platform.

We’re a team of 20 in Berlin-Charlottenburg. A mix of our best people from the last journey and brilliant new joiners. High ownership. Low ego. Kind humans. We ship fast, help each other, and celebrate wins.

Join early. Help build the global champion for prepaid.

Tasks

As a Founders Associate Intern, you’ll work directly alongside the founding team and be involved in every aspect of building finperks. As we move fast, your tasks and responsibilities will evolve with the company – expect new topics to land on your desk regularly.

  • Brand Approvals: Own brand approval workflows across clients, markets and suppliers – from building client-specific brand lists to preparing one-pagers and volume forecasts for suppliers and tracking approvals until brands go live

  • Sales Support & GTM Automation: Build and run outreach campaigns, create and enrich lead lists, and prepare tailored offers and materials for clients and brands

  • Strategic Projects: Work on founder-level topics such as market entry, internationalization and pricing, building your own analyses and decision materials. You’ll also be involved in our next funding round by preparing fundraising and due diligence materials

  • Operational Excellence & Automation: Build internal tools, trackers and automations (e.g. with AI tools) that help us scale

  • Client Onboarding: Support new clients from contract signing to go-live, including product setup in our platform and supplier coordination

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales, brand & supplier, product and tech to drive projects across team boundaries – and occasionally represent finperks at conferences, events or client dinners

Requirements

  • Drive & Ambition: You’re motivated to go the extra mile and thrive in fast-paced, dynamic startup environments

  • Analytical Mindset: You’re proficient in Excel and PowerPoint and comfortable working with CRM tools and Notion, with strong analytical skills and the ability to quickly grasp complex business models and market dynamics

  • Organized & Detail-Oriented: You keep many workstreams on track at once and care about getting the details right

  • Tech-Savvy: You’re comfortable with AI tools and can implement small automations independently

  • Communication Skills: Excellent English; German is a plus. Any additional European language (e.g. French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Romanian) is a big advantage

  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: You’re excited about building something from scratch and comfortable with ambiguity and rapid iteration

  • Location: You’re willing to relocate to Berlin and work from our office in Berlin-Charlottenburg

Nice to have: Prior startup/FinTech or Consulting experience

Benefits

  • Learn from Proven Entrepreneurs: Work directly with founders who’ve built and successfully exited one of Germany’s most successful FinTech companies

  • Ownership from Day One: You’ll be a full team member with real responsibility and the opportunity to shape the company’s direction

  • Deep Startup Ecosystem Access: Immerse yourself in Berlin’s vibrant startup scene and build a network that will accelerate your career

  • Insights into Scaling a Startup: Experience first-hand how a venture grows from its first clients to expansion across Europe, and learn how business models, markets and partnerships are evaluated along the way

  • Venture Capital Insights: Get close to the investment side through our next funding round, learning how investors evaluate startups and make investment decisions

Ready to build the next Unicorn in FinTech?

Join us at finperks and help us financially empower people across Europe. If you’re excited about the opportunity to learn from experienced entrepreneurs while making real impact, we want to hear from you!
