title: iOS Engineer - Design System
descriptionHtml:
About the team:

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide.

What you’ll do:

  • Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem
  • Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful
  • Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation
  • Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development
  • Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

You’ll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications
  • Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each
  • Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable
  • Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought
  • Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation
  • Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team
  • Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment
  • Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team

Why you should join SumUp:

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide.

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced.

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp’s future success.

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advancing your career through further education.

💶 Competitive Health & Life Insurance: Includes comprehensive cover (optical, dental) and Life Assurance (2 x your salary).

💰 Financial Future: A corporate pension scheme and a referral bonus for bringing in top talent.

🏖️ Generous time off: 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days.

🌴 Break4me: 1-month paid sabbatical after 3 years of service.

🎉 Culture of Connection: Attend global offsites and/or hackathons with your teammates.

About SumUp

We believe in the everyday hero.

Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating tools that help them run their businesses. With a founder’s mentality and a 'team-first’ attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America and the United States work together to ensure that the small business owners we partner with can be successful doing what they love. 

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

SumUp will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

descriptionHtml:
• Take ownership of the development of IoT systems, with a focus on embedded software, system architecture, and hardware and firmware integration

  • Design and develop robust, efficient, and scalable embedded software for IoT products based on microcontroller platforms and, optionally, Linux based systems

title: Junior Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Lumiform ist eine spezialisierte Software, mit der Frontline-Teams Inspektionen, Audits und Checklisten skalierbar über viele Standorte hinweg durchführen. Gegründet 2019 in Berlin, hauptsächlich für europäische Unternehmen gebaut. Unternehmen wie EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media und Nordsee sowie Prüf-, Inspektions- und Zertifizierungsgesellschaften setzen auf Lumiform (4,6 von 5 auf G2).

Jährlich laufen über unsere Plattform Millionen von Prüfungen. Jede einzelne macht einen Arbeitsplatz sicherer, einen Prozess effizienter oder ein Produkt oder einen Service besser. Wenn du mit deiner Arbeit einen Unterschied in der Gesellschaft machen möchtest, dann arbeitest du hier an einem Produkt, das genau das jeden Tag tut.

Über die Rolle

Das ist eine Rolle für jemanden, der den nächsten Schritt gehen will. Du bringst bereits 1 bis 2 Jahre Customer Success mit und willst jetzt echte Verantwortung: dein eigenes Portfolio aus namhaften Enterprise-Kunden, das dir gehört und das du weiterentwickelst.

Deine zentrale Kennzahl ist die Net Revenue Retention deines Portfolios. Das heißt, du denkst kommerziell und erkennst Wachstumspotenziale, kannst aber genauso souverän deeskalieren, kritische Situationen drehen und Churn verhindern, bevor er entsteht. Du bekommst kein „Startpaket" aus kalten Leads, sondern ein starkes Bestandsportfolio mit starken Marken, das nur darauf wartet, ausgebaut zu werden.

Aufgaben

  • Ownership deines Portfolios: Du verantwortest ein eigenes Book of Business aus namhaften Enterprise-Kunden, treibst es proaktiv statt auf Anfragen oder schlechte Health-Scores zu warten, und entwickelst es strategisch weiter.

  • Net Revenue Retention steigern: Du treibst Renewals, erkennst Expansion-Potenziale (zusätzliche Use Cases, Standorte, neue Buying Center) und machst aus zufriedenen Kunden wachsende Accounts.

  • Strategischer Sparringspartner auf Entscheider-Ebene: Du erarbeitest dir Zugang zu den relevanten Stakeholdern, führst strategische Account-Reviews und wirst zum Trusted Advisor deiner Kunden.

  • Deeskalation und Churn-Prävention: Du erkennst Risiken früh, führst kritische Gespräche souverän und drehst gefährdete Accounts, bevor sie kippen.

  • Onboarding, Aktivierung und Schulungen: Du führst neue Teams erfolgreich ein, leitest Workshops und sorgst dafür, dass deine Kunden das volle Potenzial der Software ausschöpfen.

  • Produkt und Zusammenarbeit: Du bündelst Kundenfeedback strukturiert fürs Produktteam und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing und Produkt zusammen.

Qualifikation

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du bringst 1 bis 2 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Customer-Success, Account Management oder Vertrieb mit, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld, und willst jetzt den nächsten Schritt mit mehr Verantwortung gehen.

  • Du hast ein kommerzielles Gespür: Du erkennst Expansions- und Wachstumschancen in deinem Portfolio und gehst aktiv auf sie zu.

  • Du kannst deeskalieren: Auch in kritischen Situationen bleibst du souverän, findest Lösungen und hältst Kunden.Kommunikation ist eine deiner Stärken. Du gehst selbstständig in Gespräche, auch auf Entscheider-Ebene, und bleibst dran, bis der Termin steht.

  • Du verstehst technische Konzepte und kannst sie verständlich erklären.

  • Du denkst strategisch, planst vorausschauend und arbeitest gerne im Team.

Benefits

  • Ein eigenes Bestandsportfolio aus etablierten Kunden, das du eigenverantwortlich weiterentwickelst, mit klarem Weg zu größeren und strategischeren Accounts.

  • Neben deinem Fixgehalt eine variable Komponente mit Umsatzbeteiligung, wenn du dein Portfolio in neue Buying Center hinein ausbaust (horizontale Expansion).

  • Eine internationale Kundenbasis und die Chance, mit starken Brands auf Enterprise-Niveau zu arbeiten.

  • Ein Produkt mit echtem Purpose: Millionen von Prüfungen pro Jahr, die Arbeitsplätze sicherer und effizienter und Produkte und Services besser machen.

title: Junior Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About EDITED

EDITED is the world’s leading AI-driven retail intelligence platform. We empower the world’s most successful brands and retailers with real-time decision making power. 

By connecting internal business and external market data, EDITED infuses intelligence into every retail decision. We help retailers increase margins, generate more sales, and drive better business outcomes through AI-powered market and enterprise intelligence that fuels automation. 

At EDITED, we foster a dynamic and inclusive culture where creativity thrives and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Our environment is dynamic and supportive, encouraging team members to take initiative, innovate, and continuously grow. We value diversity, transparency, and a shared commitment to excellence, creating a workplace where everyone's voice is heard and contributions are recognised. 

We believe that achieving a positive work-life balance is key to driving innovation and success. Our flexible working options—including hybrid working, flexible hours and a work from anywhere policy—empower our team to perform at their best. 

The Opportunity

We're seeking a motivated and curious Junior Data Scientist to join our team. In this role, you'll work alongside experienced data scientists and engineers to deliver actionable insights and build data-driven solutions across EDITED. You'll learn key methodologies, contribute to impactful projects, and develop your technical and analytical skills in a supportive environment.

What You'll Do As A Junior Data Scientist:

  • Deliver Data Science Projects: Assist in designing, building, and maintaining data science models and pipelines to solve core business problems.

  • Data Analysis & Exploration: Analyze complex datasets to extract meaningful insights, trends, and patterns supporting retail intelligence.

  • Collaborate & Learn: Work closely with senior team members, receiving mentorship and feedback to continuously refine your technical skills.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product and engineering teams to integrate data products into production systems.

  • Maintain Data Quality: Validate and clean data sources to ensure high reliability and consistency across models and reporting.

  • Communicate Findings: Present project outcomes and analytical findings clearly to team members and key stakeholders.

What You'll Bring:

  • A strong STEM degree (including Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics/Statistics, etc), or equivalent experience.

  • Solid understanding of foundational data science concepts and statistical methods.

  • Proficiency with Python and standard data science libraries (e.g. Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn).

  • Strong problem-solving ability and enthusiasm for learning new technologies.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Curiosity to learn in an ever changing, fast paced environment.

What We’re Looking For In A Junior Data Scientist

It’s important for us to look for candidates that strive for excellence with a positive attitude, a strong sense of ownership and work ethic, and a passion to consistently develop and improve their knowledge and skillset. If you’re excited about the role of Junior Data Scientist and the opportunity to work at EDITED, we encourage you to apply even if you only match some, rather than all, of the requirements.

Essential:

  • 1+ years of experience (or strong academic/project background) in data analysis or machine learning.

  • Good working knowledge of Python.

  • Understanding of core machine learning concepts and statistical analyses.

What We Offer You As A Junior Data Scientist

We value our team and to attract exceptional people, we offer an excellent package! This year, we were recognised as one of the top companies to work for in the UK.

  • You can utilise our flexible working policy to ensure you can work around your schedule - this means starting & finishing when it suits you best!

  • At EDITED we are set up to work remotely

  • Enhanced parental leave policy

  • 25 days annual leave + public holidays (and an extra day for every year at EDITED)

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

  • Access to an Employee Assistance Programme

  • Gifts for work anniversaries and big life events

  • Dog friendly office

We do not use AI to source, screen, evaluate, or make decisions about candidates - every hiring decision is made by our team. We use Ashby, our applicant tracking system, which includes AI-assisted interview notetaking and automation for scheduling interviews and sending routine emails. These tools support our hiring process but do not make hiring decisions. We aim to be an equal opportunities employer and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.

descriptionHtml:
Location and travel

You can be based in Europe; across several countries that we hire in.

We expect significant travel across the Europe, with occasional travel to other regions when the audience quality justifies it. The exact cadence will change with the event calendar, but you should expect travel to be a meaningful part of the job.

 

Why this role?

Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications.

However, many of the highest-signal moments happen in person: hallway conversations, workshops, meetups, dinners, conference demos, and technical talks.

We want someone who can own that motion end to end; put Langfuse in the right AI engineering rooms, make the product clear to technical audiences, and turn in-person conversations into durable marketing momentum.

The goal is not to do every event. The goal is to make the right events excellent, scalable, and measurable.

 

What you'll do

  • Represent Langfuse at conferences, meetups, workshops, customer events, partner events, and community gatherings across Europe

  • Run live demos and technical sessions on tracing, evals, prompt management, datasets, metrics, and related LLM engineering workflows.

  • Build and maintain field-ready material: demo flows, workshop runbooks, talk abstracts, event landing pages, follow-up emails, signup flows, and conference-in-a-box assets.

  • Organize Langfuse-hosted meetups, workshops, dinners, and smaller technical gatherings around the highest-quality audiences.

  • Partner with ClickHouse field marketing, sales, solutions, product marketing, and engineering teams where it helps Langfuse show up well.

  • Turn event learnings into useful artifacts: better messaging, better demos, better docs, better talks, better customer stories, and sharper product feedback.

 

What we're looking for

  • You have worked in DevRel, product marketing engineering, solutions engineering, field engineering, developer advocacy, or technical community roles.

  • You have spoken at developer conferences, meetups, workshops, webinars, or technical customer events.

  • You already create technical content, demos, videos, talks, open source projects, or educational material.

title: Legal Counsel, Product & Privacy
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

⚖️ Our Legal team

The Legal team is at the heart of Joko’s growth and protection. We navigate the complexities of contracts, regulations, and risk management to ensure the company operates smoothly and seizes opportunities with confidence.

We handle all legal matters: Contracts, Corporate, Labor, Data protection, IP etc… enabling other teams to innovate with confidence.

Leveraging our expertise and external partners, we collaborate with all functions to protect Joko’s interests efficiently and proactively.

🚀 What you will do

As Legal Counsel, Product & Privacy, you will work hand in hand with our Product, Tech and business teams to make sure our product, including Juno, complies with privacy, AI, consumer and platform rules, from the PRD to the launch. You will report directly to the Head of Legal (Maya).

🔐 Privacy and AI

  • Run our GDPR programme on a centralised, cross-European basis, working closely with our DPO: records of processing, DPIAs, privacy notices, data subject requests, processor agreements and transfers.

  • Ensure compliance with non EU privacy laws as the teams grow our international activity.

  • Champion privacy by design within the product teams: show up early, ask the right questions, and help find solutions that work for users and the business.

  • Act as product counsel on Juno alongside the Product team: AI Act compliance, transparency obligations, and model and vendor terms.

🛍️ Consumer and platform rules

  • Maintain our terms of use and terms of sale with the teams who design our offers, including the cashback and gift card terms, withdrawal rights, the referral programme, and the rules of our prize draws and contests.

  • Keep Joko compliant with the expectations of the DGCCRF and its equivalents in each new country, including country-specific terms where local law requires them.

  • Own our compliance with app store and browser store rules (Apple, Google, Chrome Web Store, Firefox), together with the Security and Product teams.

  • Ensure our compliance with the terms of our affiliate networks, with the teams who manage these partnerships.

💳 Banking and payments regulation

  • Map the regulatory perimeter of each business line and each new market (payment and e-money regimes, gift cards) with the teams building them and our external specialist counsel.

  • Monitor whether each business line stays within its current status as the product evolves.

💡 How the scope is covered. We don't expect you to be an expert in all of these areas. Privacy and AI are the core of the role; consumer law and platform rules can be learned on the job if they're new to you, and we rely on external counsel in needed.

🙌 Who you are

  • You have 4 to 6 years of experience in data protection, including time in a top-tier law firm or as in-house product or privacy counsel.

  • You have worked with product and tech teams, and you can read a PRD or a data flow and identify the issues it raises.

  • You follow AI regulation closely and you have already advised on AI products.

  • Experience in consumer law is a plus; a CIPP/E or equivalent certification is a plus.

  • You hold a Master's degree in IP/IT law, data protection law or business law from a leading French law school. Admission to the Paris Bar is a plus.

  • You are fluent in French and English.

  • You give clear and actionable answers to non-lawyers, and you know when a risk is acceptable.

  • You are curious about AI and want to learn how to build the tools that change legal work.

What we tell you upfront. Until the three poles are staffed, every Legal Counsel works across the full legal scope with the Head of Legal. Functional ownership is formalised as soon as the Commercial & IP and Product & Privacy seats are both filled.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

  • Ship to production and use real user behavior to guide the next iteration

  • Speed up the training loop so experiments are faster, easier to compare, and more reproducible

title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is building the team to help the world's most ambitious organizations adopt Claude in ways that are transformative, safe, and lasting. Our Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with strategic customers to ship production AI applications that solve real business problems. As this practice grows, we need a founding leader to build and scale it.

As the first FDE Manager in DACH, you'll own the team that sits at the frontier of enterprise AI deployment. You'll hire and develop a high-performing team of FDEs, set the technical and operational bar for customer engagements, and build the playbooks that turn one-off successes into repeatable patterns. You'll work hand-in-hand with Engagement Managers who own delivery logistics and stakeholder management, while you ensure your team is shipping quality code, growing technically, and representing Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments.

This is a player-coach role with a strong bias toward leadership. You'll stay close enough to the technical work to review architectures, debug production issues, and pair with your team when it matters — but your primary impact will come from the people you hire, the standards you set, and the culture you create. You'll partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering to shape how Anthropic serves its most strategic customers, and your team's field insights will directly influence product direction.

This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity and is energized by building from zero to one. You'll be defining what good looks like for FDE management at Anthropic — there is no existing playbook to follow.

Responsibilities

  • Hire, develop, and retain a world-class team of Forward Deployed Engineers. Set a high bar for technical talent and customer instincts.

  • Conduct regular 1:1s, provide technical mentorship, and invest in the career growth of each team member. Create an environment where FDEs do the best work of their careers.

  • Staff and oversee customer engagements across your team's portfolio, making resource allocation decisions that balance customer needs, team development, and business priorities.

  • Collaborate with account teams and Engagement Managers during the pre-sales process to qualify engagements, scope work, and inform statements of work.

  • Review technical architectures and code produced by your FDEs, ensuring the team ships high-quality, production-ready solutions that solve real customer problems.

  • Stay hands-on enough to lead technical discovery sessions, prototype solutions, and debug complex issues alongside your team when needed.

  • Build repeatable playbooks, starter repositories, integration templates, and an internal knowledge base that captures what your team learns in the field.

  • Define team OKRs that tie to customer success outcomes and product adoption goals. Create operational cadences — standups, retros, engagement reviews — that keep the team aligned.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to translate field insights into product improvements. Serve as the voice of the customer in internal planning.

  • Travel to customer sites as needed (25-50%), particularly during engagement kickoffs and for your team's highest-priority accounts.

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or a technical customer-facing role such as forward deployed engineering or consulting.

  • 2+ years of people management experience within a services/post-sales/FDE organization with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.

  • Experience building organizations from 0->1, not just inheriting an existing one.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers on technical implementations, including comfort navigating complex organizational dynamics.

  • Executive presence with the ability to move fluidly between strategic conversations with senior stakeholders and hands-on debugging sessions with engineers.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can translate technical complexity into clear narratives for diverse audiences.

  • Genuine excitement about building something new and defining what great looks like for a team that doesn't yet exist.

Why this role matters

You'll be a founding leader of a team that defines how enterprises adopt and scale AI. Your work will directly influence Anthropic's product direction, create reusable patterns for the broader customer base, and establish Anthropic as the trusted partner for AI transformation — all while advancing the responsible development of frontier AI systems.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Husky is what we call the distributed, petabyte-scale columnar event store at the heart of our Event Platform, which powers dozens of Datadog’s most popular products – Logs, RUM, APM, Cloud Network Monitoring, Netflow, and many more. Husky was built from the ground up at Datadog to store and query massive volumes of event data at low cost, with data fully queryable within seconds of arrival.

As an Engineering Manager on Husky, you will lead one of a few closely collaborating teams that work directly on Husky’s internals. We own the full lifecycle of events stored by our Event Platform – whether it’s managing the ingestion of over 100 million events per second exactly-once, optimizing the persistence layer with lightning-fast compaction, tweaking our columnar format, timely deletion across hundreds of thousands of customer tables, or building the metadata service that enables hundreds of thousands of queries per second – you will be responsible for the growth and success of a team constantly meeting new scalability requirements driven by Datadog’s growing customer base and suite of products.

title: Manager, Sales Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Checkout.com will grow you faster than you expect - the deals, the pace, and the people demand it. If you've ever felt a role never let you show what you're truly capable of, this is the opposite problem: meaningful deals with some of the UK's and the world's biggest brands, real autonomy, and no ceiling on what you can take on.

You'll join the Solutions team in London and own the technical side of deals from first conversation to go-live. Pre-sale, you're front and centre: positioning the platform, building demos and POCs, winning over the merchant's engineers and architects while your Account Executive drives the commercial thread. Once the deal is ready, the weight shifts: our Implementation Engineers lead the build and you stay close, so your designs survive contact with reality.

You'll work on a modern, fast-moving platform with docs that answer your questions, alongside one of the strongest commercial teams in payments.

People who do well here are curious by default: they pull threads, teach themselves what the job needs next, and act before anyone asks. If that's how you work, you'll like it here.

What you will be doing:

  • Support the commercial team to position Checkout.com's products, solutions, and services - and win deals. You'll be a key partner to Account Executives on product, payments, regulation, and tech.

  • Understand merchant requirements and technical needs, map them to our APIs and products, create solution designs and internal documentation.

  • Run demos, build "show-me" payment flows, create POCs, customise and create presentations.

  • Provide thought leadership on all aspects of Payment Performance - Acceptance Rate, Fraud Prevention, Tokenisation, Payment Methods, and others.

  • Lead all technical interactions with merchants - chats, calls, meetings, and workshops - from first contact through go-live, partnering with our Implementation Engineers during integration.

  • Support the BID management team with RFP and RFI responses.

  • Enable internal functions, commercial and tech, with market and merchant feedback on product capabilities. Champion product change and improvement.

  • Stay up to date with industry standards, solutions, and tech.

  • Be an expert on Checkout.com's platform and products.

About You:

If the list below looks like you, apply.

Experience

  • 2+ years as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales Consultant, Implementation Engineer, or TAM. At a PSP or payments company is a bonus.

  • Merchant-side counts too: checkout engineering, an in-house payments team, a payments product role.

  • Experience in a technical, client-facing role.

Payments and technical skills

We need real depth in one of the two areas below and the appetite to close the gap on the other. If payments is your strength, this job will make you more technical, you'll need to want that. Strong coder lighter on payments: payments can be taught, you'll have time.

Payments:

  • Understanding of the end-to-end payment flow and the industry's rules, regulations, and schemes.

  • Experience with 3DS, Network Tokenisation, Apple/Google Pay, APMs, Open Banking, or fraud-risk engines.

Tech:

  • You can code and you're comfortable with web technologies - payments run on the web. At least one front-end (JavaScript, React, Angular) or back-end (Java, .NET, Python, Node) language.

  • Familiar with API-based integration (REST/JSON, Postman); can reproduce, isolate, and explain issues using logs, API responses, and tests.

How you work

  • Clear written and verbal English; equally at home with developers and product teams as with payments, finance, and C-level stakeholders.

  • Commercially minded: you talk revenue, volume, and pricing, not just APIs, and push deals forward without being asked.

  • Highly organised; able to prioritise shifting workloads.

Nice to have:

  • Previous exposure to RFI/RFP processes.

  • Familiarity with PSD2/PSD3/PSR, FCA, ISO-8583.

  • An additional language.

  • Former engineering, developer, or product manager background.

  • Prior roles in the e-commerce industry.

Not sure whether to apply?

Build a working payment demo using our public docs at docs.checkout.com and send it to ----- A working demo tells us more than a perfect CV.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Manufacturing Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.


About the role

We are looking for a manufacturing systems engineer to own the production process and make it ready for a significant scaleup. You will work closely with our engineering and production team in Zürich to make our production more reliable and scalable.


This role is very hands-on and you will spend a lot of your time on the shop floor solving issues and improving production hand in hand with assembly technicians. You will be building out a world class production system to support a rapidly growing supply base.


What you will do

  • Own how our product is built from start to finish

  • Create and maintain production process documentation, both for internal and external manufacturing

  • Improve workstation layout, flow design and tooling from incoming goods to product shipping

  • Support make vs buy decisions and supplier selection

  • Support new product introduction from development to production

  • Close DFM feedback loop to improve manufacturability

title: Manufacturing Technician
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Set up, operate and change over the HTS cable line and plate assembly stations. Deliver routine production alongside complex, first-article and non-standard builds.

  • Carry out precision assembly, fitting, fabrication and approved rework using drawings, work instructions and practical judgement.

  • Troubleshoot process, assembly and quality problems, including handling issues, setup errors, dimensional variation and inconsistent output. Contain affected work, investigate the cause and help implement a verified correction.

  • Resolve unfamiliar or undocumented scenarios within agreed safety, quality and change-control limits. Develop and document practical solutions, and obtain engineering or quality approval before proceeding outside your authority.

  • Verify setups and initial output, and inspect assemblies against released acceptance criteria at assigned in-process and final checks. Raise non-conformances and refer deviations or product-disposition decisions to the authorised owner.

  • Work with equipment technicians on machine faults; provide design and manufacturing engineers clear measurements and feedback on buildability, tooling, and process performance.

  • Run first-article builds and process trials with manufacturing engineering, and help prove tooling, fixtures and equipment ready for production.

  • Write, redline and improve work instructions and standard operating procedures using build experience. Route changes through review and release, and help improve cycle time, yield and repeatability.

  • Maintain complete build records, material traceability, deviation records and clear handovers.

     

WHO YOU ARE

  • Substantial hands-on experience building complex, high-precision assemblies, with capability beyond routine machine operation.

  • A technical apprenticeship or vocational qualification in a relevant discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Confidence interpreting engineering drawings, assembly requirements and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T), and using measuring equipment to verify work.

  • Proven practical troubleshooting skills, including experience investigating unfamiliar problems and distinguishing symptoms from underlying causes.

  • Experience setting up equipment, using fixtures and handling sensitive components or materials with consistent workmanship.

  • The judgement to work with incomplete instructions while recognising when to proceed, stop or escalate, supported by a practical understanding of traceability, non-conformance and change control.

  • The ability to write instructions others can follow, explain technical problems clearly and train or support less-experienced technicians.

  • Working English for drawings, procedures, technical discussions and production records.

Nice to have

  • Experience manufacturing cables, coils, superconducting magnets or other high-reliability assemblies involving delicate materials or controlled handling.

  • Experience with winding, insulation, impregnation, soldering, brazing, precision bonding or reel-to-reel processing.

  • Experience introducing new products or processes, supporting pilot builds or transferring development work into production.

  • Familiarity with structured problem solving, such as Lean/Six Sigma improvement methods.

  • A Techniker or Meister qualification.

  • German language skills.

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

This job would require frequent travels to our office in Villigen ( Zurich, CH)
*This role sits at "L3" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Marketing Manager (12-18 month FTC)
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE BRAND TEAM

The Brand Team is responsible for all brands within the Carwow Group. We’re an ambitious team who thrive on storytelling, performance and collaboration.

We bring our portfolio of brands to life across every channel; from large-scale campaigns to social-first paid marketing creative, events, brand identity, commercial initiatives and internal culture-building.

We move quickly, adapt often and work closely with colleagues across the whole business. Due to the scale up nature of the business you’ll enjoy a unique mix of variety, ownership and exploration.

THE ROLE

Plan and deliver integrated marketing that builds the Carwow brand and drives results, from big campaigns to always-on activity.

You’ll own campaigns from brief to results, working across brand and performance so everything we put out works hard at every stage of the funnel. You’ll brief and manage in-house creatives and agency partners, as well as working closely with performance, CRM and content teams. You’ll also use data to shape the work and prove its impact as part of a performance-focused Marketing team. Most of your focus will be the UK, with some work supporting our team in Spain.

This is a 12-month contract with real ownership. In that time you’ll establish test and learn plans across our marketing stack, run flagpole campaigns for new launches and leave behind ways of working that last beyond your time with us.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Plan and deliver integrated campaigns from brief to results, across brand and performance channels.

  • Drive innovation with pace using AI tools across the Marketing org; speeding up planning, briefing, reporting and campaign delivery, sharing what works with the wider team

  • Building relationships across the org to ensure adoption of systems and processes, including AI innovation

  • Write clear, insight-led briefs for creative, media and agency partners.

  • Manage agencies and production partners, keeping work on time, on budget and on brand.

  • Work with performance teams to improve existing test and learn plans and implement new processes where needed.

  • Partner and project manage cross-functionally with CRM, social, content and product teams to ensure campaigns and launches are joined up across every touchpoint.

  • Work with Brand Creative to bring campaigns to life and keep the brand consistent, briefing with clear insight and giving constructive feedback on the work.

  • Manage campaign budgets and keep spend accurately tracked.

  • Report on what worked and what didn’t, and use it to shape the next initiative.

  • Support our team in Spain to adapt campaigns for their market.

  • Find and test new ways of working, including AI, to plan and deliver faster.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years in marketing, in-house or agency, ideally at a consumer brand or scale-up.

  • A track record of integrated campaigns that delivered commercial results, across brand and performance.

  • Strong knowledge of ATL and digital channels, including TV, OOH, Meta, YouTube and paid search.

  • Experience briefing and managing creative and media agencies.

  • Comfortable with data: reading results, running tests and turning insight into action.

  • Confident managing budgets and tracking spend.

title: Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:

Verifone has a diverse, dynamic and fast paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. Whether it’s developing the next platform of secure payment systems or searching for new ways to bring electronic payments to new markets, the team at Verifone is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners and investors. Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located. Currently, we do allow a hybrid work schedule but we regularly revisit our attendance policy.

title: Mechanical Design Engineering Team Lead
descriptionHtml:
About pplwise

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will lead the mechanical design of the robots as they move from prototype to series production.

About the role

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics builds its own robot hardware in-house: mechanics, electronics and software. Orders are growing, and the robots are moving from prototypes to series production. Designs that worked in the lab now need to be built reliably, at scale and at the right cost. The hardest problems often sit between disciplines: parts that work on their own can fail once they're assembled with the electronics.

The mechanical team has four engineers, most of them at the start of their careers, and they need someone who guides them every day. You'll be the technical lead for the mechanical side of the product and the counterpart to the electronics lead, so the current mechanical manager can focus on core R&D. Your time splits roughly evenly between hands-on engineering and technical leadership. You'll work closely with Electronics, Production, Procurement and the CTO, and you'll set the engineering habits while the team is still small.

What you'll do

  • Mentor the mechanical engineers day to day: help them make design decisions, set methods and keep projects focused

  • Design parts and assemblies in CAD, including tolerancing, and check every design for manufacturability and cost before it goes out

  • Lead testing and integration of mechanics and electronics, and solve the problems that only show once everything is assembled

  • Prioritise incoming work, follow up on progress and make the day-to-day technical calls on the mechanical side

  • Make the gated design process work in practice and run design reviews (safety, mechanics, electronics, manufacturability) before parts are integrated

  • Put design for manufacturing and design for cost in place: fewer, standardised parts and production methods that scale

  • Work with the electronics owner of each robot module from the first prototype on, and with Production on manufacturability and production jigs

  • Build and iterate prototypes based on customer and field feedback

About you

  • Several years of hands-on mechanical design in R&D at a company that develops and builds its own electromechanical products (e.g. power tools, home appliances, e-mobility, production machines, robotics, marine propulsion)

  • A proven record of taking an electromechanical product from prototype to series production (ideally 1,000+ units a year) on a fast development cycle of about a year, not a decade-long program

  • You still design hands-on in CAD, mainly metal parts and assemblies, with strong tolerancing skills (any CAD tool; Onshape is a plus)

  • You've applied design for manufacturing and design for cost, and cut cost through design: fewer parts, standard parts

  • At least two years of mentoring or technically guiding other engineers; a team-lead title isn't required

  • Experience testing and integrating mechanics with electronics

  • You've introduced processes, design reviews or engineering standards that helped a team deliver

  • You handle unclear requirements and break complex problems down so others can work on them

  • German is a plus, since production is mostly German-speaking

  • Bonus: GD&T and tolerance stack-ups, design of production jigs, or projects with motors, motor controllers or electronics

What Filics offers

  • A key role at an early stage: shape both the mechanical team and the product

  • Real ownership of the mechanical side, from first prototype to series production

  • A mix of hands-on engineering and leadership, with a path into team lead and engineering management as Filics grows

  • Fast design cycles driven by customer and field feedback

  • A small, high-caliber team with close collaboration across mechanics, electronics, software and production

  • Fast growth: one year at Filics teaches you what usually takes many years at a large company

  • An on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to Engineering and Assembly

Sound like you? Apply with your CV.

title: Meewerkstage Berenschot-COT Instituut voor Veiligheids- en Crisismanagement
descriptionHtml:
0,8-1 fte | Utrecht | Hybride | Veiligheids- en crisismanagement | € 600,– | Wo

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Ben jij een wo-student die gefascineerd is door veiligheid, crisismanagement en complexe maatschappelijke vraagstukken? Vind je de theorie boeiend, maar kun je niet wachten om de praktijk te ervaren? Wil je meedraaien in een team dat adviseert bij ingrijpende incidenten en organisaties voorbereidt op het onvoorspelbare? Dan is een stage bij Berenschot-COT iets voor jou!

Tijdens deze meewerkstage draai je als volwaardige collega mee in het hart van het veiligheidsdomein. Je werkt aan opdrachten voor ministeries, veiligheidsregio’s en private organisaties. Van het analyseren van cyberaanvallen tot het ondersteunen bij grootschalige crisisoefeningen: jij maakt écht het verschil.

Dit ga je doen

Als stagiair bij Berenschot-COT werk je onder begeleiding van een ervaren projectleider samen met collega’s aan diverse projecten binnen het veiligheids- en crisisdomein. Je bent actief betrokken bij zowel trainingen en oefeningen als onderzoeks- en adviesopdrachten.

Je draagt onder andere bij aan:

  • het ontwikkelen en voorbereiden van trainingen en crisisoefeningen, waaronder het opstellen van oefenscenario’s en trainingsmateriaal

  • het ondersteunen bij de uitvoering van trainingen en oefeningen, inclusief observatie en evaluatie

  • het uitvoeren van onderzoeks- en adviesopdrachten voor uiteenlopende inhoudelijke thema’s binnen crisismanagement

  • het verzamelen en analyseren van informatie

  • het bijwonen van bijeenkomsten en verzorgen van verslaglegging

  • het meewerken aan (calamiteiten)onderzoeken

Daarnaast neem je deel aan interne overleggen, kennissessies en teamactiviteiten. Zo leer je niet alleen het vakgebied goed kennen, maar ook de dynamiek van werken in een professioneel adviesbureau.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid vanaf dag één krijg je de kans om te ontdekken waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Berenschot-COT is gespecialiseerd in advisering, onderzoek, trainingen en oefeningen op het gebied van veiligheids- en crisismanagement. Wij adviseren organisaties vóór, tijdens en na crisissituaties en helpen hen hun crisis- en veiligheidsmanagement structureel te verbeteren.

Berenschot-COT heeft brede ervaring binnen zowel de publieke als private sector, in binnen- en buitenland. Opdrachten die landelijke bekendheid kregen zijn onder meer het onderzoek naar het schietdrama in Alphen aan den Rijn, de tramaanslag in Utrecht, de ongeregeldheden rond Ajax-Maccabi Tel Aviv en de cyberaanval bij de TU Eindhoven. Voor meer informatie en recente opdrachten zie: www.cot.nl.


Dit neem je mee

We zoeken een gemotiveerde wo-student (laatste jaar bachelor of master) met affiniteit voor crisis- en veiligheidsvraagstukken. Denk qua studieachtergrond bijvoorbeeld aan communicatie, media, politicologie, bestuurskunde, security studies of criminologie. Andere relevante opleidingen zijn uiteraard ook welkom, mits je motivatie aansluit bij ons werkveld.

Daarnaast:

  • je kunt zelfstandig werken en functioneert goed binnen een team

  • je bent communicatief vaardig en presenteert je professioneel, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

  • je hebt een sterk analytisch vermogen

  • je bent beschikbaar voor een stageperiode van vijf of zes maanden voor vier of vijf dagen per week (maximaal 38,75 uur)

  • startmomenten zijn maart (t/m juli) of september (t/m februari).

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot-COT werk je in een professionele en maatschappelijk betrokken adviesomgeving met veel ruimte voor initiatief en ontwikkeling. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • een uitdagende meewerkstage van vijf of zes maanden

  • een stagevergoeding van € 600,– per maand (op fulltimebasis)

  • een laptop

  • flexibele werkmogelijkheden, ook thuis

  • regelmatige feedback- en check-in momenten met je stagebegeleider

  • een platte organisatie waarin je écht iets kunt betekenen

  • een gezellig team dat werk en plezier goed weet te combineren.

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. title: Microsoft 365 Administrator (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Sie haben schon einmal einen gewachsenen Microsoft-365-Tenant aufgeräumt: Gruppen zusammengeführt, Rechte und Zugriffe neu geregelt und Richtlinien so aufgesetzt, dass alles verlässlich läuft? Und Sie möchten diese Verantwortung jetzt für ein Unternehmen mit Standorten in mehreren Ländern übernehmen?

Über unseren Mandanten

Unser Mandant ist ein international tätiger Industriezulieferer der Mobilitätsbranche mit Hauptsitz im Großraum Kassel. Das Unternehmen wächst auf einer sehr soliden Auftragsbasis, und die IT soll dieses Wachstum mit zuverlässigen Services begleiten.

Warum diese Rolle?

Die IT-Infrastruktur soll jetzt Schritt für Schritt sauber aufgestellt werden. Rollen, Gruppen und Gruppenrichtlinien sind über die Zeit entstanden und brauchen eine klare Ordnung. Zugleich soll der Tenant alle Standorte sauber abbilden, und der weitere Rollout von Microsoft 365 in die Organisation steht an.

  • Weil Sie Ihre Vorstellung eines sauberen Tenants einbringen und die Verantwortung dafür tragen.

  • Weil Sie die Roadmap für den weiteren Rollout von Anfang an prägen.

  • Weil am Ende ein Backend steht, auf das sich das Unternehmen beim Wachsen verlassen kann.

Das sind Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie ordnen Rollen, Gruppen und Berechtigungen neu: Gruppen zusammenführen, Namenskonventionen festlegen, ein Rollenkonzept mit RBAC und Privileged Identity Management aufbauen, bei Bedarf mit Administrative Units je Land.

  • Sie verantworten Identitäten und Zugriffe in Entra ID, je nach Umgebung hybrid mit lokalem Active Directory, einschließlich Conditional Access und MFA.

  • Sie bereinigen bestehende Gruppenrichtlinien und überführen sie schrittweise nach Intune.

  • Sie bauen Intune als Plattform für die Geräteverwaltung aus: Autopilot, Softwareverteilung, Compliance-Richtlinien sowie Smartphones und Tablets.

  • Sie setzen Sicherheitsgrundlagen im Tenant um, darunter Defender-Basisschutz in Abstimmung mit dem externen SOC, und halten Lizenzen und Admin-Konten sauber.

  • Sie betreuen Exchange Online, Teams und SharePoint auf technischer Ebene.

  • Sie planen den weiteren Rollout von Microsoft 365 mit, bringen ihn in die Organisation und halten Standards schriftlich fest.

Zur Einordnung: Die Rolle verantwortet das technische Backend von Microsoft 365, also Tenant, Identitäten, Berechtigungen, Richtlinien und Sicherheit. Sie konzipieren und setzen selbst um. Dabei arbeiten Sie im Infrastruktur-Team eng mit den Kolleginnen und Kollegen an den Standorten in Europa und Nordamerika zusammen.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Eine abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung oder ein Studium mit IT-Bezug

  • Mehrere Jahre Praxis in der Administration von Microsoft 365 im Betrieb eines Unternehmens, idealerweise mit mehreren Standorten oder Ländern

  • Sicheren Umgang mit Entra ID, Conditional Access, Intune und Exchange Online sowie Erfahrung in der Migration von Gruppenrichtlinien

  • Automatisierung mit PowerShell und Microsoft Graph

  • Projekterfahrung und die Fähigkeit, ein Thema eigenständig zu strukturieren und zum Abschluss zu bringen

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch

  • Von Vorteil: Zertifizierungen wie MS-102, MD-102, SC-300 oder AZ-104 sowie Erfahrung mit Microsoft Defender

Das erwartet Sie

  • Eine Fachrolle mit voller Verantwortung für Ihr Thema, in einem Infrastruktur-Team mit erfahrener Führung, die Rückhalt gibt

  • Arbeitsplatz im Großraum Kassel: Die Rolle lebt vom direkten Austausch, deshalb arbeiten Sie überwiegend vor Ort

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Bikeleasing und Weiterbildung

Interesse?

Wenn Sie sich in dieser Rolle wiederfinden, senden Sie uns Ihren Lebenslauf mit Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestem Eintrittstermin.

title: Mid-Market Account Executive - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €20k to €200k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

  • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
  • Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. 
  • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.
  • Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • The Winning DNA: A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Verified Overachievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We’ll want to see this on your resume. 
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV.
  • Native French language

An ideal candidate also offers:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don’t rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Mid-Market Account Executive - Southern Europe
descriptionHtml:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Your tasks

  • Build and execute a territory plan that prioritises high-value target accounts.

  • Generate your own pipeline through consistent, tailored outbound activity, while following up promptly on inbound interest.

  • Lead structured discovery conversations to understand customer needs, qualify opportunities and identify where Statista can deliver value.

  • Develop proposals that connect our solutions to customer priorities and recognise opportunities for larger deals.

  • Own your new-business ARR target, maintain healthy pipeline coverage and forecast accurately.

  • Negotiate and close new business, then hand over won accounts with clear context on customer goals and agreed next steps.

  • Continue developing the account-planning and deal-management skills needed for more complex enterprise sales.

Your profile

  • 2–5 years of B2B sales experience, including responsibility for closing new business.

  • A track record of achieving sales targets and creating pipeline through your own outreach.

  • Strong territory-planning, discovery and qualification skills, including the judgement to step away from poor-fit opportunities.

  • Commercial curiosity and the ability to uncover relevant metrics and explain business value.

  • Experience preparing proposals, negotiating and closing deals.

  • Fluent English and professional working proficiency in French, Italian or Spanish. Additional southern european languages are an advantage.

  • Able to work from our London office, opposite Southwark Station, two days a week, and travel for customer meetings and industry events when needed.

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

  • Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year

  • Hybrid work and flex-time

  • International team and social events

  • Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options

  • Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities

  • Career & training opportunities

  • Attractive locations and modern offices

  • Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.
