title: Mid-Market Account Executive - UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive platform, with AI agents that work alongside every team, from Finance to HR, to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.

Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally, passing $100M in ARR in 2026 and doubling revenue for the second year in a row. Industry leaders like Unilever, Uber, Anthropic, Snowflake, and Siemens use Pigment every day to make better-informed decisions and navigate any scenario with confidence.

In October 2026, we raised a $250M Series E at a $2.3B valuation, bringing our total funding to $650M+. Today we’re a growing team of 700+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco, and Austin, and we’ve been named a Visionary in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software two years running.

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo - all while working as one team. If you’re driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.
What you'll do

title: Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im Kundendienst
descriptionHtml:
Über pakajo

pakajo ist ein KI-gestütztes Vergleichs- und Versandportal für den eCommerce, das internationalen Versand für Online-Händler vereinfacht. Mit einer Auswahl an 60.000 Versandpreis-Optionen und einem KI-Tracking-Tool hilft das Team in Hamburg Kunden dabei, Versandkosten zu reduzieren und Erträge zu steigern.

Ihre Aufgaben im Kundendienst

  • Du betreust und berätst unsere Bestandskunden und kümmerst dich um ihre Anliegen.

  • Du führst Nachforschungen bei unseren Versandpartnern durch und bearbeitest Schadensfälle sowie Reklamationen.

  • Du verfolgst offene Vorgänge konsequent bis zur abschließenden Klärung.

  • Du findest eigenständig Lösungen bei Kundenproblemen und sorgst für eine professionelle Bearbeitung.

  • Du stimmst dich mit internen Abteilungen und externen Versandpartnern ab, um Kundenanliegen schnell und zuverlässig zu lösen.

  • Du dokumentierst Kundenanfragen und Servicefälle nachvollziehbar.

  • Du unterstützt uns beim Aufbau, der Strukturierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Kundenserviceprozesse.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und eine ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung.

  • Du kommunizierst freundlich, sicher und professionell – sowohl telefonisch als auch schriftlich.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Du bringst gute Englischkenntnisse mit, um auch internationale Anliegen bearbeiten zu können.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und zuverlässig.

  • Du bist lösungsorientiert, denkst mit und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung.

  • Du verfügst über einen sicheren Umgang mit dem PC und digitalen Systemen.

  • Du behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Vorgängen den Überblick.

  • Erste Erfahrungen im Kundenservice oder in der Logistik sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Auch motivierte Quereinsteiger sind willkommen!

Das erwartet dich bei uns

  • Ein modernes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld in einem wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Kommunikation.

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Prozesse aktiv mitzuentwickeln.

Rahmendaten

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

title: Mitarbeiter in der Qualitätssicherung / Produktkontrolleure (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams an unserem Standort in Gudensberg suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Mitarbeiter in der Qualitätssicherung / Produktkontrolleure (m/w/d)

Informationen über unseren Betrieb

Unser Betrieb im hessischen Gudensberg spielt eine essenzielle Rolle bei der Produktion frischer Geflügelspezialitäten. Mit einer großen und innovativen Produktpalette versorgen wir von Gudensberg aus nicht nur den deutschen Lebensmitteleinzelhandel, sondern auch Großverbraucher und die Cateringbranche. Erstklassige Qualität steht für uns dabei immer im Mittelpunkt.

Deine Tätigkeiten: 

  • Du pflegst und optimierst unser HACCP-System sowie das bestehende Hygienekonzept, um höchste Sicherheitsstandards zu garantieren.

  • Du führst regelmäßige Probennahmen nach Plan durch und sorgst dafür, dass alle Vorgaben präzise eingehalten werden.

  • In enger Abstimmung mit dem Produktionsteam stellst du sicher, dass alle Fertigungsschritte den gesetzlichen, internen und kundenspezifischen Qualitätsvorgaben entsprechen.

  • Du übernimmst Mitverantwortung dafür, dass wir alle lebensmittelrechtlichen Anforderungen jederzeit sicher erfüllen.

  • Du stellst eine lückenlose Rückverfolgbarkeit entlang der gesamten Produktionskette sicher – vom Rohstoff bis zum fertigen Produkt.

  • Du überwachst die Einhaltung der Hygienevorschriften im Alltag und schulst deine Kollegen direkt vor Ort durch praxisnahe Unterweisungen.

  • Du führst alle qualitätssichernden Kontrollen während der laufenden Produktion durch und dokumentierst die Ergebnisse sorgfältig.

Diese Qualifikationen solltest Du mitbringen:

  • Idealerweise bringst du bereits Berufserfahrung aus der Lebensmittelindustrie mit und kennst die dortigen Abläufe.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, bist top organisiert und behältst durch deine strukturierte Art auch bei vielen Aufgaben den Überblick.

  • Zuverlässigkeit und Eigeninitiative sind für dich selbstverständlich. Du denkst lösungsorientiert und verfolgst deine Ziele mit gesundem Ehrgeiz.

  • Du verstehst dich als Teamplayer, der andere motivieren kann und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen den Abteilungen geschickt koordiniert.

  • Deine ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke hilft dir dabei, komplexe Sachverhalte klar zu vermitteln und Probleme schnell aus der Welt zu schaffen.

  • Du hast eine echte Affinität für hochwertige Lebensmittel und begeisterst dich für deren handwerkliche oder industrielle Herstellung.

  • Du hast Lust auf neue Herausforderungen und möchtest dich fachlich wie persönlich mit uns gemeinsam weiterentwickeln.

Das bieten wir:

  • Dich erwartet eine spannende Herausforderung mit viel Raum für deine eigenen Ideen und echtes Mitgestalten in einem dynamischen Umfeld.

  • Halte dich fit mit unserem Firmenfitnessprogramm, wir bezuschussen deine Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft im Rahmen des EGYM Wellpass-Verbundes.

  • Sei umweltfreundlich unterwegs mit unserem E-Bike-Leasing – eine attraktive Option für deine tägliche Mobilität

  • Sichere dir attraktive Rabatte auf unsere Produkte – ein Plus, das sich für dich lohnt!

  • Parke stressfrei und kostenlos – direkt bei uns am Arbeitsplatz.

  • Empfiehl uns als Arbeitgeber weiter und freue dich über attraktive Prämien, wenn du neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen zu uns bringst.

Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt?

Wenn Du Lust auf neue Herausforderungen hast, freuen wir uns Dich kennenzulernen. Bewirb Dich einfach über unseren Bewerbungsbutton und das entsprechende Bewerbungsformular. Wenn Du noch Fragen zu dieser Stelle hast, kannst Du uns telefonisch oder per E-Mail kontaktieren. Du erhältst so schnell wie möglich eine Rückmeldung.

Herr Ronny Böhme

Besserstr 45, 34281 Gudensberg
Telefon: +49 (0) 1522 2628 934
E-Mail: Akquise im Zusammenhang mit dieser Stellenausschreibung ist nicht erwünscht.

title: Mobile Application Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Mobile Application Engineer

The Role

Lyrebird’s product lives or dies in a single moment: a clinician starting a consultation and trusting that every word is being captured. Today, that moment happens in the browser. As our first Mobile Application Engineer, you’ll take ownership of bringing Lyrebird to iOS and Android, starting with the capability that matters most: reliable audio capture on a phone. You’ll own the mobile application end to end, from the build pipeline and store releases to bringing our core web features into a native experience that works in the real conditions clinicians face every day.

This role suits someone who enjoys being the person who owns the whole thing. You’re comfortable moving between native platform APIs and a TypeScript codebase, you care about the unglamorous details (permissions, interruptions, flaky networks), and you get satisfaction from shipping something that simply works when it matters. You’ll enjoy the autonomy of shaping a platform from its early days, and the responsibility of building for people who can’t afford for their tools to fail mid-consultation.

About Us

Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks.

Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Implement and own the mobile build pipeline, producing signed iOS and Android builds and keeping configuration current

  • Release the app to the App Store and Google Play, managing versioning, phased rollouts, and store review

  • Deliver mobile audio capture for consultations, handling microphone permissions, background recording, and interruptions such as incoming phone calls

  • Make audio uploads resilient on poor networks, with retry and resume built in

  • Bring mature web features into the mobile app, matching their behaviour and resilience whilst adapting the experience for small screens

  • Optimise reporting and telemetry, then use what you learn to make the app more stable

  • Build and maintain the mobile test suite and run it as part of the build pipeline

  • Keep across platform changes from Apple and Google and plan the work they require

What you’ll bring

  • Strong experience in cross-platform development (React Native). Preferable to also have experience in Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin.

  • Hands-on experience with mobile audio capture, including background audio, interruption handling, and microphone permissions (for example AVAudioSession, AudioRecord, or MediaRecorder in a WebView)

  • Experience automating mobile builds and releases with tools such as Expo (EAS), Xcode Cloud, or Gradle, including code signing and phased rollouts on both stores

  • Confidence in TypeScript and the ability to read and change a SvelteKit web codebase

  • Experience with mobile test automation using Browserstack.

  • Experience integrating mobile apps with REST APIs

Nice to have

  • Experience with Progressive Web Apps, including service workers, web app manifests, and offline caching

  • Experience setting up mobile crash reporting and telemetry with Sentry or similar

  • A working knowledge of on-device data protection, such as encryption at rest and short data retention

  • Familiarity with Sveltkit and Typescript backend frameworks

  • Familiarity with AWS and Terraform

  • Experience building software for healthcare or other regulated environments

Every minute a clinician spends on admin is a minute taken away from a patient. Putting Lyrebird in a clinician’s pocket means it can be there on a ward round, in a community visit, or anywhere care actually happens. You’ll be building the foundation that makes that possible, and your work will be felt directly by clinicians and the patients in front of them.

We’re building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. If you’re from an underrepresented background in tech, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

title: Principal Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wie durft het fundament onder AI écht op orde te zetten?

Iedereen praat over AI. Weinigen hebben het data-fundament eronder al staan. Als Principal Data Engineer bepaal jij hoe dat fundament wordt gebouwd: schaalbaar, soeverein en klaar voor wat er nog komt.

De uitdaging

In een wereld die wordt gevormd door technologische ontwikkeling en geopolitieke spanningen, helpt LINKIT organisaties met IT-oplossingen die bijdragen aan een duurzame toekomst. Data en AI engineering komen daarbij steeds vaker samen in één platform, vaak gerealiseerd op een soevereine manier: op een private cloud of een Europese cloud zoals STACKIT.

Als Principal Data Engineer ben je de rechterhand van de business lead Data & AI en neem je het voortouw in het ontwerpen en moderniseren van schaalbare, toekomstbestendige data-oplossingen. Je komt in dienst bij LINKIT en gaat aan het werk bij toonaangevende opdrachtgevers in overheid en enterprise, waar data engineering een centrale positie inneemt in de technologische stack.

Je bouwt niet alleen, je geeft ook richting en advies. Je bewaakt kwaliteit, stimuleert verbetering en zorgt met je team voor duurzame oplossingen. Daarnaast werk je actief mee aan de Data & AI platformpropositie van LINKIT: samen met de directie en collega-leads (waaronder de Platform Lead en de AI Lead) zorg je voor een aanbod dat relevant blijft in een snel veranderend technologisch en geopolitiek landschap.

Concreet ga je aan de slag met:

  • Ontwerpen en bouwen van data-oplossingen en platforms op schaalbare, cloud native en soevereine architecturen, samen met Platform, AI en Software engineers uit andere squads.

  • Implementeren van data engineering oplossingen (ingestion, storage en warehousing, pipelines) als integraal onderdeel van een modern data en AI-platform.

  • Vertalen van businessvraagstukken bij overheid en enterprise naar productieklare data en AI-oplossingen binnen klantprojecten, PoC's en presalestrajecten.

  • Verkennen van nieuwe technologieën, producten en partners om versnelling continu mogelijk te maken.

  • Vormgeven en aanscherpen van de data en AI-diensten van LINKIT, zodat ze relevant blijven in een snel veranderend speelveld.

  • Coachen en begeleiden van engineers binnen het data engineering team.

Je plek: de Data Engineering squad

Je landt in de Data Engineering squad: een groep engineers die dagelijks schaalbare data-oplossingen bouwt voor klanten in overheid, finance en logistiek. Je werkt nauw samen met platform en AI-engineers uit andere squads, deelt kennis en scherpt elkaar aan. Om de twee weken op vrijdag kom je terug naar het hoofdkantoor in De Meern voor de ‘clubdag’, waarop we tijd investeren in kennisdeling, leren en verbinden.

Lees hier meer over de Data Engineering squad.


Wat we vragen

  • 8+ jaar ervaring in data engineering.

  • Sterke programmeervaardigheden in talen zoals Python, Scala en SQL.

  • Affiniteit met complexe klantomgevingen bij de overheid en grote private organisaties en met de maatschappelijke vraagstukken die daar spelen.

  • Sterk in architectuurdenken en het ontwerpen van schaalbare systemen, met oog voor hoe AI samenkomt met dataplatforms, applicaties en soevereine infrastructuur.

  • Hands on ervaring met het ontwerpen en bouwen of moderniseren van dataplatformen met open source technologieën zoals Apache Kafka, Spark, Flink en Iceberg.

title: Principal Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

Shape the future of agentic automation: UiPath is evolving from RPA to the worldʼs first Agentic Orchestration platform, enabling enterprises to deploy autonomous AI agents at scale. As part of this transformation, Peak (a UiPath company) is building new B2B agentic solutions that deliver immediate, measurable business value. Youʼll play a pivotal role in shaping and growing one of these solutions.

As a Principal Product Manager for one of our supply chain and/or manufacturing agentic solution areas, youʼll define how applied AI and automation combine to create measurable value in complex B2B domains such as supply planning, commercial operations and inventory optimization. Youʼll join a high-performing, cross-functional team building next-generation products in a rapidly evolving space where innovation, learning, and impact are daily drivers. Youʼll identify and prioritize the most valuable product opportunities, lead discovery and delivery, and work across Peak and UiPath teams to bring transformative solutions to life. From influencing go-to-market strategy to driving customer adoption, youʼll own the product vision for your area that excites and motivates our teams and delivers significant commercial impact.

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Define and drive an inspiring vision for one of Peakʼs agentic solution areas in supply chain or manufacturing, aligning to UiPathʼs broader strategic aims and the evolving agentic landscape

  • Bring deep credibility and domain expertise to customer and commercial conversations, steering sales, roadmap and design partnerships to maximise customer value

  • Own the roadmap for your area, making challenging tradeoff decisions for complex, ambiguous problems

  • Engage with our customers and the market to understand their needs, validate strategy and use cases, and ultimately drive amazing outcomes for our customers

  • Deeply understand the technical reality of our solution, anchoring our go-to-market motions to product truth

  • Lead product launches, enable sales teams to sell your solution and drive revenue growth in your areas of responsibility

  • Collaborate with and elevate the broader product team through knowledge sharing, thought leadership and mentoring

What you'll bring to the team

  • Typically 8+ years in product management, including significant experience leading strategic initiatives in a SaaS product business

  • Strong domain expertise in supply chain and/or manufacturing.

  • Deep experience with AI/ML/agentic products, and the ability to effectively navigate the technical complexity and rapidly evolving landscape characteristic of these products

  • Proven track record of working closely with cross-functional colleagues, including sales, marketing, professional services and engineering teams

  • Excellent stakeholder management across all levels of seniority, both within our business and within our customerʼs businesses

  • A highly effective strategic thinker, able to solve strategic problems creatively and pragmatically and drive disciplined execution across relevant teams off the back of it

  • Proven experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise software. Particularly desirable: experience in supply chain, pricing, procurement, ERP, or adjacent enterprise software domains.


Youʼll join a team that values clarity, autonomy, and experimentation — where weʼre building the future of agentic automation, together.

Peak is a business unit of UiPath headquartered in Manchester, UK. This position is either Manchester- or London-based. London-based candidates will be expected to visit Manchester on a weekly basis. You will report directly to the Director of Product Management. This is an Individual Contributor (IC) role, with the possibility of future people management responsibilities.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

title: Principal Software Architect
descriptionHtml:
About Graphcore 

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute.  

It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.  

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.   

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore enjoys a culture of continuous learning and constant innovation.

Job Summary 

We are looking for a Principal Architect to define and drive the architectural vision of the software stack for the Graphcore ML accelerator.

In this role, you will shape the architecture of our software ecosystem and maintain a deep understanding of the product’s hardware and software components, their interfaces, and how they interact.

You are an excellent communicator, and you proactively convey the software architecture.

You bring a pragmatic, trade-off-aware approach to decision-making, fully recognising the impact of architectural choices on product direction and engineering outcomes. 

The Team 

The software architecture team is responsible for defining, maintaining and communicating the overarching architecture of our software stack, from firmware to ML frameworks.

The team works within the wider software organisation, partnering closely with engineering teams who deliver against this architectural vision. 

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Define & document the software architecture of the software stack.  
  • Work across different software domains to ensure a coherent end too end architecture.
  • Clearly communicate the software architecture to engineering teams.

  • Continuously maintain the software architecture as the product evolves. Communicate architectural changes proactively to all relevant stakeholders. 
  • Stay informed about trends and developments in the ML/software ecosystem.

  • Prototyping and validating architectural concepts through proof-of-concept implementations. 
  • Contribute to future and/or related product definitions with a forward-looking mindset, understanding and communicating the impact of future direction on software architecture. 
  • Work with the HW and Silicon architects to ensure product the needs of software stack. 
  • Ensure the software architecture meets the product requirements.  
  • Work closely with engineering, product, leadership, and partners to ensure alignment between business goals and architectural direction. 

Candidate Profile

Essential:

  • Expertise in one or more of these technologies; Firmware, Drivers, ML frameworks (PyTorch, Triton, etc), Collectives, HPC, Tooling, C & C++, CPU architectures.

  • Collaborative mindset and ability to influence. 
  • Pragmatic approach to decision making, being very aware of trade-offs and implications. 

Desirable

  • Demonstrable experience in a previous architecture role.

We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. title: Principal Software Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
The role

Reporting directly to the VP Technology, you'll build new capability for Awin with AI at the core, free from the constraints of our established delivery model. You'll take ideas from concept to production quickly, prove what works, and turn the best of it into patterns the wider engineering organisation can adopt.

You'll work closely with product and commercial leaders to find where AI changes the economics of our affiliate marketing platform: what we can build, how fast, and at what cost. You'll be hands-on most of the time, writing code, shipping and measuring results, rather than coordinating others.

You'll know enough of our existing platform to connect new things to it safely, but you won't be absorbed into running it. Your job is to show what modern, AI-native engineering looks like at Awin, and make it real.

This is a step-up opportunity. We're looking for a bright, self-starting engineer who is ready for more scope than their current role allows. You might not have held a principal title yet. What matters is that you're already building this way, you learn fast, and you want the room to prove it. You'll have direct access to senior leadership, real problems with commercial weight, and the freedom to choose how you solve them.

Key tasks and accountabilities

Build and ship

  • Design, build and run AI-powered products, tools and services from prototype to production
  • Own outcomes end to end: problem framing, architecture, implementation, evaluation, release and operation
  • Run fast, time-boxed experiments; scale what works and stop what doesn't, with the evidence to back either call
  • Set up and evolve the AI infrastructure these builds rely on: model access, evaluation tooling, observability and guardrails

Shape direction

  • Work with the VP Technology to set Awin's engineering-specific AI direction, grounded in what has actually been built and measured
  • Scope strategic opportunities early with product and commercial leaders, with effort, cost and value made explicit
  • Make clear recommendations on build vs buy, model and vendor choice, and where AI should not be used

Architecture and design

  • Design new capability so it connects safely to the existing platform: APIs, events, data and identity
  • Select tools and technologies, and define the patterns and practices for AI-native development at Awin
  • Weigh long-term maintainability, economic viability and reuse against speed, and document the trade-offs

Spread what works

  • Turn proven builds into reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, and share them so other teams can adopt them without hand-holding

Ways of working

  • Works autonomously, guided by the VP Technology's priorities rather than team-level delivery processes
  • Engages directly with engineering, product, data, security and commercial stakeholders as each build requires

Skills & Expertise

AI-native engineering

  • Builds with coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as the default way of working. Can show how they decompose work, manage context and review agent output to get production-quality code at pace
  • Has shipped LLM-powered features to production: prompt and context engineering, tool use and function calling, structured outputs, retrieval (RAG) and multi-step agent workflows
  • Builds evaluations first: test sets, automated evals and regression checks for non-deterministic behaviour, with quality measured before and after release
  • Connects models to enterprise systems and data safely, e.g. MCP servers, internal APIs and event streams, with clear permissions and audit trails
  • Understands model selection, token economics, latency, caching and fallback strategies, and can explain cost and benefit trade-offs to commercial stakeholders
  • Designs for AI-specific security and privacy risks: prompt injection, data leakage, PII handling under GDPR, and guardrails on what models can do

Engineering foundations

  • Expert in at least one modern language (Python or TypeScript ideal), and able to work in our existing Java, PHP and JavaScript estate when integrating
  • Strong cloud-native and serverless architecture on AWS, with infrastructure as code (Terraform)
  • Experience with event-driven and distributed systems (Kafka/MSK, SQS/SNS) and with relational and non-relational data stores
  • Builds observability into everything: tracing, logging and monitoring, including LLM-specific telemetry
  • Treats automated testing, CI/CD and secure-by-default design as standard, and automates as much of the delivery loop as possible

Ways of building

  • Takes an idea to a working prototype in days, then hardens it for production, and knows when to stop
  • Leaves behind reusable patterns, templates and internal tools, not one-off solutions

Soft skills

  • Bias to action: ships, measures and iterates rather than waiting for perfect requirements
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: frames vague opportunities into concrete, testable bets
  • Commercially minded: connects technical choices to revenue, cost and customer outcomes, and balances effort against value
  • Intellectually honest: kills their own ideas when the evidence says so, and says plainly where AI is not the answer
  • Clear communicator: explains technical trade-offs to executives, engineers and commercial teams in language each understands, in writing and in person
  • Influences without authority: gets teams to adopt new patterns because they work, not because they're mandated
Our Offer
  • Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.
  • Flexi-office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.
  • Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home.
  • Health and Wellbeing: With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.
  • Development: We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.
  • Appreciation: Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme.
We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview.

Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.

Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is the role

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join the Elasticsearch - Search team. This globally-distributed team of expert engineers focuses on delivering a robust and feature-rich search experience, including contributing to improving the search experience in Lucene. This is a principal software engineering role that focuses on enhancing the vector similarity search functionality within Elasticsearch, covering the design and implementation of new vector search features, enhancements to existing vector search functionality, and resolving bugs.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. We collaborate across continents every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. At our best, we write fast, scalable and intuitive software. We believe that the best way to do that is to empower individual engineers, code review every change, decide big things by consensus, and strive for incremental improvements.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead initiatives within Elasticsearch to produce an industry-leading vector database offering, supplying unparalleled speed and relevance in search.
  • Contribute to Elasticsearch full time, building new search features and fixing intriguing bugs, all while making the code easier to understand. Sometimes you'll need to invent a new algorithm or data structure. Or find one and implement it. Sometimes you'll need to get close to the operating system and hardware.
  • Work with a globally distributed team of experienced engineers focused on the vector search capabilities of Elasticsearch.
  • Be an expert on how Elasticsearch implements vector similarity in support of search relevance and everyone will turn to you when they have a question about this area. You'll improve this area based on your questions and your instincts.
  • Work with community members from all over the world on issues and pull requests, sometimes triaging them and handing them off to other experts and sometimes handling them yourself.
  • Write idiomatic modern Java -- Elasticsearch is 99.8% Java!

What You Bring Along

  • You have implemented novel techniques in vector similarity on a search platform with a large user base or progressed the field of academic research in vector similarity information retrieval.
  • Professional experience with vector similarity and vector databases, and you used HNSW, IVF, or other relevant algorithms and libraries on search platforms at scale.
  • You have strong skills in core Java and are conversant in the standard library of data structures and concurrency constructs, as well as other features like lambdas.
  • You work with a high level of autonomy, and are able to take on projects and guide them from beginning to end. This covers both technical design and working with other engineers to develop needed components.
  • You're comfortable developing collaboratively. Giving and receiving feedback on code and approaches and APIs is hard! Bonus points if you've collaborated over the internet because that's harder. Double bonus points for asynchronous collaboration over the internet. That's even harder, but we do it anyway because it's the best way we know how to build software.
  • You've used several data storage technologies like Elasticsearch, Solr, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or Cassandra and have some idea how they work and why they work that way.
  • You have excellent verbal and written communication skills. Like we said, collaborating on the internet is hard. We try to be respectful, empathetic, and trusting in all of our interactions. And we'd expect that from you too.
  • You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities
  • You work autonomously and can drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.

Bonus Points

  • You've built things with Elasticsearch before.
  • You've worked with open source projects and are familiar with different styles of source control workflow and continuous integration.
  • Experience with data storage technology.
  • You have experience designing, leading and owning cross-functional initiatives

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

title: Product Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

 

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

     

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

     

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

     

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

title: Product Manager - Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL) + Market Interactions, Paris (French & English)
descriptionHtml:
Job title: Product Manager - Customer Account Lifecycle

Location: Location: Paris, France — 3 days a week in office

Team: Product Management

Reporting To: Group Product Manager

Please note: This role is based in France, so you need to live here or be open to

relocating, and it requires an existing right to work in the EU. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

Fluent French and English (spoken and written) are essential, and we kindly ask you to submit your CV in English.

 

About Kaluza

Kaluza reimagines energy to bring net-zero within everyone’s reach. Our intelligent platform enables energy utilities to unlock the full value of a radically changing energy system and propel us to a future where renewable energy is sustainable, affordable and accessible for all.

From automating and simplifying core operations including billing to create a lower-cost, higher-engagement experience, to optimising energy usage across smart devices in the home, we turn tough challenges into win-win-win outcomes for customers, suppliers and the energy system.

At Kaluza we embrace a flexible, hybrid work model that balances autonomy with the power of in-person connection. Many of our teams find value in coming together regularly to collaborate, strengthen relationships, and accelerate progress. We’re focused on shaping thoughtful, team-driven approaches that support both business impact and individual well-being.

We also prioritise meaningful company-wide gatherings like our annual conference and end-of-year celebrations, that bring us together to align, connect, and celebrate.

What will I be doing?

You will work closely with a team of software engineers on the Belgian expansion of our Customer Account Lifecycle (CAL) domain, one of the core product domains of the Kaluza platform. It holds customer, account and contract information and owns the customer journeys around them (for example, moving home or changing contract). It is a full-stack domain: a front end for customer service agents, APIs that expose the data, and back-end services that own the databases and workflow logic. You will therefore work across the whole product domain. This is not a product owner role: you will own features end to end, from dialogue with clients and users to delivery of the software, while running the team’s day-to-day and the discovery work.

Occasional trips to Belgium are possible (around two per quarter).

  • Translate Belgian market requirements into clear specifications — turn the rules of the Belgian energy market into product requirements

  • Become the client’s trusted partner: — work hand in hand with ENGIE and future clients in the Belgian market to understand their needs, run discovery workshops to define how the product works and scope the work, shape requirements together, and build a relationship where they come to you first. That closeness helps you steer what CAL builds next.

  • Build, don't just specify. Go from idea to working prototype yourself — query data, explore API schemas, and stand up proofs of concept. We expect you to use AI tooling (e.g. Claude Code) as a daily multiplier to prototype, investigate, and unblock, not just to draft documents.

  • Align global and local teams across all functions — partner closely with engineering, UX, QA and more, with a full stack influence, keeping everyone pointed at the right outcomes, and act as the link between our global and local teams to inform priorities and strategy

Ideally you’ll have/be

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager, Business Analyst, orequivalent role in software companies, with a track record of successfully localising complex software products for international markets

  • Fluent in French and very comfortable in English — our platform and many of our teams operate in English, so you move easily between both.

  • Confident working directly with clients — you can run a working session with client stakeholders, draw out the real requirement behind the ask, and keep senior people aligned and brought in.

  • A builder's mentality — resourceful and hands-on, comfortable building a working prototype rather than waiting for the perfect specification.

  • Technically comfortable — at ease with data and data models, databases, and APIs, and able to prototype with modern AI tooling. You don't need to be an engineer, but you think like one and can hold your own in a technical conversation. Equally happy reasoning about a data model and about what the end user sees on screen.

  • A clear, sharp communicator — able to cut through noise and articulate technical and market complexity to a range of stakeholders, including clients.

  • Experience collaborating across cross-functional teams — engineering, QA, BA, Programme, Delivery etc — to deliver localised solutions.

  • Proficiency in AI tools throughout all stages of the product lifecycle — from discovery and ideation to delivery and iteration.

Our Values

 

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

  • Financial & Insurance: Discretionary bonus, Alan Mutuelle Health Insurance, x3 Life & Death insurance (Prévoyance) via Alan, and standard Sécurité Sociale contributions (pension, family allowance, unemployment insurance)

  • Allowances: 50% commuting expense reimbursement, €200 Home Working Allowance, and €150 Learning Fund

  • Time Off & Flexibility: 25 days holiday + 1 birthday day off + bank holidays + RTT days (11), Moments That Matter Leave, Compassionate Leave, two paid Volunteering Days, Flexible Working, and Career Break eligibility

Come as you are

 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Read more about our values over on our careers site.

  

Find out more about working in Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn. You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.

Compensation: €46K – €63K

title: Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Product Manager

Location: UK (remote)

Job Description

About Us

Reachdesk is the first truly end-to-end global SaaS gifting and swag platform, helping B2B companies create meaningful connections with prospects, customers, and employees, while driving measurable ROI.

We believe gifting is more than just a transaction: it’s about building genuine human connections that fuel business growth. Whether it’s engaging prospects, celebrating customers, or recognizing employees, our platform makes it easy to deliver personalized gifts, branded swag, and unforgettable event & brand experiences at scale through automated sourcing, storage, and global delivery.

Trusted by many of the most recognized names in technology and SaaS, Reachdesk integrates effortlessly with marketing, sales, and HRIS tech stacks and is powered by our world-class team across New York, London, and Lisbon.

We’re growing, and we’re currently looking for a Product Manager to join us.

About the Role

As a Product Manager at Reachdesk, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping the Reachdesk Platform. You will be accountable for turning complex customer and business problems into software products that deliver measurable impact.

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll lead product initiatives end-to-end,  from identifying and deeply understanding the right problems to solve, through discovery and delivery, to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, proactively building context across customers, the market, internal stakeholders, data, and technology to understand what Reachdesk needs to achieve its goals. You’ll also make sound decisions when the path forward isn’t obvious.

You’ll partner closely with Engineering and Design and work across the wider business to create alignment, communicate decisions clearly, and ensure what we build is successfully launched, adopted, and delivers the outcomes we set out to achieve.

If you enjoy solving difficult problems, taking ownership, and moving comfortably between customer, technical, and business conversations, you’ll thrive in this role.

Responsibilities

  • Set product direction and priorities, bringing together company goals, internal stakeholder needs, customer insight, market context, data, and technical considerations to focus on the highest-impact opportunities.
  • Define problems and experiences before solutions, creating clear stories, journeys, and shared context so the Design and Engineering teams understand the problem and intended outcomes before determining the solution.
  • Lead product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and solution definition through delivery, rollout, and iteration, partnering with Engineering to manage scope, make pragmatic trade-offs, and deliver valuable solutions at pace.
  • Make sound product decisions and trade-offs, balancing customer and business needs, commercial impact, user experience, and technical considerations while aligning the wider business on compromises, priorities, and expectations.
  • Develop product opportunities with external partners, building relationships with technology partners to uncover mutual opportunities, shape integrations, align roadmaps, and navigate the product and commercial considerations required to bring them to market.
  • Orchestrate successful launches and adoption, working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Services, Logistics, Finance, Legal, and other teams to ensure the business is ready and customers realise value from what we build.
  • Communicate with clarity throughout, ensuring leadership and teams across Reachdesk understand product decisions, progress, risks, changes, and results.

About you

  • You have a strong track record of owning B2B SaaS products end-to-end, from identifying the right problems through delivery, adoption, and measurable customer and business outcomes.
  • You’re a strong problem solver who gets to the root of complex problems, brings structure to ambiguity, and uses evidence and judgement to determine the right path forward.
  • You operate with independence and initiative: you seek out the customers, stakeholders, data, and context you need rather than waiting for direction, while staying anchored to Reachdesk’s goals and priorities.
  • You have strong business and commercial awareness and are curious about how the wider company operates, allowing you to understand competing needs and make pragmatic decisions beyond the boundaries of Product.
  • You’re technically fluent enough to work effectively with Engineering, understand systems, integrations, and constraints, ask the right questions, and contribute meaningfully to solution and scope decisions.
  • You’re an exceptional communicator, able to create clarity, influence decisions, surface difficult trade-offs, and adapt how you communicate across customers, engineers, leadership, and teams throughout the business.
  • You’re comfortable operating externally as well as internally, building productive relationships with technology partners, uncovering shared opportunities, influencing without authority, and navigating product, technical, and commercial conversations.
  • You have a strong sense of product and user experience, caring about the coherence and quality of the complete experience rather than whether individual requirements or features have simply been delivered.

The benefits

  • Competitive salary with generous stock options
  • Pension with employer contributions (NEST)
  • Affordable Private Medical Insurance, including mental health support and fast access to care
  • Flexible PTO that increases the longer you’re with us, plus extra flexibility for life’s unexpected moments
  • A genuinely collaborative culture with innovative, fun, and ambitious people

Reachdesk believes that a diverse team helps us achieve our mission faster, and so we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

title: Product Manager Supply Chain & Transport - F/H
descriptionHtml:
Le Product Management, c’est notre ADN.

Chez Hubvisory, tu ne te contentes pas de gérer un backlog : tu deviens la référence produit incontournable pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes sur les produits digitaux qui tiennent leur chaîne d’approvisionnement debout. Référencement transporteurs, flux maritimes, routiers et ferroviaires, données critiques, maîtrise des coûts réels. Des sujets denses, peu spectaculaires vus de loin, et parmi les plus structurants qu’un Product Manager puisse porter.

Ce que tu fais concrètement :

  • Tu pars du terrain avant de concevoir. Cartographie des flux de données, entretiens avec les coordinateurs transport parfois répartis sur plusieurs pays, identification des vrais irritants. Tu traduis ce qui remonte en parcours cibles, pas en liste de demandes.

  • Tu portes une vision à deux ou trois ans. Tu construis la roadmap d’une plateforme de référencement et de pilotage : automatisation des appels d’offres, gestion des quotas, prévision des délais d’acheminement. Tu décides ce qu’on construit, et ce qu’on laisse tomber.

  • Tu prends la donnée en main. Modèles interconnectés, qualité de la donnée, écarts entre coûts réels transporteurs et refacturation interne. Tu interprètes toi-même les indicateurs, tu structures des hypothèses, tu mesures pour décider, pas pour afficher.

  • Tu pilotes le cadrage et la delivery. Briefs produit et scénarios d’usage pour ta squad technique, animation des rituels, validation de la conformité à chaque jalon, mise en service et formation des utilisateurs. Un outil historique ne disparaît que si le nouveau tient vraiment la route.

  • Tu mesures l’impact. Réduction de la charge manuelle des équipes transport, fiabilisation des délais, tenue des coûts. Tu définis les KPI et les OKR qui comptent et tu les défends.

  • Tu participes à la vie d’Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant, tu partages tes retours d’expérience et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de Product Leader ou Manager Conseil.

  • Tu as déjà vu ce que l’automatisation des flux ou un algorithme de prévision change sur un produit supply chain ? On cherche des PM qui qualifient les cas IA avant de les mettre en place, pas des PM qui militeraient pour de l’IA partout.


👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ?

  • Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l’IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. On fait une chose, on la fait bien, on la fait avec les meilleurs clients.

  • Un parcours d'accompagnement sur-mesure. Si tu es PO aujourd'hui et que tu veux devenir PM, on te donne les moyens : mentorship, cas complexes, retours structurés. Nos rituels collectifs (Hub'Times) et nos revalorisations bi-annuelles récompensent la vraie progression, pas l'ancienneté.

  • Une communauté interne engagée : 20% des collaborateurs qui se sont volontairement engagés à travers plus de 20 projets à impact menés depuis 2022 (mécénat de compétence, organisation de maraudes, fresque du climat, etc.)

  • Des valeurs fortes : depuis 8 ans Hubvisory grandit autour de la bienveillance, la méritocratie, l’ambition, l’expertise et l’apprentissage.

Le package : 42.000-52.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu’à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire.



👉 Le profil que nous recherchons

  • Tu justifies d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager sur des produits digitaux avec un passage par la supply chain, la logistique, le transport international ou les référentiels de données critiques.

  • Tu es à l’aise dans des architectures fonctionnelles denses et des modèles de données interconnectés, avec une exigence forte sur la qualité de la donnée. Le pilotage de roadmap et de backlog fait partie de ton quotidien, et ton orientation valeur est ton moteur.

  • Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : une autonomie opérationnelle réelle, une communication capable d’embarquer des interlocuteurs internationaux et dispersés, et une rigueur analytique à toute épreuve.

  • Anglais professionnel attendu.

  • Environnement technique que tu croiseras : Jira, Confluence, Figma, data lakes, API REST, écosystèmes ERP et TMS.

Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ?

Étape 1 : Echange avec un RH pour valider l’adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle

Etape 2 : Validation de tes hard skills avec cas pratique avec un manager

Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP

Etape 4 : Echange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d’embauche

Quelle que soit l’issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum !

Si tu veux plus d’information sur notre processus de recrutement, on en a fait un article sur notre blog.

title: Program Director - Hardware Systems (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

YOUR MISSION

As a Program Manager at STARK, you will lead one of our core hardware programs taking it from early R&D all the way to production readiness. You’ll be responsible for translating ambitious technical concepts into operational products and building the team that makes it happen.

You’ll work hand-in-hand with a dedicated Chief Engineer, combining program leadership with technical direction. Together, you’ll shape the vision, align priorities, and drive execution across engineering, production, and business functions.

A key part of your mission will be to build and scale a world-class engineering team, recruiting top talent, defining structure, and fostering a high-performance culture that moves fast, collaborates openly, and delivers. You’ll also coordinate with shared engineering functions (simulation, testing, systems, etc.) to allocate resources effectively and ensure critical work gets the attention it needs.

This role is about ownership and leadership: Building both a product and the organization that delivers it.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • End-to-End Program Leadership: Own the delivery of a major hardware program from R&D, to go-to-market verification to production readiness.
  • Team Building: Build, structure, and grow a high-performing multidisciplinary team. Recruit top engineering talent and create an environment where they can deliver their best work.
  • Partnership with Chief Engineer: Co-lead the program, pairing strong technical direction with decisive program leadership.
  • Strategic Planning: Translate strategic goals into clear milestones, deliverables, and resource plans.
  • Execution & Prioritization: Drive focus on what matters most. Keep teams aligned, proactive, and moving fast.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Connect the dots across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and business functions to maintain alignment and momentum.
  • Program–Portfolio Alignment: Work closely with the VP Programs to ensure key programs get the focus and resources needed to deliver cutting-edge technology to customers at record speed.
  • Leadership & Culture: Set high standards, communicate clearly, and keep teams motivated and accountable even in demanding phases.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Deliver concise, transparent updates on progress, risks, and key decisions to leadership.
  • Process & Structure: Implement pragmatic governance and scalable processes that enable speed without bureaucracy.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Experience: 4–10 years in program or project management, ideally in hardware, aerospace, robotics, or defense. Proven experience leading complex technical programs and growing teams.
  • Background: Technical or technically literate background: e.g. engineering, industrial engineering, or technical management. You don’t need to design systems yourself, but you must understand how engineers think and work.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to build and lead high-performing teams. You attract talent, set structure, and keep people aligned through clarity and purpose.
  • Mindset: Mission-driven, decisive, and pragmatic. You thrive in ambiguity and bring structure to complexity. You seek feedback, learn fast, and raise your own bar continuously.
  • Communication: Clear, direct communicator with strong written and verbal skills in English and German.
  • Execution: Strong bias for action: >ou get things done, stay close to the details, and drive accountability.
  • Tools: Comfortable with modern program tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence, Excel, and PMO systems).

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

DATA PRIVACY STATEMENT

This data privacy statement, which refers exclusively to data collected as part of the online application process, is to inform you about how your personal data that is collected as part of the online application process is handled at our end.

The controller

The controller under data protection law is:

SKD SE

Französische Strasse 12, 10117 Berlin

Data Protection officer: heyData GmbH, Schützenstraße 5, 10117 Berlin, www.heydata.eu, -----

Personal data collected as part of the application process

Personal data means any information concerning the personal or material circumstances of an identified or identifiable individual. This includes information such as, for example, your name, address, telephone number and date of birth, but also data relating to your specific career etc. by reference to which a specific individual can be identified with reasonable effort. However, information which cannot be (in)directly associated with your real-life identity is not personal data.

Fundamentals and purposes of processing personal data collected from application documents and during the application process

If you apply to us electronically, i.e. via e-mail or using our online form, we will collect and process your personal data for the purpose of executing the application process and preparing contracts.

By submitting an application via our recruitment website, you express your interest in taking up work with us. In this context, you transmit personal data, which we will use and store exclusively for the purpose of your job search / application process.

In particular, the following data is collected during this process:

  • name (first and last names)

Furthermore, you can choose to upload expressive documents such as a cover letter, your CV and reference letters. These may contain additional personal data such as date of birth, address etc.

Only authorized HR staff and/or staff involved in the application process have access to your data.

The personal data is stored, as a rule, exclusively for the purpose of filling the vacancy for which you have applied.

In case of anonymization, the data will only be available to us in the form of so-called metadata, without any direct personal reference, for statistical analysis (for example, share of male and/or female applicants, number of applications per specified period of time etc.).

Furthermore, we reserve the right to store your data for 180 days after the application process has been concluded for the purpose of adding it to our Talent Pool in order to identify any other vacancies that may be of interest to you. Should you be offered and accept a position with us during the application process, we will store the personal data collected as part of the application process for at least the duration of your employment.

In this context, Greenhouse is our processor under article 28 of the GDPR. In this case, the processing is based on an agreement for the processing of orders between us as the controller and Greenhouse.

Rights of data subjects

If we as the controller process personal data, you as the data subject have certain rights under Chapter III of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), depending on the legal basis and the purpose of the processing, in particular the right of access (article 15 of the GDPR) and the rights to rectification (article 16 of the GDPR), erasure (article 17 of the GDPR), restriction of processing (article 18 of the GDPR), and data portability (article 20 of the GDPR), as well as the right to object (article 21 of the GDPR). If the personal data is processed with your consent, you have the right to withdraw this consent under article 7 III of the GDPR.

To assert your rights as a data subject in relation to the data processed during this online application process, please refer to our Data Protection Officer (see item 2).

Concluding provisions

We reserve the right to adjust this data privacy statement at any point in time to ensure that it is in line with the current legal requirements at all times, or in order to accommodate changes in the application process or other processes. title: Projectontwikkelaar vastgoed
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij bouwen aan de woningbouwopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na tendergunning en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met bouwpartners én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.

Dit wordt jouw baan

Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als Senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de bouw om projecten succesvol richting uitvoering te brengen. Daarnaast krijg je de mogelijkheid om in de toekomst ontwikkelaars te begeleiden en bijvoorbeeld door te groeien naar een rol als Hoofd Vastgoedontwikkeling.

Wat ga je doen

Deze functie richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op de initiatieffase of acquisitiekant van gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen en projecten daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd gaan worden. Je werkt aan (midel)grote woningbouwontwikkelingen van honderden woningen en bent de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het realiseren van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie.

· Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning tot aan de start van de realisatie;

· Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's;

· Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders;

· Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken;

· Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering;

· Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming;

· Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces;

· Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie;

· Je begeleidt en coacht minder ervaren projectontwikkelaars en krijgt de ruimte om op termijn een meer aansturende rol te vervullen.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.


Hier zit je op jouw plek

Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling.

Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen.

Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.


Dit breng jij mee

· Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als projectontwikkelaar, ontwikkelmanager of vergelijkbare functie;

· Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding;

· Ervaring met woningbouwontwikkelingen;

· Aantoonbare ervaring met projecten van substantiële omvang (200+ woningen is een pre).;

· Ruime ervaring met ontwikkeltrajecten in de SO-, VO- en DO-fases, het verkrijgen van omgevingsvergunningen en verkooptrajecten;

· Inzicht in bouwtechnische uitgangspunten om adviseurs aan te sturen en het plan verder uit te werken;

· Ervaring binnen een ontwikkelaar, ontwikkelende bouwer of vastgoedorganisatie.

Je bent een ontwikkelaar die vooral energie krijgt van de projecten na tendergunning verder te brengen richting realisatie. Je begrijpt de dynamiek van de bouw en weet hoe je samen met alle betrokken partijen woningbouwprojecten succesvol kunt ontwikkelen én realiseren.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Het salaris voor deze functie ligt bij een medior profiel tussen € 5.639,- en € 7.049,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur) en bij een senior profiel tussen € 6.512,- en € 9.512,- (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Het exacte salaris is afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring.

  • Voor deze functie geldt een individuele bonusregeling, waarbij de hoogte van de bonus afhankelijk is van de behaalde resultaten.

  • Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra).

  • 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Van deze dagen worden er 13 uitbetaald in je individuele budget, je kunt ervoor kiezen om deze dagen terug te kopen;

  • Een laptop en een smartphone.

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap.

  • Je hebt de keuze tussen een elektrische leaseauto, een mobiliteitsbudget of NS Business Card.

  • Bij een contract voor onbepaalde tijd kun je een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets uitzoeken dankzij onze samenwerking met lease-a-bike.

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar ook op het gebied van vitaliteit.

  • Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland.

  • Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij een flexibel werken beleid en soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of sabbatical.

  • Voor verse vaders en partners: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens de 5 weken van het aanvullend geboorteverlof, in plaats van de standaard 70%.

Wil jij ook meer uit je werk halen?

Dan zijn wij nieuwsgierig naar jou! Solliciteren kan direct via onze website middels de solliciteerbutton onder de vacature.

Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze recruiter

Bel, whatsapp of e-mail interim recruiter Arnold van Stade via 06-18702179 of ----- style="min-height: 1.7em;">

Bij Dura Vermeer werven en selecteren we onze kandidaten graag zonder de goedbedoelde hulp van “onderaannemers”. Bij acquisitie behouden we ons het recht voor om meerwerk in rekening te brengen.

title: QA Director
descriptionHtml:
