At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. 

Stumble Guys is a global sensation, with millions of fans joining the party every single day and with the ambition of becoming nothing less than a beloved franchise to be played for many years to come.

What You Will Do 

You will collaborate and coordinate with peers, senior management and external partners, to ensure operations are aligned with the departmental mission, values, and long-term strategic goals as well as ensuring continued service improvements are implemented throughout the world on behalf of Scopely QA & Deployment. 

You will help shape the future on how we continue to iterate and evolve our products at a high level, while ensuring our products delight our players release after release. Day to day responsibilities may include:

  • Lead an ambitious Mobile and Console QA & Deployment Program involving multiple disciplines, including Functionality QA, Dev QA, Live-Ops QA, Build Distribution and Submissions across all platforms
  • Manage and provide leadership, technical expertise and career development for multiple QA & Deployment Project Owners; support the skillset growth across the QA & Deployment crafts, leading to higher value individual contributors and managers
  • Build on existing team metrics for measurement of quality and operational excellence and a consistent, regular process for assessment and improvements
  • Manage day-to-day relationships with external QA vendors, aligning priorities, capacity and deliverables with project needs; assess vendor performance against agreed quality and delivery targets and drive improvement actions
  • Be an advocate and spokesperson for Automation Engineering efforts and AI implementation into QA pipelines. Clearly communicate issues, risks, concerns, and successes to stakeholders, partners, and executives
  • Establish and maintain strong communication with cross-functional teams across all disciplines for both internal and external development, QA and Localization partners
  • Work with the Deployment Project Managers and Dev QA teams to create efficient plans, assignments, and schedules for associated quality functions
  • Continually improve the operational efficiency and effectiveness of the QA & Deployment effort by assessing current practices and incorporating new strategies
  • Be the internal advocate and spokesperson for all things QA & Deployment. Clearly communicate issues, risks, concerns, and successes to stakeholders
  • Hold fellow leaders accountable for including quality as an essential factor in product development
  • Lead regular performance assessments of QA & Deployment Project Owners and their teams, using clear objectives, quality metrics and stakeholder feedback to guide coaching, development and performance improvement.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10 + years as a quality assurance professional
  • 6 + years management experience in leading a team through a full game cycle
  • Excellent written/verbal communication in English
  • Experience in building and managing a QA organization that is responsible for end-to-end validation for a critical system or application
  • Demonstrated experience managing external QA vendors, including setting delivery expectations, assessing performance and driving service improvements, alongside a strong understanding of Dev QA and external testing strategies.
  • Experience working with remote teams and with a cross functional team that is distributed around the globe
  • Experience and ease in interfacing with Senior Management, working to develop and maintain strong, effective relationships across the organization
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to multitask under pressure of hard deadlines
  • Demonstrated experience managing bug defect solutions & creating test plans
  • Strong understanding of software development (SDLC) practices & nomenclature, quality assurance techniques, frameworks and methodologies
  • Flexible and dynamic – quickly adapt to changing needs of the business
  • Good understanding of the current and evolving landscape of AI-powered testing tools, and experience driving the transition from manual testing approaches to AI-native.
  • Business awareness - the ability to view situations from a business perspective
  • Proficient with setting up and navigating through bug database management, test case management tools, Google Docs, Google Sheets/Excel, and a build distribution management system (AppLivery), JIRA
  • Mobile Freemium/F2P gaming experience

Bonus Points 

  • Experience with Console and PC deployment & compliance.
  • Any experience with Localization, LQA, build distribution and submissions 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Automation)
descriptionHtml:
Quality Assurance Engineer (Automation)

The Role

You’ll own the quality of the Lyrebird platform, from the first commit to the release gate. This is a hands-on, code-first engineering role, not manual test scripting. You’ll make our Playwright end-to-end and integration suites faster and more reliable, build contract tests that stop backend changes from silently breaking the web app, and design ways to evaluate clinical model output where exact-match assertions don’t work. You’ll also be the quality partner to our SRE function, giving them the health checks, synthetic monitors, load test results and post-deployment signals they need. When a release is ready to go, you’ll give a clear yes or no, backed by evidence.

This role suits an engineer who sees testing as a craft and treats a test suite as production code. You’re comfortable moving between TypeScript and Python in the same day, you get real satisfaction from deleting a flaky test and cutting minutes off a pipeline, and you’d rather help other engineers write better tests than be the only person who writes them. You’ll enjoy the hard problem at the centre of this role: how to prove that non-deterministic AI output is safe and accurate enough for clinicians to rely on.

About Us

Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks.

Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Optimise our Playwright end-to-end suite, cutting run time and removing flaky tests for good

  • Extend our API and partner integration suites, and build contract tests from our OpenAPI schemas so no backend change can break the web app without warning

  • Add coverage gates to our Buildkite pipeline, using reporting that already breaks quality down by product area

  • Support and collaborate with our engineering teams with CICD development and oversight

  • Test the clinical output of our models with DeepEval, openevals and Langfuse traces, designing evaluations that hold up when responses change from run to run

  • Run load tests with Locust ahead of major releases and hand clear findings to the SRE function

  • Build the signals SRE depends on: health checks, synthetic monitors and post-deployment tests

  • Own the release quality gate, giving a clear yes or no with the evidence behind it

  • Raise the standard of testing across engineering through shared patterns, fixtures and thoughtful code review

What you’ll bring

  • Strong test automation experience in both TypeScript and Python, writing tests as production-quality code

  • Deep hands-on experience with Playwright, plus component testing with Vitest and Testing Library

  • Solid pytest skills, including async tests, fixtures, mocking and test data factories such as polyfactory or Faker

  • Experience running tests in CI pipelines (ideally Buildkite) and in Docker, with coverage measurement and reporting

  • Working knowledge of SQL and Postgres, and confidence testing at the database layer

  • Experience with API contract testing against OpenAPI schemas

Nice to have

  • Experience evaluating large language model output with tools such as DeepEval, openevals or Langfuse

  • Load testing experience with Locust

  • Familiarity with Svelte, Storybook, or Supabase and its CLI-based database testing

  • Experience with observability tools such as Sentry, OpenTelemetry and Honeycomb

  • A background in healthcare, clinical software or other regulated, safety-critical environments

Every test you write protects a clinician who is relying on Lyrebird in the middle of a busy day, and the patient sitting in front of them. When our platform is fast, stable and trustworthy, clinicians spend less time on admin and more time on care. You’ll be the person who makes sure we can promise that with confidence, release after release.

We’re building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. If you’re from an underrepresented background in tech, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.

title: Regulatory & Certification Engineer, Hydrogen Energy
descriptionHtml:
About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

 

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

     

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

  • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

  • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

  • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

  • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

  • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

  • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

  • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

     

Preferred qualifications and personal profile

Nice to have

  • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

  • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

  • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

  • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

Personal profile

  • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

  • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

  • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

  • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

     

Start date: Immediately

title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
descriptionHtml:
Functie Reliability engineer

Beschrijving functie

De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets. De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.

De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren.



Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.

  • Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem

  • Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn.

  • Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf.

  • Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren.

  • Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout



    • Taken

    1. Trouble shooting

      1. Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen

      2. Daily problem solving

    2. Continue verbeteren

      1. Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers om van daaruit middels verbetervoorstellen bij te dragen aan een maximale beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid van installaties tegen minimale kosten

      2. Innovatief denken m.b.t. het verlagen van de kosten en verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid

      3. Leiden/faciliteren van verbeterteams c.q. verbeterprojecten

    3. Change Management

      1. Beoordelen van wijzigingen op technische haalbaarheid met het bestaande machinepark. Vanuit procurement komen verzoeken op het gebied van grondstof wijzigingen ( andere leverancier, andere specificaties ed.)

      2. Begeleiden van proeven vanuit de technische kant op de machines

      3. Installatie nieuwe machines / introductie nieuwe producten

    4. Technische beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid

      1. Evalueren van preventief onderhoud en voorstellen doen ter verbetering met als doel het verhogen van de beschikbaarheid van het machinepark

      2. Het verlagen van onderhoudskosten door het optimaliseren van onderhoudsconcepten en doorvoeren van technische verbeteringen.

    5. Investeringsprojecten

      1. Participeren in investeringsprojecten om de onderhoudbaarheid te borgen en het inregelen van onderhoud en spare parts.

      2. Inbrengen van technische kennis en ervaringen.

      3. Toezien op naleving van de standaard op gebied van onderdelen en installaties.

    6. Onderhoudsstrategie bepalen

      1. Opstellen van effectieve onderhoudsconcepten zodat onderhoud van de installaties op de meest efficiënte en effectieve manier kan worden gerealiseerd tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten

      2. Borgen van compliance; het inregelen van wettelijke inspecties en keuringen en toezien op tijdige uitvoering daarvan.

    7. Beheren van de Standard Operating Procedures voor de installaties (SOP)

      1. Schrijven van nieuwe SOP’s, inclusief autonoom onderhoud

      2. Herzien van SOP’s als gevolg van proces verbeteringen en aanpassingen

    8. Bewaken standaarden voor veiligheid en kwaliteit

      1. Uitvoeren van risico assessments

      2. Borgen dat processen voldoen aan veiligheids standaarden en kwaliteits standaarden.

      3. Uitvoeren van optimalisatie testen.

      4. Ontwikkelen van best practice die de productkwaliteit borgen

title: Product Manager (ElevenCreative Self-Serve)
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring a Product Manager to own the core ElevenCreative product experience for creators and marketers who sign up, subscribe, and build on their own. Self-serve users make up the majority of ElevenCreative’s user base, and they use the platform to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

You’ll drive growth and adoption across the self-serve product experience, focusing on how users discover what ElevenCreative can do, how they move from a first generation into agents, video, and multi-step creative workflows, and what keeps them coming back and upgrading. There’s no shortage of things we could build. The job is defining the big bets, scoping them well, and shipping them quickly with the team.

PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward growth or go-to-market work, and you’ll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for its users.

What you’ll do

  • Drive growth and adoption of the self-serve product, focusing on onboarding, activation, and upgrade moments, and partnering with growth, lifecycle, and pricing teams where they connect

  • Scope and define the big bets for the self-serve product across image, video, music, agents, and editing workflows

  • Find the biggest opportunities in the user journey through product data and user behavior, and turn them into clearly scoped projects

  • Drive adoption of newer experiences like agents and video, helping users expand from a single product into the full platform

  • Work with engineering and design to ship quickly, mocking up early concepts yourself when it speeds things up

  • Partner with growth, lifecycle, and social teams on launches and the moments that bring users into new parts of the product

  • Define success metrics for your area and track activation, engagement, retention, and conversion to paid plans

  • Talk to creators and marketers regularly to understand how they work and where the product falls short, and bring those insights back to the team

Requirements

  • 5+ years of product management experience on consumer or self-serve products

  • A track record of moving growth and adoption metrics through the products you’ve shipped

  • Deep familiarity with the creative space and the creators and marketers who use these tools, with a habit of bringing user insights into every product decision

  • Experience scoping and defining large, ambiguous bets and owning them end to end

  • Design-minded, with a high bar for quality and user experience and the ability to mock up concepts yourself

  • Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on how things are built and the tradeoffs involved

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort in product analytics tools to find opportunities and measure impact

  • A track record of shipping quickly and iterating based on what the data shows

  • Ownership pedigree, meaning you drive your own projects fully rather than handing off after the spec

  • Curiosity about AI and creative tools, and close attention to how the space is moving

title: (Senior) Full Stack Engineer (m/f/x) - Based in Germany
descriptionHtml:
Cara Care, a digital health company backed by Bayer AG, is on a mission to improve people’s digestive health through technology. As we expand our product portfolio and modernize our platform, we’re looking for a versatile, pragmatic, and forward-thinking (Senior) Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/x) to help shape the future of digital therapeutics.

Your Role

You’ll join a cross-functional product team with high ownership, lean processes, and a clear focus: deliver real impact to patients. We’re looking for someone who thrives on solving real-world problems with code, is technology-open, and knows when to build fast and when to build right. Your main focus will be building and improving our backend services, while also contributing to our React Native apps. You’ll also help us use AI tools and coding agents thoughtfully in day-to-day engineering, turning emerging capabilities into reliable workflows that improve how we design, build, test, and operate patient-facing products.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate reliable backend services and APIs, primarily using Python, Django, and PostgreSQL, and contribute targeted changes to our React Native applications with TypeScript.
  • Use AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and generate tests. Define clear tasks and constraints, provide relevant context, Provide clear context and constraints, and validate changes through code review, automated tests, and application-level checks.
  • Take an end-to-end view of features: understand how mobile clients, APIs, data models, and infrastructure interact, and make pragmatic technical decisions across these boundaries.
  • Own backend delivery from architecture and implementation to automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration, and continuously improve our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Improve the performance and reliability of our backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Connect AI-assisted development to engineering and design tools via MCP, for example to automate repetitive coding tasks or check frontend changes against Figma designs. Keep patient data, credentials, and other sensitive information out of unapproved tools and workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Medical to explore, define, and deliver patient-centric features across our platform, supporting regulated digital health products for IBS, GERD, and upcoming indications.
  • Uphold technical excellence in architecture, code quality, and security, including applicable requirements under IEC 62304, BSI TR-03161, and the MDR.
  • Mentor other developers and help raise the technical bar across the team.

Requirements

Your Profile

Must haves

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong backend focus and an understanding of how complete applications work from user interface to infrastructure.
  • Strong backend development skills in an established language such as Python, TypeScript, Java, or PHP. Our current stack includes Python, Django, and PostgreSQL.
  • Working knowledge of React Native and TypeScript, with the ability to implement and test changes in an existing mobile application.
  • Solid understanding of relational databases, API design, distributed systems and services.
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for backend services and APIs, including unit and integration tests.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and privacy, including authentication, authorization, secrets management, and secure handling of personal and patient data.
  • Strong practical knowledge of containers, Kubernetes, and cloud-native architecture, with experience using GCP or another major cloud provider such as AWS or Azure.
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents to implement features, refactor code, and write automated tests, including connecting agents to engineering tools via MCP. You can explain how you scoped the work, verified the results, and handled tool permissions and sensitive data.
  • A pragmatic product mindset: you collaborate effectively with non-technical stakeholders, understand the impact of technical decisions on patients and UX, and continuously improve both product and platform.

Nice-to-have

  • Strong Linux administration skills, including setting up, operating, and securing self-managed cloud instances; familiarity with monitoring and observability concepts.
  • Experience with Prometheus, Loki, and Grafana; GitOps using ArgoCD or FluxCD; or configuration management using Ansible or similar tools.
  • Networking knowledge and experience with mobile CI/CD, release automation, or application monitoring tools such as Sentry.
  • Experience in regulated industries, healthcare, or other security-conscious environments.


💡Please note: Cara Care is a remote-first company with a fully distributed team. All team members are based in Germany so candidates must reside in Germany to join us.

Zur Verstärkung unseres 15-köpfigen, deutschlandweit verteilten Netzwerk-Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt engagierte Unterstützung.

Was du bei uns bewegst

Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was du kannst - sondern auch, was du bewirkst. In dieser Rolle trägst du zu folgenden Punkten bei:

  • Planung, Implementierung und Optimierung komplexer Netzwerkinfrastrukturen bei unseren Kund:innen

  • Eigenständige Umsetzung von Netzwerkprojekten, beispielsweise bei der Modernisierung von Netzwerkkomponenten, Optimierung von VPN-Verbindungen oder Erweiterung von Managed Services

  • Analyse und Behebung komplexer Netzwerk- und IT-Störungen durch strukturiertes Troubleshooting und nachhaltige Lösungsansätze

  • Sicherstellung eines stabilen Netzwerkbetriebs sowie schnelle Unterstützung bei kritischen Störungen und technischen Herausforderungen

  • Technische Beratung unserer Kund:innen zur Weiterentwicklung ihrer IT-Infrastruktur, inklusive Analyse bestehender Umgebungen und Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen IT-Teams und Administrator:innen als technische Schnittstelle zwischen Kund:innen und verschiedenen Fachbereichen

  • Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung technischer Dokumentationen sowie Einbringen eigener Ideen zur Optimierung von Netzwerklösungen und internen Prozessen

Womit du bei uns glänzt

Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt.

  • Du bringst langjährige Erfahrung im Network Engineering mit und kennst dich mit der Implementierung, Administration und dem Betrieb komplexer Datacenter-Netzwerke aus

  • Du hast bereits Netzwerkprojekte eigenständig umgesetzt und überzeugst durch fundierte Erfahrung im Troubleshooting komplexer Netzwerk- und IT-Störungen

  • Du arbeitest proaktiv, eigenständig und lösungsorientiert, überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung und entwickelst dein Fachwissen gerne kontinuierlich weiter

  • Du bringst idealerweise weitere Zertifizierungen in Cisco ACI, Fortinet (NSE 5 oder höher), Palo Alto oder LANCOM sowie Erfahrung mit Kund:innen aus regulierten Branchen mit

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch - im Team, mit Kund:innen und im Alltag

  • Du lebst in Deutschland und bist berechtigt hier zu arbeiten - so können wir im Alltag gut und reibungslos zusammenarbeiten

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Bei uns bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job. Wir wollen, dass du dich weiterentwickeln, wohlfühlen und mitgestalten kannst. Hier ein paar Gründe, warum du gerne bei uns arbeitest:

  • Mehr Freiheit: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und bis zu 25 Tage arbeiten im EU-Ausland

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt: Ob im Büro oder von zuhause - du entscheidest, was für dich am besten funktioniert

  • Wissen, das weiterbringt: Zertifizierungen, individuelle Weiterbildungen und Raum für deine Entwicklung

title: Software Engineer, Operations Research
descriptionHtml:
About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

What you'll do

CircuitHub builds circuit boards on demand, every order different. Each day thousands of decisions are made: which orders run on which machines, which parts to buy and when, what to promise a customer and what to charge. You'll build the models behind those decisions.

  • Plan the factory. Schedule orders, panels and machines across our factories for throughput and on-time delivery, and know days ahead when we will run out of work or capacity.

  • Model the Grid. The Grid is our factory-scale robot: dozens of movers, gantries, printers and ovens. Model how work flows through it, find the bottlenecks, and tell us what the next machine or change is worth.

  • Price and promise. Estimate what an order really costs in labour, machine time and parts, and help set prices and lead times that win work and make money.

  • Buy smarter. Decide what parts and consumables to stock, when to order them, and how much risk of a shortage to accept.

  • Put it into production. Your models don't live in a spreadsheet: they run every day, feed the planning and quoting systems, and get checked against what actually happened.

What we look for

  • A quantitative background in operations research, applied maths, statistics, quantitative finance, economics or a similar field, and a record of models that changed real decisions.

  • Optimisation: linear and integer programming, constraint programming, or heuristics, and judgement about when a simple rule beats a solver.

  • Simulation and forecasting: building a model of a messy system, calibrating it to data and saying how far to trust it.

  • Strong Python and SQL. You write code other people can run and rely on.

  • You use coding agents to move faster and take full ownership of what they produce.

  • Curiosity about how things are physically made. You'll spend time in our factories in the US and UK.

Manufacturing experience is welcome but not required. If you have priced risk, optimised a portfolio or forecast demand, the problems here will feel familiar.

Stack

  • Modelling: Python, OR-Tools, simulation

  • Data: PostgreSQL, Snowflake, dbt, Dagster

  • Agents: Claude Code and Codex throughout

Location

Remote anywhere, or from our offices in London or Cambridge (UK) if you prefer, with regular visits to our factories in the UK and US.

Pay

UK £80k–£125k · US $125k–$250k, depending on experience, plus equity.

descriptionHtml:

title: Revenue Operations Associate
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone hungry to learn and early in their career to join us as our Revenue Operations Associate!

You'll get an inside look at, and be a key part of, how a high-performing GTM function operates: this is a great opportunity for exceptionally smart, motivated individuals who want to immerse themselves in the world of tech startups and gain real exposure to what it takes to keep a high-growth business moving.

You'll sit at the intersection of our GTM, Customer and Finance teams, keeping our systems, data, and reporting sharp as we scale. This isn't a "keep the lights on" role – you'll inherit processes that are still being built, and you'll have real room to audit what's working, fix what isn't, and put your own stamp on how we operate.

You'll get broad exposure early: one week you might be untangling a HubSpot workflow, the next you're building a dashboard the CCO takes into a board meeting. It's a genuinely excellent grounding in how a B2B SaaS business scales – but it comes with real pace, longer hours than a typical first job, and a learning curve to match. If you want breadth of exposure and a steep climb early in your career, this is a great seat.

What Can You Expect?

  • Keep our GTM tech stack in good shape: Own day-to-day CRM administration – data hygiene, permissions, and workflow upkeep – and support the configuration and integration of the wider stack.

  • Stay ahead of what's new: Keep across releases and new features across our tools – joining release webinars, reading release notes, and flagging what's worth adopting.

  • Help evaluate and set up new tools: Get involved as we add to the stack, from evaluation through to implementation.

  • Improve our data quality: Spot where data is incomplete or inconsistent, fix what you can, and propose fixes for the rest.

  • Build reporting and dashboards: Turn raw data into dashboards and reports that track pipeline health, funnel conversion, and the other KPIs the GTM team relies on day to day.

  • Support incentive tracking: Help maintain and monitor commission and incentive tracking, making sure calculations are accurate.

  • Onboard new GTM joiners: Train new starters across the GTM and Customer teams on our tools and processes so they're productive quickly.

  • Own our recurring admin cadence: Take ownership of the regular tasks that keep the engine running and look to automate where ever possible.

About You

  • You have a top-class academic record: you'll have graduated with (or be on track for) a 1st class degree, or have attended one of the top universities in the country you studied in – we're looking for a strong, proven track record of academic performance as the clearest early signal of the analytical rigour this role needs.

  • You're curious about how technology fits together: you likely have a STEM background, and you enjoy working out how systems, data, and workflows connect to make a business run – even if you've never worked in RevOps before.

  • You want pace, eyes open: you're drawn to a fast-scaling business precisely because of the pace, and you understand that means longer hours and a steeper learning curve than a typical grad role. You see that as a trade worth making.

  • You're happy to get stuck in: you know not every task here is glamorous – some of it is spreadsheet clean-up, data hygiene, or repetitive admin – and you take real satisfaction in doing that work well, not just the exciting parts.

  • You want to understand how B2B SaaS businesses scale: you're looking to build a first-hand understanding of the GTM engine – pipeline, systems, data, and the commercial mechanics behind it – as a foundation for wherever your career goes next.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Revenue Operations Lead (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft

Wir suchen Dich als Revenue Operations Lead für unser Revenue Operations Team in Berlin. Revenue Operations bündelt die kommerzielle Planung und Steuerung für alle Sales Motions, von Zielen und Kapazität über Pipeline und Performance bis zu Pricing und Packaging.

Als Revenue Operations Lead verantwortest Du die kommerzielle Steuerung von Inside Sales, vom Neugeschäft bis zu Upsell und Retention im Bestand, und bist dort die Ansprechperson für das Leadership, wenn aus Zahlen Entscheidungen werden. Zugleich übernimmst Du Themen, die über alle Motions laufen, etwa gemeinsame KPI-Definitionen oder die jährliche Planungsrunde, und gestaltest unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie mit: in welche Segmente, Motions und Kanäle wir investieren.

Nach sechs Monaten steuert Inside Sales auf einer gemeinsamen Zahlenbasis mit festen Routinen, die nächste Planungsrunde mit Zielen und Kapazität steht auf nachvollziehbaren Regeln, und mindestens eine wiederkehrende Steuerungsaufgabe läuft KI-gestützt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Business Reviews & Follow-up: Du bereitest Business Reviews vor, führst sie mit dem Leadership und bleibst dran, bis aus jedem Befund eine Entscheidung mit klarer Verantwortung geworden ist

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

title: SaaS Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

We are seeking a talented SaaS Engineer to take ownership of the full lifecycle of our SaaS and Software portfolio, from spend and license management to day-to-day governance and tooling policies. This will cover both Internal IT and Engineering SaaS and Software used across Mistral.

You will be the go-to person for everything SaaS: how much we spend, who has access, whether our tools are secure and compliant, and how new tools are evaluated and approved. You will map our AI connectors, integrations, MCPs and other tooling, define the associated policies, and report on costs and usage. Working closely with Security, Compliance, Finance, IAM and Procurement, you will help define and enforce how software is adopted across the company.

If you enjoy combining technical expertise, financial ownership and operational governance, this role offers the opportunity to shape how a fast-growing global organization manages and scales its software ecosystem.

What You Will Do

SaaS Cost and Billing Management

  • Own the SaaS budget: track spend, forecast costs, and report on SaaS expenditure to Finance and IT leadership.

  • Manage vendor contracts, renewals, and license tiers, working closely with our Procurement Manager and negotiating pricing at renewal where relevant.

  • Regularly audit licenses and seats, reclaim unused seats, and eliminate redundant or overlapping tools.

  • Work with IT leadership to define policies and budgets related to AI usage across Mistral.

  • Detect and reduce shadow IT spend and consolidate vendors wherever possible.

  • Build and maintain a complete and accurate SaaS inventory, including costs, owners, contracts, and renewal dates.

SaaS Governance and Operations

  • Ensure SAML/SSO and SCIM provisioning are enforced across all supported SaaS applications, working with our IT Engineers and IT DevOps teams to close existing gaps.

  • Design and roll out RBAC policies across our SaaS portfolio.

  • Run periodic user and access reviews, auditing accounts, licenses, permissions, and privileged access while ensuring proper offboarding cleanup.

  • Keep collaboration and engineering tools clean, organized, and properly managed.

  • Define and enforce naming conventions, ownership rules, and lifecycle policies for SaaS accounts and workspaces.

  • Act as the escalation point for SaaS access issues and tooling-related questions from across the business.

SaaS Assessment and Policy

  • Define and maintain the company's SaaS and Software assessment and procurement policies, covering intake, evaluation, approval, and decommissioning workflows.

  • Lead new tool evaluations in partnership with Security (vendor risk assessments and security reviews), Compliance (data protection, GDPR and DPAs), Finance (budget impact), and Procurement (contracting).

  • Maintain a vendor risk and compliance matrix for the existing SaaS portfolio, tracking certifications such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and HIPAA, as well as data processing agreements.

  • Own the internal tool catalog: publish approved tools, highlight restricted ones, and guide employees toward compliant alternatives.

  • Contribute to IT policy documentation and internal training and awareness around software and tool usage.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of experience in IT operations, SaaS management, IT asset management, or a similar role.

  • Hands-on experience administering IT SaaS platforms, including SSO/IdP solutions such as Okta, Entra ID and Google Workspace, SCIM provisioning, and tools such as Slack, Notion, Bitwarden and Microsoft 365 or equivalent.

  • Hands-on experience with engineering and cloud platforms such as GitHub, GCP, AWS and Azure.

  • Proven experience in license and seat management, as well as SaaS spend optimization.

  • Familiarity with AI tooling and models, including Mistral and other providers, and an understanding of how they integrate into SaaS environments, billing, and budgets.

  • Good understanding of identity and access management concepts, including SAML, SCIM, RBAC, and the principle of least privilege.

  • Familiarity with vendor security reviews and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with Security, Legal/Compliance, Finance, and Procurement teams.

  • Strong organizational skills and a documented, process-driven mindset.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. French is a plus.

Bonus:

  • Experience with SaaS management platforms such as BetterCloud, Torii, Productiv, Nexthink, or Vanta/Drata for compliance.

  • Familiarity with ITIL or similar process frameworks.

  • Experience negotiating contracts and pricing with SaaS vendors.

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Samsara is seeking an experienced and results-driven Sales Engineering Manager to focus on our Enterprise Core business in Mainland Europe (DACH & France). Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value trust and human relationships built over time.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. title: Sales Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

About the Role

Relay sells through two core motions. The first is our new-business engine: a B2B enterprise sales motion winning large retailers and brands with significant parcel volumes — and, in time, extending down-market into Small medium enterprises (SME) as that segment opens up. The second is our field engine, which grows Relay's network of "Pitstops" — local shops and businesses that act as pick-up and drop-off points where consumers can collect parcels and return items.

Both motions depend on the systems and processes this role will build and own: the account universe and TAM, lead scoring and prioritisation, outreach, CRM architecture, governance, and sales tooling.

You'll be both architect and operator, and AI-native in how you work. You'll define what great looks like across the systems and processes underpinning both sales motions, then take ownership of making it happen. You’ll also be highly fluent in metrics — using dashboards and funnel data to identify where performance is breaking down, where opportunities are being lost, and where we can drive greater efficiency.

What You'll Do

  • Build the new-business engine: own TAM, account scoring and weekly prioritisation, plus a top-of-funnel (enrichment, multi-threaded contacts, sequencing, signal-based triggers) that lets sales spend their time pitching, not hunting.

  • Own the CRM and deal desk: architect Pipedrive around the selling rhythm, govern deal terms, stages and approval gates from pitch to activation, and raise the quality and speed of pitches and proposals.

  • Scale the Pitstop engine: run the field team's scoring, territories, targets and dashboards, manage pricing levers and CPA, and keep lead-to-live data clean, pushing toward a self-running engine with algorithmic assignment, referrals and AI-handled inbound.

  • Automate relentlessly: own the tooling stack and build-vs-buy calls (defaulting to building), strip manual work out of the sales day, and design systems that extend to SME and self-serve through configuration, not a rebuild.

  • Diagnose and fix the funnel: use funnel data to find where deals stall and pipeline leaks, then ship the fixes.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

  • Systems thinker. You build systems rather than one-off fixes, and you take ideas all the way to a shipped, working solution yourself.

  • Proven RevOps experience. You've run sales or revenue operations in a fast-moving environment and know what best-in-class looks like across top-of-funnel, CRM, deal desk and process.

  • CRM owner, not just admin. You've implemented and evolved Pipedrive (or similar) so it fits the selling motion, rather than bending the motion to fit the tool.

  • Native AI builder. You're fluent with Claude and have shipped real tooling and automations in a live business.

  • Fast, practical delivery. You implement quickly and are comfortable scoping work for engineering when you need their help.

  • High bar for quality. You insist on clean data and tight processes

  • Equally strong in detail and with people. You're comfortable refining a workflow in depth and equally at ease talking pipeline quality with sales.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay's success

  • Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you'd need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it

  • 25 days of holidays

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Hardware of your choice

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more)

  • Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Security Associate
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

Overview

We're looking for an exceptional Security Associate to join our Platform Engineering team at Omnea!

This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who's smart, technically curious and excited to get hands-on with how a fast-growing technology company operates behind the scenes.

You'll be embedded in our Platform Engineering team and collaborate closely with our Operations team to help manage the security, IT infrastructure and compliance processes that keep Omnea running smoothly and securely. From managing our internal IT systems and device fleet to coordinating security audits and working with external auditors, you'll play an important role in ensuring we can scale without compromising on security.

You don't need to be an engineer to join us. We're looking for someone who's comfortable with technology, loves solving problems, and is excited to learn. You'll gain first-hand exposure to the systems, infrastructure and security practices behind a fast-growing enterprise SaaS business, with a pathway to take on more technical responsibilities and grow into Platform Engineering over time.

This is a rare opportunity to learn directly from an experienced engineering team, build a strong technical foundation and make a meaningful impact at one of Europe's fastest-growing startups.

What you can expect

  • Own the day-to-day of security and compliance: You'll help us manage our security and compliance programmes, including SOC 1, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR and other certifications and frameworks as we grow. You'll be responsible for keeping documentation, evidence and controls up to date, and making sure we're always prepared for the next audit.

  • Become a GRC expert: You'll work extensively with Vanta, our compliance automation platform, monitoring controls, investigating issues, collecting evidence and coordinating with teams across the business to keep us compliant. You'll look for opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve how we manage our compliance processes.

  • Help manage our IT systems and devices: You'll support internal IT operations, including laptop provisioning, device fleet management, access controls and employee onboarding and offboarding. You'll get hands-on experience with the tools and systems that support a growing team.

  • Work with auditors and external partners: You'll help coordinate our security audits, manage relationships with external auditors and compliance partners, respond to evidence requests and keep audit projects moving forward. You'll also work with teams across Omnea to ensure we're meeting our security commitments.

  • Improve and automate how we work: We're scaling quickly, and processes that work for 50 people don't necessarily work for 200+. You'll identify inefficiencies, improve our internal workflows and find ways to use technology and automation to make our security and IT operations more scalable.

  • Learn from our Platform Engineering team: You'll work alongside an exceptional team responsible for Omnea's infrastructure, security and developer experience. As you build your knowledge and technical skills, you'll have opportunities to get involved in increasingly technical projects, with a potential pathway into Platform Engineering.

You'll get exposure to a wide range of technologies, work directly with experienced engineers and learn by doing. We don't expect you to know how everything works when you join!

About you

We're looking for someone intelligent, curious and incredibly resourceful. You might be a recent graduate, have a couple of years of experience in a technical or operational role, or be looking to transition into a career in technology.

What matters most is your ability to learn quickly, figure things out independently and take pride in getting the details right.

  • You're smart and a natural problem-solver: You can get your head around unfamiliar problems, work things out for yourself and aren't afraid to dive into something you've never done before. You've got a track record of performing exceptionally well, whether that's academically, professionally or elsewhere.

  • You're technical for a non-technical person: You're comfortable using new software, understanding how different systems work and troubleshooting when something breaks. You might have taught yourself to code, built something using APIs or automation tools, or just be the person everyone comes to when they need help with technology. You don't need an engineering background, but you do need a genuine interest in technology.

  • You're incredibly organised and detail-oriented: You enjoy making sure things are properly documented, processes are followed and nothing slips through the cracks. You can juggle multiple workstreams and take satisfaction in knowing everything is in good shape.

  • You take ownership and get things done: You don't need someone to tell you every next step. You're proactive, resourceful and happy to roll up your sleeves to work through whatever needs doing, whether that's solving an IT issue or chasing down evidence for an audit.

  • You're a strong communicator: You'll work with engineers, employees across the business and external auditors. You can communicate clearly, follow up effectively and build good working relationships with different types of people.

  • You're humble and happy to do the unglamorous work: A lot of good security and IT operations happens behind the scenes. You're equally happy sorting out a laptop issue or updating compliance documentation as you are working on a more interesting technical problem.

  • You're ambitious and eager to learn: You want to build a career in technology and are excited by the opportunity to develop your technical skills alongside experienced engineers. You're willing to put in the work to build a strong foundation and take on more responsibility over time.

  • You're excited about startups: You want to be part of building something, you're comfortable with changing priorities and you enjoy the pace and responsibility that come with working at an early-stage company.

You don't need previous experience in security, compliance or engineering. If you've got the right mindset, an aptitude for technology and the willingness to learn, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Security Assurance Analyst
descriptionHtml:
At a glance

Location: Cambridge

In-office expectation: One day per week on average

Employment type: Permanent

Salary: £45-£55,000

Why this role exists

As Redgate grows, so does the scrutiny our customers place on how we handle their data, and our need to have the same confidence in our suppliers.

This role exists to drive the assurance process, giving customers confidence in Redgate, and ensuring our supply chain lives up to our expectations of security.

About Redgate

Redgate brings together people who want to do their best work in an environment built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

We build solutions that help data professionals securely manage the data and databases that their organizations depend on, a space that's only becoming more critical as systems scale, data regulations increase, and AI adoption accelerates.

AI at Redgate

By 2028, Redgate will operate as an expert-plus-agent company, domain experts amplified by AI, delivering customer value at a pace our peers can't match.

AI handles the heavy lifting. Our people control the judgement. Everyone at Redgate works with Claude, giving you access to the best AI tools from day one.

Why join our Security team?

● You'll join a team that values thoroughness, collaboration, and building genuine trust with our partners both within the company and externally.

● There's a clear pathway to grow your technical security skills, with structured mentoring from our Security and Technical Operations teams.

● We value sustainable ways of working, giving you the time to build strong processes rather than just clearing the backlog.

About the role

This role places you at the centre of Redgate's customer and vendor security assurance, from completing detailed security questionnaires to leading due diligence on potential suppliers. You'll build the evidence base and relationships that let customers trust how we handle their data, while developing your technical expertise in both our products and infrastructure over time.

● You'll cover the full lifecycle of customer security questionnaires and vendor due diligence, working directly with Sales, Product, Procurement and Legal.

● There's scope to shape how assurance work gets done, including building a central repository of responses and evidence that speeds up future reviews.

● You'll work closely with the Security Manager and Cyber Security Engineer, with a structured route towards more technical security responsibilities such as integration and API reviews.

● This is a role where your judgement on vendor risk directly influences decisions made by Procurement, Legal, and the wider business.

What makes you a great fit

● Experience in a security, compliance, vendor risk, or customer assurance role, or a closely related analytical or customer-facing role with a genuine interest in cybersecurity.

● Experience completing or coordinating customer security questionnaires (such as SIG, CAIQ, or VSAQ) or equivalent structured assessments, or clear evidence you could pick this up quickly.

● Working knowledge of at least one information security or privacy framework, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST, or GDPR.

● Ability to translate how a product works in security requirements and risks.

● Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain security concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.

● Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent deadlines and form sound risk judgements from supplier documentation.

What we offer

Salary range: £45-£55,000

● Hybrid working: home and Cambridge office.

● Monthly wellbeing allowance and generous paid time off.

● Genuine investment in learning, development, and career progression.

● Private health insurance.

See our full list of benefits here - Careers At Redgate - Benefits

What happens next?

Your application will be reviewed by a person. We don't use AI or automated tools to assess applications. Every profile is read by one of our Talent Partners.

You'll hear back within a few days. Whether it's a next step or a no, we aim to respond promptly so you're not left wondering.

Our interview process is straightforward and consistent. You'll find more detail on our typical hiring process below, so you know what's coming and why.

Belonging at Redgate

We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust, and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. Redgate is an equal opportunity employer, and we make hiring decisions based on skill, potential, and alignment with our values.

Read more about how we approach belonging and inclusion at Redgate

Benefits
