title: Select Major Account Executive, UK&I
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
The Select Major Accounts team is Samsara’s primary engine for enterprise growth, responsible for landing high-value, net-new logos across the UK & Ireland’s largest physical operations. In this role, you will lead multi-million-dollar, full-cycle sales processes from a cold start—executing a disciplined qualification playbook, building true C-suite champions, and closing strategic $1M+ ARR deals. This position is built for an elite, strategic Account Executive who thrives in complex, multi-stakeholder environments—equally comfortable navigating IT and lines of business to digitize industries traditionally reliant on legacy systems.

Why Now? Samsara combines the agility of a high-growth startup, the market authority of a public company, and the momentum of a hyper-scale tech leader. Named a Best Place to Work for 3 consecutive years, we offer enterprise sellers a combination of unique differentiators:

  • Proven Leadership & Hyper-Growth: Founded by serial entrepreneurs with a history of building multi-billion-dollar companies, Samsara has scaled past $2.1B+ ARR with 30%+ YoY global growth.

  • Market-Dominating Platform: Backed by $2.8B+ in R&D investment, our Connected Operations Cloud makes us the Category Leader delivering class-leading AI, IoT, and telematics capabilities with a genuine AI moat.

  • Massive Untapped Market: Physical operations represent a $160B+ Global TAM, with EMEA remaining 99% greenfield opportunity.

This brings strong upside earning potential on a winning trajectory, rapid professional growth alongside elite sales talent, and a massive, unpenetrated territory waiting to be captured.

Whilst we do support remote working, flexibility is required to travel to visit customers onsite across the region as required.

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. 
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. 
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. 

In this role, you will:

  • Develop Executive-Level relationships within strategic, named accounts 
  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close
  • Demonstrate excellent solution-based sales process in complex sales campaigns
  • Mobilize a large matrix virtual team of business stakeholders to include Operations, Finance, IT, dedicated Solution Engineer and Account Development Representative
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Min. 7+ years full-cycle Enterprise-level Account Executive closing expertise, winning complex SAAS deals
  • Proven track record of consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts and $1M+ ARR deal execution
  • New Logo & Self-generated pipeline: Demonstrated ability to build and win deals through a repeatable outbound prospecting motion
  • Structured Qualification: Mastery of Playbook methodology-led selling (e.g. MEDDPICC / Command of the Message / Force Management) to quantify genuine business pain
  • Champion & Economic Buyer navigation: Proven ability to test and build true champions, access executive buying centres, and engineer compelling events
  • A Team player used to winning as a team, collaborative and within a coachable growth mindset

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Awards for elite achievement (particularly President’s Club, Winner’s circle, Top 10%)
  • Passionate about transformational technology in the world operations 
  • Excited about solving new problems in innovative ways 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Senior Account Executive (SaaS / Remote / German / DACH)
descriptionHtml:
Ready to own it, build it, and grow it?

The Mission

Publitas turns static, dead PDFs into interactive, shoppable digital content discovery experiences. Across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH), massive retailers and e-commerce brands are sitting on print catalogs that need to move digital.

Your mission as Senior Account Executive is simple: take complete ownership of the DACH territory, aggressively prospect into mid-market and enterprise retail accounts, and turn relationships into closed ARR. We work 80% asynchronously and judge you entirely on pipeline velocity and quota achievement—not on the number of hours you sit on Zoom.

What Success Looks Like (Your First 90 Days)

We don't measure you by years of experience; we measure you by outcomes. Here is what you will achieve in your first 3 months:

  • Day 30: You have completely mastered the Publitas value proposition, understand our core retail/e-commerce personas, and have built a targeted list of your top 50 high-priority DACH accounts.

  • Day 60: You have independently built and launched multichannel outbound sequences. You are running discovery calls completely unassisted and have successfully moved your first self-generated opportunities into the negotiation stage (at least 1).

  • Day 90: Your outbound engine is predictable. You have built an active pipeline worth 3x your quarterly target and closed your first mid-market DACH deal.


The DNA of a Sales Executive at Publitas (Culture & Ownership)

  • Founder-Level Ownership: You treat the DACH territory like your own independent business. You don't wait around for inbound marketing leads, sales enablement decks, or a manager to tell you who to call. You map the territory, identify the decision-makers, and architect the outbound strategies required to break into enterprise accounts from scratch.

  • A Continuous Growth Mindset: Modern B2B sales cycles shift rapidly, and legacy sales scripts no longer work on smart e-commerce buyers. You are constantly experimenting with new outreach mediums, testing messaging hooks, and studying the digital retail landscape. When a deal stalls, you don't blame the product, you treat it as a data point to dissect, learn from, and iterate your approach for the next pitch.

  • High Autonomy, Zero Ego: In a remote-first, asynchronous sales team, there is nowhere to hide behind "busywork" or metrics vanity. You thrive on being judged entirely by your pipeline health and closed ARR. You don't need continuous synchronous cheerleading; your motivation is entirely internal.

What We Offer You to Win

  • Transparent & Uncapped Compensation: A competitive base salary of €60k - €85k (geo-bracketed to your location) + an uncapped Variable Compensation Plan (VCP) where you are rewarded heavily for target overachievement.

  • True Remote Autonomy: No clock-watching or useless alignment meetings. You manage your territory as if it were your own business.

  • Global Team Retreats: Working remotely shouldn't mean working isolated. We gather the entire company in inspiring cities across the globe once a year to connect, strategize, and celebrate in person.

  • Modern Sales Stack & Gear: A premium MacBook, remote work accessories, and a co-working budget if you want to work outside your home.

  • Personal Growth Budget: A monthly wellness allowance, an education/course budget to sharpen your skills, and free access to Kindle and Audible books.

  • Time Off: 25 days of paid vacation plus your local national holidays.

The Non-Negotiables

  • Native/Fluent German & Professional English: You will be closing deals in German; you will be collaborating with the global team in English.

  • Proven B2B SaaS Closing Record: You have spent at least 3+ years managing full-cycle sales cycles (from cold outreach to signed contract) directly within the DACH retail, e-commerce, or digital marketing spaces.

  • Outbound Execution: You do not wait for inbound marketing leads. You know how to multi-thread accounts and hunt your own pipeline.

  • AI-First Execution: We do not scale headcount to solve manual problems. You must have a proven track record of working in an AI-first way, leveraging generative AI tools to hyper-personalize outbound messaging, automate account research, summarize call data, and accelerate your sales velocity.

At Publitas, we see AI as a core lever for performance, efficiency, and innovation. We expect all team members to actively use AI in their daily work to improve quality, speed, and output.

Depending on the role, this ranges from effectively using AI tools in day-to-day workflows to designing and scaling AI-driven systems. We are not looking for candidates who are “AI-curious”; we look for people who already use AI to do better work and can demonstrate tangible impact.

title: Senior AI Enabled Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Working at CreateFuture

CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team:

You’ll join our team, working side by side with clients and our delivery teams to turn architectural designs into production systems. Increasingly, our clients want products and platforms that are AI-native from the start. As a Senior AI-enabled Software Engineer, you’ll be both a hands-on individual contributor and a technical driving force in your team: closing the gap between design and delivery, recognising operational bottlenecks, and establishing good engineering practice in client environments. 

How we work
CreateFuture is an AI-native organisation. Every core technical role is expected to:

  • Work with AI-native delivery and workflow practices.
  • Practise agentic engineering through at least one harness.
  • Apply context engineering through prompts, skills, tools and harnesses.
  • Know at least one runtime or language.
  • Use CI/CD and automated quality practices to verify work in all its forms.

What you'll be doing:

As a Senior AI-enabled Software Engineer, you’ll develop application features using AI-assisted engineering, combining sound software engineering practice with agentic ways of working.

You’ll bring credible, role-specific capability in:

  • Application architecture and modular design.
  • Application data, state, and persistence design.
  • Application feature, API, interface, and service-integration engineering.
  • Spec-driven development.
  • Test-driven development.
  • Secure application development.
  • Application performance and operability.
  • Context and workflow optimisation for agentic engineering.
  • AI Agent Orchestration & Workflow Design.
  • AI Evaluation, Observability & Guardrails.
  • Java, Kotlin Multiplatform or .NET, with significant commercial experience in at least one.

You won’t need depth in all of these, but experience in one or more of the following would be valuable:

  • Front-end application development.
  • Mobile application development.
  • Back-end and service development.
  • Cloud-native application development.
  • Real-time and event-driven systems.
  • Legacy application modernisation and migration.
  • AI-enabled product features.
  • Agentic development environments and harnesses.
  • Agentic engineering evaluation and observability platforms.

We’d love to talk to you if you

  • Resolve complex or ambiguous application engineering problems within a team or engagement, making sound judgement calls.
  • Shape technical direction for application design and delivery, influencing how work gets done as well as what.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients on application architecture, quality and engineering trade-offs.
  • Coach and develop other engineers, and raise standards across our software engineering discipline.

We'd love to talk to you if: 

  • Lead the resolution of complex, ambiguous problems that span teams, systems or an entire engagement, and make sound calls when the right answer isn’t obvious.
  • Set and own technical direction for application design and delivery, deciding how work gets done and holding the team to it.
  • Act as the senior technical voice with client stakeholders, advising on architecture, quality, risk and engineering trade-offs, and helping shape engagements from discovery onwards.
  • Lead, coach and grow engineers, including Seniors, and contribute to hiring and capability building.
  • Raise standards beyond your own engagement, shaping practices, patterns and tooling across our software engineering discipline.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team 
  • Role specific capability interview 

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du brennst für Kubernetes, Plattform-Engineering und moderne AI-Technologien? Du möchtest nicht nur einzelne Modelle deployen, sondern die Infrastruktur und Plattformen schaffen, auf denen innovative AI-Anwendungen zuverlässig, sicher und skalierbar betrieben werden?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Als (Senior) AI Platform Engineer (m/f/d) entwickelst, betreibst und optimierst du moderne AI- und ML-Plattformen für unsere Kunden. Du arbeitest mit Kubernetes, GPU-Infrastrukturen, Infrastructure as Code sowie modernen CI/CD-, MLOps- und LLMOps-Ansätzen und unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, Generative AI und Machine Learning erfolgreich in den produktiven Einsatz zu bringen.

Dich erwarten spannende Projekte in unterschiedlichsten Branchen, technologischer Gestaltungsspielraum und ein Team aus Cloud-, Plattform-, Data- und AI-Spezialisten, das Innovation nicht nur diskutiert, sondern täglich umsetzt.

Aufgaben

  • Planung, Aufbau und Betrieb von hochverfügbaren AI/ML-Plattformen und -Services, insbesondere auf Basis von Kubernetes in On-Premises-, Hybrid- und Cloud-Umgebungen.
  • Design und Umsetzung skalierbarer GPU-Infrastrukturen innerhalb von Kubernetes-Clustern – inklusive GPU-Scheduling und -Sharing (z. B. Kueue, KAI-Scheduler, Run:ai, NVIDIA MIG/Time-Slicing) mit Blick auf Auslastung und Kosteneffizienz.
  • Aufbau und Betrieb von Model-Serving- und Inferenz-Diensten (z. B. vLLM, NVIDIA Triton, KServe, NVIDIA NIM, Ray) für klassische ML-Modelle und Large Language Models.
  • Entwicklung und Betrieb von MLOps-/LLMOps-Workflows für produktive GenAI-Services – inklusive Guardrails & Policies, Evaluierung, Regressionstests sowie Kosten- und Qualitätsmonitoring.
  • Bereitstellung von Fine-Tuning- und Re-Training-Workflows (z. B. LoRA, kontinuierliches Re-Training) auf der Plattform.
  • Monitoring, Troubleshooting und Performance-Tuning von AI-Plattformen (u. a. GPU-Auslastung, Inferenz-Latenz, Durchsatz), um höchste Performance und Verfügbarkeit sicherzustellen.
  • Beratung unserer Kunden in Bezug auf Best Practices, AI-Governance, Datensicherheit und Datenschutz im Kontext von AI-Plattformen auf Kubernetes.
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Data-Science-, Data-Platform- und Entwicklungsteams zur Sicherstellung der nahtlosen Integration von AI-Lösungen.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Betrieb und der Optimierung von Plattformen und Services at Scale in Kubernetes-Umgebungen, egal ob On-Premise oder in der Cloud.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Architektur und dem Betrieb von skalierbaren Lösungen unter Verwendung von Kubernetes, idealerweise inklusive GPU-Workloads.
  • Programmierkenntnisse in Python, idealerweise ergänzt um Golang oder Java.
  • Erfahrung mit mindestens einem Model-Serving-Framework (z. B. vLLM, NVIDIA Triton, KServe) sowie erste oder vertiefte Erfahrung mit MLOps-Werkzeugen (z. B. MLflow, Kubeflow, ClearML).
  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code-Tools wie Ansible und Terraform sowie CI/CD- und GitOps-Werkzeugen (z. B. Argo CD, Flux).
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch. Idealerweise hast du bereits Kunden beraten und kannst technische Themen zielgruppengerecht vermitteln – vom Engineering-Team bis zum Management.

Für die Senior-Rolle zusätzlich:

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung im Plattform-Engineering.
  • Architektur-Ownership: Du verantwortest das Design von AI-Plattformen end-to-end und triffst technologische Grundsatzentscheidungen.
  • Technische Führung in Kundenprojekten (Lead-Rolle) sowie Mentoring von Kolleginnen und Kollegen.

Darüber hinaus verfügst du idealerweise über:

  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-AI-Diensten (z. B. AWS SageMaker/Bedrock, Azure ML/Azure OpenAI/Azure AI Foundry) und deren Integration mit Kubernetes-Workloads.
  • Kenntnisse im Betrieb von LLM-basierten Architekturen, z. B. RAG-Pipelines, Vektordatenbanken und Embedding-Services sowie Agentic-AI-Ansätze und Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Verständnis von System-Level-Grundlagen des LLM-Servings (Rate Limiting, Token Streaming, Load Balancing) und LLM-Konzepten wie Reasoning, Tool Calling und Prompt Templates.
  • Erfahrung mit neuen Serving-Bausteinen wie llm-d oder Kubernetes Inference Gateway.
  • Kenntnisse in der Absicherung von AI-Plattformen, z. B. TLS, RBAC und Network Policies innerhalb von Kubernetes-Umgebungen, sowie Grundverständnis von AI-Governance (z. B. EU AI Act).
  • Zertifizierungen im Bereich relevanter Technologien (z. B. Certified Kubernetes Administrator/Developer, NVIDIA-Zertifizierungen).
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen im DACH-Raum.

Benefits

Wir bieten dir u.a.:

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Teamorientierte Unternehmenskultur mit regelmäßigen Teamevents
  • Gezielte Förderung deiner fachlichen Weiterentwicklung
  • Corporate Benefits Programm
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit zeitgemäßer Ausstattung
  • Remote-Work-Möglichkeiten

Wir freuen uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung und darauf, mehr über dich zu erfahren.

title: Senior AI Product Manager – Growth
descriptionHtml:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Product Manager to join Growth at Zego. Growth is how more good drivers find us, choose us and stay with us, and it is one of the biggest levers on our commercial performance.

You’ll own a growth domain, defining its quarterly strategy and goals and helping shape the longer-term growth strategy. You’ll find the levers that matter most and run a high-velocity programme of experiments to pull them - aiming for growth that is profitable, not just big.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Define your domain’s quarterly strategy and goals, and help refine the longer-term growth strategy.

  • Find the biggest growth levers, diagnosing where customers drop off, hesitate or leave, and sizing each opportunity.

  • Run a high-velocity experimentation engine, with a prioritised backlog of tests and guardrails on customer sentiment and risk quality.

  • Design journeys and loops that compound, from first touch to purchase, renewal and referral.

  • Shape the commercial levers with Pricing and Marketing, from propositions and packaging to channel strategy.

  • Drive profitable growth, with business cases and domain metrics grounded in unit economics, not just volume.

  • Establish AI-enabled workflows for your domain, from generating test variants to automated funnel analysis.

  • Bring stakeholders along, running ceremonies with senior stakeholders, facilitating big-room planning and knowing when to escalate.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Growth product ownership. A track record of leading consumer growth - acquisition, conversion, retention or monetisation - in a high-growth environment.

  • Experimentation at velocity. Hands-on experience running high-volume A/B testing programmes, with a solid grasp of experiment design and statistics.

  • Funnel expertise. You know how to diagnose a funnel, prioritise the biggest drop-offs and fix them end to end.

  • Data and commercial fluency. Comfortable in Amplitude, Looker or Snowflake, and you know the difference between growth and profitable growth.

  • Technical literacy. Confident with engineers on architecture, APIs and service design. Ideally, you come from engineering or data science.

  • Regulated environment. Ideally, experience in insurance, fintech or other regulated consumer products.

  • You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

title: Senior AI Research Engineer - LLM Training & Inference Infrastructure
descriptionHtml:
As a Research Engineer on the Frontier Foundations team, you will partner with Research Scientists to build the systems that run large-scale LLM training, reinforcement learning, and inference at Datadog. You will build and operate an in-house distributed runtime that schedules work across large GPU clusters, and you will own how quickly researchers can iterate and how reliably long training runs complete. 

Building on our track record of AI-powered solutions (e.g., Bits AI, Bits Evolve, and our time series foundation model Toto), Datadog AI Research (DAIR) tackles high-risk, high-reward problems grounded in real-world challenges in cloud observability and security. 

The Frontier Foundations team builds and maintains the high-performance infrastructure that lets us train and serve large language models at scale. It supports both of our research areas: 

Trained Agents for Observability -- Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog's domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost. 

What You'll Do: 

  • Design, build, and operate distributed training and inference infrastructure for large language models, including Mixture-of-Experts models 
  • Scale training with parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, and expert), memory optimization, checkpointing, and failure recovery
  • Build inference and rollout systems that support evaluation, experimentation, and RL without slowing down training
  • Build execution environments and sandboxes for online RL and agent post-training
  • Own continuous performance validation: regular benchmarks of rollout speed, training throughput, and learning behavior, with dashboards that make regressions visible 
  • Improve the researcher experience: job submission, scheduling, quotas, GPU utilization, and observability
  • Work with platform teams on cluster capacity, networking, and scheduling across GPU providers 
  • Investigate performance and reliability problems across hardware, software, and distributed systems 

Who You Are:

  • You have depth in distributed systems and ML infrastructure for training and inference at scale; experience with Ray, Kubernetes, Slurm, or similar frameworks is a plus
  • You are proficient in Python and in at least one systems language (e.g., Rust, C++, or Go) ● You have experience operating large-scale training or serving infrastructure, or schedulers and orchestration systems for GPU or other high-performance workloads
  • You understand what limits throughput/latency in distributed inference workloads: communication, memory, scheduling, and stragglers
  • You have strong debugging, profiling, and incident-diagnosis skills, ideally including on-call experience 
  • You can explain design and performance trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences 
  • Prior experience training machine learning models is valuable but not essential for engineers with strong distributed systems or HPC backgrounds 

Bonus Points (any of the following): 

  • You are familiar with distributed training frameworks such as Megatron-LM, TorchTitan, or DeepSpeed
  • You have experience with LLM inference engines such as vLLM or SGLang, including batching and KV-cache management 
  • You have experience with RL training systems and rollout infrastructure 
  • You have experience with collective communication (NCCL), RDMA, or low-latency networking 
  • You have experience with GPU benchmarking, profiling, and cluster performance monitoring 
  • You have experience building sandboxed code execution or large-scale evaluation infrastructure 
  • You have contributed to open-source ML or distributed systems projects 

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. 

Benefits and Growth:

  • Competitive global benefits
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Opportunity to collaborate closely with colleagues across the Datadog offices in New York City and Paris 
  • Opportunity to attend and present at conferences and meetups
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking 
  • An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)
  • Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

About Datadog: 

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. title: Senior Application Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €359 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 000,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

👪 Team and environment

As we keep on growing (+500 people joined Pennylane in 2025!), we're seeking an Application Security Engineer to join Louis's team of 5. You'll handle all technical security matters, support ISO 27001 compliance, and advise employees—especially developers—on security best practices.

The technical security team manages security issues from detection to resolution, collaborating with developers and Security Champions when needed.

🎯 Your tasks

Security by design : ensure the security of Pennylane’s application and infrastructure

  • Engage with Product Team to integrate security in our features from from the beginning, from design to delivery

  • Ensure the security of the main Web application written in Ruby on Rails and ReactJS: its dependencies, its code, its infrastructure and its configuration

  • Conducting code reviews from a secure development point of view (about 80 releases per day).

  • Detect vulnerability and propose associated patches

  • Raise the security level of our CI/CD configuration

  • With the DevOps team, secure our AWS infrastructure, including its Kubernetes environment (AWS EKS)

Vulnerability Management

  • Conduct and perform regular security assessments (internally or by an external consulting companies) on the applications (code reviews/pentests/bug bounty in particular) and the infrastructure

  • Strengthen the current means of detecting malicious attempts

  • Be involved in all security incidents, investigate logs, block attacks, and propose corrective measures to prevent future threats.

Compliance & awareness

  • Ensure compliance with ISO 27001 controls (processes) related to development (mandatory code practices, validation, patch management, vulnerability management, etc.) by training developers, monitoring projects (tech, product), conducting regular internal audits and managing tech non-conformities

  • Build/Improve secure development training materials and conduct regular training sessions with the developers. Engaging them in our Security Champions program

  • Improve the security awareness through the company

  • Contribute to tenders to explain our security policies and provide the necessary technical details

These missions are not exhaustive and remain evolving.

🥇You’re the right candidate if

You ideally have the following skills/experience:

  • Able to perform offensive security assessments on an infrastructure and an application

  • You know how to exploit and fix a wide range of Web vulnerabilities and are able to explain them to non-technical person (not just the OWASP top 10)

  • You already have an experience in a programming language (Ruby, Python, JavaScript), either for quick and dirty scripting to exploit a vulnerability or for larger projects

  • You have an experience in cloud infrastructure security

  • You are able to popularize technical terms to facilitate the adoption of security measures within projects or to broadcast messages to Pennylaners

  • You are fluent in French and/or English (both oral and written)

Your soft skills :

  • You are humble

  • You are a team player, and working with remote colleagues is not an issue for you

  • You are proactive and organized

  • You are a quick learner, and you like to work on different projects (application security, cloud infrastructure, training, ISO 27001…)

💬 What does the recruitment process look like ?

  • You will first have a general chat with Alexandre, Talent Acquisition (30min)

  • Then you’ll meet Louis, (AppSec Team Lead) and 1 team member for a technical interview (1h)

  • You carry out independently the technical challenge for the next 48h

  • Then, you’ll discuss about your solutions with Louis and another team member - (1h)

  • Finally, a last culture fit meeting with Guillaume, Head of Security (1h)

We make sure we move fast; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total.

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

title: Senior China Research Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Datenna is a fast-growing tech scale-up combining cutting-edge OSINT and AI technologies to provide governments with critical insights into China's techno-economic landscape. Our platform transforms open-source intelligence into actionable insights through advanced data processing and analysis.


The Role:
Do you enjoy turning complex data into strategic insights that drive critical decisions? As a Senior China Research Analyst, you will lead analytical research projects for our government clients. You'll turn their most pressing questions about China's technology, industrial, and defence-industrial landscape into data-driven reports and the datasets behind them. You'll work with Datenna's data on patents, procurement, research funding, and companies, and go beyond it when a question demands, to find the patterns and connections that inform high-stakes policy and security decisions.


You'll independently manage several client research projects at a time, from scoping through final delivery, using both qualitative and quantitative analysis across China's corporate, academic, defence, and technology sectors. Client questions often start ambiguous and open-ended, and topics range widely, from advanced materials to semiconductors and aerospace. You'll work through uncertainty, get up to speed quickly on unfamiliar technologies, design creative analytical approaches when the path isn't obvious, and refine your research direction as new information emerges. The role needs strong China expertise, Chinese-language research skills, the ability to work autonomously, and clear communication with senior government stakeholders.

Your mission at Datenna:

  • Lead end-to-end research delivery: Take full ownership of research projects, from initial scoping and analysis through to final deliverables.

  • Design the research: Turn open-ended client questions into sound research design, and build new analytical frameworks when standard methods don't fit.

  • Build and analyse the evidence base: Work directly with Chinese-language sources and Datenna's data on entities, patents, procurement, and research funding to map the actors, links, and trends that answer the client's question.

  • Set the quality bar: Review colleagues' deliverables independently, verify findings against the underlying data, and guide Analysts on their research approach.

  • Work with AI, with judgement: Use AI-assisted research tools to work faster and at greater scale. You own the interpretation and verify every output.

  • Contribute to the China Research Lab: The Lab is our exploratory research track. It develops the methods, tools, and data sources that shape where China research at Datenna is heading, and tests them through internal R&D. You will dedicate part of your time to Lab initiatives, such as prototyping a new analytical approach, scouting and testing new sources, or contributing to webinars and publications.

  • Strengthen the data and product: Turn what you learn on client projects into data and product improvements, working with the Product and Data teams.


What makes you a great candidate:
Core requirements

  • Experience: 5–8 years of professional experience in China-focused research, analysis, or related fields.

  • Deep China expertise: Strong knowledge of Chinese industry, economy, policy, the defence-industrial base, and the technology and research landscape.

  • Analytical excellence: Exceptional pattern recognition and analytical skills to connect the dots between corporate, state, and military actors in China's techno-economic landscape.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: Proven ability to tackle research questions where the analytical path isn't predetermined, designing creative approaches and adapting as you learn.

  • Chinese language proficiency: Professional reading proficiency in Chinese (minimum HSK5, HSK6 preferred) to work directly with Chinese-language sources such as technical literature, patents, procurement notices, and policy documents, and to build and verify Chinese technical terminology for data retrieval.

  • Self-directed project management: Proven ability to independently break down complex research questions, run several multi-week projects in parallel against fixed client deadlines, and deliver high-quality output with minimal oversight.

  • Quality ownership: An evidence-first approach. You trace every claim back to its source records, catch inconsistencies in data and drafts, and review others' work independently and constructively.

  • Communication skills: Strong written and verbal communication, including precise, concise English writing for an international readership. You are comfortable presenting complex analysis to senior government stakeholders and refining requirements through client dialogue.

  • Methodological versatility: Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methods.


Technical skills

  • Working proficiency in SQL and/or Python to query, clean, and structure large datasets, plus advanced Excel.

  • Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in research, with a clear sense of where their output needs human verification.

  • Familiarity with data-quality work such as deduplication and entity resolution.


Nice to have

  • Experience in the technology, science, and research sector within governmental organisations, think tanks, or international corporate settings.

  • Background conducting research for external clients or stakeholders.

  • Experience analysing patents, public procurement, research funding, or corporate registry data.

  • Experience collecting web data from Chinese-language sources, or with BI tools such as Metabase.

  • A technical or scientific background (for example materials science, engineering, or physics) relevant to dual-use technology topics.

*Please know that applicants may be subject to a screening process.*


  • Work on globally impactful projects in geopolitical intelligence

  • Lead innovation in OSINT and AI technologies

  • Competitive compensation and benefits

  • Dynamic, international team environment

  • Significant growth opportunities in a scale-up

descriptionHtml:
Über uns: Wer/Was ist Artefact?

Artefact ist eine weltweit führende Beratung für Daten- und KI-Dienstleistungen mit Hauptsitz in Paris. Wir beraten führende nationale und internationale Kunden branchenübergreifend dabei, das volle Potenzial ihrer Daten auszuschöpfen, skalierbare Datenarchitekturen aufzubauen und innovative KI-Lösungen zu implementieren.

  • Kundenberatung & Strategie: Du arbeitest eng mit (internationalen) Kunden zusammen, verstehst deren geschäftliche Anforderungen und übersetzt diese in datengestützte Empfehlungen, die strategische Entscheidungen und die Business Transformation unterstützen.

  • Projektumsetzung: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für Projekt-Workstreams und stellst eine qualitativ hochwertige, termingerechte Lieferung im Einklang mit den übergeordneten Projektzielen sicher. Dabei arbeitest du kollaborativ in interdisziplinären Teams aus den Bereichen Consulting, Data und Tech.
  • Daten- & KI-Lösungen: Du unterstützt die Entwicklung von Datenstrategien, KI-Use-Cases sowie Business-Intelligence-Lösungen und wirkst bei Governance-Frameworks und Implementierungs-Roadmaps mit.

Das bringst du mit:

Im Kern definieren wir uns über eine Kultur der Eigenverantwortung, der intellektuellen Neugier und der Zusammenarbeit. Wir suchen motivierte, fähige und umsichtige Talente, die hungrig auf neue Herausforderungen sind und die Chance nutzen wollen, zu lernen und zu wachsen.

  • Daten- & KI-Verständnis: Du besitzt eine hohe Affinität für Datenmanagement und moderne KI-Technologien. Konzepte wie Generative KI, LLMs oder Predictive Analytics sind dir vertraut und du brennst darauf, die Lücke zwischen Business-Anforderungen und KI-Einsatz zu schließen. Idealerweise hast du bereits Erfahrung in der Konzeption von KI-Use-Cases oder im Data-Platform-Tracking.
  • Business-Orientierung & analytisches Denken: Du verbindest ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten mit einer geschäftsorientierten Denkweise. Es macht dir Spaß, geschäftliche Herausforderungen zu identifizieren und sie in praktische, KI- und datengestützte Lösungen zu übersetzen.
  • Technische Fähigkeiten: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Excel und PowerPoint. Praktische Erfahrung mit Statistik-Tools, BI-Software oder Programmiersprachen wie SQL, R oder Python zur Datenexploration und -aufbereitung ist ein klares Plus.

title: Senior Consultant - Home Affairs
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Home Affairs practice are looking for an experienced Senior Consultants to join the team. 

Following the continued growth of Baringa, we are excited to be building our Government Home Affairs practice and we are looking for amazing consultants who will thrive with us as we grow.
We collaborate across the criminal justice system and champion the work of Arm’s Length Bodies, helping our clients realise diverse ambitions and better serve citizens throughout the UK. Our Home Affairs team works at the heart of UK Government, partnering with Policing, Defence, Justice and Home Office clients to deliver lasting change. The UK public sector faces major challenges over the coming years, as well as opportunities to drive the recently laid out missions. If you are excited about working alongside our clients to solve their challenges, then we could be what you are
looking for.
We are supporting the public sector’s most important programmes across Whitehall and the wider public sector, using our skills in Strategy and Business Cases, Project Delivery, Operational Delivery, DDaT and Government Commercial.

What you will be doing

  • Conducting structured analysis and modelling to assess the impact of new or proposed policies (e.g. in policing, immigration or justice reform), and translating insights into clear recommendations
  • Supporting the development of robust business cases, funding submissions and options appraisals for new services or ways of working across government
  • Contributing to the design of operating models, service blueprints and delivery approaches for new or evolving government functions
  • Supporting the delivery of transformation programmes that improve citizen outcomes, public safety and operational resilience
  • Analysing and improving front- and back-office processes in high-security and sensitive environments
  • Working alongside client teams to embed change, track benefits and support sustainable implementation
  • Contributing to digital, data and analytics initiatives (including AI-enabled solutions), working with specialists to solve complex data challenges and support evidence-led decision-making
  • Bringing relevant best practice from industry and across government into client work
  • Supporting commercial and procurement activities, including market engagement, option development and evaluation

As you progress, you will take on greater ownership for workstreams or discrete outputs, mentor junior colleagues, and build trusted relationships with client counterparts.

 
Your skills and experience 
 

  • Experience working in, or delivering projects for, government or public sector organisations, ideally within a professional services/consulting environment
  • A strong interest in, or experience with, one or more of the following domains: Policing (e.g, Police Forces and central bodies like NPCC/APCC, CoP or PDS), Defence (e.g. MoD, Front line commands and defence suppliers), Justice (e.g. MoJ, Prisons, Probation and associated organisations), Home Office
  • Ability to structure ambiguous problems, analyse data and information, and communicate clear, evidence-based insights
  • Confidence working collaboratively with client teams and internal specialists in fast-paced, delivery-focused environments
  • Curiosity and interest in technology, digital, data and/or AI, and how these can be applied to improve public services
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages for different audiences
  • A genuine motivation to improve outcomes for citizens and public servants

All roles will require a level of security clearance; BPSS OR Security Clearance OR Developed Vetting.

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include:

  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice.

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

title: Senior Controls Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Voor onze afdeling Controls Engineering in Gorinchem zijn we per direct op zoek naar een ervaren Senior Controls Engineer voor het programmeren van de aansturing van onze nieuwste voedselproductie lijnen voor onze klanten van het merk Tromp uit Gorinchem. Dit betreft een full time functie, met veel afwisseling en hulp van betrokken teamgenoten om de meest slimme/ efficiënte besturingsoplossingen te bouwen.

Ontwerp en programmeer jij graag de nieuwste deegverwerkingsmachines van AMF Bakery Systems? Step dan in als Senior Controls Engineer! Heb je ervaring als software, controls of mechatronica engineer in machinebouw, ben je vertrouwd met programmeren in structured text en ben je bekend met Siemens besturingstechniek? Hecht je aan betrokken en slimme collega's waarmee je samen 'state of the art' voedselproductielijnen ontwerpt, programmeert en bouwt? Super, dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Maandsalaris tussen €4.00,00 en €5.800,00 o.b.v. 40 uur; afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring, excl. toeslagen

  • Reiskostenvergoeding (€0,25 / km); vitaliteitsbudget tot €25,00 netto per maand en een zeer goede pensioenvoorziening (PME)

  • Flexibele werktijden, deels thuiswerken mogelijk

  • Vakantiegeld 8%

  • CAO Metalektro waaronder 27 vakantiedagen en 13 adv dagen per jaar

  • Winstdeling, afhankelijk van de winst betreffende het jaar, tot max. €2.000,00

  • Uitstekende opleidingsmogelijkheden zodat jouw vakkennis up to date is en blijft

  • Werken in een enthousiast en innoverend team

  • Informele werksfeer, teamuitjes, vrijdagmiddagborrel

  • Alle ruimte om te groeien in je functie afhankelijk van jouw ambities

Wat ga je doen:

  • Ontwikkelen / programmeren, configureren en integreren van software van onze machines (PLC + HMI). We passen veel techniek toe van Siemens en Allen Bradley.

  • Testen op locatie Gorinchem (IO, netwerk, drives, functioneel)

  • Softwarematig helpen met voorbereiden van productielijnen voor de FAT

  • Inzetten van jouw software expertise voor ondersteuning van Assembly, Buitendienst en aan klanten bij complexe software gerelateerde issues

  • Incidenteel naar de klant voor ondersteuning van commissioning van nieuwe productie lijnen

  • Als onze software expert werk je intensief samen met Electrical en Mechanical engineers, collega's van Sales, Projectmanagers, Assembly Engineers etc. Je bent dan vraagbaak en neemt besluiten mbt onze software oplossingen.

  • Bijdragen aan het continue verder verbeteren van onze technische controls oplossingen conform onze Markel Business aanpak

  • Helpen met verder standaardiseren van onze software oplossingen van onze product portfolio van het merk Tromp in Gorinchem.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig aan jouw projecten


  • HBO Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar, of ROC Mechatronica niv 4 met ruime ervaring

  • Gedegen kennis van en ervaring met Siemens Tia Portal en of Allen Bradley Studio 5000

  • Kennis van hogere programmeertalen (vb. Structured text of VBA)

  • Teamplayer, pragmatisch en leergierig

  • Communicatief vaardig (goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal)

In wat voor bedrijf kom jij te werken?

Bij AMF Bakery Systems ben je onderdeel van een hechte en trotse groep collega’s die wereldwijd bijdraagt aan het succes van industriële bakkerijen. Wat ons verbindt, is onze drive om te innoveren én onze zorg voor de wereld om ons heen. Zo ontwikkelden wij samen de eerste industriële oven op waterstof – een grote stap richting een duurzamere toekomst.

We werken met ruim 220 collega’s in Nederland – vanuit Gorinchem, Amersfoort en Nieuwleusen – en maken deel uit van de internationale Markel Food Group. Binnen AMF voelt iedereen zich thuis: of je nu op kantoor werkt, in de werkplaats of bij de klant op locatie. We geloven dat we samen sterker zijn als iedereen zich welkom, gehoord en gewaardeerd voelt.

Diversiteit en inclusie zitten dan ook in ons DNA. We staan open voor mensen met verschillende achtergronden en ideeën, omdat we weten dat juist die mix leidt tot slimme oplossingen en sterke teams. Jij hoort erbij – precies zoals je bent.

Samen bouwen we aan iets groters dan alleen machines. We bouwen aan een toekomst waarin we samen kunnen groeien, leren en impact maken.

title: Senior Counsel - Product (UK & EU)
descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Join our growing Product Legal team of 10, embedded with Kraken’s Product, Design, and Engineering teams to ship novel products and experiences that accelerate the global adoption of crypto. We’re a tight, experienced group of product lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech, and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious, and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice - partnering directly with product teams to chart clear, defensible paths to launch.

This is a fully remote role for a qualified solicitor in the UK or admitted in an EU jurisdiction.

 

The opportunity

The Senior Counsel (Consumer Legal) role is based in the UK or EU within our Consumer Legal team, partnering on cutting edge consumer products including crypto trading, earn, payments, on-chain integrations, equities, and tokenised equities. Reporting to the Head of Consumer Legal, you’ll work shoulder-to-shoulder with Product, Design, and Engineering teams to shape and ship novel consumer products and experiences. We’re looking for a hands-on lawyer with strong product development instincts, regulatory fluency, and negotiation skills (ideally honed in the regulated financial sector) combined with a crypto-forward mindset. Curiosity, flexibility, and a bias for action at the intersection of crypto and traditional global markets are essential.

  

What you bring

  • Qualified lawyer (Solicitor of England & Wales, Irish Solicitor, or equivalent admitted in an EU Member State).

  • 5+ years’ PQE in financial services law gained at a regulated financial services firm, crypto services provider, or in private practice (ideally with direct product counselling experience).

  • Preference for experience with advising on regulated MiFID investment services and familiarity with relevant crypto-asset regimes, including MiCA, AMLD5, UK financial promotions, and/or e-money regulations.

  • Outstanding analytical, drafting, and organisational skills with crisp, plain-English writing.

  • Ability to efficiently and confidently distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyers and product stakeholders.

  • Pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that prioritises providing stakeholders with a useful range of options and delivers clear recommendations to decision-makers.

  • Demonstrates an authentic passion for crypto and familiarity with the features of both Kraken and its competitors’ apps and products.

  

Nice to haves

  • Expertise in MiCA framework applicable to CASPs including brokerage, custody and the operation of trading platforms.

  • Expertise in UK crypto-asset financial promotions regime and proposals for incoming authorisation regime for regulating crypto asset service providers.

  • Expertise in MiFID frameworks applicable to investment services including derivatives, equities, funds and emerging tokenised financial instruments.

  • Familiarity with using AI tools such as Enterprise GPTs to increase efficient provision of legal services, create custom GPTs allowing stakeholders to self-serve on commoditised legal and regulatory queries.

title: Senior CRM Manager - Conversion & Lifecycle
descriptionHtml:
Join our expanding Product Growth team! We’re actively recruiting a Senior CRM Manager as we continue to scale at M-KOPA. Most senior growth hires get one channel and one pod for years. This role is built differently: you’ll own two of our core growth pods in your first year, then land where you’ve had the most impact. It’s a fast track to pod leadership, not a support seat.

The Impact 💚

You’ll drive the conversion growth that turns customers into long-term, high-value ones, creating financial inclusion for Africa’s traditionally excluded. We’ve already helped over 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit 🌍

The Opportunity

🏗️ Real ownership from day one. You'll be the one accountable for delivery in Repeat Phones, not shadowing or supporting someone else's plan.

🎒 Two growth motions, one year. You'll take on Digital Lending mid-way through, working directly with one of our strongest performers to understand cash loans end to end, then carry that pod solo for a defined stretch. Few people get this breadth this early.

🧭 A defined path, not indefinite floating. You'll build real expertise in our two conversion pods first, then move into Lifecycle in the second half of next year, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead once you're there. The destination is set. What you bring to it is up to you. 🌍 Work inside a proven CLV engine. M-KOPA has helped more than 10 million customers access over $2 billion in credit. You'll be executing inside systems that already work, not guessing at what might.

What You'll Do

Phase 1: Repeat Phones. Take ownership of reactivation and upgrade campaigns in CleverTap, working closely with the Growth Lead there to understand what's driving the pod's numbers and where the next opportunity is. You'll be trusted to make real calls here, not just execute a checklist.

Phase 2: Cross into Digital Lending. Work directly with the Digital Lending lead, one of our top performers, to understand cash loan growth end to end before taking it on yourself.

Phase 3: Own Digital Lending. Carry primary responsibility for Digital Lending for a defined period, with the Repeat Phones lead available if you need a second opinion.

Phase 4: Move into Lifecycle. In the second half of next year, join the Lifecycle pod full-time, reporting to the Lifecycle CRM Lead. You'll bring a year of hands-on conversion experience into a pod that's still being built, real currency for shaping what Lifecycle does next. Throughout all phases, you will:

  • Build and run multi-channel campaigns (SMS, WhatsApp, push, in-app) in CleverTap against pod goals

  • Track funnel performance and flag drop-off points to the pod lead you're supporting

  • Run structured experiments (creative, audience, incentive, or timing) with clear hypotheses

  • Turn what works into documented playbooks the next person can pick up

  • Keep data quality and campaign tracking clean enough that leadership can trust the numbers

Key Metrics You'll Influence

Repeat Phones: Reactivation rate, upgrade conversion %, unit economics per sale

Digital Lending: Approval → disbursement rate, digital loan volume, approval quality

Campaign ROI and payback period across both

Your Environment

💼 Tech Stack: CleverTap (primary), Looker Channels: WhatsApp, SMS, push, in-app messaging

Markets: Kenya, Nigeria, Uganda, Ghana

What You Need

  • 5+ years in growth, performance, or lifecycle marketing, ideally in fintech, telco, or e-commerce, with real ownership over what a campaign or a pod achieved, not just involvement in it.

  • Judgment as much as skill. You can walk into a pod, understand what's working and why, and make calls on where to push, not just follow a brief.

title: Senior Customer Solutions Engineer
descriptionHtml:

A fundamental understanding of cloud architectures and AI principles is essential. Deep understanding and knowledge of Residential and SMB Gateways is a big plus.

As the creator of the only open, hardware-independent, cloud-controlled experience platform for ISPs and their subscribers, Plume partners with over 400 ISP customers, including some of the world's largest such as Charter, Liberty Global, and J:COM.

descriptionHtml:

Strategien und Planungslogiken werden von dir klar aufbereitet, sauber dokumentiert und an die zuständigen Teams übergeben.

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Ausbildung: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine Ausbildung in Marketing, Medien, Wirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich bringst du mit.
  • Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Planung digitaler Mediakampagnen, idealerweise aus einer Mediaagentur, und übernimmst Themen dabei eigenständig.
  • Fachliche Expertise: Gängige Planungstools, relevante Mediabegriffe und KPIs sowie die digitale Medienlandschaft (Programmatic, Social, SEA, Retail, Content- und Performance-Marketing) sind dir bestens vertraut.
  • Analytik & Strategie: Exzellente analytische Fähigkeiten verbindest du mit einer ausgeprägten strategischen und lösungsorientierten Denkweise.
  • Kommunikation: Hohe Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich und überzeugend zu erklären, zeichnen dich aus.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab.

Darüber hinaus bist du: #teamorientiert #zielstrebig #zuverlässig

title: Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer - Quantum Computing (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and own the real-time firmware that turns our control electronics into a working quantum computer. You will work on our next-generation system, where the control electronics are being integrated into a single, highly integrated chip. You sit at the heart of the machine, between the hardware that generates the pulses and the higher-level software that describes the experiments. Timing is not a detail here; it is the product. You are the person who makes sure the right signal reaches the ions at the right nanosecond, reliably, run after run.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the embedded firmware on our ARM-based control platform, from architecture through implementation to on-hardware debugging

  • Develop and maintain the real-time software layer that coordinates pulse sequencing, timing, and data flow across our highly integrated control chip

  • Write and maintain the low-level drivers and board support the hardware relies on

  • Guarantee deterministic, low-latency behaviour under hard real-time constraints

  • Lead firmware bring-up together with our electronics and physics teams, and debug at the boundary where software meets signal

  • Define the firmware architecture and engineering practices — build, test, and release processes for the embedded layer as the system matures

  • Contribute to the interfaces between the embedded layer and the rest of the stack, so experiments defined in software run correctly on the machine


Required Skills:

  • 5+ years of professional embedded software development for real-time or timing-critical systems

  • Deep command of C (and ideally C++) on ARM platforms, working close to the hardware

  • Experience with bare-metal and/or RTOS environments, and a clear understanding of when each is appropriate

  • Comfortable reading schematics and datasheets, and debugging real hardware with oscilloscopes, logic analysers, and JTAG

  • Strong grasp of real-time concepts: interrupts, DMA, timing, concurrency, and determinism

  • A track record of bringing up firmware on new hardware, not only maintaining existing systems

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental physicists and engineers, and to turn imprecise physical requirements into robust firmware

  • Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset

  • Good proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Nice to have (Bonus)

  • Experience on highly integrated SoCs, particularly ARM+FPGA platforms such as Xilinx Zynq / RFSoC

  • Working alongside FPGA/digital-electronics engineers at the software–gateware boundary

  • Rust for embedded systems

  • Embedded Linux on ARM (Cortex-A), including driver and kernel-module work

  • Signal processing or control-loop implementation on embedded targets

  • Experience with high-speed data acquisition or precision timing systems

  • Familiarity with laboratory, scientific, or measurement instrumentation

  • Prior experience with quantum computing or other deep-tech domains


What you can expect from eleQtron:

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remunerations that reflect this, additionally rewarding achievements

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the culture

  • Further development: We want to grow together and so we offer our team members needs-based, individualized further training as well as plenty of room for personal development

  • Wellness Package: We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being

  • Bike Leasing: Stay Mobile and Sustainable with Our Company Bike Leasing Program

  • Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus

  • At the forefront: Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications

  • Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices and meeting rooms
