title: Senior Fleet Manager
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een vooruitdenker die complexe data moeiteloos vertaalt naar glashelder advies? Neem jij van nature de regie, ben je sterk in stakeholdermanagement en heb je affiniteit met de dynamische wereld van Schiphol? Lees dan snel verder!

Binnen Orion Fleet Management zijn we op zoek naar een proactieve Senior Fleet Manager met een specifieke focus op onze klant Schiphol en ons label AirportPartners. Waar een reguliere Fleet Manager sterk leunt op de dagelijkse operatie, sta jij als Senior Fleet Manager daarboven. Jij kijkt verder dan de waan van de dag, anticipeert op wat komen gaat en gebruikt keiharde data om onze klant op strategisch niveau te adviseren.

Wat ga je doen?

In de rol van Senior Fleet Manager ben jij de absolute eigenaar van de vlootbeschikbaarheid voor Schiphol. Met ons label AirportPartners beheren wij hier de unieke en bedrijfskritische vloot van Schiphol: van de brandweerwagens en de onmisbare sneeuwvloot tot de personenwagens van het KLM-personeel. Jouw werk draait niet om achteraf reageren, maar om proactief sturen. Omdat jij de operationele basis feilloos begrijpt en beheerst, kun jij de vertaalslag maken naar optimalisatie en strategisch partnership.

Jouw takenpakket als Senior Fleet Manager bestaat uit de volgende pijlers:

Datagedreven Regie & Strategie:

  • Proactieve advisering: Je wacht niet tot de klant belt met een probleem, maar je adviseert hen ongevraagd over rendementsverbetering en risicobeperking op basis van jouw data-analyses;

  • Datagedreven regie: Je gebruikt voorspellende data om de vloot optimaal in te zetten en stilstand te minimaliseren. Vooruitdenken is jouw tweede natuur;

  • Bewaking van SLA’s en KPI’s: Je monitort continu de prestaties, stuurt bij waar nodig en garandeert dat we onze beloftes aan de klant waarmaken (of overtreffen);

  • Rapportage en overleg: Je zit regelmatig aan tafel met het management van klanten en leveranciers. Je presenteert heldere rapportages en treedt op als een volwaardig en strategisch gesprekspartner.

Operationele Excellentie:

Om op strategisch niveau te kunnen adviseren, zorg jij dat de basisprocessen, de motor van de afdeling, vlekkeloos verlopen:

  • Triage en analyse: Je overziet de storingsmeldingen en zorgt voor een feilloze initiële beoordeling.

  • Slimme planning: Je overziet de planning van (preventief) onderhoud, altijd met de impact op de 24/7 luchthaven operatie en veiligheid op Schiphol in je achterhoofd;

  • Toetsing en beoordeling: Je beoordeelt complexe reparatie aanvragen kritisch op basis van historie, vastgelegde afspraken en toekomstige inzet van het voertuig;

Wat vragen we van jou?

Voor de rol van Senior Fleet Manager zoeken we iemand die stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat. Je overziet het grote geheel, maar snapt de details die de data beïnvloeden. Verder zien wij graag het volgende terug:

  • Denkniveau: Je beschikt over HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau;

  • Sterk analytisch: Je bent een kei in het analyseren van data en haalt hier moeiteloos de juiste conclusies en actiepunten uit;

  • Proactieve mindset: Je wacht niet af, maar signaleert kansen en knelpunten voordat ze een probleem vormen;

  • Kennis & Ervaring: Je snapt hoe onderhoudsprocessen (triage, MTTR, MTBF) werken. Ervaring als Fleet Manager is een must en ervaring in de automotive of specifiek de OV-sector (bussen) is een zware pré;

  • Overtuigingskracht: Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden. Je kunt draagvlak creëren en complexe technische of data-gerelateerde zaken begrijpelijk uitleggen aan directie, klanten en leveranciers.

Ben jij klaar voor deze stap als Senior Fleet Manager en wil je bouwen aan de toekomst van ons wagenparkbeheer op Schiphol? Druk dan snel op de sollicitatieknop en laat jouw cv en motivatie achter!

Wat bieden wij

Een leuke en uitdagende baan met veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Je komt te werken in een professionele en stabiele kantooromgeving. Orion is een sterk groeiend bedrijf binnen de Pon-onderneming en biedt doorgroeimogelijkheden in de toekomst.

Wat bieden we nog meer voor de functie van Senior Fleet Manager:

  • Een goed salaris tussen de € 4.579,- en € 6.538,- o.b.v. fulltime. Uiteraard is dit afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 28 vakantiedagen* en 6 ADV dagen;

  • Een individueel keuzebudget (o.a. te besteden voor het aankopen van verlof);

  • Directe en korte lijnen; je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Operations;

  • De mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken;

  • Een enthousiast, gezellig, compact en ambitieus team;

  • Een ruime Pon-pensioenregeling;

  • Een collectieve ziektekostenverzekering bij ONVZ of Zilveren Kruis waarbij Pon €300 per jaar bijdraagt;

  • Pon Fit: sportieve activiteiten waar je aan kan deelnemen! Van bootcamp tot golfclinic;

  • Korting op eigen producten van Pon (bijv. een nieuwe Gazelle fiets of privé lease auto), €500 per jaar;

  • Lease-a-bike regeling voor het leasen van een Pon-fiets.

Over de organisatie

Orion ontzorgt bedrijven met grote complexe wagenparken door het reparatie- en onderhoudsproces optimaal te structureren.

Binnen het netwerk heeft Orion een 15-tal eigen werkplaatsen onder de labels: AirportPartners, BusPartners en WastePartners. Onze werkplaatsen zijn gevestigd in: Almere, Amersfoort, Badhoevedorp-Schiphol (2 locaties), Ede, Emmeloord, Helmond, Leeuwarden, Leiden, Lichtenvoorde, Middelburg, Montfoort, Oosterwolde, Utrecht en Zwolle. Deze vacature is gericht op ons hoofdkantoor in Barneveld!

Met circa 250 collega’s zetten wij ons dagelijks in om ervoor te zorgen dat onder andere huis en bedrijfsafval opgehaald kunnen worden, vliegtuigen kunnen blijven opstijgen en landen en OV-reizigers in veilige en betrouwbare bussen kunnen reizen. Wij staan midden in de maatschappij en spelen in op trends als verstedelijking, elektrificatie, duurzaamheid en digitalisering.

title: Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) – PHP/Symfony & React
descriptionHtml:
Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring für unseren Kunden die Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD

  • Gehalt: 52.000–62.000 € brutto/Jahr, für außergewöhnliche Profile auch mehr · unbefristet, Vollzeit

  • Arbeitsmodell: hybrid, 3 Tage Büro / 2 Tage remote

  • Standort: Berlin

  • Produkt: Eine Software für Termin- und Vorgangsmanagement in der öffentlichen Verwaltung

  • Start: so bald wie möglich oder nach Vereinbarung

Die Rolle

Das Kernprodukt unserer Kunden ist über viele Jahre gewachsen, und das sieht man dem Code an. Das Backend läuft auf PHP 8.1 ohne Framework. Im Frontend stehen jQuery und Vanilla-JS neben React, und automatisierte Tests gibt es bisher wenige.

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Legacy-Module bei laufendem Betrieb schrittweise durch Symfony-Services und React-Oberflächen ersetzen

  • Fullstack-Features von der Datenbank bis zum Frontend entwickeln, teils auch als kundenspezifische Erweiterungen

  • Bestehenden Legacy-Code pflegen, debuggen und weiterentwickeln

  • Code-Reviews durchführen und die Testabdeckung ausbauen

  • Mit Entwicklungsleitung und Geschäftsführung abstimmen, welche Bereiche als Nächstes modernisiert werden

  • Zwei Auszubildende im letzten Ausbildungsabschnitt fachlich begleiten (ohne disziplinarische Führung)

  • Gelegentlich an Kundenterminen teilnehmen, etwa alle 3–4 Wochen

Nach 6 Monaten …

… setzt du Features eigenständig um, hast spürbar zur Modernisierung beigetragen, die Codequalität verbessert und bist für die Auszubildenden eine feste Ansprechperson.

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: etwa 4–5 Jahre in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung (ein Richtwert, keine harte Grenze)

  • PHP: fundierte Kenntnisse in modernem PHP 8.x mit objektorientierter Architektur, etwa Dependency Injection, Interfaces und SOLID

  • Symfony: nachweisbare Praxiserfahrung mit dem Framework

  • Legacy-Code: Du gehst sicher mit gewachsenen Codebasen um. Du refaktorierst, debuggst und entwickelst weiter, ohne alles neu zu schreiben.

  • JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab

  • Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL

  • Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD

  • Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1

  • Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch

  • Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter.

  • Abschluss: Ausbildung oder FH-Abschluss zählen genauso viel wie ein Uni-Studium. Entscheidend ist deine Praxiserfahrung.

Pluspunkte: REST/API-Design und Schnittstellenentwicklung, automatisiertes Testing (PHPUnit, Jest), Docker, Deployment-Pipelines und Cloud, Software-Architektur und Design-Patterns, produktiver Einsatz von KI-Tools wie Claude Code oder Codex. Erfahrung mit Software für den öffentlichen Sektor ist nicht nötig.

Dein Team

Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: ein Developer Lead, ein Geschäftsführer und Projektmanager, der selbst aktiv mitentwickelt, ein externer Entwickler und zwei Auszubildende. Ihr stimmt euch täglich ab. Die Entwicklungsleitung und die Geschäftsführung übernehmen dein Onboarding persönlich.

Was wir bieten

  • Ein sinnstiftendes Produkt, das täglich in Bürgerämtern genutzt wird, in einem krisensicheren Markt

  • Echter Einfluss auf technische Entscheidungen und eine Modernisierung mit klarem Ziel

  • 30 Urlaubstage

  • Gleitzeit mit Kernzeit ab 10 Uhr, 2 Remote-Tage pro Woche

  • Weiterbildung während der Arbeitszeit, Udemy-Kurse; eigene Vorschläge sind willkommen

  • Claude-Lizenz, offen für weitere Tools

  • Hardware: Lenovo ThinkPad, offen für Vorschläge

  • UrbanSportsClub und JobRad

  • Gute Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr

So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess

  • Kennenlerngespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team

  • Technisches Interview mit Live-Projektarbeit mit dem Developer Lead und der Geschäftsführung

  • Teamgespräch vor Ort

  • Angebot

Über das Unternehmen

Unser Kunde entwickelt seit über 25 Jahren Software für die öffentliche Verwaltung. Städte wie Berlin, München, Bonn und Dessau setzen seit Jahrzehnten auf die Lösungen des Unternehmens.

Du willst ein bewährtes Produkt fit für die Zukunft machen? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Senior Group Marketing Controller (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
The role

The Group Marketing Controller is the primary finance interface for HelloFresh's global marketing function. The role exists to ensure marketing spend is planned accurately, closed correctly, and reported transparently — bridging the gap between marketing execution and the Group P&L.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

What you’ll do

1. Close & Accruals

  • Own the month-end close process for marketing cost lines across all markets
  • Review and validate marketing accruals submitted by local finance teams
  • Identify and resolve booking errors, misclassifications, or missing accruals
  • Maintain clean actuals in the income statement for all marketing line items
  • Work with SE Finance Controlling to improve and create transparency to the markets on marketing IC charges

2. Budget & Forecast Management

  • Consolidate and challenge market-level marketing budgets during planning cycles
  • Lead marketing Guidance creation for Business Plan cycles
  • Maintain the Group marketing budget with actuals vs. budget vs. forecast
  • Flag material variances early and escalate to marketing stakeholders

3. Reporting & Analysis

  • Work with Tech and local markets to improve and automate input quality of weekly reporting
  • Produce monthly marketing performance reports covering spend vs. budget, phasing, and key variance drivers (Leverage A.I. and Databricks Dashboards)
  • Support the CFO/board reporting pack with accurate marketing cost commentary
  • Build and maintain performance reports for Global Marketing teams

4. Business Partnering

  • Act as the day-to-day finance contact for the Global Marketing teams
  • Manage Direct and Indirect spend for the Marketing team

5. Process & Controls

  • Document and improve the end-to-end marketing close process
  • Ensure consistent cost treatment across markets (e.g. working vs. non-working spend, agency fees, media)
  • Identify gaps in how marketing costs are captured and propose fixes

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Clean marketing close every month — no material restatements or late accruals
  • Stakeholders can trust the marketing numbers without re-checking them
  • Variances are explained proactively, not reactively
  • Marketing controller processes are standardised across markets

WHAT THE FUTURE LOOKS LIKE

  • Manage marketing spend between markets by reviewing ROI, AOR and agreed upon KPI performance
  • Centralised and automated marketing controlling at month-end

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

  • Not a marketing strategist — not expected to have opinions on campaign effectiveness or brand direction
  • Not a data analyst — analytical support comes from the Finance Systems team; this role translates outputs into financial conclusions
  • Not a local market controller — this role holds the Group view; local controllers own their market execution

What you’ll bring

  • Several years of experience in financial controlling, FP&A, or a similar finance business-partnering role, ideally with exposure to marketing or performance-marketing cost structures
  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; comfort working with large datasets and BI/reporting tools
  • Ability to explain financial variances clearly to non-finance stakeholders
  • Experience running or supporting a month-end close process
  • Comfort operating across multiple markets and currencies in a fast-paced, matrixed organisation
  • Curiosity about how AI and automation can modernise financial reporting

What we offer

Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.

  • Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.
  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.
  • Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.
  • Invest in your growth with an annual learning & development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.
  • Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

title: Senior Growth Director (Commercial Lead)
descriptionHtml:
About Moloco:

Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.

Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system. Moloco Ads is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet. Moloco Commerce Media is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture), the AI system behind every Moloco product.

At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer. Come build what's next.

The Impact You’ll Be Contributing to Moloco:

Join Moloco as a Senior Growth Director and lead the strategic growth of some of our most important partners across EMEA. As a senior individual contributor, you will own a dedicated portfolio of top accounts, building executive partnerships and developing commercial strategies that create lasting value for customers and Moloco.

You will bring a deep understanding of each customer’s business, connect their priorities to Moloco’s capabilities, and lead our most complex commercial conversations. Your impact will extend beyond your own portfolio through selective support on high-stakes opportunities, coaching, and influencing Moloco’s product and commercial direction.

The Opportunity:

Based in London, you’ll operate as a Commercial Lead within the EMEA Growth team, accountable for substantial revenue outcomes and long-term customer growth. This is an individual contributor role combining hands-on account ownership with commercial leadership across the wider team.

Strategic Growth & Commercial Ownership

  • Own and deliver revenue targets across a dedicated portfolio of top EMEA accounts, with accountability for forecast accuracy, risk management, and long-term growth.
  • Set and drive the multi-year growth agenda for your customers, leading joint business planning with executive stakeholders to secure investment commitments, establish shared accountability, and drive delivery against ambitious commercial goals.
  • Unlock incremental revenue through expansion into new geographies, business units, use cases, and product adoption.
  • Own the most complex and ambiguous commercial negotiations across your portfolio, structuring non-standard agreements in partnership with Sales, Finance, Legal, and leadership to balance customer value, commercial risk, and sustainable growth.

Consultative Selling & Executive Partnership

  • Act as a trusted commercial advisor and industry expert to your customers, combining deep knowledge of their business models and company goals with insight into market dynamics and competitive trends to challenge assumptions, shape growth strategies, and identify where Moloco can create lasting business value.
  • Develop tailored proposals grounded in customer business outcomes, including lifetime value, payback period, and return on ad spend at scale.
  • Build long-term strategic partnerships with customers, independently owning C-suite and senior commercial relationships and aligning Moloco’s role in their growth with shared objectives, investment priorities, and measures of success.
  • Use trusted executive relationships to shape customer priorities, influence investment decisions, and unlock growth opportunities beyond existing campaigns—including opening doors to new decision-makers, business units, and markets.
  • Lead executive business reviews and strategic planning conversations, translating performance data into clear recommendations for long-term growth.

Product Expertise & Cross-Functional Influence

  • Apply deep knowledge of Moloco’s products, machine learning capabilities, and the mobile advertising ecosystem to shape credible solutions for customers.
  • Work hands-on with data to test growth hypotheses, diagnose challenges, and build commercially sound recommendations.
  • Act as the voice of the market, partnering with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to translate customer needs, industry trends, and competitive insights into recommendations that shape product priorities and unlock growth.
  • Lead the commercial development of new and ambiguous growth opportunities, setting direction, mobilising cross-functional teams, and driving customer validation to turn successful approaches into repeatable revenue opportunities across EMEA.
  • Influence senior cross-functional stakeholders to prioritise strategic account opportunities, secure resources, and resolve competing priorities to deliver commercial outcomes.

Coaching & Commercial Leadership

  • Set the standard for consultative selling, deal strategy, negotiation, and executive engagement across EMEA, leading by example in your own accounts and coaching Growth Managers and Growth Directors to strengthen their commercial capabilities.
  • Bring senior commercial expertise to accounts beyond your own portfolio, working alongside account owners to lead high-stakes customer conversations, navigate complex negotiations, and resolve escalations.
  • Turn successful approaches into practical frameworks and playbooks that raise commercial standards across EMEA.
  • Build a reputation as a recognised industry expert in adtech and mobile growth, actively speaking at industry events and sharing insights that strengthen Moloco’s credibility with customers and the wider market.
  • Adapt your leadership and communication style to the audience and situation, using expertise and sound judgment to build trust, navigate disagreement, and secure commitment to action without formal management authority.

How Do I Know if the Role Is Right for Me?

Experience & Expertise

  • 10+ years of experience in mobile advertising, account management, consultative sales, or commercial leadership.
  • A proven track record of owning and growing some of an organisation’s largest and most strategically important accounts, navigating complex customer relationships and delivering substantial, sustained revenue growth.
  • Experience leading complex commercial negotiations and structuring agreements around customer business objectives.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted executive relationships and influence strategic investment decisions.
  • Deep understanding of the mobile advertising ecosystem, mobile measurement partners (MMPs), attribution, and programmatic performance marketing.
  • Evidence of improving commercial outcomes beyond your own accounts through coaching, co-selling, or cross-functional leadership.
  • Fluency in English (Turkish a strong plus).

Skills & Mindset

  • Exceptional commercial judgment and the ability to understand how customers make money, assess opportunities, and make disciplined trade-offs.
  • Strong product and analytical fluency, with the ability to connect technical capabilities and performance data to business value.
  • Executive presence and clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to simplify complex issues for senior audiences.

title: Senior Information Security Infrastructure Engineer - Security Architecture - InfoSec
descriptionHtml:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role :

Join the InfoSec - Security Architecture team as a Senior Information Security Infrastructure Engineer, where you'll have the chance to play a key role in protecting our organization's data and systems. This position offers the opportunity to work on meaningful projects that directly impact our security posture and collaborate with a skilled team passionate about information security.   In more details: We ingest the security telemetry that the whole security org runs on. In this role you'll get that telemetry into Elasticsearch consistently and keep the underlying Elastic clusters healthy. You own the pipeline end to end: from a new security data source landing, through ingest pipelines, into the indices detection, IR, and consulting teams query, plus the clusters that store it all. 

What You Will Be Doing :

  • Security telemetry ingestion - build and maintain ingestion of security-relevant data into Elasticsearch (cloud provider audit logs, identity/SaaS activity, endpoint and asset data). This means integrating with third-party and cloud provider APIs to pull telemetry: auth, pagination, rate limits, and handling schema changes. Both Elastic integrations and one-off custom integrations.
  • Keep the Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes clusters healthy. Monitor and upgrade them regularly. This involves updating versions and builds. Manage capacity and shards. Handle index lifecycle management (ILM). Enable cross-cluster search (CCS).
  • Use Terraform to manage cloud infrastructure and Elasticsearch resources. This includes managing pipelines, index templates, and alerts. Utilize Kubernetes and Helm to deploy scheduled ingest jobs.
  • Use AI automation and tooling to reduce toil. This includes self-healing jobs and health checks. It also involves alerting, internal CLIs, and AI or agent-assisted workflows for investigation and operations.
  • Data quality & reliability - Own the "is the security data actually flowing correctly?" question. Monitor backfills. Ensure that schemas and fields are consistent. Keep an eye on costs.

What You Bring :

  • Ability to operate Elastic and Elasticsearch in production. This includes managing ingest pipelines, index templates, mappings, and queries, while ensuring that clusters are healthy and upgraded. Experience with ECK or Elasticsearch on Kubernetes is strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and accelerate operations, while still owning the final outcomes.
  • Kubernetes - deploying and operating workloads (scheduled jobs, Helm charts, operators); troubleshooting pods/jobs in a cluster.
  • Terraform - managing cloud and Elasticsearch resources as code.
  • API integration - consuming REST APIs for data ingestion: authentication, pagination, rate limiting concurrency, and error handling.
  • Python scripting - able to read, write, and modify ingestion/automation scripts. Scripting-level, not full software-engineering depth.

Bonus Points :

  • Experience with cloud providers.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud providers, preferably GCP, and working with audit and logging data.
  • Knowledge of GitHub, PR-based workflows, GitHub Actions and Continuous Integration (CI).
  • Knowledge of SOC operations and incident response (IR) workflows, including the use of security telemetry during investigations.
  • Ability to develop and use dashboard/visualization tools.

Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

title: Senior Machine Learning Scientist (Viator)
descriptionHtml:
About Tripadvisor 

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

As our new Senior Machine Learning Scientist you’ll be joining the Viator R&D Team. This team is evolving the world's leading marketplace for travel experiences. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.

About the Role

You’ll serve as a key technical lead and pod architect within our core discovery engine. You will independently own and execute the machine learning strategy for major product capabilities—such as Search, Retrieval, Ranking, or Content AI—that power how millions of users discover and plan their travel itineraries.

This Senior Machine Learning Scientist role bridges the gap between state-of-the-art (SOTA) research and robust, production-grade engineering. You will navigate technical ambiguity, implement custom algorithmic components, and explicitly map offline model metrics directly to business KPIs like booking conversion and user engagement. If you are a relentlessly curious scientist who excels at rapid prototyping, practical SOTA deployment, and multiplying the capabilities of your peers, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Leadership & Custom Implementation: Act as the technical lead for specific ML projects within your pod. Design and implement custom model components or loss functions that don't exist "off-the-shelf," breaking down massive research goals into deliverable, iterative milestones.
  • Optimization & SOTA Scouting: Evaluate the global research landscape to conduct cost-benefit analyses on new architectures, balancing model complexity against inference speed, memory usage, and execution costs (such as token consumption). Optimize models for production using techniques like quantization and distillation.
  • Operational Frameworks & Rigor: Tailor Golden Datasets and leaderboards with minimal supervision, and implement rigorous validation automation (such as backtesting and slice-based evaluation) to prevent data leakage, over-fitting, and production regressions.
  • Engineering Partnership & Handovers: Collaborate closely with Engineering Leads to ensure compute/GPU infrastructure supports model requirements. Clearly define model failure modes, edge cases, and confidence thresholds—to enable SWE partners to build robust fallback systems.
  • Applied Debugging & Guardrails: Diagnose complex algorithmic bugs and implement automated checks for "Silent Failures" (e.g., concept drift or production feature distribution shifts). Lead team-level post-mortems and resolve blocking corrective actions.
  • Career Multiplier: Formally mentor mid-level and associate ML scientists, reviewing their experimental logic to ensure high scientific rigor while guiding them through applied ML and production constraints.

Skills & Experience

  • Education: Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a highly quantitative field.
  • Experience: 5+ years of industry experience developing, validating, and deploying large-scale ML models in production environments.
  • Algorithmic Expertise: Strong practical and theoretical foundation in machine learning techniques, feature engineering, and deep learning paradigms.
  • SOTA Adaptability: Proven ability to tweak, hybridize, and adapt existing state-of-the-art architectures to solve non-linear business problems. Experience with multi-task learning (MTL), ranking, Content AI stacks, Agentic AI etc is highly desirable.
  • Technical Stack: Mastery of Python and deep learning frameworks (such as PyTorch, PyTorch Lightning, or TensorFlow) alongside familiarity with data versioning and experiment tracking tools.

Desired

  • Next-generation retrieval pipelines, multi-stage ranking systems and Content AI stacks.
  • Advanced sequential recommendation systems designed to model real-time user session dynamics.
  • Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), knowledge graphs, and multi-modal representation learning to map travel entities.
  • Generative AI and Agentic AI workflows to improve conversational discovery experiences.

What We Offer 

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars:

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. 

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges. 

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

title: Senior Manager, Performance Creative Strategy – Fanatics Market (Remote Fixed Contract)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Fanatics is a leading global sports platform redefining how fans connect with the teams, players and moments they love. Our businesses — Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, Fanatics Betting & Gaming, Fanatics Events, Fanatics Advertising, Fanatics Markets and Fanatics Studios — maximize the presence and reach for hundreds of partners globally and create a one-stop experience that allows fans to buy, bet, collect, and earn, while engaging with sports in deeper, more immersive ways. This includes licensed fan gear and lifestyle products, sportsbook and iGaming, physical and digital trading cards, live events, premium sports entertainment content, credit card offerings and more. Together, they form a powerful, integrated ecosystem — connected by the Fanatics ONE loyalty program and FanCash, the currency of sport — delivering personalized experiences to over 100 million fans worldwide. Fanatics holds partnerships with over 900 sports properties, from professional leagues and players’ associations to teams, colleges and retail partners; over 7,000 athletes and celebrities; and over 2,000 retail locations, including all Lids stores. Backed by a team of more than 22,000 employees, Fanatics is committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience.

Primary Focus:

As Senior Manager, Performance Creative Strategy at Fanatics Betting & Gaming (FBG), you are responsible for shaping the strategic priorities, audience opportunities and learning agenda behind Fanatics Markets performance creative. You'll uncover the hooks, angles and fan insights most likely to resonate, translate them into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative team, and track performance to understand what works and why. This role connects fan insight, creative development and performance results, ensuring learnings continuously inform future briefs across acquisition, engagement and retention. Markets and Sportsbook share many of the same fans, moments and creative systems, so you'll work in close partnership with the OSB Performance Creative team to align priorities, share learnings and avoid duplicating effort.

This is a six-month contract role reporting to the Senior Director, Performance Creative & GTM.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive the Markets performance creative strategy across paid social, app networks, CTV, affiliates and lifecycle, aligned with business priorities, audience insight and brand positioning.
  • Build and maintain the Markets creative variation framework, mapping hooks, angles, reasons to believe, formats and offers to audience and funnel stage.
  • Translate business objectives and fan insight into clear, inspiring briefs for the internal creative team, including messaging territories, hook hypotheses, angles and iteration briefs.
  • Own the Markets testing agenda, defining what we want to learn, how we measure a win, and which tests run each month.
  • Run a high-velocity testing program across hooks, openers, formats, offers and creators, improving hit rate and speed to learning.
  • Partner with Media and Analytics to track creative performance, identify winners and fatigue early, and apply learnings to the next round of briefs.
  • Write concise test readouts and maintain a living library of what works for Markets audiences, shared with the OSB team so learnings travel across both products.
  • Identify performance territories, audience tensions and messaging opportunities to support creative briefs.
  • Support brand and full-funnel campaign briefs with clear performance requirements, working with Integrated Marketing and Media so channel, audience, format and measurement needs are set before creative development begins. Partner with the Creative Studio to translate those requirements into effective creative, with the Studio retaining ownership of creative direction and execution.
  • Advise Brand and agency partners on hooks, edits, cutdowns, aspect ratios and platform-native versions, so big campaign moments carry through to always-on performance and lifecycle.
  • Source fan insight, competitor ad libraries, creator content and platform trends to identify new angles and white space.
  • Contribute a strong performance POV to creative insight sessions and brainstorms, working closely with the Creative Studio.
  • Share performance learnings and recommendations in GTM forums and monthly reviews.

What You'll Deliver in Six Months:

  • A Markets testing agenda and monthly testing cadence, live within your first 30 days.
  • A documented creative variation framework for Market.
  • A shared testing and learnings rhythm with the OSB Performance Creative team.
  • A steady flow of briefs, tests and written readouts, with winners scaled into the always-on mix.
  • A learnings library and handover documentation so the work continues after the engagement ends.

How This Role Connects Across the Team:

  • Partners closely with the OSB Performance Creative team on shared sport moments, audiences and testing, aligning briefs and calendars, pooling learnings, and adapting proven OSB creative for Market where it fits.
  • Partners with the internal producer, who owns production timelines and delivery, to keep briefs, priorities and the content calendar aligned.
  • Partners with the Creative Studio and Integrated Marketing to shape high-quality output, providing direction and feedback while respecting executional ownership.
  • Partners with Brand and Integrated Marketing to embed performance best practice into campaigns, ensuring work is both distinctive and built to perform across the funnel.
  • Partners with Media, Analytics and CRM to define success measures, read results and feed learnings back into strategy.
  • Partners with the affiliate team on UGC briefs aligned to channel best practice.
  • Works with Legal, Compliance and Creative Operations to keep all creative compliant and aligned with Responsible Gaming standards.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative or brand strategy, ideally within a fast-growing D2C brand, mobile app, sports, gaming or entertainment business.
  • Portfolio demonstrating hook-led, insight-driven creative and the performance results behind it.
  • Strong knowledge of platform-native creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Snap and app networks, including UGC and creator formats.
  • Hands-on experience running creative testing programs at volume.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to read performance data and translate it into clear recommendations.
  • Excellent storytelling and writing skills, from a 6-second hook to a campaign narrative to a performance readout.
  • Experience working across matrixed teams and influencing work you don't directly own.
  • Able to ramp quickly and deliver within a fixed-term engagement.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally for team meetings and Fanatics events.

Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

title: Senior Manager, Sanctions Regulatory Analysis
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

Role Overview

Airwallex is seeking highly skilled Sanctions Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our second line of defense (2LoD) Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) team. To support our global operations and ensure nuanced, localized oversight, we are looking for dedicated, in-region sanctions specialists across EMEA/UK.

In this role, you will act as the ultimate regional escalation point for L3 sanctions alerts to advise on complicated sanctions matches, drive sanctions investigations and efficacy of sanctions screening, determine potential reporting obligations, and assist in scaling a global sanctions program. This role requires a strategic thinker who can seamlessly translate complex regional regulatory changes into practical, scalable control enhancements across the business and multiple geographies.

Responsibilities

  • Act as an in-region Sanctions Subject Matter Expert (SME) and serve as the second-line escalation point for highly complex, ambiguous sanctions matches, special investigations, and potential block-and-reject.

  • Own L3 Sanctions case investigation and decisioning regionally, assessing applicable reporting, disclosure, and recordkeeping obligations.

  • Provide practical, timely, and risk-based sanctions advice on complex cross-border payment flows, indirect exposure, jurisdictional conflicts, new products and services, customer segments, commercial transactions, and geographic expansion.

  • Own and maintain regional Sanctions operational procedures and provide effective second-line oversight of sanctions controls implemented by first-line teams, ensuring alignment with the Global Sanctions Policy while incorporating applicable local requirements.

  • Liaise with global teams to provide actionable feedback on product-specific controls and screening technologies, leveraging in-region expertise and historical L3 escalations to ensure continuous optimization and alignment with the organization’s risk appetite.

  • Monitor US, regional, and international sanctions and export-control developments, geopolitical events, and regulatory expectations, assessing their impact on customers, products, jurisdictions, lists, systems, procedures, and risk appetite.

  • Develop and deliver targeted training and ongoing guidance for L2 sanctions reviewers, KYC, Operations, and other stakeholders on sanctions risk, alert adjudication, investigative research, discounting criteria, escalation standards, and documentation requirements.

  • Lead responses to banking partners and other external stakeholders on sanctions-related inquiries and due diligence reviews.

Qualifications

  • 7-10 years of relevant experience, preferably at a fintech, payments company, or large financial institution specializing in sanctions.

  • Experience managing sanctions alerts at the L3 level, recommending blocking/freezing transactions, assessing sanctions-related licenses and respective transactional permissibility, and managing reporting.

  • History of assessing current sanctions frameworks and recommending enhancements to strengthen the program, including designing and scaling sanctions programs.

  • Demonstrated understanding of in-region sanctions regulations and industry best practices pertaining to economic sanctions; knowledge of US sanctions in addition to in-region expertise is strongly preferred.

  • History of executing the operationalization of sanctions controls in collaboration with technological teams, adhering to global policies, in-region procedures, and risk appetite.

  • A history of interacting or supporting engagement with external stakeholders such as regulators or financial institution partners on sanctions matters.

  • Expert knowledge of financial and trade sanctions within the European Union (EU) framework and UK regulations administered by the Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) and corresponding export control bodies.

  • Strong understanding of the EU/UK Blocking Statute and how to navigate conflicting regulatory obligations within European jurisdictions and the UK.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

You’ll use player feedback, analytics and playtesting to refine gameplay, experiment with new ideas and shape the ongoing evolution of the game’s core puzzle experience.

  • Experience improving level editors, pipelines or content creation workflows.

  • Passion for cosy games and creating emotionally engaging player experiences.

What We're Looking for

  • A consistent track record of delivering high-quality work that meets design requirements and project goals.

  • Sound judgement in balancing creative excellence with production efficiency.

  • A player-first mindset, balanced with an understanding of creative, technical and commercial goals.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our London office. The team values in-person collaboration and typically works from the office three days a week: Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. Wishing you all the best,

title: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Search
descriptionHtml:
The role 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Agentic Search team, building the search and retrieval infrastructure that powers AI agents and LLM-based applications at scale.

This is a hands-on IC role with real ownership. You will take full end-to-end responsibility over a core product area, from defining strategy through shipping and iterating based on real usage data. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, design, and go-to-market, shaping how AI agents discover, retrieve, and act on web information in real time.

The product serves both a developer-facing PLG motion and a growing enterprise customer base, so you will need to be equally comfortable digging into API design and search quality as you are running customer discovery calls and informing competitive positioning. We are looking for someone who can operate as a senior strategic partner, not just an executor, and who has the potential to grow into a principal-level PM over time.

You’re welcome to work hybrid from Tel Aviv, Israel.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Own a core product area end-to-end: strategy, roadmap, execution, and iteration based on real usage signals and customer feedback.
  • Drive search quality and relevance improvements by working closely with engineering and research to define evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and release criteria.
  • Engage directly with enterprise customers and developer users to validate ideas, understand pain points, and shape product-market fit across both PLG and enterprise motions.
  • Monitor the competitive landscape in agentic search and AI-powered retrieval, identifying shifts, threats, and opportunities that should inform product decisions.
  • Collaborate with go-to-market teams (sales, solutions, growth) to ensure product positioning, ICP definitions, and enablement materials reflect product reality.
  • Contribute to product strategy as a senior voice on a small, high-impact team, challenging assumptions and bringing independent judgment to key decisions.
  • Lead product experiments and rapid iteration cycles, moving from hypothesis to prototype to production with clear success criteria.

We expect you to have: 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in developer tools, API platforms, or search and retrieval infrastructure.
  • Track record of shipping products in fast-moving markets, working closely with engineering and design from concept through launch and iteration.
  • Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows. Hands-on technical background is a strong plus.
  • Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs.

  • Experience in search, information retrieval, NLP, or adjacent domains.

title: Senior Product Manager - Core Experience
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to make building with n8n feel simple, powerful, and intuitive at every level, helping first-time users get to value quickly while enabling experienced builders to confidently create and run sophisticated workflows in production.

To do so, you’ll own high-impact product areas across n8n’s Experience: from identifying the biggest builder problems to shaping strategy, shipping solutions, and continuously improving them based on real usage:

Make the core building experience exceptional

  • Identify and solve the highest-leverage problems across the workflow-building journey, making n8n easier to understand, faster to use, and more powerful as workflows grow in complexity.

  • Turn technically complex capabilities into polished, intuitive product experiences through close collaboration with Design and Engineering.

  • Continuously improve how users create, configure, debug, and evolve workflows, with a high bar for usability, performance, and reliability.

Reduce friction from first workflow to production

  • Find opportunities to dramatically shorten the path from an idea to a working workflow, particularly around setup, configuration, connectivity, and access to external services.

  • Shape experiences that make capabilities such as AI models, web search, integrations, and other services immediately useful while handling underlying complexity elegantly.

  • Balance simplicity with transparency and control so streamlined experiences continue to work for advanced, business-critical, and production use cases.

Shape the foundations of a powerful builder platform

  • Define product experiences and platform capabilities that make n8n flexible and extensible without exposing unnecessary complexity to users.

  • Improve how builders interact with integrations, data, credentials, schemas, reusable capabilities, and emerging standards such as MCP.

  • Partner with Engineering and developer-facing teams to ensure the product scales across an expanding ecosystem of services, use cases, and technical users.

Drive product outcomes through discovery, data, and leadership

  • Engage deeply with customers, community members, and internal teams to understand real workflows, pain points, and opportunities across the builder experience.

  • Define clear product bets, success metrics, and priorities, combining quantitative evidence with strong product judgment and fast learning loops.

  • Lead cross-functional teams across Engineering, Design, Data, DevRel, Docs, PMM, Support, and Customer Success through clear decisions, strong communication, and ownership of outcomes.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • Proven product management experience: You’ve shipped impactful software products in fast-moving environments and can clearly explain the outcomes, decisions, and tradeoffs you owned.

  • Builder mindset: You’re entrepreneurial and hands-on, and you enjoy moving from an ambiguous problem to a prototype, shipped product, and iteration quickly.

  • Excellent product & UX judgment: You’re known for simplifying complexity and have a strong instinct for what makes technical products intuitive, polished, and enjoyable to use.

  • Technical fluency: You’re comfortable reasoning about APIs, integrations, authentication, schemas, data flows, and system constraints and can partner deeply with engineers.

  • Strong product discovery skills: You get close to users, uncover the underlying problem behind feature requests, validate assumptions, and turn insights into focused product decisions.

  • Data fluency: You can define meaningful success metrics, investigate product behaviour and funnels, and combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight and product intuition

  • AI-native product thinking: You actively use modern AI tools in your own work and understand the opportunities and product challenges created by AI-powered experiences.

Nice-to-haves

  • Developer product experience: You’ve built products for technical users and understand what great developer and builder experiences look like.

  • Integrations experience: You’ve worked on products involving third-party APIs, authentication, developer platforms, or integration ecosystems.

  • Community or open-source experience: You’ve built products alongside developer communities, contributors, or external ecosystems.

  • AI product experience: You’ve worked with LLMs, agents, model providers, evaluations, or other AI platform capabilities and understand their unique product tradeoffs.

  • Experimentation experience: You know how to use prototypes, experiments, and incremental releases to learn quickly without adding unnecessary process.

  • Cloud/SaaS experience: You understand the reliability, scalability, security, and enterprise considerations involved in building critical SaaS products.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll work on the heart of the product experience - shaping how builders go from an idea to a workflow they trust in production. Your work will influence some of the most fundamental parts of n8n: how people build, connect services, access powerful capabilities, understand what’s happening in their workflows, and scale from simple automation to complex AI-powered systems.

You’ll join n8n at a stage where the product and company are scaling rapidly, but there is still enormous opportunity to define what a world-class automation building experience should feel like. You’ll have the autonomy to identify important problems, work deeply with users and technical teams, and turn ambitious ideas into product experiences people rely on every day.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now - and help us build the future of automation

title: Senior Product Owner, Support Platform & AI
descriptionHtml:
About Jimdo

We exist to unleash the power of the self-employed - helping solopreneurs and micro-businesses thrive by doing what they're passionate about and removing the complexity of building lasting, successful businesses.

Jimdo started in 2007 when three school friends built a website builder in a Northern German farmhouse to help everyone build a presence online. Today, we're a profitable, remote-first company with 220+ people from 50+ nationalities working across 15+ countries. We've helped build over 36 million websites to get online across the world.

We're more than just a website builder. We're an AI-powered platform that helps self-employed people actually run and build successful businesses — from getting found online, winning customers and running their business with a peace of mind by knowing exactly what to do next to move forward.

At the heart of Jimdo is a strong belief in personalized, data-driven guidance. Our platform combines design, business tools, and an AI-powered core that turns real customer data into clear insights and next steps helping our customers focus on what moves their business forward.

Role Overview

At Jimdo, we think the best support is the one a customer never needs. When our customers, self-employed people and small business owners, do need help, it should come fast: from self-service and AI first, and from a person when that's what the case needs.

We're bringing our support tooling, Zendesk, chatbots and AI work together into one team with one backlog and one roadmap. As Senior Product Owner, you'll lead that team and own the outcome: more questions answered by AI, faster help, lower cost to serve, and customers who still trust us.

You'll also shape where this goes next. Over the next couple of years AI will handle more and more first-line support, and you'll decide how the work is split between AI and people, and build the platform around it.

 

The team and who you'll work with

You'll report to the Head of Customer Support Services and join CSS, our support organisation.

You'll lead a small team of Zendesk and AI specialists and work day to day with the engineers who build our support tools.

You'll work closely with our knowledge and readiness team, support agents and team leads, product teams, our Company AI team, Data & Analytics, and our support and AI vendors.

 

What you'll be doing:

  • Set the vision for our support platform and AI with the Head of CSS, and turn it into a roadmap, a business case and results.

  • Lead, coach and grow your team, and bring specialists and engineers together around one backlog and clear quarterly outcomes.

  • Own how well our chatbot, Zendesk AI agents and Copilot perform: define what a good AI answer is, measure it, and switch off what doesn't help customers.

  • Improve routing, user identification and self-service entry points so customers get to the right answer faster.

  • Spend real time with customers and support agents: read tickets, listen to chats, see where people get stuck.

  • Build a written case for every bigger piece of work, own the cost to serve, and check results against your forecast.

  • Turn what you learn in support into evidence that helps product teams fix problems at the source.

Your first months

  • After 3 months: your team works from one backlog and one outcome roadmap, and the quality bar for AI answers is agreed.

  • After 6 months: you've delivered and reported your first quarterly outcome, including how AI resolution compares with your forecast.

What you bring to the table

  • 5+ years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally including support, CX, service or internal platform products.

  • You've shipped AI or chatbot features in production and can name the metric you moved, the baseline and the result.

  • You explain product decisions in commercial terms: cost, savings, effect, and what you learned when a forecast was wrong.

  • You've managed people and led people who didn't report to you, ideally across departments.

  • You do your own analysis with SQL or BI tools, and design and read experiments without waiting for an analyst.

  • A clear point of view on what a good support experience is, and fluent English for everyday work.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Zendesk (or a similar tool such as Intercom or Salesforce Service Cloud), including AI agents, routing and automations.

  • Experience using support insights to change a product team's roadmap.

  • German language skills.

What we offer:

Inspiring Mission: At our core, we are driven by a meaningful mission - to  empower solopreneurs and small businesses to succeed and  to contribute to the sustainability and vibrancy of the communities they serve.

Flexibility and Trust: Our work environment thrives on flexibility and trust. We offer fully remote work set-up  with opportunities for in-person collaboration. You can manage your working hours flexibly because we prioritize the results you deliver over the number of hours you put in. 

An International Diverse Team: Our team is a mosaic of over 248 individuals hailing from 50+ different countries and working across 15+ diverse locations. We take pride in our openness and inclusivity.

Continuous  Growth and Career Development: We invest in your growth with company-wide access to LinkedIn Learning and curated learning paths. From day one, you have the chance to contribute your ideas and create a meaningful impact. Our flat hierarchies and swift decision-making processes provide an open platform for your career progression.

Competitive Benefits Package: 

  • Annual compensation reviews to ensure you're rewarded fairly.

  • A remote office set-up bonus to enhance your workspace.

  • An employee assistance program, offering resources and counseling.

  • Plus, a perk that keeps giving: up to three free Jimdo websites for your personal or professional projects that you get to keep forever.

Jimdo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. This means that we don’t discriminate based on race or ethnic origin, color, the language(s) you speak, where you (or your parents) are from, or whether or not you consider yourself to have a disability. Neither will your age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, beliefs, or political opinions play a part in your application with us. Our diverse team values and celebrates the uniqueness of each individual. We embrace differences and believe that they enrich our organization, making us stronger and more innovative. Join us, and let's continue to create a workplace where everyone can thrive, regardless of background or identity.

title: Senior Projectmanager
descriptionHtml:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

title: Senior Quantum Applications Architect
descriptionHtml:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. 

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. 

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. 

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström. 

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. 

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real. 

Job Summary:

Within the Quantum Algorithms team, we develop and adapt quantum algorithms, identify and scope promising use cases, and analyze their resource requirements. In this role, you will translate computational tasks into abstract quantum-algorithm specifications, analyze their asymptotic performance, and define meaningful problem instances that lie beyond the practical reach of classical computation. You will also work closely with PsiQuantum’s Compilation team to develop explicit implementations of these algorithms and evaluate their resource requirements on our architecture. 

In this position, you will be expected not only to conduct outstanding individual research, but also to formulate and lead broader research programs that draw on the work of other researchers and collaborators. You will contribute to cross-team initiatives spanning PsiQuantum’s applications, architecture, and compilation efforts, helping to connect algorithm design with the practical requirements of fault-tolerant quantum computation. 

The role will also involve external collaboration. You will have the opportunity to lead projects with industrial and research partners, working with domain experts to identify important computational challenges, formulate them as well-defined problems, and map them to appropriate quantum algorithms. Success in this work requires the ability to communicate across disciplinary boundaries and to move fluently between real-world applications, mathematical abstractions, algorithmic complexity, and implementation-level resource analysis. 

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with scientific leadership, intellectual independence, and a collaborative mindset. They will be comfortable shaping open-ended research directions, assessing the practical significance of algorithmic advances, and guiding projects from the initial identification of an application through to a concrete fault-tolerant quantum algorithm and a detailed resource estimate. 

Responsibilities:

  • Propose initiatives into research and development of quantum algorithms tailored for fault-tolerant quantum computers; act as primary contributor to research programs beyond the current state of the art in quantum algorithms design.
  • Work closely with external partners to instantiate, validate and optimize quantum algorithms for use cases across a variety of domains, such as life sciences, industry and sustainability.
  • Establish families of benchmarks and problem instances to validate post-classicality of quantum algorithms.
  • Guide both the simulation and analysis of resource requirements for fault tolerant implementation of quantum algorithms in photonic quantum computing.

Experience/Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of research experience (academia or industry) in the field of quantum computing, with focus on algorithms and applications.  
  • A degree in Physics, Math or Computer Science or equivalent is required. PhD in Physics, Math or Computer Science, with a focus on quantum information theory or quantum computation will be preferred. 
  • Experience with quantum algorithms and compiling in the regime of fault tolerant gates preferred.
  • Experience working with partners in academia or industry to analyze real-world quantum applications of interest preferred.
  • Proven team player with an ability to work effectively across departments, sites and time zones.
  • Ability to work independently and contribute to fast-moving start-up environment.
  • Experience programming in Python, C++ or similar languages.
