title: Sr. Engineering Manager - Developer Ecosystem
descriptionHtml:
RDQ427R369

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business.

Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform.

The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers.

The impact you will have:

  • Lead and grow the team: Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Hire, coach and promote, and grow engineers into tech leads.
  • Make agentic development the default path: Shape how developers and AI agents author, validate and deploy projects, both inside the workspace and from the developer's own coding agent. Design the tools, skills and guardrails so agents get the same safety and auditability as humans.
  • Own the strategy and roadmap: Partner with Product and Design to set a multi-quarter roadmap for declarative deployment: agentic development, governed deployments and deployment history, enterprise CI/CD, and new resource coverage. Make the trade-offs explicit when the demand is larger than the team.
  • Raise the bar on execution and operational excellence: Run a predictable delivery process for a fast-moving, open-source product with frequent releases. Own reliability, on-call health, incident response and the quality bar for a tool customers depend on to ship to production.
  • Treat backward compatibility as a product feature: Lead engine and configuration migrations without forcing customers through a flag day, and communicate change clearly to customers, the community and field teams.
  • Lead across the platform: Drive alignment with the many platform teams whose resources and services the framework deploys, and with our sibling teams in Developer Ecosystem (SDKs, CLI, IaC provider, IDE). Make the whole toolchain feel like one product.

What we look for:

  • 5+ years managing software engineering teams, and 8+ years of software engineering experience overall.
  • A track record of building and shipping developer tools or platforms used by many external developers or internal teams, such as infrastructure-as-code, deployment or CI/CD systems, CLIs, SDKs, or internal developer platforms.
  • A deep understanding of declarative systems and deployment workflows: plan/apply, state management, drift and reconciliation, environment promotion, GitOps.
  • Enough technical depth to engage on architecture and trade-offs with senior and staff engineers, and to hold a high-quality bar for public, versioned interfaces.
  • Experience leading teams through ambiguity, with competing priorities from customers, partners and platform dependencies, and making clear calls.
  • Strong product sense and a customer-first mindset. You enjoy talking to developers, reading their issues, and turning feedback into roadmap.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including with executives, partner teams and an external developer community.

Stand-out experience:

  • Built or led teams on infrastructure-as-code or deployment platforms, e.g. Terraform, Pulumi, AWS CDK / CloudFormation, Kubernetes controllers, Argo CD / Flux / Helm, or Vercel / Netlify-style deploy platforms.
  • Managed an open-source developer tool with an active community and a frequent release cadence.
  • Shipped developer workflows for AI coding agents (CLI-first tooling, agent skills, MCP), or AI-assisted authoring.
  • Have managed managers or multiple teams (~15 to 20+ engineers), owned a multi-year platform strategy, and grown tech leads and managers.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

The Role

The Workflow Platform team builds Addepar's orchestration layer: a platform, on top of Temporal, that lets other Addepar teams turn long-running, multi-step business processes (approvals, data operations, reporting, client notifications) into reliable, observable, human-in-the-loop workflows. As part of the platform offering we own: Task Centre, where users act on the work workflows assign to them; the Executions view, where teams monitor and manage running workflows; and Client Notifications.

We're adding a senior full-stack engineer in Edinburgh. To begin with you'll mostly work on the user-facing side of the platform, and you'll also work on the services behind it. Our engineers work across the stack and in more than one language. Whichever side is newer to you, we'll give you real work there and the support to grow into it. You'll be given high-impact projects to lead end to end, such as a new Task Centre surface, the Executions view, or the components product teams use to build their own task types. You'll work closely with Product and Design to shape what we build, and with our Staff-level tech lead on how we build it, alongside colleagues in Pune and the US and the product teams building on the platform.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the design and delivery of a defined area of the platform end to end, from interface to API: write the design, break it into deliverable slices, ship it and support it in production.
  • Build user-facing features in React and TypeScript that make complex, long-running workflows clear and actionable for the people working in them.
  • Work on the services behind those experiences (Python and Java APIs and workflow workers), and shape API contracts so the front end and back end evolve together.
  • Make the platform easier for other teams to build on: reusable UI components and patterns, clear contracts, and documentation that lets them self-serve.
  • Spot gaps and opportunities in your area and act on them without waiting for direction.
  • Write RFCs for your area, present them at our weekly Architecture Working Group, and contribute to design reviews of others' work.
  • Share in running what we build: observability, debugging live issues, incident response and our on-call rotation.
  • Share what you know with less-experienced engineers through code review, pairing and design discussion.
  • Help the team use AI-assisted development effectively and responsibly.

Who You Are

  • Extensive software engineering experience, much of it building web front ends, with a track record of taking features from design to production.
  • Strong in TypeScript and a modern component framework (we use React), including state management, data fetching and testing UI code.
  • Has worked on the backend of products they've built (APIs, data models, services) in any language, and wants to do more of it.
  • Cares about usability and accessibility. Can turn a rough requirement into an interface people can use without a manual, with or without a finished design.
  • Designs UIs for systems that are slow, asynchronous or failing: loading, partial and error states, retries and stale data.
  • Makes and owns decisions in their area, including when established processes don't fully fit.
  • Finds and closes gaps in their area without waiting to be told.
  • Collaborates across teams without a manager driving alignment, and uses clear reasoning and evidence to influence decisions in their area.

Our Values 

  • Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
  • Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value. 
  • Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success. 
  • Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. 
  • Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset. 

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Staff Backend Engineer - Operations Tech Team
descriptionHtml:
Staff Backend Engineer - Operations Tech Team

Hybrid in London, UK

We’re looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join the Operations Tech team.

You’ll influence the technical direction of iwoca’s in-house CRM and build parts of it yourself – the system that hundreds of staff across sales, account management, credit, and collections use to give our customers five-star service.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Operations Tech team builds the tools iwoca’s UK operations teams use every day: the CRM, and the systems behind phone calls, emails, notifications, and task management. Those tools are a competitive advantage – they help colleagues manage risk and enable the outstanding customer service that sets iwoca apart.

The team works closely with the Operations Strategy team, which sets operational priorities and scopes much of the tooling. Many of its users work in the same building, and you’ll see how your changes affect the people you work with.

We’re growing the team to ten engineers (including this role), two of them tech leads, and two product owners. Most of its time goes on quarterly roadmap projects, alongside a support rota, and regular small feature improvements.

The role

As a staff backend engineer, you’ll take whole projects end to end: work out what operations teams need, design it, build it, and look after it in production. You’ll decide with the tech leads where the CRM’s service boundaries sit and how to model each domain’s data. You’ll judge your work by what it changes for those teams and their customers.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no line management, but you’ll mentor the engineers around you. You’ll often pair with a more junior engineer, share what you know, and set the standards the team works to through design discussions and code review.

You’ll learn how iwoca lends, from credit decisions to collections and financial crime. The team is adding AI to the CRM’s workflows, and you’ll have a say in where it helps.

Live project examples:

  • Migrating the monolith. Moving CRM functionality out of iwoca’s Django monolith into separate services, such as customer contact and phone calls, that deploy and scale on their own.

  • Building customer-facing AI agents to take the load off our teams as we grow, and the infrastructure to make them reliable and trustworthy

  • Improving our onboarding journey to so that there’s less manual work getting a customer their funds, for example using LLMs to speed up compliance checks

  • Credit card operations. Building the CRM services that let operations teams support customers on iwoca’s business credit card.

  • iwocaChat. Extending the Claude-powered assistant that answers operations staff questions about a customer, using data held across several systems.

The requirements

Essential:

  • System design. You’ve designed large production systems and the domain models at their core, and changed their architecture while people relied on them.

  • Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You’ve written and run backend services in it.

  • Technical leadership. You’ve led technical decisions across a team as an individual contributor, and helped other engineers grow through code reviews and design sessions.

  • Operational problems. You’ve worked with non-technical colleagues to understand a problem they had, and built the system that solved it.

  • AI leverage. You’ve built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Python stack. You’ve worked with Python, Django, Celery, and PostgreSQL.

  • Full-stack. You’ve contributed to frontend codebases, particularly in React or TypeScript.

  • Monolith migration. You’ve moved functionality out of a large monolith into separate services, while both stayed in production.

  • Asynchronous systems. You’ve built services that communicate through message queues such as RabbitMQ.

  • Contact systems. You’ve worked on telephony, email, or messaging systems, such as Twilio.

  • Models in production systems. You’ve built systems that use model outputs to make operational decisions, such as which work to prioritise.

The salary

We expect to pay from £100,000 to £130,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Staff Software Engineer (Onboard Services)
descriptionHtml:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

The Staff Software Engineer (Onboard Services) will design, build, and operate the software services that run on UFORCE’s uncrewed vehicles — spanning video streaming, telemetry, autonomy integration, vehicle control, health monitoring, navigation, and device integrations.

You will turn independently evolved services into one secure, testable, and maintainable onboard platform. This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on production Python services, service architecture, messaging, and reliable operation on constrained Linux hardware, including Raspberry Pi, x86, and NVIDIA Jetson.

You will also own the boundary between the vehicle and the backend: clear, versioned contracts with cloud services, deployment systems, video infrastructure, and operator interfaces that work over intermittent, low-bandwidth links. Working with backend, autonomy, hardware, QA, and field teams, you will make releases predictable and catch failures on the bench, not in the field.

What you’ll do

  • Define and evolve a unified onboard service architecture: service boundaries, messaging, configuration, startup ordering, readiness, watchdogs, and graceful degradation when dependencies or devices are unavailable.

  • Build and migrate production services to shared patterns, using reusable libraries and a reference service template covering project structure, packaging, logging, health reporting, and lifecycle management.

  • Standardise local service communication around NATS, with clear rules for integrating MAVLink, ZMQ IPC, and HTTP where appropriate.

  • Design stable, versioned vehicle-to-backend contracts for telemetry, commands and acknowledgements, video metadata and control, configuration, health, and logs.

  • Engineer for unreliable connectivity: buffering and store-and-forward, idempotent commands, explicit acknowledgements and timeouts, reconnection, back-off, and safe behaviour when the backend is unreachable.

  • Implement secure-by-default services: least-privilege identities and messaging permissions, mutually authenticated and encrypted backend links, secure credential provisioning and rotation, sandboxed runtimes, and audit events for safety-critical commands.

  • Strengthen automated testing across unit, contract, integration, simulation, and hardware-in-the-loop tests, with CI gates that catch regressions before release.

  • Build safer release workflows with signed packages, dependency scanning, bench smoke and soak tests, staged fleet rollouts, and reliable rollback.

  • Profile services and enforce practical CPU, memory, and latency budgets on target hardware.

  • Improve field diagnostics through structured logs, metrics, standardised health reporting, post-mission log capture, and actionable runbooks.

  • Document architectural decisions and service interfaces, communicate trade-offs clearly, and use AI coding tools to accelerate delivery without compromising quality.

What success looks like

  • Actively developed onboard services converge on a shared architecture, supported Python runtime, messaging model, and service template.

  • Engineers can take a new service from an empty repository to running on a bench vehicle in a day or less, with less duplicated infrastructure code.

  • Vehicle-to-backend contracts remain compatible as cloud and vehicle software evolve at different speeds, preventing integration failures in the field.

  • Authentication, least privilege, secret handling, runtime hardening, and supply-chain checks are consistently applied across the onboard stack.

  • Automated tests and bench validation catch defects before deployment, reducing issues discovered in the field.

  • Releases move predictably from bench validation to pilot vehicles and the wider fleet, with clear readiness gates and rollback procedures.

  • Services stay within resource budgets and remain diagnosable under hardware constraints and degraded connectivity.

  • Architecture documentation and runbooks help engineering, QA, and field teams integrate changes and resolve failures faster.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional experience in software engineering, delivering and operating production systems.

  • 2+ years as a Tech Lead or Staff Engineer, owning architecture across multiple services or teams and establishing standards adopted by others.

  • Expert Python — designs and ships production services (asyncio, packaging, testing, profiling, and performance); Node.js experience is a plus.

  • Distributed / edge system architecture — has designed service architectures and messaging systems (e.g., NATS, MQTT, ZMQ, Kafka) with versioned contracts across system boundaries and unreliable networks.

  • Web development and API experience — has built and evolved HTTP/WebSocket APIs and message-based integrations for multiple consumers.

  • Security architecture — has led the design of authentication and authorisation, secrets and key management, secure updates, and supply-chain controls; security reviews or certification evidence are a strong plus.

  • Quality engineering leadership — has established test strategies, CI gates, and staged release pipelines for a team or organisation; simulator or hardware-in-the-loop experience is a strong plus.

title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Privacy
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is working on frontier AI systems that handle sensitive information at enormous scale. How we protect that data, and how we build privacy into our systems rather than bolting it on afterward, is central to our mission of building AI that is safe and beneficial.

This is a foundational role. As one of our first dedicated privacy engineers, you will help establish the privacy engineering function at Anthropic and shape how privacy is designed into our AI systems from the ground up. You'll sit within our Data Infrastructure team, architecting privacy-preserving systems, leading the implementation of privacy-enhancing technologies across our infrastructure, and providing technical leadership on privacy across engineering, research, and product teams.

You'll work at the intersection of privacy engineering, AI safety, and distributed systems, solving problems that don't yet have established answers. This is a senior individual contributor role with high autonomy and broad influence.

Key responsibilities

  • Design and implement privacy-preserving architectures for AI training and inference systems operating at very large scale, using techniques e.g. differential privacy, federated learning, and secure multi-party computation

  • Partner with researchers to implement privacy-preserving training methods that protect user data while maintaining model quality

  • Build foundational privacy infrastructure, including automated data discovery, classification, access controls, audit logging, and lifecycle management

  • Translate regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, the EU AI Act) into technical implementations and automated compliance controls

  • Architect data governance systems for tracking data lineage, purpose limitation, and retention across distributed AI systems

  • Lead privacy reviews and threat modeling for new models and features, identifying risks and designing scalable mitigations

  • Partner with product and infrastructure teams to embed privacy controls into Claude's inference systems, user interfaces, and data pipelines

  • Develop privacy engineering toolkits and frameworks that enable other engineers to build privacy-preserving features by default

  • Design privacy-preserving analytics and measurement systems that surface useful insights without exposing individual user data

  • Evaluate emerging privacy technologies from academia and industry, and contribute to open-source tooling and AI privacy standards

  • Advise on and advocate for privacy practices as a core part of how we approach AI safety

Minimum qualifications

  • Experience applying privacy engineering principles in production systems, including privacy by design, data minimization, and purpose limitation

  • Proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages, with experience building and operating production systems at scale

  • Experience designing and implementing privacy infrastructure for systems with a large user base

  • Experience with data governance, classification, or data lifecycle management systems

  • Experience with distributed systems and cloud infrastructure at scale

  • Understanding of privacy regulations such as GDPR and CCPA, and the ability to translate legal requirements into technical designs

  • Experience conducting privacy reviews, threat modeling, or risk assessments

  • Written and verbal communication skills sufficient to build alignment across engineering, research, legal, and product teams

Preferred qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (e.g., differential privacy, homomorphic encryption, secure enclaves, secure multi-party computation)

  • Experience building privacy infrastructure or controls for machine learning or AI systems

  • Experience establishing a privacy engineering practice, or being an early hire in a function

  • Experience serving as a technical lead on complex, multi-quarter projects

  • Contributions to open-source privacy tooling, privacy research, or industry standards

  • 12+ years of experience in a software engineering role, including building and operating large-scale infrastructure

  • 3+ years of experience leading large, complex projects as a technical lead

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Runtime Systems
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You’ll Do:

The Physical AI Engineering Team at CoreWeave is building the software and infrastructure that enables demanding AI, simulation, robotics, and engineering workloads to run reliably at scale.

As these workloads become more complex, the challenge is no longer simply providing compute. We need to make heterogeneous workloads easier to execute, observe, reproduce, and move across different systems without hiding the capabilities or semantics of the infrastructure underneath them.

About the role:

We’re seeking a Staff Software Engineer, Runtime Systems to help design and build this layer.

This is a hands-on systems engineering role at the intersection of distributed systems, runtimes, workflow execution, programming language concepts, and large-scale compute infrastructure.

You’ll work on the foundations that allow complex workloads to move from an abstract description into reliable execution across systems such as Kubernetes, Argo, OSMO, and future execution environments.

A major part of the role is deciding where abstraction is useful — and where it creates more complexity. Rather than building another universal workflow engine, you’ll help establish clear contracts between our platform and the systems that execute work, while preserving native capabilities.

You’ll operate across architecture and implementation: defining contracts, writing production software, validating assumptions against real workloads, and working closely with platform and infrastructure teams.

In this role, you will:

  • Runtime Systems & Architecture
  • Design and build runtime components for complex AI, simulation, and engineering workloads.
  • Define abstractions for workloads, execution environments, dependencies, state, capabilities, and failure.
  • Design interfaces between higher-level services and systems such as Kubernetes, Argo, and OSMO.
  • Establish clear boundaries around which systems own state, decisions, and side effects.
  • Make architectural decisions balancing simplicity, extensibility, performance, and operational reality.
  • Execution Models & Contracts
  • Define durable contracts between workload definitions, control-plane services, and execution backends.
  • Develop typed representations and schemas that allow workloads to be transformed safely across systems.
  • Design compatibility and evolution mechanisms for those contracts.
  • Build conformance and validation mechanisms that make guarantees executable rather than dependent on documentation.
  • Reason deeply about retries, partial failure, idempotency, cancellation, dependencies, and uncertain outcomes.
  • Hands-On Systems Engineering
  • Write production-quality software for critical runtime and control-plane components.
  • Build adapters and integrations for heterogeneous execution environments.
  • Diagnose behaviour across application, orchestration, cluster, and infrastructure boundaries.
  • Improve the reliability, observability, and debuggability of distributed workload execution.
  • Work closely with Go, Kubernetes, and infrastructure engineers to turn architecture into production systems.
  • Performance & Experimentation
  • Develop rigorous ways to understand workload performance across large-scale GPU infrastructure.
  • Design experiments that separate real performance gains from noise, warm-up effects, scheduling behaviour, and stragglers.
  • Build repeatable workload and benchmark environments.
  • Use evidence from real execution to challenge assumptions and guide platform development.
  • Technical Leadership
  • Lead ambiguous systems problems where the correct architecture is not yet known.
  • Reduce complex problems into smaller contracts and mechanisms that can actually be implemented.
  • Challenge unnecessary abstraction and simplify designs where complexity has outgrown its value.
  • Influence technical direction across teams without requiring direct authority.
  • Mentor engineers and contribute to technical hiring and engineering standards.

Who You Are:

  • Significant experience building complex systems software, distributed infrastructure, runtimes, workflow systems, or adjacent technology.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of:
    • Distributed systems
    • Runtime systems
    • Workflow or execution engines
    • Programming languages, compilers, or interpreters
    • Cluster scheduling and orchestration
    • High-performance or systems software
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and production coding ability.
  • Experience designing APIs, protocols, schemas, or contracts between independently evolving systems.
  • Strong understanding of distributed-system failure modes, state, authority, retries, concurrency, and side effects.
  • Strong technical judgement around when abstraction helps and when it simply moves complexity elsewhere.
  • Comfortable entering unfamiliar technical domains and building depth quickly.
  • Strong communication skills and experience influencing architectural decisions across teams.

Experience with some of the following would be valuable, but is not required:

  • Go, Rust, C/C++, or Python.
  • Kubernetes and containerised infrastructure.
  • Argo, OSMO, Temporal, Ray, Kubeflow, or similar systems.
  • GPU clusters or large-scale AI infrastructure.
  • High-performance computing.
  • Simulation, robotics, autonomous systems, or Physical AI.
  • Programming language or compiler research.
  • Performance engineering.
  • Cloud infrastructure at scale.
  • Platforms designed to be operated by autonomous software or AI agents.

Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren’t a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team:

  • Systems Thinker: You ask where authority lives, what guarantees actually exist, and what happens when systems fail.
  • Technically Deep: You want to understand how systems really behave, not just how they are supposed to behave.
  • Pragmatic: You value elegant engineering, but care more about whether it works for real workloads.
  • Evidence-Driven: You test assumptions and change direction when the evidence says you should.
  • Strong Technical Leader: You can form a view, challenge senior stakeholders, and bring others with you.
  • Commercially Aware: You understand that technical decisions need to improve customer outcomes, engineering velocity, reliability, or economics.
  • Ownership Mentality: You take responsibility for getting difficult systems into production.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast. We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support entrepreneurial thinking, independent judgement, and collaboration. You’ll work alongside some of the best talent in the industry on technically difficult problems at the frontier of AI infrastructure.

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

  • Family-level Medical Insurance
  • Family-level Dental Insurance 
  • Generous Pension Contribution 
  • Life Assurance at 4x Salary 
  • Critical Illness Cover 
  • Employee Assistance Programme 
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Work culture focused on innovative disruption

Benefits may vary by location. 

Equal Opportunity 

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Recruitment Agencies

CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.

Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to export controlled information.  To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications

Such processing is legally permissible under Art. 6(1)(f) of (i) Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”) and (ii) the GDPR as it forms part of the laws of the UK (“UK GDPR”), as necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the Controller, which are the solicitation, evaluation, and selection of applicants for employment. With respect to transfers originating from the UK or the European Economic Area ("EEA") to a country outside the UK or the EEA, we implement the appropriate transfer mechanism(s) and other appropriate solutions to address cross-border transfers as required by applicable law. descriptionHtml:
Nous recherchons un.e stagiaire Assistant·e de coordination de projet événementiel pour le Séminaire international « Aides techniques et inclusion » (Dakar, juin 2027).

Contexte :

Titre de travail du séminaire : « Une offre de services de qualité en aides techniques : un pilier pour l’inclusion intersectorielle ».

Le séminaire vise à construire et partager une approche commune de HI et de ses partenaires sur l’offre de services de qualité en aides techniques (identification, orientation, évaluation, adaptation, information et conseil aux usagers et aux aidants). Il couvre la mobilité, la vision, l’audition et la communication, et s’adresse aux secteurs de la réadaptation, de l’éducation inclusive et des moyens de subsistance.

Il s’inscrit dans l’accord-cadre (AC) 2023–2027, qui appuie 16 pays : en Afrique (Sénégal, Burkina Faso, Éthiopie, Mali, Niger, Madagascar, RDC, Rwanda) et hors Afrique (Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Cambodge, Laos, Myanmar, Népal, Palestine, Haïti). L’invitation pourra être ouverte à d’autres pays disposant de leurs propres sources de financement.

Il est organisé en articulation avec AT EXPO AFRICA 2027, premier dialogue international dédié à l’innovation, à la production et à l’accès aux aides techniques en Afrique, qui se tiendra sur le même site les 3–5 juin 2027 (Journée mondiale des aides techniques le 4 juin). Dates, agenda et logistique des deux événements sont à coordonner.

Cadre du stage :

Le stage se déroulera à Lyon, avec un déplacement à Dakar (Sénégal). Vous êtes intégré à l'équipe de la Direction Réadaptation, composée de 12 personnes, incluant des spécialistes thématiques (dont 1 manager), des spécialistes de la réadaptation en urgence (dont 1 manager), une unité de reconditionnement de composants (avec 1 chef d’atelier), un adjoint à la direction et 1 assistante.

Vos principaux interlocuteurs seront :

• Le point focal en charge du contenu et de l’animation du séminaire (binôme de travail au quotidien)

• Les points focaux de HI Luxembourg et de HI Sénégal (logistique, finances, sécurité)

• Le point focal de la Division Résilience & Inclusion (éducation inclusive, moyens de subsistance)

• Les points focaux des pays de l’accord-cadre et le point focal de AT EXPO AFRICA 2027

• Les services communication, achats et finances de HI

Vos missions principales :

Une phase d’intégration est prévue en début de stage : procédures HI, règles de sécurité, code de conduite et politiques de protection.

Axe 1 – Coordination et pilotage opérationnel

• Participer à la réunion de cadrage avec la tutrice, le point focal contenu et animation et les autres points focaux ; clarifier les rôles et les circuits de validation

• Reprendre et tenir à jour le rétroplanning et le plan d’action ; identifier les moyens nécessaires (budget, transport, salles, documentation, outils de présentation…)

• Assurer le secrétariat du comité d’organisation : préparation des réunions, comptes rendus, suivi des décisions

• Tenir un tableau de bord partagé (avancement, risques, points de blocage) et alerter rapidement la tutrice en cas de difficulté

Axe 2 – Participants et parties prenantes

• Consolider la liste des participants (pays de l’AC, secteurs, partenaires, intervenants externes) à partir des premiers échanges déjà tenus avec les points focaux pays

• Préparer et envoyer les invitations et lettres d’invitation pour les visas ; gérer les inscriptions

• Mettre en place et tenir l’outil de suivi des participants (vols, visas, hébergement, contacts, besoins spécifiques), dans le respect de la protection des données personnelles

• Recenser les besoins d’accessibilité et organiser les aménagements raisonnables (accès des lieux, formats accessibles, accompagnants, interprétation)

• Recueillir les attentes des participants en amont ; concevoir, administrer et analyser l’évaluation du séminaire

Axe 3 – Logistique et achats

En lien étroit avec les points focaux de HI Luxembourg et les équipes logistiques de HI Sénégal :

• Finaliser le choix du lieu (déjà en discussion avec AT EXPO AFRICA 2027 et HI Sénégal), réserver les salles et l’hébergement ; négocier les tarifs et préparer avec le lieu tous les arrangements nécessaires

• Organiser les déplacements : billets d’avion des participants et intervenants, visas, transferts aéroport, transport local

• Organiser l’interprétation et les équipements techniques (sonorisation, connexion pour d’éventuels participants à distance)

• Sélectionner et suivre les fournisseurs selon les procédures d’achat HI ; commander le matériel, les impressions et les supports

• Préparer la logistique de la visite de terrain et des temps communs avec AT EXPO AFRICA 2027

• Pendant le séminaire : faire un point quotidien avec l’équipe d’organisation et le lieu, gérer les imprévus et remonter les problèmes

Axe 4 – Suivi budgétaire et administratif

• Contribuer au budget prévisionnel détaillé ; suivre les engagements et les dépenses au regard du budget et des codes d’imputation

• Gérer les per diem, avances et remboursements des participants ; collecter les justificatifs

• Après le séminaire : clôturer les paiements fournisseurs, préparer les éléments financiers du rapport bailleur et transmettre les dossiers en cours

Axe 5 – Contenu, documentation et capitalisation

En appui au point focal en charge du contenu et de l’animation du séminaire :

• Contribuer à l’élaboration de l’agenda avec les parties prenantes et AT EXPO AFRICA 2027 (consolidation, gestion des versions, traductions)

• Appuyer les intervenants et facilitateurs dans la préparation des outils d’animation, des présentations et du matériel

• Produire le kit participant : agenda final, note logistique, informations pratiques sur Dakar, santé et sécurité, per diem, contacts

• Prendre des notes pendant les sessions et centraliser les ressources (présentations, documents) sur un espace partagé

• Rédiger le rapport du séminaire (plus spécifiquement le rapport au bailleur) avec le comité d’organisation ; contribuer à la compilation des outils et approches pour la note d’orientation

Axe 6 – Communication

• Interne : informer les équipes via les canaux HI (Hinside, Teams, réseaux métiers)

• Externe : rédiger et/ou traduire en anglais des articles et publications (LinkedIn Rehabilitation), en lien avec le service communication et AT EXPO AFRICA 2027, en respectant les règles de visibilité du bailleur

• Assurer le lien avec les intervenants externes (experts, chercheurs, partenaires)

title: Stage : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi- flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM)
descriptionHtml:
Projet porté par : Marwa Trabelsi - IMT Mines Albi Centre Génie Industriel (CGI)

Partenaires IMT impliqués :

  • Telecom Sud Paris, Département Electronique et Physique, Laboratoire Services répartis, Architectures,

Modélisation, Validation, Administration des Réseaux (SAMOVAR): Nel Samama

  • Mines Saint-Etienne : Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS), Marius Huguet

Sujet proposé (5-6 mois à partir de Février):

Acronyme : HOPAL : Hospital Process Automatic Learning

Titre long : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi-flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM)

Description du projet :

L’étude du processus de prise en charge aux urgences est essentielle pour comprendre et résoudre le problème croissant de surcharge, qui touche de nombreux pays. Cette surcharge, souvent liée à un déséquilibre entre la demande de soins et les ressources disponibles, a des conséquences graves : retards de traitement, allongement des temps de triage, et même une augmentation de la mortalité. Elle révèle aussi des défis systémiques, comme l’accès difficile aux soins primaires, qui poussent les patients vers les urgences.

Optimiser l’utilisation des ressources humaines et matérielles permet non seulement de réduire les files d’attente, mais aussi d’améliorer la qualité des soins et l’efficacité globale du système. Enfin, analyser ces processus aide à identifier des solutions durables, comme une meilleure organisation ou une réallocation ciblée des moyens.

Ces processus laissent des traces numériques dans le système d'information hospitalier (SIH), mais leur modélisation reste aujourd'hui largement manuelle, coûteuse et rapidement obsolète.

Le process mining permet de découvrir des modèles de processus à partir de ces traces. Les techniques classiques de découverte atteignent toutefois leurs limites face à des logs hétérogènes, bruités et multi-flux.

Les grands modèles de langage (LLM) ouvrent une voie nouvelle : générer automatiquement des modèles de processus (BPMN, graphes de processus) directement à partir de traces organisationnelles, sans intervention humaine, et en produire une lecture compréhensible par les acteurs de terrain.

Par ailleurs, des travaux menés au CGI ont démontré la faisabilité de la prédiction de parcours patients par LLM. La question scientifique au cœur de ce stage est l'articulation de ces deux briques : comment relier la prédiction de parcours à la construction automatique de modèles, pour passer de modèles rétrospectifs (ce qui s'est passé) à des modèles prospectifs (ce qui va se passer) ?

Ce projet s’inscrit dans une dynamique inter-écoles IMT autour de l’IA explicable pour la santé publique. Les équipes CGI, CIS et SAMOVAR collaborent déjà via le projet TRACKING (Carnot M.I.N.E.S – CARINGS), avec des travaux sur la géolocalisation indoor au sein des urgences de l’Hôpital Le Corbusier de Firminy. Cette synergie s’est prolongée par un stage M2 en 2025, financé par le Fonds d’amorçage Santé, dédié au prototypage d’une application mobile de localisation indoor/outdoor des patients. Une thèse INTERCARNOT a été lancé dans la continuité avec la validation des deux instituts Carnot (M.I.N.E.S et TSN) et va démarrer en Octobre 2026.

Objectif du stage

L'objectif est de concevoir et prototyper un pipeline dans lequel un même module de construction automatique de modèles par LLM est alimenté par deux sources :

  • Branche A (rétrospective) : les logs SIH réels, normalisés en event logs, produisent des modèles as-is des processus observés ;

  • Branche B (prospective) : dans la suite des travaux réalisés, les parcours prédits par LLM sont sérialisés au même format de traces (activité, timestamp, ressource) via un adaptateur, et produisent des modèles to-be des processus à venir.

La comparaison des modèles as-is et to-be permet la détection d'écarts, l'anticipation des goulots d'étranglement et le support à la décision explicable, jusqu'à la simulation contrefactuelle (perturber les prédictions, reconstruire le modèle, observer l'impact).

Profil recherché

  • Formation : M2 ou dernière année d'école d'ingénieur en informatique, science des données, IA ou génie industriel ;

  • Compétences techniques : Python indispensable ; une expérience des LLM (fine-tuning, prompting, API)

  • et/ou du process mining (pm4py) est un atout fort ;

  • Qualités : rigueur scientifique, autonomie, goût pour le travail avec des données réelles imparfaites, intérêt pour le domaine hospitalier.

Références

Huguet M, Pehlivan C, Ballereau F, Dodane-Loyenet A, Fontanili F, Garaix T, Yordanov Y, Augusto V, Tazarourte K, Redjaline A. Indoor positioning systems provide insight into emergency department systems enabling proposal of designs to improve workflow. Commun Med (Lond). 2025 Mar 11;5(1):72.

Ayed SB, Layeb SB, Huguet M, Fontanili F, Samama N. Developing a Mobile Application and Dashboard for Proactive Management of Patient No- Shows via Geolocation and Dynamic Scheduling. In: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Advanced Healthcare Systems (ICAHS). IEEE; 2025 Dec. p. 1-5.

Trabelsi M, et al. TRACE4PM: Trace Related Analysis and Clustering for Process Modeling of Users Interactions in IS. In: RCIS 2025. Springer; 2025.

Rebmann A, et al. Evaluating the Ability of LLMs to Solve Semantics-Aware PM Tasks. In: ICPM 2024. IEEE; 2024.

Kourani H, Berti A, Schuster D, van der Aalst WMP. Process Modeling with Large Language Models. In: BPMDS/EMMSAD@CAiSE 2024. 2024. p. 229- 244.

title: Stage Consumentengedrag
descriptionHtml:
Waarom pak je in de supermarkt het ene product wel uit het schap en het andere niet? Ligt het aan de verpakking? De prijs? Smaak? Gemak? Of simpelweg omdat het precies op de juiste plek staat?

Bij Growy telen we verse sla, kruiden en microgreens in Amsterdam in onze vertical farm. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten.
Nu onze producten in steeds meer Nederlandse supermarkten te vinden zijn, willen we onze consumenten nóg beter leren begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen.

En nee, dit wordt geen stageproject wat ergens in een lade verdwijnt en niemand ooit nog bekijkt, jouw stage gaat voor ons echt een verschil maken!

🌱Wat ga je doen?

Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat meer consumenten Growy ontdekken, proberen én opnieuw kopen?

Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld:

  • consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren;

  • onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden;

  • ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen;

  • onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop;

  • kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid;

  • kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen;

  • jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen.

Aan het einde van je stage presenteer je jouw belangrijkste inzichten en aanbevelingen aan ons Sales & Marketing team. En als het binnen je stage past, kun je misschien zelfs één van je ideeën in de praktijk testen.

De precieze inhoud stemmen we af op de duur van je stage en de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding.

Goed om te weten; onze farm is nog volop in ontwikkeling, we zitten nog in onze start-up/scale-up fase. Dit betekent dat je naast je onderzoek ook tijd zult besteden aan andere zaken in onze farm. Dit geldt niet alleen voor jou als stagiair maar voor ons hele team. Zo draait iedereen uit kantoor maandelijks een shift in de farm, waarbij we helpen met zaaien, oogsten of verpakken.

🌱Wat kun je van ons verwachten?

  • Een unieke stageplek; wij bouwen aan de toekomst van voedselproductie;

  • Je wordt onderdeel van een klein team, er wordt naar je ideëen en input geluisterd;

  • We werken fulltime vanaf onze farm in Amsterdam;

  • Een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van 500 euro, we vergoeden geen andere zaken;

  • Veel ruimte en tijd voor creativiteit en een ‘ga het maar proberen!' mentaliteit

  • Een gezellige werksfeer waarin we graag samen na werk nog leuke dingen ondernemen


🌱Wat breng jij?

  • Je volgt een HBO of WO opleiding in Nederland en staat daar ingeschreven gedurende de hele stage periode. Qua studies denken wij in de richting marketing, bedrijfskunde of (commerciële) psychologie, maar wie weet volg jij een andere studie die ook goed aansluit 🙂

  • Fulltime beschikbaar voor 4 of 5 maanden, startdatum december 2026 of januari of februari 2027

  • Je hebt je rijbewijs B; je zult veel op pad zijn om supermarkten te bezoeken

  • Een flinke portie nieuwsgierigheid

  • Je bent sociaal; je stapt makkelijk op mensen af en maakt een praatje met ze

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt je ook goed redden in het Engels

  • Je bent een zelf-starter; we zullen je uiteraard begeleiden tijdens je stage, maar het initiatief voor de invulling en aanpak ligt bij jou

title: Stage Marketing Associate - Growth & Events
descriptionHtml:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

⚡ Notre équipe Marketing

Chez Lifen, nous travaillons à mieux faire circuler les données de santé pour faciliter le travail des professionnels et améliorer la coordination des soins. Cela passe aussi par notre capacité à faire connaître nos solutions aux bons interlocuteurs.

Ce stage rejoint l’équipe Marketing pour renforcer ses actions de visibilité, d’acquisition et de génération de demandes pour les équipes commerciales. Le poste couvre aussi une dimension événementielle : webinaires, salons et autres rendez-vous qui permettent de rencontrer nos audiences et de faire avancer les projets marketing.

Tu interviendras sur des sujets variés, avec un périmètre à construire avec ta manager. L’objectif : faire avancer des actions concrètes, mesurer leurs résultats et proposer les prochaines étapes.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

  • Faire évoluer le site pour améliorer sa visibilité, son trafic et la conversion des visiteurs en demandes de rendez-vous.

  • Identifier des opportunités marketing : requêtes sur lesquelles Lifen pourrait mieux se positionner, parcours à optimiser, contenus, campagnes ou partenariats à tester.

  • Mettre en place et suivre des actions d’acquisition et de génération de leads : séquences email, campagnes, retargeting, partenariats ou activation de la base existante, selon les priorités.

  • Appuyer l’organisation de webinaires, salons et autres événements : recherche de lieux, coordination opérationnelle, préparation des éléments nécessaires et suivi des actions associées.

  • Analyser le comportement des visiteurs et les résultats des actions menées pour comprendre ce qui fonctionne, ce qui bloque et quoi tester ensuite.

  • Transformer tes analyses en recommandations concrètes, puis les faire avancer avec l’équipe Marketing et les équipes commerciales.

À la fin du stage, tu auras contribué à construire un pipe marketing pour une équipe commerciale, à générer du trafic, à optimiser la conversion et à organiser des actions événementielles.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

  • Tu recherches un stage de fin d’études de 6 mois dans le cadre d’un M2.

  • Tu as déjà acquis des bases en marketing, idéalement sur des sujets d’acquisition, de CRM, d’email marketing ou d’événementiel.

  • Une première expérience, un projet personnel ou un travail mené dans le cadre de tes études montre que tu as déjà travaillé sur des sujets marketing.

  • Face à un problème, tu sais chercher, comprendre le contexte, formuler une approche et aller jusqu’à une proposition concrète.

  • Tu as envie de travailler sur des sujets variés, avec de l’autonomie et de la prise d’initiative.

Nice-to-have

  • Des connaissances en référencement, web performance ou acquisition payante.

  • Une première pratique du scraping.

  • Une expérience, même ponctuelle, dans l’organisation de webinaires, de salons ou d’autres événements.

  • L’habitude d’utiliser l’intelligence artificielle pour avancer dans ton travail, tout en restant capable d’expliquer et de challenger ce que tu produis.

Soft skills

Tu es curieux·se, organisé·e et tu apprends vite. Tu ne te contentes pas d’exécuter une demande telle quelle : tu cherches à comprendre le problème, tu vas chercher les informations qui te manquent et tu proposes des pistes utiles. Tu sais tenir un sujet opérationnel dans la durée, coordonner les interlocuteurs concernés et demander de l’aide quand c’est nécessaire. Le diplôme ou l’école ne feront pas la différence : ce qui compte, c’est ce que tu as déjà appris, ce que tu veux comprendre et le soin que tu mets dans ton travail.

Nos valeurs

  • Embrace Complexity : tu sais découper un sujet large, tester des pistes et relier les résultats aux enjeux marketing et commerciaux.

  • Bienveillance : tu échanges simplement avec tes interlocuteurs, tu écoutes les retours et tu construis avec eux.

  • Real Impact : tes actions doivent aider à accroître la visibilité de Lifen, générer du trafic qualifié et créer des occasions de rencontre avec nos audiences.

👥 Process de recrutement

Le process est volontairement court :

  1. Entretien initial - 30 minutes
    Avec Pauline, ta future manager. L’objectif est de comprendre ton parcours, ton intérêt pour le stage, tes premières expériences ou projets marketing, ainsi que ta manière d’aborder un problème.

  2. Use case préparé en amont, puis présentation live - 60 min
    Tu recevras un cas à préparer avant l’échange. Tu présenteras ensuite ton raisonnement, les informations que tu es allé·e chercher et les actions que tu proposes. Nous évaluerons surtout ta curiosité, ton autonomie, ta compréhension des enjeux marketing et ta capacité à faire des choix.

Nous partageons un retour sous 48 heures ouvrées après chaque étape et prenons la décision finale sous deux jours ouvrés après le dernier entretien.

Compensation: €1K – €1.2K per month

title: stagiair(e) Advies & Onderzoek – Arbeidsmarkt en Strategisch HRM
descriptionHtml:
0,8- 1fte per week | Utrecht | Hybride | Transformaties van organisaties| € 600,- | Wo-master

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat mensen en organisaties klaar zijn voor de arbeidsmarkt van morgen? Hoe kunnen we talent beter benutten, ontwikkeling stimuleren en organisaties helpen om toekomstbestendig te blijven?

Bij Berenschot krijg je de kans om als stagiair mee te werken aan actuele arbeidsmarkt- en HR-vraagstukken. Je maakt kennis met het adviesvak, werkt samen met ervaren adviseurs en ontdekt hoe je wetenschappelijke inzichten vertaalt naar oplossingen die in de praktijk het verschil maken.

Je werkt op het snijvlak van arbeidsmarkt, human capital, strategisch HRM, skills, leren en ontwikkelen en organisatieverandering.

Dit ga je doen

Tijdens je stage draai je mee in verschillende advies- en onderzoeksprojecten. Je helpt bij het onderzoeken van complexe vraagstukken, het verzamelen en analyseren van informatie en het ontwikkelen van adviezen, programma's en instrumenten.

Je werkzaamheden kunnen onder andere bestaan uit:

  • Uitvoeren van literatuuronderzoek, interviews en kwalitatieve of kwantitatieve analyses.

  • Ondersteunen bij adviestrajecten voor werkgevers, overheden en brancheorganisaties.

  • Voorbereiden en uitwerken van gesprekken, workshops en werksessies.

  • Meedenken over nieuwe methodieken, instrumenten en oplossingen.

  • Ondersteuning bij het vertalen van onderzoeksresultaten naar heldere rapportages, presentaties en adviezen.

  • Bijdragen aan publicaties over actuele arbeidsmarkt- en HR-thema's.

Je kunt bijvoorbeeld werken aan vraagstukken rondom arbeidsmarktkrapte, strategische personeelsplanning, skillsgericht werken, talentontwikkeling, leren en ontwikkelen, duurzame inzetbaarheid of regionale samenwerking op de arbeidsmarkt.

Afhankelijk van je interesses en de mogelijkheden binnen onze projecten krijg je ruimte voor een eigen onderzoeks- of ontwikkelopdracht. Ook is het mogelijk om je stageperiode te combineren met het schrijven van je scriptie.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je komt terecht in de adviesgroep Transformaties van Organisaties, waar we organisaties helpen bij complexe verander- en ontwikkelvraagstukken. We werken op het snijvlak van strategie, organisatie-inrichting, leiderschap, cultuur en mensontwikkeling. Daarbinnen maak je onderdeel uit van het Arbeidsmarkt & Mensen. Samen werken we aan vraagstukken rondom HR-transformaties, goed werkgeverschap, arbeidsmarkt, talentontwikkeling en de toekomst van werk. Wat ons verbindt, is de overtuiging dat organisaties pas echt succesvol kunnen zijn wanneer mensen kunnen groeien, samenwerken en het beste uit zichzelf halen. Vanuit die overtuiging combineren we inhoudelijke expertise met een resultaatgerichte en praktische aanpak, waarbij kennisdeling, samenwerking en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan.


Dit neem je mee

Je bent een nieuwsgierige WO-masterstudent met interesse in arbeidsmarkt-, organisatie- en HR-vraagstukken. Je vindt het leuk om maatschappelijke thema's te onderzoeken en wilt ontdekken hoe het adviesvak in de praktijk werkt.

Daarnaast:

  • je volgt een universitaire masteropleiding, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van bestuurskunde, organisatiekunde, psychologie, sociologie, HRM, Strategic HRM, Business Administration (Management Consulting), economie, onderwijskunde of een vergelijkbare studie.

  • je bent analytisch sterk en weet informatie kritisch te beoordelen, waarbij je ook effectief gebruikmaakt van hulpmiddelen zoals AI.

  • je neemt initiatief, werkt zelfstandig en pakt nieuwe vraagstukken met enthousiasme op.

  • je communiceert helder, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • Je bent gedurende je stage ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en ons in te zetten voor maatschappelijke thema’s. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei. Daarnaast bieden we:

  • Een stagevergoeding van € 600,- bruto per maand op basis van fulltime.

  • flexibele werkmogelijkheden, ook thuis

  • begeleiding door twee adviseurs op het gebied van strategie en operations

  • een stimulerende en leerzame werkomgeving waarin ruimte is voor eigen inbreng

  • de mogelijkheid om een netwerk op te bouwen binnen Berenschot en met bedrijven

  • Een laptop.

  • Veel stagiairs zijn na hun stage aan een traineeship bij Berenschot begonnen – bij goed presteren biedt deze stage uitstekende kansen voor jouw carrière.

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het Stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma . Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Solliciteer meteen

Spreekt deze stage je aan? Wacht niet langer en solliciteer! Neem contact op met Oumnia Makrani via WhatsApp (06 13 33 87 70) of per e-mail () voor informatie over de procedure. Oumnia is op vrijdag bereikbaar. Heb je een dringende vraag? Mail dan naar .

Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Heb je gesolliciteerd? Dan ontvang je binnen één werkweek een reactie. Is die positief? Dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een kennismaking. Zijn we na dit gesprek allebei enthousiast? Dan volgt een gesprek met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Dat is het moment om jouw laatste vragen te stellen. Blijkt daaruit dat jij een echte Berenschotter bent? Dan gaan we snel over tot een concreet aanbod. Hierna ben je een echte Berenschotter en heten we je graag welkom in ons team.

title: Stagiair(e) Flair – Redactie (november/december 2026)
descriptionHtml:
Amsterdam - Flair is de plek voor de jonge vrouw (25-45 jaar) die alles uit het leven en zichzelf wil halen. We maken verhalen die inspireren, verrassen en vrouwen helpt zelfbewuster in het leven te staan. We zijn altijd op zoek naar frisse ideeën, een scherpe pen en dito social-skills. Als stagiair bij Flair haal je geen koffie: je bent een volwaardig onderdeel van ons team. Je bedenkt, schrijft en post op de site en de socials.

Wat ga je doen?

Geen dag is hetzelfde (en we love it). Je gaat onder andere:

  • Zelf onderwerpen bedenken die aansluiten bij de doelgroep, ideeën pitchen bij collega’s, interviews uitzetten en artikelen schrijven.

  • Meedenken over en meewerken aan social formats: van Instagram reels tot TikToks, van idee tot uitwerking en publicatie. Jij weet wat de doelgroep wil zien.

  • Reageren op en communiceren met onze volgers, sparren over hoe we onze community nog leuker kunnen maken en analyseren wat werkt (en wat niet).

  • Je brainstormt mee tijdens redactievergaderingen, helpt met de contentplanning en het doorvertalen van verhalen uit het blad naar online.

  • En als je wil: af en toe naar events, video’s maken of een eigen rubriek opzetten. Alles kan, zolang jij er energie van krijgt.

Wie zoeken wij?

Jij snapt de Flair-vrouw (en misschien ben je haar wel een beetje). Je hebt gevoel voor taal, humor, weet wat er speelt en hebt veel zin om aan de slag te gaan. Verder:

  • Je bent HBO- of WO-student in bijvoorbeeld Journalistiek, Communicatie, Media & Cultuur of een vergelijkbare opleiding.

  • Je hebt een lekkere pen, met oog voor tone of voice en doelgroep.

  • Je barst van de ideeën en bent niet bang om ze te delen.

  • Je leeft op Insta en TikTok, praat in memes.

  • Je bent nauwkeurig, proactief en maakt online tools snel eigen (CMS, social dashboards).

  • Ervaring op een soortgelijke redactie is een pré (maar geen must).

  • Je bent beschikbaar vanaf november/december voor minimaal 4 – 5 dagen per week voor de duur van je stageperiode.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een afwisselende stage vanaf november/december 2026, waar je werkelijk meedraait in zowel redactie als social media.

  • Begeleiding van ervaren (eind)redacteuren en social-specialisten.

  • Alle ruimte voor jouw ideeën: we houden van initiatief en creativiteit.

  • Een gezellig team dat hard werkt, veel lacht en dol is op borrels.

Stuur ons via de button op de website een motivatiebrief met je cv, waarin je ons laat weten waarom deze stage perfect bij jou past.

title: STORE MANAGER
descriptionHtml:
