title: Strategic account executive (UK)
descriptionHtml:
🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com.

📐 About the role

Join WRITER's sales team as a strategic account executive and help shape the future of work. You'll empower global enterprises (8,000+ employees) to transform their operations through our cutting-edge AI agent platform, enabling organizations to deploy AI at scale and unlock unprecedented productivity. This isn't just about hitting quota – it's about becoming a trusted advisor to some of the world's most influential companies as they navigate their AI transformation journey.

This role is perfect for high performers who thrive in fast-paced, intellectually stimulating environments where you have the autonomy to drive results and build lasting relationships with both clients and teammates. If you're energized by meaningful work, the opportunity to make a real impact, and the challenge of selling category-defining technology, we want to hear from you. You'll be selling solutions that fundamentally change how enterprises operate, working with executive buyers who are making multi-million dollar, multi-year commitments to AI transformation.

This is a hybrid role based out of our London hub. You'll be reporting to our regional vice president.

🦸🏻‍♀️ What you’ll do

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle from prospecting through close, managing complex deals with 8-18 month sales cycles and navigating multi-stakeholder buying committees across procurement, legal, IT, and business units

  • Drive net-new revenue by identifying, qualifying, and developing strategic opportunities within target verticals and named account lists, consistently building a robust pipeline that exceeds coverage targets

  • Engage C-level executives and senior decision-makers in consultative discovery to understand their business priorities, uncover transformational use cases, and position WRITER as the strategic platform to achieve their AI vision

  • Partner cross-functionally with solutions engineering, product, and customer success teams to architect tailored solutions, run successful pilots, and ensure seamless deployments that deliver measurable business outcomes

  • Lead complex negotiations involving multi-year contracts, custom pricing structures, and enterprise terms, while maintaining deal momentum and driving consensus across diverse stakeholder groups

  • Become a trusted product expert who educates prospects on how to set up and leverage WRITER's AI agent platform, going hands-on during critical evaluation phases to demonstrate value and accelerate time-to-deployment

  • Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene and forecasting accuracy, consistently delivering predictable revenue results while providing leadership with transparent visibility into deal progression and risk factors

⭐️ What you need

  • 7-10+ years of quota-carrying strategic SaaS sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding annual quotas in complex, value-based sales motions targeting Fortune 500 and Global 2000 accounts

  • Demonstrated expertise in managing sophisticated enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders, navigating procurement processes, and orchestrating cross-functional resources to drive deals through technical evaluations and executive approvals

  • Executive presence and communication skills that allow you to credibly engage with C-suite buyers (CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, COOs), translate complex technical concepts into business value, and build authentic relationships based on trust and strategic insight

  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to conduct discovery that uncovers underlying business challenges, connects AI capabilities to measurable outcomes, and creates urgency around transformation initiatives

  • Experience in outbound prospecting, account mapping, and territory planning, with a hunter mentality that drives you to consistently create new opportunities rather than waiting for inbound leads

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for ownership – you thrive in fast-paced environments where you're expected to figure things out, make decisions with incomplete information, and drive your own success with minimal oversight

  • Deep alignment with WRITER's values: you naturally Connect across functions and build collaborative relationships, you Challenge the status quo and aren't afraid to have difficult conversations, and you Own your outcomes with accountability and a commitment to long-term impact

title: Strategic Account Manager, Firefox Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

Firefox Enterprise is a new team within Mozilla that is addressing the needs of business and government customers for a secure enterprise browser that gives organizations greater control over their data, policies, and digital infrastructure. We’re now seeking a Strategic Account Manager, Firefox Enterprise to help grow Firefox Enterprise in France.   1. Collaboration: Foster unprecedented levels of data collaboration across WPP and partners through WPP Open, turning every channel into a smarter opportunity.

We empower ambitious experts to deliver extraordinary work by challenging ordinary thinking. If you are passionate about an AI-driven future, thrive in a collaborative and data-centric environment, and are driven to deliver unparalleled growth, we invite you to be part of our transformative journey.

Role Summary and Impact
The Senior Vice President (SVP) is a critical, impactful leader within WPP Media, demanding deep expertise and strong leadership. They will relentlessly optimise and innovate, translating high-level strategy into actionable plans, ensuring operational excellence and robust performance. This role involves leading a large department, executing strategic initiatives whilst tackling complex problems within defined strategic boundaries. Ultimately, their strong performance and impactful decisions directly contribute to critical functional goals, supporting our objectives and competitive advantage.

Role Summary and Impact

  • This role is for Data Science across Global Clients. Provide expert oversight across statistical modelling, econometrics, machine learning, AI, forecasting, optimisation, attribution, propensity modelling and experimentation, ensuring methodologies are robust, explainable, reproducible and appropriate to the business problem.
  • Team Leadership, Technical Mentoring & Capability Building: Lead, mentor and develop the Data Science team, with particular emphasis on technical coaching and craft excellence. Create an environment in which data scientists can challenge methods, learn from each other, deepen their technical expertise and progress their careers. Establish and champion best practices for code, model validation, documentation, QA, version control and model governance.
  • Data Science Product & Service Portfolio Leadership: Own the technical stewardship and ongoing evolution of the Data Science CoE/Hub portfolio within the Analytics & Data Science Menu of Services. This includes Propensity Modelling, ML driven econometrics, MTA approaches, and other advanced measurement, attribution, forecasting & simulation solutions. Ensure solutions remain differentiated, scalable, operationally sound and connected to client needs.
  • Innovation & Solution Development: Partner with the Head of CoE, DTA leaders and adjacent product, data, technology and consulting teams to identify high-value opportunities for new Data Science solutions. Translate emerging techniques in AI, machine learning, econometrics and optimisation into practical, repeatable offerings that can be piloted, proven and scaled across clients.
  • Technical Assurance & Delivery Excellence: Provide senior technical review and challenge on complex projects, from problem framing and data requirements through modelling, validation, deployment and interpretation. Establish consistent development and QA standards so that solutions are accurate, transparent, maintainable and fit for scaled client delivery.
  • Cross-Functional DTA Partnership: Act as the senior Data Science partner across the wider DTA organisation, helping Data Strategy, Client Analytics, DTA Leads, Client Enablement and technology partners understand where Data Science can create differentiated value. Bring technical expertise into complex client opportunities and connect specialist teams around the right solution.
  • Client & Commercial Leadership: Serve as a senior technical advisor on priority client engagements and pitches, translating complex modelling and AI approaches into clear business value. Support solution scoping, resourcing and commercialisation of Data Science projects and managed services, balancing technical ambition with delivery feasibility and client impact.
  • Thought Leadership & Community: Build a strong Data Science craft community across the CoE, Global Client Teams & partner global hubs, sharing reusable methods, code, learning and case studies. Stay current with developments in statistical science, machine learning, AI, marketing effectiveness and media technology, and turn relevant advances into practical improvements to our people, products and client solutions.

Skills and Experience

  • Senior Data Science Leadership: Significant experience leading Data Science teams, with a track record of building strong technical capability, developing senior talent and setting a clear technical vision in a complex, matrixed organisation. Experience in the media advanced analytics space desirable.
  • Deep Technical Expertise: Expert-level understanding of statistical modelling, machine learning, AI and predictive analytics, with the depth to review, challenge and mentor technical work rather than operating solely as a people or commercial leader.
  • Modelling & Measurement Breadth: Strong experience across a range of methods relevant to marketing and media, such as econometrics/MMM, attribution, propensity and classification models, forecasting, optimisation, experimentation, model validation and scenario planning.
  • Programming & Data Fluency: Strong proficiency in Python, R and/or SQL, with a practical understanding of reproducible analytical workflows, data pipelines, APIs, cloud data environments, version control, model QA and deployment.
  • Product & Solution Leadership: Demonstrated ability to turn technical methodologies into repeatable products or services, manage an existing solution portfolio, establish technical standards and prioritise a roadmap of enhancements and new capabilities.

  • Stakeholder & Communication Skills: Ability to act as a trusted technical partner to senior business, client and DTA stakeholders, translating complex concepts into clear choices, implications and commercial value.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner (Recruitment) · Freelance (3 Months) · Remote-First
descriptionHtml:
About Kyra

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

Talent Acquisition Specialist
(3-Month Freelance Contract, Remote-First)

Internal Recruitment | Kyra | Remote-First

Availability: Immediate start required.

Contract: Initial 3-month freelance engagement, with potential to extend or become permanent.

Location: Remote-first. If you're near London, we'd love to meet in person during onboarding to help you get up to speed, but there's no expectation to do so.

Day rate: We're flexible depending on experience and welcome proposals that reflect what you bring. Please share your preferred day rate and currency in the application form.

👋 The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced in-house recruiter to help us find the people who'll shape what's next for Kyra.

We've got ambitious plans, challenging roles to fill and priority hiring projects supporting our key client accounts.

The challenge isn't always finding candidates. It's knowing exactly who to look for.

We need someone who can get under the bonnet of a team's challenges, work out which skills will make the biggest difference and find people we wouldn't otherwise meet.

Then help us test for those skills, make good hiring decisions and build relationships that last beyond a single vacancy.

The goal? Better hires, faster searches and a talent network that gets stronger with every assignment.

You'll have ownership of your projects, room to experiment and my support to get up to speed.

🏃 Can You Keep PACE?

Four qualities I look for in a recruiter.

P: People Person

You're a natural relationship builder. You connect easily with people from different backgrounds, listen carefully and have a knack for putting people at ease.

You remember the details, nurture relationships and genuinely enjoy getting to know people.

A: Adaptable

Different personalities, markets, hiring managers and priorities. You read situations well, welcome feedback and know when to change approach.

C: Curious & Up for a Challenge

You're fascinated by what makes people brilliant at their jobs.

You ask questions others miss, enjoy learning about unfamiliar subjects and recognise skills that aren't always obvious from a CV.

E: Effective at Pace

You have at least three years' recruitment experience in a startup, scaleup or similarly fast-paced, high-volume hiring environment.

You're a confident headhunter who knows how to manage multiple searches, prioritise competing demands and keep things moving without cutting corners.

Bonus points for experience recruiting across Europe and the US, particularly in creative, marketing, technology or growing businesses.

We also value excellent writing, commercial awareness, confidence with recruitment data and ATS tools, and an appetite for experimenting with AI.

🔎 What You'll Deliver

You'll take responsibility for a defined portfolio of priority hiring assignments.

  • Understand the problem: Get to the heart of what each team needs and identify the skills that matter.

  • Find the people: Headhunt, research talent markets and tap into networks to reach candidates others might miss.

  • Test for skills: Help hiring managers look beyond CVs and assess what candidates can actually do.

  • Follow through: Keep candidates informed, manage interviews and feedback, and maintain relationships beyond the immediate vacancy.

  • Build the network: Make every search count. The people you meet today could be tomorrow's best hires.

  • Keep improving: Use data, maintain accurate ATS records, follow hiring requirements and experiment with AI to improve how we work.

🎯 The First Three Months

Understand the bar. Find the talent. Build momentum.

You'll take ownership of priority searches and work closely with hiring managers across the business.

We already have some brilliant creative and innovative people. Your challenge is to help us find more.

Three things matter:

  • Quality of hire: Understand what separates good from great, challenge assumptions and build shortlists of candidates who genuinely meet the bar.

  • Speed of hire: Deliver against agreed timelines without compromising quality.

  • Talent network: Build relationships and pipelines that give us a head start on future searches.

title: Talent Development Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely

Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.

Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.

Job Summary

The Talent Development Specialist is a hands-on operator building the learning experience for an AI-first organization. You’ll design and build learning that people actually use, manage the platform’s daily execution, and run compliance campaigns at scale. You’ll partner with leadership and the AI transformation team to translate how Snyk works into learning that sticks. This is a mix of designing, building, running, and improving—skills you’ll develop across each dimension. You’ll identify where AI workflows remove friction from L&D and People Ops, and you’ll ship them. You’re helping people develop the capabilities they need to thrive as AI reshapes how we build, collaborate, and secure software. This role sits at the intersection of planning and execution, learning and operations, where you own impact from build to outcome.

What You’ll Do:

  • Help draft and deliver the H1 2027 content strategy for SnykU, our learning platform, building engaging learning that people want to use, in an AI-first organisation.

  • Design and build learning assets and hub pages, using AI tools.

  • Build on our HelloSnyk onboarding with product and role-based learning.

  • Run compliance learning campaigns with Security, GRC and Legal (annual cycles, campaign comms, completion tracking), making them easier to complete and report on.

  • Help run SnykU day to day: supporting content creators and working with IT and People Tech on integrations and data.

  • Support the launch of our new career pathways and year-end review enablement.

  • Where time allows, find and build AI workflows that take manual work out of L&D and People Ops.

What you’ll bring:

  • L&D Design Chops: You’ve built learning experiences from the ground up—instructional design, SCORM, authoring tools, the whole stack. Your portfolio shows work that actually landed, not just pretty decks.

  • LMS Operator: You know your way around an LMS admin panel—enrollments, reporting, data, the parts that actually make learning happen. You can troubleshoot without Googling.

  • Cross-Functional Project Leader: You’ve shipped multiple projects and campaigns on deadline while navigating stakeholders who aren’t in L&D. You speak their language and get things done.

  • AI-First Thinker: You’re not waiting to adopt AI—you’re already using it in your work. Claude, ChatGPT, automation tools—you experiment, you iterate, you see where it saves time.

  • Process Fixer: You spot gaps before they become problems. Detail-oriented, yes. But more than that—you fix things proactively, and people trust your deadlines.

  • Clear Communicator: You write in a way non-L&D people actually understand. You can explain a learning strategy to an engineer or a compliance requirement to a CEO.

  • Growth-Minded: You see this role as a place to learn—the product, the org, new technical skills. You’re self-directed. You don’t wait for permission to level up.

About Snyk

Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.

title: Teamleiter Elektrotechnik (m/w/d) | Industrie, Instandhaltung & Arbeitsvorbereitung
descriptionHtml:
Du kommst aus der Elektrotechnik, kennst industrielle Instandhaltung nicht nur aus der Theorie und möchtest fachlich wie organisatorisch mehr Verantwortung übernehmen?

Dann könnte diese Position genau der nächste saubere Schritt sein.

Für ein etabliertes Industrieunternehmen im chemischen Raffinerieumfeld in Hamburg suchen wir einen Teamleiter Elektrotechnik (m/w/d), der tägliche Instandhaltungsarbeiten plant, koordiniert und überwacht – nah an der Technik, nah am Team und nah am Betrieb.

Hier geht es nicht um reine Schreibtischverwaltung. Hier geht es um Elektrotechnik, Verlässlichkeit, Sicherheit und ein Team, das eine klare Führung braucht.

Aufgaben

In deiner neuen Rolle übernimmst du die fachliche Verantwortung für die elektrotechnische Instandhaltung im laufenden Betrieb.

Du planst, steuerst und überwachst die täglichen Instandhaltungsarbeiten im Bereich Elektrotechnik und sorgst dafür, dass Aufträge technisch sauber, termingerecht und zuverlässig abgewickelt werden.

Außerdem gehören zu deinen Aufgaben:

  • Planung, Koordination und Überwachung elektrotechnischer Instandhaltungsarbeiten

  • Sicherstellung der termingerechten und fachgerechten

  • Ausführung von Aufträgen

  • Abstimmung technischer Voraussetzungen und Abläufe im Tagesgeschäft

  • Planung und Umsetzung von Sonderprojekten, z. B. im Rahmen von Stillständen

  • Steuerung und Einteilung deines Teams

  • Verantwortung für Qualität, Arbeitssicherheit, Gesundheits- und Umweltschutz

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit angrenzenden Fachbereichen im industriellen Umfeld

  • Mitarbeit an einer stabilen, sauberen und vorausschauenden Arbeitsvorbereitung

Qualifikation

Du musst nicht seit 20 Jahren Führungskraft sein. Wichtiger ist, dass du Elektrotechnik wirklich verstehst, Verantwortung übernehmen willst und im industriellen Umfeld klar und verbindlich auftreten kannst.

Wichtig ist uns:

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, z. B. als Elektroniker, Elektriker, Mechatroniker oder vergleichbar

  • Weiterbildung zum Meister oder Techniker im Bereich Elektrotechnik

  • Erste bis mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung industrieller Anlagen

  • Erfahrung in Planung, Arbeitsvorbereitung oder Koordination technischer Arbeiten

  • Grundverständnis für Sicherheitsvorschriften, technische Normen und saubere Dokumentation

  • Freude daran, ein Team fachlich zu führen und weiterzuentwickeln

  • Strukturierte, verbindliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Teamfähigkeit, Bodenhaftung und ein klarer Blick für das, was im Betrieb wirklich zählt

Ideal ist, wenn du bereits erste Führungserfahrung gesammelt hast. Entscheidend ist aber vor allem: Du möchtest den nächsten Schritt gehen und bringst das fachliche Fundament dafür mit.

Benefits

Dich erwartet eine langfristige Perspektive in einem stabilen industriellen Umfeld mit guter Struktur, klaren Aufgaben und einem attraktiven Gesamtpaket.

Dazu gehören unter anderem:

  • Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit

  • Attraktives Gehaltspaket im Bereich ca. 65.000–70.000 € p. a.

  • Regelmäßige tarifliche Gehaltserhöhungen

  • Geregelte Arbeitszeiten mit Überstundenausgleich

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Gleitzeitkonto

  • Freitags früher Start ins Wochenende möglich

  • Individuelle Weiterbildungsangebote, E-Learning und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Shuttle-Service bis zum Werkseingang

  • Hochwertige Arbeitskleidung und persönliche Schutzausrüstung

  • Unterstützung bei betrieblicher Altersvorsorge

  • Corporate Benefits und weitere Vergünstigungen
    Arbeitgeberzuschuss für Kantine bzw. Verpflegung

  • Gesundheitsangebote wie Rückenschule, Yoga oder Massagen

  • Sonderurlaubstage für besondere Lebensereignisse

Diese Position ist spannend für Menschen, die aus der Elektrotechnik kommen und mehr wollen als „nur mitlaufen“.

Du bekommst hier Verantwortung, aber keinen Elfenbeinturm. Du bist nah an der Anlage, nah an den Menschen und nah an den Entscheidungen. Genau dort, wo Technik nicht in PowerPoint-Folien lebt, sondern morgens funktionieren muss.

Wenn du Meister oder Techniker bist, industrielle Instandhaltung kennst und Lust hast, ein Team fachlich zu führen, dann ist das hier kein schlechter nächster Schritt. Eher ein ziemlich guter.

Und keine Sorge: Du musst nicht alles schon perfekt können. Wenn das fachliche Fundament stimmt, die Haltung passt und du bereit bist, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, sprechen wir sehr gerne mit dir.

  • Nachweisbarer Track Record: Du hast selbst überdurchschnittlich verkauft und Teams messbar zur Zielerreichung geführt.

title: Technical Product Manager - AI Finance App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

Doit is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX - and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation

What We're Looking For

  • Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation - solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement - hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have - engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Technology Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
About the role

We are looking for a Technology Marketing Manager to turn Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and long-term vision into compelling stories for engineers and executives.

This role sits at the intersection of product, engineering, marketing, and go-to-market.

You will develop a deep understanding of Neural Concept’s technology and work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams to create and continuously improve how our platform is explained to enterprise audiences.

Your work will directly shape how global enterprises perceive Neural Concept: not as a point solution, but as an intelligence layer that brings AI into engineering workflows, helping Global 2000 engineering leaders design better products faster.

This is a high-impact role with significant autonomy, offering the opportunity to take ownership of complex topics, shape Neural Concept’s technical and market narrative, and potentially grow into leading a product marketing team as the company scales.

What you will do

Technology & Product Narrative

  • Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of Neural Concept’s platform, technology, and roadmap.

  • Act as a primary internal reference for market-facing technology and product narratives.

  • Turn complex technical concepts into clear explanations, examples, and value stories for engineering and executive audiences.

  • Work closely with leadership and Product to ensure alignment between vision, roadmap, and market messaging.

Messaging & Positioning Framework

  • Structure and maintain the core messaging framework in collaboration with leadership and Sales Enablement.

  • Define how Neural Concept’s technology is positioned across personas, industries, and use cases.

  • Ensure consistency and clarity across all market-facing materials (website, flagship assets, campaigns).

  • Clearly articulate technical differentiation and competitive positioning in a factual, grounded way.

Content Strategy & Creation

  • Own and produce technology- and product-driven content across flagship assets (hero blogs, whitepapers, product pages, decks).

  • Translate ongoing technical innovation into concrete, high-quality content that can be used externally by customers, partners, and sales teams.

  • Partner with the Design team to shape and produce high-quality product and technology content, including diagrams, visual explanations, demos and videos.

Go-to-Market Foundations (in collaboration)

  • Produce use-case content, value stories, and messaging inputs that Sales Enablement and Marketing actively use in customer conversations and campaigns.

  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement to ensure product and technology narratives are translated into clear, consistent sales messaging.

  • Support entry into new industries or use cases by clarifying positioning and value stories, without owning sales strategy or execution.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Applied Engineering, Sales Enablement, Marketing, and Leadership.

  • Act as a bridge between technical teams and market-facing functions.

  • Contribute to strategic discussions on positioning, category evolution, and long-term narrative.

Who you are

Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in technology marketing, technical product marketing, or market-facing technical roles within B2B or deep-tech companies.

  • You combine technical depth with a strong sense for marketing and storytelling, whether you built it in a marketing role or on the technical side.

  • Demonstrated ability to deeply understand complex technology platforms and systems, and reason about how they create value in real-world engineering workflows.

  • Engineering background (e.g., mechanical, aerospace, or computational engineering) or hands-on familiarity with CAD, CAE, or simulation tools is a strong plus.

  • Experience working closely with product and engineering teams to translate technical capabilities, constraints, and trade-offs into clear market positioning.

  • Proven ability to structure and maintain coherent messaging and positioning frameworks grounded in technical reality.

  • Track record of producing substantial, high-quality marketing content for complex technical products.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt the message to very different audiences, from engineers and technical experts to executives, decision-makers, and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfortable engaging in technical discussions and asking the right questions to build accurate, credible market narratives.

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken.

Ways of working

  • Able to drive complex topics from exploration to execution.

  • Able to operate with a high degree of autonomy while staying closely aligned with leadership and peers.

  • Execution-oriented, pragmatic, and hands-on.

  • Open, direct, and collaborative in working across functions.

  • Energized by a fast-paced, ever-changing environment. You adapt quickly, stay ahead of change, and are willing to challenge your own choices and iterate on them.

  • Genuine passion for technology, engineering, innovation, and AI. You naturally follow what’s happening in the field, enjoy exploring how new technologies change the way products are designed, and have a strong appetite for learning and continuous improvement.

  • Proactive and eager to step in beyond the core scope when projects call for it, contributing to product-related communications such as events, press releases, website updates, or newsletters.

What you get

  • Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

  • Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

  • Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

  • Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

title: Technology Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

We're looking for a commercially sharp, tenacious operator who is exceptional at building relationships to further accelerate our Technology Partnerships motion. This role is based in London.

You'll build, operationalise and deepen our critical external relationships and help turn technology partnerships into a repeatable, scalable source of revenue. We've seen early success with partner-led growth — and are now scaling this into a core growth engine.

What You Can Expect

This role is highly execution-oriented, with direct ownership over Omnea's technology partnerships motion:

  • You'll build new technology partner relationships — defining your priorities based on customer & prospect needs, finding creative ways in, and articulating the mutual benefits

  • You'll operationalise our existing technology partnerships — managing the relationship day-to-day, developing joint go-to-market motions with partners serving the same businesses, and ensuring partners see consistent value from working with Omnea

  • You'll organise community building events for the technology ecosystem

  • You'll be accountable for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, helping unlock new opportunities and improve win rates across deals

  • You'll work hands-on with the Sales team on live deals and work with partners to build unfair advantages to drive joint wins, then codifying what works into repeatable playbooks

  • You'll build trusted relationships with technology partners — keeping their sales teams in lockstep with ours and equipped to confidently recommend Omnea to their clients

  • You'll build that same trust internally — giving our Sales and Customer Success teams the understanding and the incentive to recommend our technology partners to their customers and prospects, so the value flows both ways

About you

  • You have 4–6+ years of experience in fast-moving, high-performance environments

  • You have commercial experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up in a quota-carrier, account management or partnerships role

  • You've got a track record of exceptional performance, whether it's in academia, work, sport, or whatever else you've put your mind to

  • You're deeply commercial and outcome-oriented, able to move between relationship management and execution to drive measurable impact

  • You have the communication skills and polish to work confidently with a variety of stakeholders internally and across technology partners

  • You're intellectually sharp and able to quickly understand complex products, simplifying problems into clear next steps, deal strategy, or product feedback

  • You're ambitious and competitive, thrive on responsibility, and are motivated by building something meaningful in a high-ownership environment

  • You perform best in environments that demand speed, accountability, and autonomy, and you care deeply about building something that lasts

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Territory Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Team & About Role

Rubrik helps organisations in every major industry stay resilient against cyberattacks, insider threats and operational disruption, protecting the data that hospitals, banks and public institutions depend on every day. As Territory Account Executive in Germany, you’ll build business in one of Europe’s strongest industrial and financial regions, with large Enterprise companies and ambitious Mittelstand firms on your doorstep. You’ll join a close-knit German team that shares deal strategy openly, backed by regional marketing, events and partner support to help you open doors.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a territory of accounts and decide where your time creates the most value.
  • Tier your list and create the entry points that turn them into real opportunities.
  • Generate your own pipeline through outbound, LinkedIn, local events and partners, so that first conversations become qualified deals that protect customers against cyber risk.
  • Make the most of Rubrik’s regional marketing, events and partner activity by following up quickly on the interest it creates in your territory.
  • Run multi-stakeholder sales cycles end to end with MEDDPICC: find the budget owner, build champions and position Rubrik against the full scope of customer risk.
  • Work with Solutions Engineers, Channel Development and partners to extend your reach, and meet customers in person to build lasting relationships.
  • Learn from experienced colleagues through structured enablement and hands-on mentoring, and share what works with the German team in pipeline reviews and deal strategy sessions.
  • Feed local market insight and competitive signals back to Rubrik’s leadership to shape how we go to market in Germany.

Experience You’ll Need

  • A track record of winning new business in B2B enterprise software or SaaS, with consistent quota attainment and self-generated pipeline.
  • Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and engaging technical, security and executive buyers.
  • Fluent German and professional English.
  • A structured approach to qualification and pipeline management, with MEDDPICC or a comparable framework.
  • Based in or near a major German city with convenient transport links, with willingness to travel regularly across your territory.
  • A learning mindset: you seek feedback, adapt quickly and want to keep growing with the support of a hands-on manager.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in cybersecurity, data protection, backup/recovery or adjacent infrastructure and cloud categories. It’s not a must, since we’ll teach you the rest.
  • Experience selling with channel partners.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce for pipeline management and forecasting.

#LI-CH2 #LI-remote

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. descriptionHtml:
Build a business inside a fast-growing company. French salary, Algerian life.

Meet the founder: watch this 60-second video

 

About The Flex

 

Our mission: make renting an apartment as easy as buying something on Amazon.

Renting a place to stay is still slow, stressful and full of surprises. We're fixing that. With The Flex you pick your apartment, book in a few clicks and move in. Everything is handled for you: hotel-level service with the comfort of a real home.

  • Started with one apartment in London. Today we run around 1,000 rooms.

  • 7 cities, 5 countries: London, Paris, Berlin, Lisbon, Algiers, Oran and Constantine.

  • First mover in Algeria. We were the first short-term rental company in the country, and we're now the market leader.

  • Bootstrapped. No outside funding. On average, revenue grows 30% month on month.

  • Powered by AI. Everything runs on Base360.ai, the AI operating system we built in-house. It handles pricing, guest messaging, operations and bookings on autopilot.

  • Built for the diaspora. In Algeria, The Flex is becoming the go-to platform for Algerians abroad coming home.

 

The role

 

You want to be a founder. This is the fastest way to learn. You'll take a new business line in Algeria from idea to revenue, with our money, our brand and our tech behind you. Perform well and you can lead that business, or the whole country.

 

What you'll do

 

  • Find, test and launch new opportunities for The Flex in Algeria.

  • Build the plan, the team and the partners.

  • Own the numbers: revenue, costs, growth.

  • Report directly to the founder.

 

What you get

 

  • A French-level salary, paid while you live in Algeria.

  • Accommodation provided by The Flex.

  • A clear path to lead a business line, or the country.

  • Real responsibility from week one.

  • Provide constructive feedback and coaching to support competence development and operational proficiency.

  • Maintain accurate training records and certification documentation where required.

  • Use your operational experience to effectively communicate real-world use cases and mission benefits.

  • Present confidently to audiences ranging from end users and operators to senior military officers, procurement officials, and government decision-makers.

  • Proven experience delivering training to defence, security, public safety, or government organisations.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

    Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.

title: VP, Strategic Finance
descriptionHtml:
Team: Finance (G&A)

Reports to: Chief Financial Officer

Location: London, Amsterdam or Stockholm. Remote-first, with travel as and when needed

About Nivoda

Nivoda is the B2B marketplace rebuilding how the jewellery industry works. We connect independent jewellery retailers with a global network of diamond and gemstone suppliers, so a jeweller in Denver or Devon can source from anywhere in the world without the cost, risk, and hassle of doing it the old way. We handle the logistics, the payments, and the quality checks, the messy middle that used to put global sourcing out of reach for small businesses.

Today we process over $300M in transactions a year in a $350B industry that still runs largely on personal relationships and paperwork. We are growing quickly, we are backed by leading investors, and we are only getting started.

We built Nivoda so every jeweller, whatever their size and wherever they are, has access to the same global supply, pricing and tools as the biggest players.

Why this role & why now

You will sit on the Extended Leadership Team, report to the CFO, and own how Nivoda plans, reports and is funded. You will present to the board, investors and our receivables lender yourself, work directly with the CFO on equity and debt financing, and build a finance function that runs on routine rather than heroics. This is for someone who wants to lead a team and shape the company’s financial story, not only model it.

What you will own

Planning and forecasting. You own the annual budget, quarterly reforecast and long-range plan, plus scenario and funding cases for the C-suite and board. You are accountable for forecast accuracy against agreed tolerances, and for an honest post-mortem whether we miss or overachieve.

Board, investor and lender reporting. You own the monthly board pack and the numbers behind it, plus materials for existing and prospective investors and our receivables lender, including covenant reporting and onsite diligence. You present to these audiences yourself and you are their first call for analytical questions. The aim is that they trust the numbers without the CFO needing to vouch for them.

Corporate finance. You build the models and documentation for equity and debt financing, analyse term sheets, work with the People team on cap table and option pool, and support the CFO on transactions.

Commercial and unit economics. You own cohort economics, customer lifetime value, geographic and segment profitability, and the return on marketing and sales spend. With the CRO’s organisation, you build quota and commission models so targets, incentives and the forecast point at the same numbers.

Business partnering. You partner with Product and Engineering, Fulfilment, Fintech and the commercial teams on build versus buy, hiring cases, pricing and fee experiments, and capital allocation. The function says yes, no or not yet, with a model behind it.

Leading the function. You lead the team: hiring, onboarding, objectives, development and performance, including written objectives and regular structured feedback for each person. You set the review standard and deliverables calendar, agree data contracts with the Data team, and own the tooling (Snowflake, NetSuite, ThoughtSpot, Claude and the modelling stack). We measure the function on on-time delivery, errors caught internally rather than by the audience, forecast accuracy, and how many people can produce each recurring deliverable.

What good looks like

First 90 days. You have taken over the monthly pack and the reforecast without the investors noticing a handover. You have met your leadership-team peers and told the CFO what you would change and in what order.

90 to 180 days. The monthly pack, FP&A-approved numbers and lender reporting land on the agreed date, each with a named owner and a written process. No board, lender or investor number has needed restating. The first version of the business line P&Ls is delivered at day 180.

Twelve months. The function delivers month-end and board commitments without you or the CFO stepping in, including when you are away. A team member has delivered a new analytical capability end to end. FP&A and the Data team work from one set of metric definitions. Board members, lenders and the leadership team rely on the numbers without asking the CFO to vouch for them.

The standard

A finance team has no quota. The thing it sells is trust, and trust is earned with accuracy a bar above the rest of the company and delivery on the date promised.

Three things must not fail in this role.

  • Timeliness: deadlines are commitments, not targets.

  • Quality: every external-facing number reconciles to a primary source and has been reviewed by someone other than its author before it leaves the team.

  • Capacity: within reason, not a constraint. The function absorbs the demands of a 450-person company by organising, prioritising and delegating. If capacity is a hard limit, you make the case for a hire or an automation with numbers, rather than letting the work slip.

That is a high bar, and it is fair because the role comes with the means to meet it: people to delegate to, authority over how the team's week is spent, a budget line, and the standing to say no to the business with the CFO's backing.

What you bring

  • A background in investment banking, FP&A or venture capital, building models that senior stakeholders made decisions on.

  • You have led a team, directly or through managers, and you want the management part of this role.

  • You have presented to boards, investors or lenders as the person answering the question, not the person who built the slide.

  • A working understanding of marketplace dynamics: two-sided liquidity, take rates, usage-based revenue without a contract, and what FX does to all of it. Complex cohort modelling is native to you.

  • You are comfortable in Snowflake and a modern BI tool, you treat AI tooling as part of the stack, and you would rather fix the pipeline than reformat the output every month.

  • You are calm under pressure, low on ego and allergic to spin. You tell people the uncomfortable thing early.

Useful but not required: receivables financing or lender reporting, a multi-jurisdiction group, NetSuite, or a business that trades physical goods across borders.

What this role is not

It is not a bigger version of a senior analyst role, and it is not where every difficult model gets built personally. If you are at your best as the smartest modeler in the room and would rather stay that way, this will frustrate you.

It is also not a quiet seat. Month-end, board and lender deadlines are fixed, a 450-person company makes a lot of demands on finance, and you will regularly be the one saying no, with the CFO’s backing. If you want a purely advisory or slower-paced role, this isn’t it.

What we offer

Nivoda is a place where smart, driven people do the best work of their careers. We move fast, give ownership early, and don’t have layers of bureaucracy slowing things down. If you see a problem, you can fix it.

Our current benefits include:

  • Flexible working hours and a vibrant, remote-first company culture

  • Unlimited holiday allowance

  • Participation in our equity programme

  • Genuine opportunities for growth: we promote from within and invest in your development

  • The chance to join during an expansion phase and shape how Nivoda operates at scale

Interview Process

  • Screening conversation with Talent Acquisition

  • Structured career-history interview with Hiring Manager

  • Focus interview: you present a case study to a panel from Finance and the leadership team

  • Final conversation with the C-suite

Equal opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.

If you meet most of this description and not all of it, apply anyway and tell us where the gaps are.

Please submit your CV in English.

Not the right role? Join our Talent Pool

If this isn’t quite the right fit but you’re excited about what Nivoda is building, we’d still love to hear from you. Join our Talent Pool and we’ll reach out when the right opportunity comes along.

Je komt in een klein team en wordt intensief begeleid. Er wordt nauw samengewerkt met o.a. het redactieteam en collega's van logistiek en planning. Daarnaast is er contact met diverse afdelingen. Het vertaalbureau levert per maand zo'n 40 producten af, waaronder nieuwsberichten, webpagina's, corporate artikelen, brieven en presentaties.

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een opleiding tot vertaler met als studierichting Engels, of hebt een bachelor in Engels en bent bezig met een master Vertaalkunde.
Je hebt kennis van en enige ervaring met:

  • vertaaltools (liefst MemoQ);

  • vakontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI;

  • Microsoft Word, Excel en Adobe Acrobat;

  • Sociale media (LinkedIn).

Ook volg je het nieuws en de achtergronden in de media.

In deze stage krijg je de ruimte om je nauwkeurigheid, communicatieve vaardigheden en initiatief te laten zien. Je werkt graag samen, houdt overzicht en kunt goed omgaan met verschillende taken en veranderingen. Je bent flexibel, georganiseerd en zorgt ervoor dat afspraken en deadlines worden nagekomen. Samenwerken en resultaatgericht werken staan daarbij centraal.

Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • leert om heldere vertalingen te maken die feitelijk en objectief zijn;

  • jouw Engelse (vertaal)vaardigheden verbetert en werkervaring met vertaaltools opdoet;

  • ervaart hoe het is om in teamverband te werken en om te gaan met deadlines.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.
